import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Gavel, Clock, ArrowUpRight, Check, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { animalImages } from '../assets/images';

interface AuctionsSectionProps {
  onJoinWaitlist: () => void;
}

export const AuctionsSection: React.FC<AuctionsSectionProps> = ({ onJoinWaitlist }) => {
  // Live ticking countdown state
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState({
    hours: 14,
    minutes: 36,
    seconds: 42,
  });

  const [currentBid, setCurrentBid] = useState(48500);
  const [bidCount, setBidCount] = useState(27);
  const [simulatedBidInput, setSimulatedBidInput] = useState(49000);
  const [bidFeedback, setBidFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeLeft((prev) => {
        if (prev.seconds > 0) {
          return { ...prev, seconds: prev.seconds - 1 };
        }
        if (prev.minutes > 0) {
          return { ...prev, minutes: 59, seconds: 59 };
        }
        if (prev.hours > 0) {
          return { hours: prev.hours - 1, minutes: 59, seconds: 59 };
        }
        return prev;
      });
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const handlePlaceBid = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (simulatedBidInput <= currentBid) {
      setBidFeedback(`Bid must be higher than current valuation (${currentBid.toLocaleString()} Credits).`);
      return;
    }
    setCurrentBid(simulatedBidInput);
    setBidCount((prev) => prev + 1);
    setBidFeedback(`Sandbox bid of ${simulatedBidInput.toLocaleString()} Credits placed successfully!`);
    setSimulatedBidInput(simulatedBidInput + 500);
  };

  const auctionSteps = [
    {
      step: '01',
      title: 'Eligible Beast Listed',
      desc: 'Owner sets reserve pricing and chooses weekly auction slot duration.',
    },
    {
      step: '02',
      title: 'Live Player Bidding',
      desc: 'Verified participants place competitive bids backed by in-app credits.',
    },
    {
      step: '03',
      title: 'Final Hammer Close',
      desc: 'The highest valid bid secures the animal when the auction timer expires.',
    },
    {
      step: '04',
      title: 'Smart Settlement',
      desc: 'Ownership transfers immediately to the winning bidder’s stable registry.',
    },
    {
      step: '05',
      title: 'Credit Distribution',
      desc: 'Seller receives settled in-app credits minus standard arena exchange fee.',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <section id="auctions" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0F1015] py-20 lg:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Heading */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
            <span>Player Marketplace Economy</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-neutral-600">·</span>
            <span className="text-neutral-400">Weekly Scheduled Events</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
            YOUR ANIMAL. YOUR VALUE. YOUR NEXT MOVE.
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-400">
            A vibrant decentralized animal exchange. Weekly high-profile auctions allow players to monetize developed champions and acquire rare genetic lines through transparent credit bidding.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* 5-Step Auction Flow Strip */}
        <div className="mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4">
          {auctionSteps.map((st) => (
            <div key={st.step} className="border border-white/10 bg-[#14161E] p-5">
              <span className="font-display text-2xl font-black text-[#CCFF00]">
                {st.step}
              </span>
              <h4 className="mt-2 font-display text-lg font-bold uppercase text-white">
                {st.title}
              </h4>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                {st.desc}
              </p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* Live Feature Showcase Card */}
        <div className="mt-12 border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-10 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center">
            {/* Beast Auction Image */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 relative">
              <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden bg-black border border-white/10">
                <img
                  src={animalImages.africanLion}
                  alt="African Lion Sultan on auction"
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#12141A] via-transparent to-black/30" />

                {/* Live Hammer Tag */}
                <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-3 py-1 font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Gavel className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Marquee Lot #082</span>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4">
                  <span className="text-xs uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] block">
                    Panthera leo · Apex Tier
                  </span>
                  <div className="font-display text-3xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                    Sultan · Level 16 Male Lion
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Live Auction Terminal Panel */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
              {/* Top Countdown */}
              <div className="border border-white/10 bg-[#161822] p-5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 block flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Clock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                    <span>Auction Closing Countdown</span>
                  </span>
                  <div className="mt-1 font-mono text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-white tracking-widest">
                    {String(timeLeft.hours).padStart(2, '0')}h : {String(timeLeft.minutes).padStart(2, '0')}m : {String(timeLeft.seconds).padStart(2, '0')}s
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Total Activity</span>
                  <span className="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
                    {bidCount} Active Bids
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Current High Bid Box */}
              <div className="border border-white/10 bg-black/40 p-5">
                <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 uppercase block tracking-wider">
                  Highest Valid Standing Bid
                </span>
                <div className="mt-1 flex items-baseline gap-2">
                  <span className="font-display text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-black text-white">
                    {currentBid.toLocaleString()}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase">In-App Credits</span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-neutral-300">
                  Leading bidder: <span className="text-white font-mono font-semibold">Valeria_Khan (#7721)</span> · Bid verified by consensus
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Sandbox Bid Form */}
              <div>
                <form onSubmit={handlePlaceBid} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    value={simulatedBidInput}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimulatedBidInput(Number(e.target.value))}
                    step={100}
                    min={currentBid + 100}
                    className="flex-1 bg-black/60 border border-white/15 px-4 py-3 font-mono text-white text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00]"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black px-6 py-3 font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Place Demo Bid
                  </button>
                </form>

                {bidFeedback && (
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-[#CCFF00] flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                    <span>{bidFeedback}</span>
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Sandbox Disclaimer */}
              <div className="pt-2 text-[11px] text-neutral-400 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>*Illustrative demonstration using in-game test credits. No real currency transactions.</span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={onJoinWaitlist}
                  className="text-xs text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider"
                >
                  Join Waitlist For Access →
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Swords, Trophy, Play, RotateCcw, Shield, Activity, Flame } from 'lucide-react';
import { animalImages } from '../assets/images';

interface CombatLogEntry {
  round: number;
  attacker: string;
  action: string;
  damage: number;
  status: string;
}

export const BattleArena: React.FC = () => {
  const [matchState, setMatchState] = useState<'idle' | 'fighting' | 'finished'>('idle');
  const [p1Hp, setP1Hp] = useState<number>(100);
  const [p2Hp, setP2Hp] = useState<number>(100);
  const [currentRound, setCurrentRound] = useState<number>(0);
  const [winner, setWinner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [combatLogs, setCombatLogs] = useState<CombatLogEntry[]>([
    {
      round: 0,
      attacker: 'Arena Referee',
      action: 'Both beasts locked in starter inspection cages. Awaiting bout signal.',
      damage: 0,
      status: 'Match Initialized',
    },
  ]);

  const runSimulation = () => {
    setMatchState('fighting');
    setP1Hp(100);
    setP2Hp(100);
    setWinner(null);

    const simulationRounds: CombatLogEntry[] = [
      {
        round: 1,
        attacker: 'Kaiser (Nirn)',
        action: 'Explosive lateral leap and high collar clamp.',
        damage: 28,
        status: 'Tactical Strike Landed',
      },
      {
        round: 1,
        attacker: 'Vulkan (Alex)',
        action: 'Low brute shoulder charge and chest shockwave tackle.',
        damage: 22,
        status: 'Counter Shockwave',
      },
      {
        round: 2,
        attacker: 'Vulkan (Alex)',
        action: 'Jaw lock clamp on front defensive paw sleeve.',
        damage: 34,
        status: 'Heavy Grapple',
      },
      {
        round: 2,
        attacker: 'Kaiser (Nirn)',
        action: 'Tactical Counter-Lock reversal into neck pin.',
        damage: 42,
        status: 'Critical Reversal',
      },
      {
        round: 3,
        attacker: 'Kaiser (Nirn)',
        action: 'Decisive stamina exhaustion rush and arena perimeter takedown.',
        damage: 36,
        status: 'Knockout Finisher',
      },
    ];

    let step = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      if (step < simulationRounds.length) {
        const roundData = simulationRounds[step];
        setCombatLogs((prev) => [roundData, ...prev]);
        setCurrentRound(roundData.round);

        if (roundData.attacker.includes('Nirn')) {
          setP2Hp((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - roundData.damage));
        } else {
          setP1Hp((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - roundData.damage));
        }

        step++;
      } else {
        clearInterval(interval);
        setMatchState('finished');
        setWinner('PLAYER 01: NIRN (Kaiser)');
      }
    }, 900);
  };

  const resetMatch = () => {
    setMatchState('idle');
    setP1Hp(100);
    setP2Hp(100);
    setCurrentRound(0);
    setWinner(null);
    setCombatLogs([
      {
        round: 0,
        attacker: 'Arena Referee',
        action: 'Both beasts locked in starter inspection cages. Awaiting bout signal.',
        damage: 0,
        status: 'Match Initialized',
      },
    ]);
  };

  return (
    <section id="arena" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0C10] py-20 lg:py-28 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Background Esports Stadium Ambience */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/4 -translate-y-1/2 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-[#CCFF00]/5 blur-[150px]" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 right-1/4 -translate-y-1/2 w-[500px] h-[500px] bg-[#FF5500]/5 blur-[150px]" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Heading */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
            <span>Esports Bout Simulation</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-neutral-600">·</span>
            <span className="text-neutral-400">Illustrative Showcase</span>
          </div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
            IT'S NOT JUST ABOUT WHAT YOU OWN.{' '}
            <span className="text-[#CCFF00] block">IT'S ABOUT HOW YOU FIGHT.</span>
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-400">
            Raw stats set the threshold, but strategic positioning, endurance conditioning, and timing command the ring. Battles reward tactical mastery, not superficial rarity.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Esports Arena Main Clashing Board */}
        <div className="mt-12 border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-8 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Top Arena Header Bar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-4 gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Swords className="h-5 w-5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span className="font-display text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Main Card Bout · Tier I Championship Circuit
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              {matchState === 'finished' ? (
                <button
                  onClick={resetMatch}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white border border-white/15 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Reset Match</span>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={runSimulation}
                  disabled={matchState === 'fighting'}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] disabled:opacity-50 text-black px-5 py-2 text-xs font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)]"
                >
                  <Play className="h-3.5 w-3.5 fill-black" />
                  <span>{matchState === 'fighting' ? 'Simulating Bout...' : 'Simulate Arena Clash'}</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Versus Split Matrix */}
          <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center">
            {/* Fighter 1: Nirn / German Shepherd */}
            <div className={`lg:col-span-5 border transition-all duration-300 ${winner?.includes('Nirn') ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#14181F] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.15)]' : 'border-white/10 bg-[#14161E]'}`}>
              {/* Photo Frame */}
              <div className="relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden bg-black">
                <img
                  src={animalImages.germanShepherd}
                  alt="German Shepherd Kaiser"
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#14161E] via-transparent to-black/40" />

                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-black/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00] border border-white/10">
                  PLAYER 01
                </div>

                {winner?.includes('Nirn') && (
                  <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-3 py-1 font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg">
                    VICTORIOUS
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3">
                  <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Trainer: NIRN</span>
                  <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                    Kaiser · German Shepherd
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Fighter 1 Stats & Health */}
              <div className="p-6">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1 font-mono">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Conditioning Stamina (HP)</span>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold">{p1Hp}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-2.5 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/10">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-[#CCFF00] transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                        style={{ width: `${p1Hp}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2 text-center text-xs">
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Level</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">12</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Strength</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">85</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Endurance</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">90</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Center VS Indicator */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-4">
              <div className="flex h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-none border border-white/20 bg-black/80 font-display text-2xl font-black text-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.2)]">
                VS
              </div>
              <div className="mt-3 text-center">
                <span className="text-xs font-mono uppercase text-neutral-400 block">Round {currentRound || 'Ready'}</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300">Sanctioned Ring</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Fighter 2: Alex / Rottweiler */}
            <div className={`lg:col-span-5 border transition-all duration-300 ${winner?.includes('Alex') ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#14181F] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.15)]' : 'border-white/10 bg-[#14161E]'}`}>
              {/* Photo Frame */}
              <div className="relative aspect-[16/10] overflow-hidden bg-black">
                <img
                  src={animalImages.rottweiler}
                  alt="Rottweiler Vulkan"
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#14161E] via-transparent to-black/40" />

                <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 bg-black/80 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#FF5500] border border-white/10">
                  PLAYER 02
                </div>

                {winner?.includes('Alex') && (
                  <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-3 py-1 font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg">
                    VICTORIOUS
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3">
                  <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Trainer: ALEX</span>
                  <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                    Vulkan · Rottweiler
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Fighter 2 Stats & Health */}
              <div className="p-6">
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1 font-mono">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Conditioning Stamina (HP)</span>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold">{p2Hp}%</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-2.5 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/10">
                      <div
                        className="h-full bg-[#FF5500] transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                        style={{ width: `${p2Hp}%` }}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2 text-center text-xs">
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Level</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">10</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Strength</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">79</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Endurance</span>
                      <span className="font-mono font-bold text-white text-sm">86</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Combat Telemetry Feed */}
          <div className="mt-8 border-t border-white/10 pt-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 text-xs">
              <span className="font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                Live Bout Action Logs
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-neutral-300">
                {matchState === 'finished' ? 'Combat Completed' : matchState === 'fighting' ? 'Round Processing...' : 'Standby'}
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2 max-h-40 overflow-y-auto bg-black/50 p-4 border border-white/5 font-mono text-xs">
              {combatLogs.map((log, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5 last:border-0 last:pb-0">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold mr-2">
                      {log.round > 0 ? `[RND ${log.round}]` : '[INIT]'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-white font-medium mr-2">{log.attacker}:</span>
                    <span className="text-neutral-300">{log.action}</span>
                  </div>
                  {log.damage > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[#FF5500] font-bold shrink-0 ml-4">
                      -{log.damage} HP
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/diagnostic/SystemDiagnosticsModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Activity,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  Copy,
  ExternalLink,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Globe,
  Coins,
  Cpu,
  RefreshCw,
  X,
  Eye,
  Check,
  Terminal,
  Server,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { initClarity } from '../../utils/clarity';

interface SystemDiagnosticsModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface DiagnosticItem {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: 'ai' | 'payments' | 'analytics' | 'seo' | 'cloud';
  status: 'online' | 'sandbox' | 'warning' | 'pending';
  badgeText: string;
  details: string;
  metric?: string;
  link?: string;
}

export const SystemDiagnosticsModal: React.FC<SystemDiagnosticsModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [pingingAi, setPingingAi] = useState(false);
  const [aiPingResult, setAiPingResult] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Read environment variable presence safely
  const [clarityCustomId, setClarityCustomId] = useState<string>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_clarity_project_id') || (import.meta.env.VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID as string) || 'z4be9kfna6';
    } catch {
      return '';
    }
  });
  const [showClarityInput, setShowClarityInput] = useState(false);
  const [clarityInputValue, setClarityInputValue] = useState(clarityCustomId);
  const hasClarity = !!clarityCustomId;
  const clarityId = clarityCustomId;
  const maskedClarity = clarityId
    ? `${clarityId.slice(0, 3)}••••${clarityId.slice(-3)}`
    : 'Simulated Local Telemetry';

  const gscToken =
    (import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION as string) ||
    'j_EqV8f-3AEKu3a7vylHiJzMEXKiStUzD0RGf6vPCs4';
  const maskedGsc = `${gscToken.slice(0, 6)}••••${gscToken.slice(-4)}`;

  const isDodoConfigured =
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).DODO_SIMULATION === false) || false;

  const recentEvents: { event: string; time: string }[] =
    typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG
      ? (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG.slice(0, 6)
      : [];

  const diagnostics: DiagnosticItem[] = [
    {
      id: 'gemini',
      name: 'Google Gemini 2.5 Flash (@google/genai)',
      category: 'ai',
      status: 'online',
      badgeText: 'Active / 2.5 Flash',
      details: 'High-throughput procedural pet biomechanics, breed identification, and moveset compiler.',
      metric: aiPingResult || 'Latency: ~120ms',
    },
    {
      id: 'dodo',
      name: 'Dodo Payments Gateway',
      category: 'payments',
      status: 'sandbox',
      badgeText: 'Sandbox Ready (0-Friction)',
      details: 'Instant passes ($0.99 Studio, $1.99 Auction, $4.99 VIP). Webhooks at /api/dodo/webhook.',
      metric: 'Mode: Sandbox Testnet',
    },
    {
      id: 'clarity',
      name: 'Microsoft Clarity Behavior Telemetry',
      category: 'analytics',
      status: hasClarity ? 'online' : 'sandbox',
      badgeText: hasClarity ? 'Tracking Active' : 'Local Event Queue Active',
      details: 'Heatmaps, session replays, and custom combat event tracking.',
      metric: `ID: ${maskedClarity}`,
    },
    {
      id: 'domain',
      name: 'Custom Domain & Edge SSL',
      category: 'cloud',
      status: 'online',
      badgeText: 'petslam.app',
      details: 'Configured with CNAME apex mapping, HTTP/3, and Brotli compression.',
      metric: 'https://petslam.app/',
      link: 'https://petslam.app/',
    },
    {
      id: 'gsc',
      name: 'Google Search Console & SEO Suite',
      category: 'seo',
      status: 'online',
      badgeText: 'Verified & Indexed',
      details: 'Sitemap.xml, Robots.txt, and Schema.org WebApplication + VideoGame JSON-LD.',
      metric: `Verification: ${maskedGsc}`,
    },
    {
      id: 'cloudflare',
      name: 'Cloudflare Pages SPA Routing',
      category: 'cloud',
      status: 'online',
      badgeText: 'Edge Rewrite 200 OK',
      details: 'public/_redirects configured for seamless client-side single page navigation.',
      metric: '/* -> /index.html 200',
    },
  ];

  const handleTestAiPing = async () => {
    sound.playClick();
    setPingingAi(true);
    setAiPingResult('Pinging Gemini...');
    const startTime = performance.now();

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/pet/analyze-photo', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          imageBase64: 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mNk+A8AAQUBAScY42YAAAAASUVORK5CYII=',
          userGivenName: 'DiagnosticProbe',
        }),
      });
      const elapsed = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);
      if (res.ok) {
        setAiPingResult(`Latency: ${elapsed}ms (OK)`);
      } else {
        setAiPingResult(`Fallback OK (${elapsed}ms)`);
      }
    } catch {
      const elapsed = Math.round(performance.now() - startTime);
      setAiPingResult(`Local Fallback Engine (${elapsed}ms)`);
    } finally {
      setPingingAi(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCopyReport = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    const report = {
      project: 'PET SLAM 2.0',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      domain: 'https://petslam.app/',
      runtime: {
        userAgent: navigator.userAgent,
        screen: `${window.innerWidth}x${window.innerHeight}`,
        devicePixelRatio: window.devicePixelRatio,
      },
      diagnostics,
    };

    navigator.clipboard.writeText(JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2500);
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#090D16] border border-white/15 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] text-white font-sans">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#121929] via-[#0E1422] to-[#0A0D17] flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-[#CCFF00]/15 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)]">
              <Activity className="w-5 h-5 animate-pulse" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-sm sm:text-base font-display font-black tracking-wider uppercase text-white">
                  PET SLAM 2.0 Diagnostics & Integrations
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/40">
                  HEALTH: 100%
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                Live system architecture, cloud telemetry & production API status
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={handleCopyReport}
              className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-300 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer"
              title="Copy JSON Diagnostics Report"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-400">Copied!</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">Copy Report</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 rounded-xl text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Diagnostic Items Grid */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3">
          {/* Quick Hotkey Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 text-[11px] font-mono">
            <span className="text-neutral-400">
              Hotkey Shortcut: <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">Ctrl + Shift + D</span>
            </span>
            <span className="text-neutral-400">
              Target Host: <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">https://petslam.app/</span>
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Live Telemetry Events Feed */}
          {recentEvents.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                  <span>Real-Time In-Session Telemetry Events</span>
                </span>
                <span className="text-cyan-300">Last {recentEvents.length} Captured</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {recentEvents.map((ev, i) => (
                  <span
                    key={i}
                    className="text-[9px] font-mono bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-2 py-0.5 text-neutral-300"
                  >
                    <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{ev.event}</span>{' '}
                    <span className="text-neutral-500">({ev.time})</span>
                  </span>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {diagnostics.map((item) => (
              <div
                key={item.id}
                className="bg-[#0F1524] border border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all group"
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white group-hover:text-[#CCFF00] transition-colors truncate">
                      {item.name}
                    </span>
                    <span
                      className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shrink-0 border ${
                        item.status === 'online'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-400/40 text-emerald-300'
                          : item.status === 'sandbox'
                          ? 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-400/40 text-amber-300'
                          : 'bg-rose-500/15 border-rose-400/40 text-rose-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {item.badgeText}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed mb-3">
                    {item.details}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono">
                  <span className="text-neutral-300 font-bold">{item.metric}</span>
                  {item.id === 'clarity' && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowClarityInput((p) => !p)}
                      className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-500/15 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 border border-cyan-400/40 text-cyan-300 font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95"
                    >
                      <Zap className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-cyan-400" />
                      <span>{hasClarity ? 'Update ID' : 'Connect ID'}</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {item.id === 'gemini' && (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleTestAiPing}
                      disabled={pingingAi}
                      className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-[#CCFF00]/15 hover:bg-[#CCFF00]/30 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 text-[#CCFF00] font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-50"
                    >
                      <RefreshCw className={`w-2.5 h-2.5 ${pingingAi ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} />
                      <span>Ping Probe</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                  {item.link && (
                    <a
                      href={item.link}
                      target="_blank"
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline"
                    >
                      <span>Visit</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                    </a>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Microsoft Clarity Quick Connect Drawer */}
          {showClarityInput && (
            <div className="mt-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-950/40 border border-cyan-500/40 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex-1 w-full">
                <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-200 mb-1">
                  Enter Microsoft Clarity Project ID:
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={clarityInputValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setClarityInputValue(e.target.value.trim())}
                  placeholder="e.g. q1a2b3c4d5"
                  className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-cyan-500/40 focus:border-cyan-400 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-white font-mono outline-none"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0 pt-2 sm:pt-4">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    const trimmed = clarityInputValue.trim();
                    if (trimmed) {
                      try {
                        localStorage.setItem('petslam_clarity_project_id', trimmed);
                      } catch {}
                      setClarityCustomId(trimmed);
                      initClarity({ projectId: trimmed });
                      sound.playVictory();
                      setShowClarityInput(false);
                    }
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 sm:flex-initial py-1.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(6,182,212,0.4)]"
                >
                  Save & Connect
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowClarityInput(false)}
                  className="py-1.5 px-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-neutral-300 text-xs font-mono cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* DNS Checklist Quick Reference */}
          <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-white">
              <Server className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Cloudflare DNS Configuration Checklist for petslam.app:</span>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left font-mono text-[10px] border-collapse">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="border-b border-white/10 text-neutral-400">
                    <th className="py-1 px-2">Type</th>
                    <th className="py-1 px-2">Name</th>
                    <th className="py-1 px-2">Content / Target</th>
                    <th className="py-1 px-2">Proxy Status</th>
                    <th className="py-1 px-2">TTL</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5 text-neutral-300">
                  <tr>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-cyan-300 font-bold">CNAME</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">@ (root)</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-white">petslam.pages.dev</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-amber-300">Proxied (Orange Cloud)</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">Auto</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-cyan-300 font-bold">CNAME</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">www</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-white">petslam.app</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-amber-300">Proxied (Orange Cloud)</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">Auto</td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-purple-300 font-bold">TXT</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">@</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-white">google-site-verification=...</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2 text-neutral-500">DNS Only</td>
                    <td className="py-1.5 px-2">Auto</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#0B0F19] flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] animate-ping" />
            <span className="text-white font-bold">PET SLAM 2.0 Engine</span>
            <span>· All Shaders & Audio Modules Synced</span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black uppercase text-xs cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all shadow"
          >
            Close Diagnostics
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Mail, Check, Copy, Shield, Award, Zap, Send, ExternalLink, Terminal } from 'lucide-react';

interface EmailPreviewModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  email?: string;
  voucherId?: string;
  resendStatus?: { sent: boolean; message: string };
}

export const EmailPreviewModal: React.FC<EmailPreviewModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  email = 'applicant@example.com',
  voucherId = 'ps_genesis_alpha',
  resendStatus,
}) => {
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleCopyVoucher = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherId);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md overflow-y-auto">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] text-white shadow-2xl my-8">
        {/* Top Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 px-6 py-4 bg-[#14161E]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <Mail className="h-5 w-5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display text-lg font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Waitlist Confirmation Email Preview
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Official Genesis Alpha Welcome Dispatch
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white bg-white/5 border border-white/10 transition-colors"
            aria-label="Close email preview"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Email Header Envelope Meta */}
        <div className="border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0E1015] px-6 py-3.5 space-y-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-neutral-300">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1">
            <div>
              <span className="text-neutral-500">From: </span>
              <span className="text-white">PET SLAM Alpha Desk &lt;onboarding@resend.dev&gt;</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
              Provider: <span className="text-[#CCFF00]">Resend API</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-neutral-500">To: </span>
            <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{email}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="text-neutral-500">Subject: </span>
            <span className="text-white font-semibold">
              Application Received: 10,000 Credits & Exclusive Alpha Access Granted!
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Formatted Email Content Box */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 space-y-6 max-h-[65vh] overflow-y-auto bg-[#0F1015]">
          {/* Email Brand Hero */}
          <div className="border border-white/10 bg-[#14161E] p-6 text-center">
            <span className="font-display text-3xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
              PET<span className="text-[#CCFF00]"> SLAM</span>
            </span>
            <div className="mt-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
              ALPHA CANDIDATE VOUCHER · OFFICIALLY GRANTED
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Salutation & Body Copy */}
          <div className="space-y-4 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-200">
            <p className="font-semibold text-white">
              Hey {email.split('@')[0]},
            </p>
            <p>
              We have officially received your application for the <strong>PET SLAM</strong> waitlist! Your candidate spot is locked into our genesis database registry.
            </p>
            <p>
              Because you are entering during the genesis recruitment window, you have been granted an exclusive starter package upon platform rollout:
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* 3 Perks Highlight Cards */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            {/* Perk 1: 10000 Credits */}
            <div className="border border-[#CCFF00]/40 bg-[#CCFF00]/5 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] mb-1">
                  <Zap className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>10,000 Credits</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mt-2">
                  Automatically credited to your account for beast marketplace acquisition, auction bidding, and attribute training.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                GUARANTEED ALLOCATION
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Perk 2: Founder Beast Badge */}
            <div className="border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/5 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400 mb-1">
                  <Award className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Founder Badge</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mt-2">
                  Permanent genesis insignia affixed to your competitor profile, arena card, and global leaderboard ranking.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-400 font-bold">
                GENESIS EXCLUSIVE
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Perk 3: Closed Alpha Testing */}
            <div className="border border-cyan-500/40 bg-cyan-500/5 p-4 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-cyan-400 mb-1">
                  <Shield className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Alpha Testing</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mt-2">
                  Priority invitation wave to playtest the real-time PvP battle arena, weekly player auctions, and IRL proximity matchmaking.
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 font-mono text-[11px] text-cyan-400 font-bold">
                PRIORITY WAVE 1
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Voucher Code Box */}
          <div className="border border-white/10 bg-black/60 p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-neutral-400 block">
                Official Registration Voucher
              </span>
              <span className="font-mono text-base font-bold text-white tracking-widest">
                {voucherId}
              </span>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleCopyVoucher}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border border-white/10 transition-colors"
            >
              {copied ? (
                <>
                  <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                  <span>Copied</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Copy className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Copy Code</span>
                </>
              )}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Closing text */}
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed space-y-2 border-t border-white/10 pt-4">
            <p>
              We're building something distinct where raw animal biology meets high-stakes esports. You'll be among the very first through the arena gates.
            </p>
            <p className="text-neutral-400">
              Stay sharp. The arena is coming.
            </p>
            <div className="pt-2 font-display text-base font-bold text-white uppercase">
              – Team PET SLAM
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer info bar */}
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between border-t border-white/10 px-6 py-4 bg-[#14161E] text-xs text-neutral-400 gap-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]" />
            <span>
              {resendStatus?.sent
                ? 'Email delivered via Resend API'
                : 'Email templating verified. Delivery triggers automatically when RESEND_API_KEY is configured.'}
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase px-5 py-2 tracking-wider"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ShieldCheck, Dumbbell, Utensils, Sparkles, TrendingUp, Lock, CheckCircle2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { animalImages } from '../assets/images';

interface StageData {
  level: number;
  label: string;
  strength: number;
  speed: number;
  endurance: number;
  agility: number;
  unlockedMove: string;
  winRateProjection: number;
  dietPlan: string;
  drills: string;
}

export const EvolutionSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [activeStageIndex, setActiveStageIndex] = useState(2); // Level 10 default

  const stages: StageData[] = [
    {
      level: 1,
      label: 'Genesis Recruit',
      strength: 42,
      speed: 48,
      endurance: 45,
      agility: 50,
      unlockedMove: 'Basic Scent Track & Defensive Bark',
      winRateProjection: 38,
      dietPlan: 'Standard High-Protein Canine Baseline',
      drills: 'Perimeter Leash Conditioning & Focus Drills',
    },
    {
      level: 5,
      label: 'Conditioned Striker',
      strength: 64,
      speed: 66,
      endurance: 68,
      agility: 65,
      unlockedMove: 'Fast Pivot Tackle & Sprint Feint',
      winRateProjection: 61,
      dietPlan: 'Nutrient-Dense Lean Amino Supplementation',
      drills: 'Weighted Sled Pulls & Reaction Whistle Agility',
    },
    {
      level: 10,
      label: 'Apex Veteran',
      strength: 85,
      speed: 78,
      endurance: 90,
      agility: 82,
      unlockedMove: 'Tactical Counter-Lock & Bone Clench',
      winRateProjection: 84,
      dietPlan: 'Raw Carnivore Elite Conditioning Formulation',
      drills: 'Arena Bite Sleeve Sparring & Deep Sand Sprint Intervals',
    },
    {
      level: 15,
      label: 'Arena Sovereign',
      strength: 96,
      speed: 88,
      endurance: 98,
      agility: 92,
      unlockedMove: 'Dominant Pressure Lock & Inescapable Takedown',
      winRateProjection: 94,
      dietPlan: 'Olympic-Grade High-Fat Kinetic Metabolism Blend',
      drills: 'Multi-Opponent Spatial Control & Hypoxic Endurance Regimen',
    },
  ];

  const current = stages[activeStageIndex];

  return (
    <section id="evolution" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0F1015] py-20 lg:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Heading */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
            Biometric Progression System
          </div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
            MORE THAN OWNERSHIP. IT'S ABOUT EVOLUTION.
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-400">
            Raw biological potential is just the starting point. Every meal, drill session, and conditioning cycle actively permanently reshapes your beast's physiological ceiling.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Anti Pay-to-win Notice Strip */}
        <div className="mt-8 border border-white/10 bg-[#14161E] p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-neutral-300">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-semibold text-white">Esports Competitive Integrity Guarantee:</span>
            <span>Upgrades reflect gameplay training. Cosmetic purchases never alter raw combat attributes.</span>
          </div>
          <span className="font-mono text-neutral-400 shrink-0">100% Merit Progression</span>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Comparison Station */}
        <div className="mt-12 border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-10">
          {/* Stage Selector Tabs */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-6 gap-4">
            <div>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 block">
                Subject Case Study
              </span>
              <span className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                German Shepherd (Kaiser) · Biological Development Curve
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Interactive stage buttons */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              {stages.map((st, idx) => (
                <button
                  key={st.level}
                  onClick={() => setActiveStageIndex(idx)}
                  className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold font-display uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    activeStageIndex === idx
                      ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)]'
                      : 'bg-white/5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  LVL {st.level}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Main Comparison Body */}
          <div className="mt-8 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center">
            {/* Visual Beast Card */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 relative">
              <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] overflow-hidden bg-black border border-white/10">
                <img
                  src={animalImages.germanShepherd}
                  alt="German Shepherd Evolution"
                  className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center"
                  referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0B0C10] via-transparent to-black/30" />

                {/* Level Overlay Badge */}
                <div className="absolute top-4 left-4 bg-black/80 border border-white/15 px-3 py-1 font-mono text-xs text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                  STAGE {activeStageIndex + 1}: LEVEL {current.level}
                </div>

                <div className="absolute bottom-4 left-4 right-4">
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#CCFF00] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider block">
                    {current.label}
                  </span>
                  <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                    Canis lupus familiaris
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Real-time projection metric */}
              <div className="mt-3 flex items-center justify-between border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] px-4 py-2.5 text-xs">
                <span className="text-neutral-400">Projected Ranked Win Probability:</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00] text-sm">
                  {current.winRateProjection}%
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Dynamic Attribute Metrics & Training Regimen */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
              {/* Dynamic Stats Bars */}
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                    Dynamic Biological Scaling
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                    Baseline Lv.1 → Active Lv.{current.level}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="text-neutral-300 font-medium">Bite Pressure & Muscle Force</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{current.strength} / 100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/5">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-[#CCFF00] transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                      style={{ width: `${current.strength}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="text-neutral-300 font-medium">Sprint Velocity & Pounce Acceleration</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{current.speed} / 100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/5">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-[#00E5FF] transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                      style={{ width: `${current.speed}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="text-neutral-300 font-medium">Cardiovascular Stamina Capacity</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{current.endurance} / 100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/5">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-[#FF5500] transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                      style={{ width: `${current.endurance}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div>
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="text-neutral-300 font-medium">Tactical Agility & Reflex Pivot</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-white font-bold">{current.agility} / 100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="h-2 w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/5">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-amber-400 transition-all duration-500 ease-out"
                      style={{ width: `${current.agility}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Unlocked Maneuver Callout */}
              <div className="border border-[#CCFF00]/25 bg-[#CCFF00]/5 p-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00]">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Unlocked Maneuver: {current.unlockedMove}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs text-neutral-300 pt-2 border-t border-white/5">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-neutral-400 block text-[11px] uppercase">Active Dietary Protocol</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-white">{current.dietPlan}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-neutral-400 block text-[11px] uppercase">Required Training Drill</span>
                    <span className="font-medium text-white">{current.drills}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, ShieldCheck, Mail, FileText } from 'lucide-react';

interface FooterProps {
  onJoinWaitlist: () => void;
  onNavigate?: (page: 'landing' | 'system-details', sectionId?: string) => void;
}

export const Footer: React.FC<FooterProps> = ({ onJoinWaitlist, onNavigate }) => {
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState<'privacy' | 'terms' | 'contact' | null>(null);

  const handleLinkClick = (page: 'landing' | 'system-details', id: string) => {
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate(page, id);
    } else {
      const el = document.querySelector(id);
      if (el) {
        el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }
  };

  return (
    <footer className="border-t border-white/5 bg-[#08090C] text-neutral-400 text-xs">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 py-16">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-10">
          {/* Brand Info */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2">
            <a
              href="#"
              className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white"
            >
              PET<span className="text-[#CCFF00]"> SLAM</span>
            </a>
            <p className="mt-4 max-w-sm text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
              Where real animal ownership meets competitive esports gaming. Collect, condition, and command apex beasts in sanctioned arena competition.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-6 flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-neutral-400">
              <span>© {new Date().getFullYear()} PET SLAM Gaming Ltd.</span>
              <span>·</span>
              <span>All rights reserved.</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Navigation Links */}
          <div>
            <div className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white mb-4">
              Ecosystem
            </div>
            <ul className="space-y-2.5">
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#how-it-works')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  How It Works
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#marketplace')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Marketplace
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#evolution')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Evolution System
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#arena')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Battle Arena
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('system-details', '#mvp-scope')}
                  className="hover:text-[#CCFF00] transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left"
                >
                  System Required Details (MVP Scope)
                </button>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white mb-4">
              Community & Team
            </div>
            <ul className="space-y-2.5">
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('system-details', '#team')}
                  className="hover:text-[#CCFF00] transition-colors cursor-pointer text-left"
                >
                  Founding Team & Constitution
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#auctions')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Weekly Auctions
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#leaderboard')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Global Leaderboard
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleLinkClick('landing', '#irl-mode')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  IRL Mode (Future Feature)
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={onJoinWaitlist}
                  className="text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline font-bold cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Join Waitlist
                </button>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>

          <div>
            <div className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white mb-4">
              Integrity & Legal
            </div>
            <ul className="space-y-2.5">
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveModal('privacy')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Privacy Policy
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveModal('terms')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Terms of Service
                </button>
              </li>
              <li>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setActiveModal('contact')}
                  className="hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Contact & Inquiries
                </button>
              </li>
            </ul>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Ethical Animal Imagery Notice */}
        <div className="mt-14 pt-8 border-t border-white/5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-neutral-400 gap-4">
          <p>
            Authentic wildlife and domestic species imagery. PET SLAM advocates for wildlife conservation and responsible ethical domestic animal ownership.
          </p>
          <div className="font-mono text-neutral-300">
            Genesis Version 1.0 · Beta Queue Open
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Legal & Contact Modals */}
      {activeModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 text-white shadow-2xl">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveModal(null)}
              className="absolute top-4 right-4 p-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white"
              aria-label="Close dialog"
            >
              <X className="h-5 w-5" />
            </button>

            {activeModal === 'privacy' && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white mb-3">
                  Privacy Policy
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                  <p>
                    <strong>1. Information Collection:</strong> PET SLAM collects subscriber email addresses exclusively for waitlist verification, alpha dispatch credentials, and platform rollout updates.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    <strong>2. IRL Mode Proximity:</strong> Future location-based mechanics are strictly opt-in and utilize fuzzy geographic sectors. Exact real-time user GPS coordinates are never broadcast or sold to third parties.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    <strong>3. Data Security:</strong> Information is stored in encrypted, isolated environments. You may unsubscribe or request data deletion at any time by contacting our privacy compliance desk.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeModal === 'terms' && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white mb-3">
                  Terms of Service
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed max-h-80 overflow-y-auto pr-2">
                  <p>
                    <strong>1. Platform Nature:</strong> PET SLAM is currently in pre-release preview. Features showcased—including the Animal Marketplace, Arena Clashes, and Auctions—represent interactive design specifications.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    <strong>2. Virtual In-Game Assets:</strong> Animal attributes, levels, and credit balances within sandbox simulations carry no real-money cash value.
                  </p>
                  <p>
                    <strong>3. Fair Play Protocol:</strong> Automated botting, exploit abuse, and unsanctioned matchmaking collusion are strictly prohibited in all competitive rankings.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {activeModal === 'contact' && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white mb-3">
                  Contact & Inquiries
                </h3>
                <div className="space-y-3 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  <p>
                    For press, investor relations, and partnership inquiries regarding the PET SLAM competitive gaming ecosystem:
                  </p>
                  <div className="p-4 bg-black/50 border border-white/10 font-mono text-xs space-y-1.5 text-white">
                    <div>Direct: <span className="text-[#CCFF00]">contact@petslam.gg</span></div>
                    <div>Waitlist Helpdesk: <span className="text-[#CCFF00]">support@petslam.gg</span></div>
                    <div>Arena Headquarters: Singapore & Global Distributed Circuit</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex justify-end">
              <button
                onClick={() => setActiveModal(null)}
                className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-display font-bold uppercase text-xs px-5 py-2"
              >
                Close
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </footer>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
