<source>src/components/game/AccountAuthModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  Lock,
  Mail,
  User,
  KeyRound,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  AlertCircle,
  HelpCircle,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import {
  isSupabaseConfigured,
  registerPlayerWithSupabase,
  signInPlayerWithSupabase,
  resetPasswordWithSupabase,
  signInWithGoogle,
} from '../../services/supabaseClient';

interface AccountAuthModalProps {
  currentTrainerName: string;
  onUpdateTrainerName: (name: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAuthSuccess?: () => void;
}

export const AccountAuthModal: React.FC<AccountAuthModalProps> = ({
  currentTrainerName,
  onUpdateTrainerName,
  onClose,
  onAuthSuccess,
}) => {
  const { loginAccount, connectedAccount, logoutAccount, trainerName } = useGame();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'signin' | 'signup' | 'forgot'>('signin');
  const [showSwitchAccount, setShowSwitchAccount] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState<string>(currentTrainerName !== 'Trainer' ? currentTrainerName : '');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState<string>('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState<string>('');

  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [successMessage, setSuccessMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Real Google Sign In Handler via Supabase OAuth
  const handleGoogleSignIn = async () => {
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    sound.playClick();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    try {
      if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
        const res = await signInWithGoogle();
        if (res.error) {
          setErrorMessage(
            `Google OAuth is not enabled in your Supabase project yet (${res.error}). To use Google Sign-In, enable the Google provider in Supabase Dashboard -> Authentication -> Providers. In the meantime, use your Email/Username & Password below!`
          );
        }
        // If enabled, browser redirects directly to accounts.google.com
      } else {
        setErrorMessage('Supabase credentials are not configured in .env.');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMessage(err?.message || 'Google authentication failed to connect.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // Sign In Handler
  const handleSignIn = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!email.trim() || !password) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter both your email/username and password.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    sound.playClick();

    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      const res = await signInPlayerWithSupabase(email, password);
      setIsSubmitting(false);

      if (res.error) {
        setErrorMessage(res.error);
        return;
      }

      const verifiedName = res.profile?.trainer_name || res.user?.user_metadata?.username || email.split('@')[0];
      loginAccount('Supabase', res.user?.email || email, verifiedName, res.profile?.avatar_url, res.user?.id);
      onUpdateTrainerName(verifiedName);
      sound.playLevelUp();
      setSuccessMessage(`Welcome back, Trainer ${verifiedName}! Cloud sync active.`);

      setTimeout(() => {
        onAuthSuccess?.();
        onClose();
      }, 1200);
    } else {
      // Local fallback / sandbox mode
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        const demoName = email.includes('@') ? email.split('@')[0] : email;
        loginAccount('Local-Sandbox', email.includes('@') ? email : `${email}@petslam.app`, demoName);
        onUpdateTrainerName(demoName);
        sound.playLevelUp();
        setSuccessMessage(`Signed in as ${demoName}! (Running in sandbox mode - configure .env for live Supabase DB).`);

        setTimeout(() => {
          onAuthSuccess?.();
          onClose();
        }, 1200);
      }, 600);
    }
  };

  // Sign Up Handler
  const handleSignUp = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!email.trim() || !password || !username.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please fill in username, email, and password.');
      return;
    }

    if (password.length < 6) {
      setErrorMessage('Password must be at least 6 characters long.');
      return;
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setErrorMessage('Passwords do not match.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    sound.playClick();

    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      const res = await registerPlayerWithSupabase(email, password, username);
      setIsSubmitting(false);

      if (res.error) {
        setErrorMessage(res.error);
        return;
      }

      sound.playLevelUp();
      setSuccessMessage(
        'Account created! A verification link has been sent to your email via Resend. Check your inbox to confirm your account.'
      );

      // Auto login if session exists (if email confirmation is turned off or immediate)
      if (res.session) {
        loginAccount('Supabase', res.user?.email || email, username, undefined, res.user?.id);
        onUpdateTrainerName(username);
        setTimeout(() => {
          onAuthSuccess?.();
          onClose();
        }, 1800);
      }
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        loginAccount('Local-Sandbox', email, username);
        onUpdateTrainerName(username);
        sound.playLevelUp();
        setSuccessMessage(`Account registered for ${username}! (Sandbox preview mode).`);

        setTimeout(() => {
          onAuthSuccess?.();
          onClose();
        }, 1500);
      }, 600);
    }
  };

  // Forgot Password Handler
  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);
    setSuccessMessage(null);

    if (!email.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter your account email address.');
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    sound.playClick();

    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      const res = await resetPasswordWithSupabase(email);
      setIsSubmitting(false);
      if (res.error) {
        setErrorMessage(res.error);
      } else {
        sound.playVictory();
        setSuccessMessage('Password recovery email sent via Resend! Check your inbox.');
      }
    } else {
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        sound.playVictory();
        setSuccessMessage('Password reset request simulated. Set up Supabase + Resend for live email delivery.');
      }, 600);
    }
  };

  // Quick Guest Mode Bypass
  const handleGuestPlay = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    onClose();
    onAuthSuccess?.();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0e121a] border border-white/20 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#141926] border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-black font-black" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Player Authentication
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                {isSupabaseConfigured ? '🟢 Supabase Cloud DB Connected' : '🟡 Supabase Sandbox Mode'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/15 flex items-center justify-center text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Auth Mode Tabs */}
        {(!connectedAccount.isLoggedIn || showSwitchAccount) && (
          <div className="flex border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0a0d14]">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab('signin');
                setErrorMessage(null);
                setSuccessMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'signin'
                  ? 'text-[#CCFF00] border-b-2 border-[#CCFF00] bg-white/5'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Sign In
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab('signup');
                setErrorMessage(null);
                setSuccessMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'signup'
                  ? 'text-[#CCFF00] border-b-2 border-[#CCFF00] bg-white/5'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Sign Up
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setActiveTab('forgot');
                setErrorMessage(null);
                setSuccessMessage(null);
              }}
              className={`flex-1 py-3 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'forgot'
                  ? 'text-[#CCFF00] border-b-2 border-[#CCFF00] bg-white/5'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Reset
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="p-5 sm:p-6 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
          {/* Active Logged In Card */}
          {connectedAccount.isLoggedIn && !showSwitchAccount ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="bg-emerald-950/40 border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3.5">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-xl shrink-0">
                  🐾
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-display font-black text-white text-base truncate">
                      {trainerName}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-emerald-500/30 font-bold">
                      AUTHENTICATED
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-neutral-300 font-mono truncate">{connectedAccount.email}</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">
                    Provider: {connectedAccount.provider} · Cloud Synced
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowSwitchAccount(true)}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Switch / Sign In with Another Account or Google
                </button>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      logoutAccount();
                      onUpdateTrainerName('Trainer');
                      setShowSwitchAccount(true);
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-red-500/10 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/30 text-red-300 font-bold text-xs transition cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Log Out
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      sound.playClick();
                      onClose();
                      onAuthSuccess?.();
                    }}
                    className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-black text-xs transition hover:brightness-110 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Enter Arena
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Alert / Notification Feedback */}
              {errorMessage && (
                <div className="bg-red-950/50 border border-red-500/50 text-red-200 text-xs rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="leading-relaxed">{errorMessage}</div>
                </div>
              )}

              {successMessage && (
                <div className="bg-emerald-950/50 border border-emerald-500/50 text-emerald-200 text-xs rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                  <div className="leading-relaxed">{successMessage}</div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Primary Option 1: 1-Click Sign in with Google */}
              {activeTab !== 'forgot' && (
                <div className="space-y-3 pt-1">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleGoogleSignIn}
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white hover:bg-neutral-100 active:scale-[0.99] text-neutral-900 font-bold text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-3 transition shadow-md cursor-pointer border border-neutral-300 disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                      <path fill="#4285F4" d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" />
                      <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" />
                      <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.06H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.94l2.85-2.22.81-.63z" />
                      <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.06l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.52 6.16-4.52z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>Sign in with Google</span>
                  </button>

                  {/* Clean Divider */}
                  <div className="relative flex py-1 items-center">
                    <div className="flex-grow border-t border-white/10"></div>
                    <span className="flex-shrink mx-3 text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold">
                      Or use ID & Password
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex-grow border-t border-white/10"></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* SIGN IN FORM */}
              {activeTab === 'signin' && (
                <form onSubmit={handleSignIn} className="space-y-3.5">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                      Email or Username
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={email}
                        onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="trainer@petslam.app or Trainer_01"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                      <label className="text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 font-bold">
                        Password
                      </label>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setActiveTab('forgot')}
                        className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Forgot Password?
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                      <input
                        type="password"
                        value={password}
                        onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="••••••••"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    className="w-full py-3 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black font-display text-sm uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)] disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? (
                      <span>Verifying Credentials...</span>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span>Sign In to Arena</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}

              {/* SIGN UP FORM */}
              {activeTab === 'signup' && (
                <form onSubmit={handleSignUp} className="space-y-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                      Trainer Username
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <User className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={username}
                        onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. ShadowK9"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                      Email Address (For Resend Verification)
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                      <input
                        type="email"
                        value={email}
                        onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="player@domain.com"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                        Password
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="password"
                        value={password}
                        onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Min 6 chars"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                        Confirm
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="password"
                        value={confirmPassword}
                        onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="Repeat"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    className="w-full mt-2 py-3 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black font-display text-sm uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)] disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? (
                      <span>Creating Account...</span>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span>Create Account & Send Verification</span>
                        <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}

              {/* FORGOT PASSWORD FORM */}
              {activeTab === 'forgot' && (
                <form onSubmit={handleForgotPassword} className="space-y-3.5">
                  <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                    Enter the email registered to your account. We will dispatch a secure password reset link powered by <strong className="text-white">Resend</strong>.
                  </p>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-300 mb-1 font-bold">
                      Account Email
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-neutral-500" />
                      <input
                        type="email"
                        value={email}
                        onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="player@domain.com"
                        required
                        className="w-full bg-[#131824] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={isSubmitting}
                    className="w-full py-3 bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black font-black font-display text-sm uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(34,211,238,0.3)] disabled:opacity-50"
                  >
                    {isSubmitting ? 'Sending Link...' : 'Send Recovery Email'}
                  </button>
                </form>
              )}

              {/* Guest Play & Setup Helper */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleGuestPlay}
                  className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer underline text-[11px]"
                >
                  Continue as Guest / Demo Play
                </button>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-500">
                  Resend SMTP Verification Ready
                </span>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/AlphaQueueModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { X, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Shield, Users, Trophy, Coins, MessageSquare, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface AlphaQueueModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const AlphaQueueModal: React.FC<AlphaQueueModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { trainerName, setTrainerName } = useGame();
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState(trainerName);
  const [community, setCommunity] = useState('Smogon VGC');
  const [selectedStarter, setSelectedStarter] = useState('Bengal Tiger');
  const [claimed, setClaimed] = useState(false);
  const [voucherCode, setVoucherCode] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const communities = [
    { name: 'Smogon VGC', badge: 'Competitive Pokémon / VGC Hub' },
    { name: 'TFT Competitive', badge: 'Tactical Esports Discord' },
    { name: 'Auto-Chess Hubs', badge: 'Strategy & Synergy Guilds' },
    { name: 'r/CompetitiveGaming', badge: 'Reddit Esports Community' },
  ];

  const starters = [
    { name: 'Bengal Tiger', archetype: 'Predator / Ambush Burst', desc: 'Crushing bite force and lightning pounce strike' },
    { name: 'Timber Wolf', archetype: 'Pack Stalker / High Agility', desc: 'Superior stamina recovery and evasion dodge speed' },
    { name: 'African Lion', archetype: 'Apex Brawler / Dominance', desc: 'Territorial roar stun and heavy maul balance' },
    { name: 'Harpy Eagle', archetype: 'Aerial Recon / Precision', desc: 'High crit rate and razor talon dive attacks' },
  ];

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!handle.trim()) return;

    sound.playVictory();
    const code = `SLAM-ALPHA-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    setVoucherCode(code);
    setClaimed(true);

    if (handle.trim() !== trainerName) {
      setTrainerName(handle.trim());
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="w-full max-w-md bg-[#12141C] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {!claimed ? (
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
              <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>Genesis Priority Access</span>
            </div>

            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-2xl uppercase tracking-tight text-white">
              Join Week 8 Alpha Queue
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
              Register for Wave 1 closed alpha testing. Guaranteed priority server access, 10,000 credit starter grant, and Genesis Founder badge.
            </p>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-5 space-y-4">
              {/* Community Source */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                  1. Target Esports Community / Discord
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {communities.map((c) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={c.name}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setCommunity(c.name);
                        sound.playClick();
                      }}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        community === c.name
                          ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#1A1E2A] text-white ring-1 ring-[#CCFF00]/40'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-[#141620] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase text-white truncate">
                        {c.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 truncate">
                        {c.badge}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Call-Sign / Handle */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                  2. Trainer Call-Sign / Discord Handle
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={handle}
                  onChange={(e) => setHandle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. ApexTrainer#1337"
                  className="w-full bg-[#161822] border border-white/15 focus:border-[#CCFF00] rounded-xl px-3.5 py-2.5 text-xs text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none"
                  required
                />
              </div>

              {/* Preferred Starter Beast */}
              <div>
                <label className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-300 uppercase block mb-1.5">
                  3. Select Genesis Starter Animal
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {starters.map((s) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={s.name}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedStarter(s.name);
                        sound.playClick();
                      }}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        selectedStarter === s.name
                          ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#1A1E2A] text-white ring-1 ring-[#CCFF00]/40'
                          : 'border-white/10 bg-[#141620] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase text-white">
                        {s.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[9px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono mt-0.5">
                        {s.archetype}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Submit CTA */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black shadow-lg shadow-[#CCFF00]/25 transition-transform active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-2"
              >
                <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Confirm Alpha Queue & Claim Rewards</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-4">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-[#CCFF00]/10 border-2 border-[#CCFF00] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto text-[#CCFF00] mb-4 shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)]">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8" />
            </div>

            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
              Verification Confirmed
            </span>
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-2xl uppercase tracking-tight text-white mt-1">
              Priority Alpha Slot Locked
            </h3>

            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 mt-2 leading-relaxed">
              Welcome aboard, <strong>{handle}</strong>! You have been queued into Wave 1 via the <strong>{community}</strong> esports partner pipeline with starter animal <strong>{selectedStarter}</strong>.
            </p>

            {/* Voucher Box */}
            <div className="mt-5 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-[#161924] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 text-center">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-400 tracking-wider">
                Genesis Founder Voucher
              </span>
              <div className="font-mono font-black text-xl text-[#CCFF00] tracking-widest mt-1">
                {voucherCode}
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-amber-300">
                <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                <span>+10,000 Credits Alpha Stipend Granted</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="mt-6 w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black shadow-lg shadow-[#CCFF00]/25 cursor-pointer"
            >
              Enter Championship Arena
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
