<source>src/components/game/FriendsHubModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Users,
  MessageSquare,
  UserPlus,
  Swords,
  Send,
  Circle,
  Trophy,
  Smile,
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { FriendsVoiceRoomModal } from './FriendsVoiceRoomModal';

interface Friend {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  tag: string;
  beastName: string;
  trophies: number;
  status: 'Online in Arena' | 'In Menu' | 'Offline';
  avatarColor: string;
}

interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  sender: string;
  text: string;
  timestamp: string;
  isSelf: boolean;
}

const INITIAL_FRIENDS: Friend[] = [
  {
    id: 'f1',
    name: 'ViperQueen',
    tag: '#VIPER-99',
    beastName: 'Khan (Tiger)',
    trophies: 1640,
    status: 'Online in Arena',
    avatarColor: 'from-amber-400 to-red-500',
  },
  {
    id: 'f2',
    name: 'Leonidas_Fan',
    tag: '#LEO-44',
    beastName: 'Leonidas (Cat)',
    trophies: 1380,
    status: 'In Menu',
    avatarColor: 'from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-500',
  },
  {
    id: 'f3',
    name: 'TitanBrawler',
    tag: '#TITAN-12',
    beastName: 'Ghost (Husky)',
    trophies: 1520,
    status: 'Online in Arena',
    avatarColor: 'from-cyan-400 to-blue-600',
  },
  {
    id: 'f4',
    name: 'ShadowFang',
    tag: '#NIGHT-88',
    beastName: 'Shadow (Black Cat)',
    trophies: 1410,
    status: 'Offline',
    avatarColor: 'from-purple-500 to-indigo-600',
  },
];

interface FriendsHubModalProps {
  onChallengeFriend: (friend: Friend) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const FriendsHubModal: React.FC<FriendsHubModalProps> = ({
  onChallengeFriend,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'friends' | 'chat' | 'add'>('friends');
  const [showVoiceRoom, setShowVoiceRoom] = useState(false);
  const [friendsList, setFriendsList] = useState<Friend[]>(INITIAL_FRIENDS);
  const [newFriendTag, setNewFriendTag] = useState('');
  const [addSuccessToast, setAddSuccessToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Chat State
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    {
      id: 'm1',
      sender: 'ViperQueen',
      text: 'Good bout earlier! Your German Shepherd has insane clamp force.',
      timestamp: '2m ago',
      isSelf: false,
    },
    {
      id: 'm2',
      sender: 'You',
      text: 'Thanks! Just upgraded his jaw conditioning. Ready for a 2v2 Tag Team?',
      timestamp: '1m ago',
      isSelf: true,
    },
    {
      id: 'm3',
      sender: 'ViperQueen',
      text: 'Yes! Send the challenge!',
      timestamp: 'Just now',
      isSelf: false,
    },
  ]);
  const [inputMsg, setInputMsg] = useState('');

  const quickEmotes = ['Good Game! 🏆', 'Ready to Spar? ⚔️', 'Claw Power! 🐾', 'Well Played! 👏', '2v2 Tag Team? 🛡️'];

  const handleSendMessage = (textToSend?: string) => {
    const text = textToSend || inputMsg;
    if (!text.trim()) return;

    sound.playClick();
    const newMsg: ChatMessage = {
      id: `msg_${Date.now()}`,
      sender: 'You',
      text: text.trim(),
      timestamp: 'Just now',
      isSelf: true,
    };
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, newMsg]);
    setInputMsg('');

    // Mock quick reply after 1.5s
    setTimeout(() => {
      sound.playClick();
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `msg_${Date.now()}`,
          sender: 'ViperQueen',
          text: 'Accepted! Let’s crush the arena!',
          timestamp: 'Just now',
          isSelf: false,
        },
      ]);
    }, 1500);
  };

  const handleAddFriend = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newFriendTag.trim()) return;
    sound.playLevelUp();

    const newFriend: Friend = {
      id: `f_${Date.now()}`,
      name: newFriendTag.replace('#', 'Trainer_'),
      tag: newFriendTag.startsWith('#') ? newFriendTag : `#${newFriendTag}`,
      beastName: 'Kaiser (Shepherd)',
      trophies: 1250,
      status: 'Online in Arena',
      avatarColor: 'from-amber-400 to-emerald-400',
    };

    setFriendsList((prev) => [newFriend, ...prev]);
    setAddSuccessToast(`Added ${newFriend.name} to your Friends Roster!`);
    setNewFriendTag('');
    setTimeout(() => setAddSuccessToast(null), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0e121a] border-2 border-white/20 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#151c2a] border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-cyan-400" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Multiplayer Friends & Clan Chat
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                {friendsList.filter((f) => f.status !== 'Offline').length} Friends Online
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Switcher */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 p-2 bg-[#101420] border-b border-white/5 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('friends');
            }}
            className={`py-2 text-xs font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'friends'
                ? 'bg-cyan-400 text-black shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            Friends ({friendsList.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('chat');
            }}
            className={`py-2 text-xs font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'chat'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Live Chat</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('add');
            }}
            className={`py-2 text-xs font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${
              activeTab === 'add'
                ? 'bg-amber-400 text-black shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <UserPlus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Add Friend</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Quick Voice Party Banner */}
        <div className="mx-4 mt-2.5 p-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-950/60 to-cyan-950/60 border border-purple-500/30 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
            <div>
              <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span>Multiplayer Voice Room</span>
                <span className="text-[8px] font-mono bg-purple-500/40 text-purple-200 px-1 rounded">LIVE</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">Talk with friends while clashing</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowVoiceRoom(true)}
            className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white font-mono text-[10px] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95 shadow"
          >
            🎙️ Join Voice
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Toast Feedback */}
        {addSuccessToast && (
          <div className="mx-4 mt-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/60 text-center animate-in fade-in">
            <p className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300">{addSuccessToast}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 1: FRIENDS ROSTER */}
        {activeTab === 'friends' && (
          <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-2.5 flex-1">
            {friendsList.map((friend) => {
              const isOnline = friend.status !== 'Offline';

              return (
                <div
                  key={friend.id}
                  className="bg-[#121622] hover:bg-[#161c2b] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between transition-all shadow"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div
                      className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${friend.avatarColor} flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-sm shadow shrink-0 relative`}
                    >
                      {friend.name.substring(0, 2).toUpperCase()}
                      <Circle
                        className={`absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full ${
                          isOnline ? 'text-emerald-400 fill-emerald-400' : 'text-neutral-500 fill-neutral-500'
                        }`}
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="text-left">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="font-display font-black text-xs uppercase text-white">
                          {friend.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">{friend.tag}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono">
                        {friend.beastName} · {friend.trophies} 🏆
                      </p>
                      <span
                        className={`text-[9px] font-mono block ${
                          friend.status === 'Online in Arena'
                            ? 'text-emerald-400'
                            : friend.status === 'In Menu'
                            ? 'text-cyan-300'
                            : 'text-neutral-500'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {friend.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Challenge Button */}
                  {isOnline && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        sound.playCardPlay();
                        onChallengeFriend(friend);
                      }}
                      className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-600 hover:from-cyan-400 hover:to-blue-500 text-white font-display font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>Duel</span>
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 2: LIVE IN-GAME CHAT & QUICK BATTLE EMOTES */}
        {activeTab === 'chat' && (
          <div className="flex flex-col flex-1 overflow-hidden p-4">
            {/* Quick Emote Action Pills */}
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-2 scrollbar-none shrink-0">
              {quickEmotes.map((emote) => (
                <button
                  key={emote}
                  onClick={() => handleSendMessage(emote)}
                  className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#182030] hover:bg-[#222c42] border border-white/10 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-white whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95 shadow"
                >
                  {emote}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Chat Messages List */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 py-2 pr-1">
              {messages.map((msg) => (
                <div
                  key={msg.id}
                  className={`flex flex-col ${msg.isSelf ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'}`}
                >
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400 px-1 mb-0.5">
                    {msg.sender} · {msg.timestamp}
                  </span>
                  <div
                    className={`max-w-[80%] px-3 py-2 rounded-2xl text-xs font-mono shadow ${
                      msg.isSelf
                        ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-semibold rounded-tr-none'
                        : 'bg-[#182030] text-white border border-white/10 rounded-tl-none'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {msg.text}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Message Input Box */}
            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center gap-2 border-t border-white/10 shrink-0">
              <input
                type="text"
                value={inputMsg}
                onChange={(e) => setInputMsg(e.target.value)}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSendMessage()}
                placeholder="Message clan & friends..."
                className="flex-1 bg-[#121622] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00]"
              />
              <button
                onClick={() => handleSendMessage()}
                className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#d4ff1a] text-black cursor-pointer shadow active:scale-95"
              >
                <Send className="w-4 h-4" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* TAB 3: ADD FRIEND BY PLAYER TAG */}
        {activeTab === 'add' && (
          <div className="p-6 space-y-4 flex-1">
            <div className="space-y-1 text-center">
              <h4 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-white">
                Connect With Other Trainers
              </h4>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
                Your Player Tag: <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">#SLAM-7749</span>
              </p>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleAddFriend} className="space-y-3">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block mb-1 uppercase">
                  Enter Friend's Player Tag
                </label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={newFriendTag}
                  onChange={(e) => setNewFriendTag(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. #VIPER-99"
                  required
                  className="w-full bg-[#121622] border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-xs font-mono text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-amber-400"
                />
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer shadow flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-black fill-black" />
                <span>Send Friend Request</span>
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}
        {/* Voice Room Modal */}
        {showVoiceRoom && (
          <FriendsVoiceRoomModal
            onClose={() => setShowVoiceRoom(false)}
            onStartDuelWithFriend={(friendName) => {
              setShowVoiceRoom(false);
              onClose();
              onChallengeFriend?.({
                id: 'f_voice',
                name: friendName,
                tag: '#VOICE-1',
                beastName: 'Ghost (Husky)',
                trophies: 1500,
                status: 'Online in Arena',
                avatarColor: 'from-purple-500 to-cyan-500',
              });
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/FriendsVoiceRoomModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  X,
  Users,
  Copy,
  Check,
  Swords,
  Radio,
  Sparkles,
  PhoneCall,
  PhoneOff,
  Shield,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';

interface FriendsVoiceRoomModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onStartDuelWithFriend?: (friendName: string) => void;
}

export const FriendsVoiceRoomModal: React.FC<FriendsVoiceRoomModalProps> = ({
  onClose,
  onStartDuelWithFriend,
}) => {
  const { trainerName, playerTag } = useGame();

  const [isMicMuted, setIsMicMuted] = useState(false);
  const [isDeafened, setIsDeafened] = useState(false);
  const [copiedCode, setCopiedCode] = useState(false);
  const [audioLevel, setAudioLevel] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState<boolean>(true);

  // Simulated party members
  const [partyMembers, setPartyMembers] = useState([
    {
      id: 'm1',
      name: trainerName || 'Nirnai',
      tag: playerTag,
      isHost: true,
      isTalking: false,
      isMuted: false,
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=120&q=80',
    },
    {
      id: 'm2',
      name: 'Alex Vanguard',
      tag: '#ALEX-11',
      isHost: false,
      isTalking: true,
      isMuted: false,
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1570295999919-56ceb5ecca61?auto=format&fit=crop&w=120&q=80',
    },
    {
      id: 'm3',
      name: 'Maya S.',
      tag: '#MAYA-92',
      isHost: false,
      isTalking: false,
      isMuted: true,
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?auto=format&fit=crop&w=120&q=80',
    },
    {
      id: 'm4',
      name: 'Kenji & Hachi',
      tag: '#DOGE-44',
      isHost: false,
      isTalking: false,
      isMuted: false,
      avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1507003211169-0a1dd7228f2d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=120&q=80',
    },
  ]);

  const micStreamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const audioContextRef = useRef<AudioContext | null>(null);
  const analyserRef = useRef<AnalyserNode | null>(null);
  const animFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);

  // Initialize real microphone audio stream and live volume metering
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;

    async function initMic() {
      try {
        if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) return;
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
        if (!active) {
          stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
          return;
        }

        micStreamRef.current = stream;
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
        const ctx = new AudioCtx();
        audioContextRef.current = ctx;

        const source = ctx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);
        const analyser = ctx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = 64;
        source.connect(analyser);
        analyserRef.current = analyser;

        const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);

        const checkAudio = () => {
          if (!active) return;
          analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
          let sum = 0;
          for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
            sum += dataArray[i];
          }
          const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
          const normalized = Math.min(100, Math.round((avg / 128) * 100));
          setAudioLevel(normalized);

          // Update talking ring for host
          setPartyMembers((prev) =>
            prev.map((m) => (m.isHost ? { ...m, isTalking: normalized > 15 && !isMicMuted } : m))
          );

          animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(checkAudio);
        };

        checkAudio();
      } catch (e) {
        // Microphone permission denied or unavailable; use simulated voice fluctuation
        const interval = setInterval(() => {
          if (!active) return;
          const sim = Math.floor(Math.random() * 45);
          setAudioLevel(sim);
        }, 300);
        return () => clearInterval(interval);
      }
    }

    initMic();

    return () => {
      active = false;
      if (animFrameRef.current) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
      if (micStreamRef.current) {
        micStreamRef.current.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
      }
      if (audioContextRef.current) {
        audioContextRef.current.close().catch(() => {});
      }
    };
  }, [isMicMuted]);

  // Periodic member speech simulation
  useEffect(() => {
    const talkTimer = setInterval(() => {
      setPartyMembers((prev) =>
        prev.map((m) => {
          if (m.isHost || m.isMuted) return m;
          return { ...m, isTalking: Math.random() < 0.4 };
        })
      );
    }, 2400);

    return () => clearInterval(talkTimer);
  }, []);

  const handleToggleMic = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    setIsMicMuted((prev) => {
      const next = !prev;
      if (micStreamRef.current) {
        micStreamRef.current.getAudioTracks().forEach((t) => {
          t.enabled = !next;
        });
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const handleCopyCode = () => {
    sound.playCoin();
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText?.('SLAM-VOICE-842');
    setCopiedCode(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopiedCode(false), 2500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-3 sm:p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0D111A] border-2 border-cyan-400/50 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#131926] border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 flex items-center justify-center border border-cyan-400/40">
              <Radio className="w-4 h-4 animate-pulse text-cyan-400" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-white tracking-wide">
                  Multiplayer Voice Party
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
                  <span>CONNECTED</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                Room Code: #SLAM-VOICE-842 · Low-Latency 18ms
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Live Audio Visualizer Bar */}
        <div className="bg-black/40 px-4 py-2 border-b border-white/5 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-neutral-300">
            <span>Voice Activity:</span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 h-3 w-32">
              {Array.from({ length: 12 }).map((_, i) => {
                const active = !isMicMuted && audioLevel > i * 8;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className={`flex-1 rounded-sm transition-all duration-75 ${
                      active
                        ? i > 8
                          ? 'bg-red-400 h-3 shadow-[0_0_6px_#ef4444]'
                          : 'bg-[#CCFF00] h-2.5 shadow-[0_0_6px_#ccff00]'
                        : 'bg-neutral-800 h-1'
                    }`}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={handleCopyCode}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] hover:text-white bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            {copiedCode ? <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" /> : <Copy className="w-3 h-3" />}
            <span>{copiedCode ? 'Copied Link!' : 'Invite Friend'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Party Members List */}
        <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-2.5 flex-1">
          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-neutral-400 font-bold">
            Party Members in Channel ({partyMembers.length})
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {partyMembers.map((member) => (
              <div
                key={member.id}
                className={`p-2.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all flex items-center gap-2.5 ${
                  member.isTalking
                    ? 'bg-[#152336] border-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(52,211,153,0.3)]'
                    : 'bg-[#121622] border-white/10'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="relative">
                  <div
                    className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 shrink-0 ${
                      member.isTalking
                        ? 'border-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_10px_#34d399]'
                        : 'border-white/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <img
                      src={member.avatar}
                      alt={member.name}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    />
                  </div>
                  {member.isTalking && (
                    <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-emerald-500 rounded-full border-2 border-[#0D111A] flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Radio className="w-2 h-2 text-white animate-pulse" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                  {member.isMuted && (
                    <span className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-3.5 h-3.5 bg-red-500 rounded-full border-2 border-[#0D111A] flex items-center justify-center">
                      <MicOff className="w-2 h-2 text-white" />
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white truncate flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>{member.name}</span>
                    {member.isHost && (
                      <span className="text-[8px] bg-[#CCFF00]/20 text-[#CCFF00] font-mono px-1 rounded">
                        HOST
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 truncate">
                    {member.tag}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] font-mono">
                    {member.isTalking ? (
                      <span className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">Speaking...</span>
                    ) : member.isMuted ? (
                      <span className="text-neutral-500">Muted</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-cyan-400">Listening</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Quick 1v1 Battle Invitation Banner */}
          <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500/15 via-[#1A1828] to-cyan-500/15 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Swords className="w-4 h-4 text-red-400" />
                <span>Instant Friendly Duel</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-300 font-mono">
                Challenge anyone in voice party to a live 1v1 Clash!
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={() => {
                sound.playBattleStart();
                if (onStartDuelWithFriend) {
                  onStartDuelWithFriend('Alex Vanguard');
                }
                onClose();
              }}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all"
            >
              Challenge
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Voice Controls */}
        <div className="bg-[#131926] border-t border-white/10 p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {/* Mic Toggle Button */}
            <button
              onClick={handleToggleMic}
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-2xl font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                isMicMuted
                  ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-300 border border-red-500/40 hover:bg-red-500/30'
                  : 'bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/40 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(52,211,153,0.3)]'
              }`}
            >
              {isMicMuted ? <MicOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Mic className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span>{isMicMuted ? 'Muted' : 'Mic Live'}</span>
            </button>

            {/* Deafen / Speaker Button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setIsDeafened((prev) => !prev)}
              className={`p-2.5 rounded-2xl font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                isDeafened
                  ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40'
                  : 'bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-white/15'
              }`}
            >
              {isDeafened ? <VolumeX className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Volume2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
              <span>{isDeafened ? 'Deafened' : 'Sound ON'}</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Leave Voice Room */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="p-2.5 px-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md transition-all active:scale-95"
          >
            <PhoneOff className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>Leave</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/GameBottomNav.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import { Swords, PawPrint, ShoppingBag, Shield, User, Heart } from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

export type GameTab = 'arena' | 'buddy' | 'beasts' | 'market' | 'armory' | 'profile';

interface GameBottomNavProps {
  currentTab: GameTab;
  onTabChange: (tab: GameTab) => void;
}

export const GameBottomNav: React.FC<GameBottomNavProps> = ({ currentTab, onTabChange }) => {
  const tabs: { id: GameTab; label: string; icon: React.FC<{ className?: string }> }[] = [
    { id: 'arena', label: 'Arena', icon: Swords },
    { id: 'buddy', label: 'Buddy', icon: Heart },
    { id: 'beasts', label: 'Beasts', icon: PawPrint },
    { id: 'market', label: 'Market', icon: ShoppingBag },
    { id: 'armory', label: 'Armory', icon: Shield },
    { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: User },
  ];

  const handleSelect = (tab: GameTab) => {
    sound.playClick();
    onTabChange(tab);
  };

  return (
    <nav className="sticky bottom-0 z-40 w-full bg-[#0D111A]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-white/10 shadow-lg px-2 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-around select-none">
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = currentTab === tab.id;
        const IconComponent = tab.icon;

        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => handleSelect(tab.id)}
            className={`relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-w-[46px] min-h-[44px] py-1 px-1 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer ${
              isActive
                ? 'text-[#CCFF00] font-bold'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white active:scale-95'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Active Top Bar */}
            {isActive && (
              <div className="absolute -top-1.5 w-6 h-1 bg-[#CCFF00] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_8px_#CCFF00]" />
            )}

            <div
              className={`flex items-center justify-center w-6 h-6 transition-transform duration-200 ${
                isActive ? 'scale-110 text-[#CCFF00]' : 'text-neutral-500'
              }`}
            >
              <IconComponent className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>

            <span
              className={`text-[10px] font-display uppercase tracking-wider font-bold mt-0.5 transition-colors ${
                isActive ? 'text-[#CCFF00]' : 'text-neutral-400'
              }`}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Swords,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Dumbbell,
  ShoppingCart,
  Trophy,
  HelpCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  ChevronRight,
  Flame,
  Award,
  Sparkles,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface GameGuideModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onStartPracticeDrill?: () => void;
}

export const GameGuideModal: React.FC<GameGuideModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onStartPracticeDrill,
}) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'roadmap' | 'combat' | 'training' | 'armory' | 'market' | 'ranking'>('roadmap');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn select-none">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0F1117] border border-[#CCFF00]/30 rounded-3xl p-5 sm:p-6 shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9),0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.15)] flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00]/15 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 flex items-center justify-center text-[#CCFF00]">
              <HelpCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                PET SLAM · Trainer's Guide
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[10px] sm:text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                Master the Colosseum: Combat, Training, Armory & Auctions
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/15 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Navigation Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto py-2.5 border-b border-white/5 scrollbar-none">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('roadmap');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'roadmap'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>🗺️ Progression Map</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('combat');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'combat'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>1. Arena Combat</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('training');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'training'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Dumbbell className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>2. Beast Gym</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('armory');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'armory'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>3. Armory</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('market');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'market'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <ShoppingCart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>4. Marketplace</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              setActiveTab('ranking');
              sound.playClick();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold shrink-0 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
              activeTab === 'ranking'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md font-black'
                : 'bg-[#151822] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
            }`}
          >
            <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>5. Ranking</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body Content */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3 space-y-3.5 text-xs text-neutral-300">
          {/* TAB 0: 5-PHASE PROGRESSION ROADMAP */}
          {activeTab === 'roadmap' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {/* Interactive Combat Drill Callout Card */}
              {onStartPracticeDrill && (
                <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/20 via-[#18233C] to-amber-500/20 border-2 border-[#CCFF00] rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-lg flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#CCFF00] font-black text-xs uppercase">
                      <span>🥋</span>
                      <span>30-Second Combat Practice Drill</span>
                      <span className="bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-mono text-[9px] font-bold">
                        +250 CR
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 mt-0.5">
                      Practice Pounce [1], Iron Guard [3], PET SLAM [SPACE], and Tag-In [Q] in a real-time dojo!
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      sound.playClick();
                      onClose();
                      onStartPracticeDrill();
                    }}
                    className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer shadow-md shrink-0 active:scale-95"
                  >
                    Launch Drill 🥋
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Visual Progression Map Header */}
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3">
                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-xs uppercase text-white tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                  <span>The 5-Step PET SLAM Journey</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                  From real-world photo scanner to desktop screen companion:
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 5 Progression Steps */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    📸 1
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                      Scan Real Pet Photo (AI Studio)
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                      Snap or upload a photo of your dog or cat. Gemini AI analyzes breed, coat colors, and assigns competitive Combat Power stats.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-pink-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-300 font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    🏡 2
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                      Train in Sanctuary & Conditioning Gym
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                      Feed treats, wash your pet, stroke affection, and train at the Gym for permanent HP, Speed, and Jaw Bite Force upgrades.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00]/20 text-[#CCFF00] font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    ⚔️ 3
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                      Ranked Battles in Colosseum Arena (1v1 & 2v2)
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                      Climb the global esports ladder! Use Clash-style Elixir timing, dodge attacks, block with Iron Guard, and trigger 60 FPS Overdrive Slams.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-amber-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    ⚖️ 4
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                      Sanctuary Pet Adoption Shelter
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                      Adopt or sponsor sanctuary pets using earned in-game credits, or re-home your trained champions into other trainers' kennels.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-purple-500/30 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300 font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    🖥️ 5
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                      Export Desktop Buddy (Chrome Extension)
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                      Export your exact active pet into a packaged browser companion that roams across your screen with voice repeater & posture alerts!
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'combat' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CCFF00] font-black uppercase text-xs">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Manual Interactive Combat (No Auto-Play!)</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  You are in complete tactical command! Your beast only strikes when you tap an ability card. Choose your moves wisely based on your stamina and opponent telegraphs:
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-white text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-cyan-400" />
                    <span>1. Quick Jab (15 STM · 0.75s)</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                    Low stamina, instantaneous snap strike. Builds your combo counter and charges 12% Ultimate meter!
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-amber-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400" />
                    <span>2. Heavy Maul (30 STM · 1.8s)</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                    Heavy kinetic attack utilizing jaw force & muscle weight. High critical strike multiplier!
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-[#CCFF00] text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]" />
                    <span>3. Signature Ability (40 STM)</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                    Unique to each beast (e.g. Tiger Ambush, Wolf Frost Rush, Lion Sovereign Roar). Devastating burst damage!
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-amber-500/30 rounded-xl p-3">
                  <div className="font-display font-bold text-amber-400 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                    <span>4. Apex Finisher (100% Ult)</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                    Charges as you land attacks and dodge. Once at 100%, unleash for an epic screen-shaking finisher move!
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="bg-[#141A22] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-2xl p-3">
                <div className="font-display font-bold text-cyan-300 text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Defensive Mastery: Dodge & Lock Guard</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 mt-1 leading-relaxed">
                  When you see the red warning banner <strong className="text-yellow-300">INCOMING STRIKE!</strong>, tap <strong>Evasion Dodge</strong> to completely nullify the attack, or toggle <strong>Lock Guard</strong> to absorb 75% of incoming damage!
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'training' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CCFF00] font-black uppercase text-xs">
                  <Dumbbell className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Permanent Beast Stat Progression</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Take any owned beast into the Conditioning Gym to permanently upgrade their combat attributes. Each workout costs 15 Energy and 800 Credits.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-400 shrink-0 font-bold">
                    +HP
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-emerald-300 text-xs">
                      1. Caloric Feed & Nutrition
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                      Gives <strong>+2 Endurance</strong> and increases your maximum arena hit points, allowing your beast to survive extended bouts.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-cyan-500/20 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/10 border border-cyan-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 shrink-0 font-bold">
                    +SPD
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-cyan-300 text-xs">
                      2. Sprint & Reflex Drills
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                      Gives <strong>+2 Agility & +1 Speed</strong>. Improves your evasion window and quick strike recovery speed.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-[#161822] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#CCFF00]/10 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 flex items-center justify-center text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 font-bold">
                    +PSI
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-display font-bold text-[#CCFF00] text-xs">
                      3. Bite-Force & Strength Rig
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                      Gives <strong>+2 Strength & +15 PSI Jaw Pressure</strong>. Multiplies damage dealt on both basic attacks and heavy mauls!
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'armory' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-cyan-300 font-black uppercase text-xs">
                  <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Tactical Loadout Slots</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Your active beast can equip up to 4 pieces of tactical hardware:
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px]">
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white uppercase text-[10px] text-amber-400">
                    Tactical Collar
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">Adds tracking speed & reaction.</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white uppercase text-[10px] text-cyan-400">
                    Body Exo-Rig
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">Provides flat armor to deflect damage.</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white uppercase text-[10px] text-emerald-400">
                    Paw Grip Sleeves
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">Enhances lateral traction & sprint.</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white uppercase text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00]">
                    Bio-Stim Serum
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">Gives adrenaline burst & stamina buffs.</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-[#121620] rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-neutral-300 text-[11px]">
                💡 <strong>Tip:</strong> Procure gear in the Armory Store using battle credits, then tap <strong>Equip</strong> in the Loadout tab to apply the stats directly to your active beast.
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'market' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-amber-500/20 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400 font-black uppercase text-xs">
                  <ShoppingCart className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Direct Market & Community Adoption Shelter</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Expand your roster across authentic real-world canine & feline breeds:
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="p-3 bg-[#161822] rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-xs">Direct Sanctuary Adoption</div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                    Instant adoption of available pets (Bengal Cats, Huskies, Shiba Inus, Rottweilers) using earned battle credits.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 bg-[#161822] rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                  <div className="font-bold text-emerald-300 text-xs">Community Adoption Shelter</div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                    Sponsor and adopt companion pets with 100% free earned in-game credits from community trainers and sanctuary shelters.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {activeTab === 'ranking' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="bg-[#141722] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 rounded-2xl p-3.5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[#CCFF00] font-black uppercase text-xs">
                  <Trophy className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Championship MMR & Achievements</span>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-1 text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Every victory in Ranked Arena bouts awards +45 MMR rating and bonus credits. Defeats cost -25 MMR.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px] text-center font-mono">
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-white/5">
                  <div className="text-amber-400 font-bold">1,000 - 1,200 MMR</div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 text-[10px]">Challenger League</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-cyan-500/30">
                  <div className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">1,200 - 1,500 MMR</div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 text-[10px]">Apex Vanguard</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#161822] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 col-span-2">
                  <div className="text-[#CCFF00] font-black text-xs">1,500+ MMR · Grandmaster Sovereign</div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 text-[10px]">Top 10 Global Leaderboard Contender</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Footer Button */}
        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
            Have fun and conquer the ring!
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] transition-colors cursor-pointer shadow-lg shadow-[#CCFF00]/20"
          >
            Got it, Let's Fight!
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import { X, Swords, Users, Shield, Trophy, Flame, Zap, Award } from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

export type GameModeType = '1v1' | '2v2' | 'survival' | 'duel';

interface GameModesModalProps {
  currentMode: GameModeType;
  onSelectMode: (mode: GameModeType) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const GameModesModal: React.FC<GameModesModalProps> = ({
  currentMode,
  onSelectMode,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const modes = [
    {
      id: '1v1' as GameModeType,
      title: '1v1 Ranked Colosseum',
      badge: 'Competitive Ladder',
      desc: 'Standard championship rules. Battle solo against live matched rivals to climb global MMR leagues.',
      reward: '+35 Trophies · +2,200 Gold',
      icon: Swords,
      themeColor: 'from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-500',
      badgeColor: 'text-[#CCFF00] bg-[#CCFF00]/10 border-[#CCFF00]/30',
    },
    {
      id: '2v2' as GameModeType,
      title: '2v2 Tag Team Arena',
      badge: 'Multiplayer Co-Op',
      desc: 'Pair up with an ally beast or friend. Tag in and out during combat to perform double-takedown combos!',
      reward: '+50 Trophies · +3,500 Gold',
      icon: Users,
      themeColor: 'from-cyan-400 to-blue-600',
      badgeColor: 'text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10 border-cyan-500/30',
    },
    {
      id: 'survival' as GameModeType,
      title: 'Survival Beast Gauntlet',
      badge: 'Endurance Wave',
      desc: 'Endure consecutive waves of apex predators with no health regeneration between rounds.',
      reward: 'Gems 💎 · Rare Gear Chest',
      icon: Flame,
      themeColor: 'from-amber-400 to-red-600',
      badgeColor: 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30',
    },
    {
      id: 'duel' as GameModeType,
      title: 'Friendly Duel (Unranked)',
      badge: 'Custom Match',
      desc: 'Spar against clanmates or friends with custom stamina multipliers and zero trophy loss penalty.',
      reward: 'Practice XP · Bragging Rights',
      icon: Shield,
      themeColor: 'from-purple-500 to-fuchsia-600',
      badgeColor: 'text-purple-400 bg-purple-500/10 border-purple-500/30',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md bg-[#0e121a] border-2 border-white/20 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#151c2a] border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Trophy className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Select Game Mode
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                Competitive 1v1 Arena & 2v2 Tag-Team Battle Modes
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-full text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Game Mode Cards */}
        <div className="p-4 space-y-3 overflow-y-auto max-h-[70vh]">
          {modes.map((mode) => {
            const Icon = mode.icon;
            const isSelected = currentMode === mode.id;

            return (
              <button
                key={mode.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playLevelUp();
                  onSelectMode(mode.id);
                  onClose();
                }}
                className={`w-full text-left p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow flex flex-col justify-between ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'bg-[#151c2d] border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] scale-[1.02]'
                    : 'bg-[#10141f] border-white/10 hover:border-white/25 hover:bg-[#141926]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div
                      className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${mode.themeColor} flex items-center justify-center text-black font-black shadow shrink-0`}
                    >
                      <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-white tracking-wide">
                        {mode.title}
                      </h4>
                      <span className={`inline-block text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border ${mode.badgeColor} mt-0.5`}>
                        {mode.badge}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {isSelected && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase">
                      ACTIVE
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 font-mono mt-2.5">
                  {mode.desc}
                </p>

                <div className="mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono">
                  <span className="text-neutral-400">Match Rewards:</span>
                  <span className="text-amber-300 font-bold">{mode.reward}</span>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
