<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Coins,
  Trophy,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  HelpCircle,
  Home,
  Plus,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { GameGuideModal } from './GameGuideModal';
import { AccountAuthModal } from './AccountAuthModal';
import { TokenRefillModal } from './TokenRefillModal';
import { ThemeToggle } from '../ThemeToggle';

interface GameTopBarProps {
  onOpenSystemDetails: () => void;
  onReturnToTitle?: () => void;
  onChallengeFriend?: (friend: any) => void;
  onStartPracticeDrill?: () => void;
  onOpenQuests?: () => void;
  onOpenLeaderboard?: () => void;
  onOpenRadar?: () => void;
}

export const GameTopBar: React.FC<GameTopBarProps> = ({
  onReturnToTitle,
  onChallengeFriend,
  onStartPracticeDrill,
  onOpenQuests,
  onOpenLeaderboard,
  onOpenRadar,
}) => {
  const {
    trainerName,
    setTrainerName,
    connectedAccount,
    playerTag,
    credits,
    trophies,
    soundEnabled,
    toggleSound,
  } = useGame();

  const [guideModalOpen, setGuideModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [authModalOpen, setAuthModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tokenRefillOpen, setTokenRefillOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <>
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 w-full max-w-full overflow-hidden bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#090D17]/98 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 shadow-md dark:shadow-xl px-2 sm:px-5 py-2 sm:py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between select-none text-slate-900 dark:text-white gap-1.5 sm:gap-3 transition-colors duration-300">
        {/* Left Side: Profile & Account (Truncates gracefully, NEVER overlaps right controls) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2.5 min-w-0 shrink">
          {onReturnToTitle && (
            <button
              onClick={onReturnToTitle}
              className="p-1.5 sm:p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-900/90 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer shrink-0 transition-colors shadow-xs"
              title="Return to Title Screen"
            >
              <Home className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
            </button>
          )}

          {/* Account Button (Google Cloud Player Hub) */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setAuthModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-900/90 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 rounded-xl px-1.5 sm:px-2.5 py-1 sm:py-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm min-w-0 shrink text-left"
            title="Google Player Hub"
          >
            {connectedAccount.avatarUrl ? (
              <div className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-7 sm:h-7 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border-2 border-emerald-500 dark:border-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                <img src={connectedAccount.avatarUrl} alt={trainerName} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
              </div>
            ) : connectedAccount.provider === 'Google' ? (
              <div className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-7 sm:h-7 rounded-lg bg-white flex items-center justify-center p-0.5 sm:p-1 shadow-sm shrink-0 border border-slate-200">
                <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path fill="#4285F4" d="M23.745 12.27c0-.7-.06-1.4-.19-2.07H12v4.51h6.6c-.29 1.52-1.14 2.82-2.4 3.68v3.05h3.88c2.27-2.09 3.665-5.17 3.665-9.17z"/>
                  <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 24c3.24 0 5.95-1.08 7.93-2.91l-3.88-3.05c-1.08.72-2.45 1.16-4.05 1.16-3.12 0-5.77-2.1-6.72-4.93H1.25v3.15C3.26 21.36 7.33 24 12 24z"/>
                  <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.28 14.27c-.25-.72-.38-1.49-.38-2.27s.13-1.55.38-2.27V6.58H1.25C.45 8.18 0 10.04 0 12s.45 3.82 1.25 5.42l4.03-3.15z"/>
                  <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 4.75c1.77 0 3.35.61 4.6 1.8l3.42-3.42C17.95 1.19 15.24 0 12 0 7.33 0 3.26 2.64 1.25 6.58l4.03 3.15c.95-2.83 3.6-4.98 6.72-4.98z"/>
                </svg>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="w-6 h-6 sm:w-7 sm:h-7 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-[10px] sm:text-xs shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                ID
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-col leading-tight min-w-0 pr-0.5 sm:pr-1">
              <span className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-base text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase truncate max-w-[60px] xs:max-w-[85px] sm:max-w-[140px] drop-shadow-xs">
                {trainerName}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-xs font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00] font-black truncate max-w-[60px] xs:max-w-[85px] sm:max-w-[140px]">
                {connectedAccount.isLoggedIn ? `${connectedAccount.provider} ✓` : playerTag}
              </span>
            </div>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Right Side: Resources & Utilities (Locked shrink-0, zero overlap) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-2.5 shrink-0">
          {/* Trophies Pill / Hall of Fame Leaderboard Trigger */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onOpenLeaderboard?.();
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 rounded-xl px-1.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 shadow-sm cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95"
            title="Hall of Fame Leaderboards (PvP Elo & OutbidPet)"
          >
            <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 tabular-nums">{trophies}</span>
          </button>

          {/* Interactive Coins Pill -> Opens TokenRefillModal */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setTokenRefillOpen(true);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 sm:gap-1.5 bg-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/25 border border-amber-500/40 hover:border-amber-500/70 rounded-xl px-1.5 sm:px-3 py-1 sm:py-1.5 shadow-sm cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95 group"
            title="Click to Refill or Earn Slam Tokens"
          >
            <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-amber-500 shrink-0 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform" />
            <span className="font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm font-black text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 tabular-nums">
              {credits.toLocaleString()}
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center justify-center w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 rounded-md bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-900 dark:text-amber-200 text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-black group-hover:bg-amber-500 group-hover:text-black transition-colors">
              +
            </span>
          </button>

          {/* Light / Dark Mode Toggle (Desktop & Tablet) */}
          <div className="hidden sm:block">
            <ThemeToggle />
          </div>

          {/* Sound Toggle */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleSound}
            className="flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-900/90 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:border-white/20 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
            title={soundEnabled ? 'Mute Audio' : 'Unmute Audio'}
          >
            {soundEnabled ? (
              <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00]" />
            ) : (
              <VolumeX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-slate-400" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Guide Button */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setGuideModalOpen(true)}
            className="flex items-center justify-center w-7 h-7 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 border border-slate-300 dark:bg-slate-900/90 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 dark:border-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-[#CCFF00] transition-colors cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-sm"
            title="Game Guide"
          >
            <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Guide Modal */}
      {guideModalOpen && (
        <GameGuideModal
          isOpen={guideModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setGuideModalOpen(false)}
          onStartPracticeDrill={onStartPracticeDrill}
        />
      )}

      {/* Account Auth Modal (Google Player Hub) */}
      {authModalOpen && (
        <AccountAuthModal
          currentTrainerName={trainerName}
          onUpdateTrainerName={setTrainerName}
          onClose={() => setAuthModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Token Refill Modal */}
      {tokenRefillOpen && (
        <TokenRefillModal
          isOpen={tokenRefillOpen}
          onClose={() => setTokenRefillOpen(false)}
          onOpenArena={onStartPracticeDrill}
          onOpenQuests={onOpenQuests}
          onOpenRadar={onOpenRadar}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document index="61">
<source>src/components/game/liveops/DailyQuestsDrawer.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Target,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle,
  Coins,
  Zap,
  Award,
  ChevronRight,
  Clock,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { triggerSuccessHaptic } from '../../../utils/haptics';

interface DailyQuestsDrawerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenPass?: () => void;
}

interface Quest {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  current: number;
  target: number;
  creditsReward: number;
  xpReward: number;
  isClaimed: boolean;
}

export const DailyQuestsDrawer: React.FC<DailyQuestsDrawerProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenPass,
}) => {
  const { addCredits } = useGame();

  const [quests, setQuests] = useState<Quest[]>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('petslam_daily_quests');
      if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
    } catch {}
    return [
      {
        id: 'q1',
        title: 'Apex Striker',
        description: 'Land 5 Pounces or Special Moves in Arena Combat',
        current: 3,
        target: 5,
        creditsReward: 250,
        xpReward: 60,
        isClaimed: false,
      },
      {
        id: 'q2',
        title: 'Sanctuary Caretaker',
        description: 'Feed, Wash, or Pet your companion in the Sanctuary',
        current: 3,
        target: 3,
        creditsReward: 150,
        xpReward: 40,
        isClaimed: false,
      },
      {
        id: 'q3',
        title: 'Ranked Gladiator',
        description: 'Compete in 1 Authoritative Ranked 1v1 Multiplayer Duel',
        current: 1,
        target: 1,
        creditsReward: 350,
        xpReward: 80,
        isClaimed: false,
      },
    ];
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleClaim = (questId: string) => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerSuccessHaptic();

    setQuests((prev) => {
      const updated = prev.map((q) => {
        if (q.id === questId) {
          addCredits(q.creditsReward);
          return { ...q, isClaimed: true };
        }
        return q;
      });
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('petslam_daily_quests', JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch {}
      return updated;
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-end bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-sm select-none font-sans animate-fadeIn">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-md h-full bg-[#080C16] border-l border-white/10 shadow-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-white animate-slideInRight">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0C1222] via-[#090D18] to-[#06080E]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-400/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)]">
              <Target className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Daily Arena Directives</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-cyan-400 text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black font-mono">
                  3 ACTIVE
                </span>
              </h2>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-neutral-400 font-mono mt-0.5">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Resets in: 14h 22m</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Quests List */}
        <div className="p-4 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-3">
          {quests.map((q) => {
            const isCompleted = q.current >= q.target;
            const pct = Math.min(100, (q.current / q.target) * 100);

            return (
              <div
                key={q.id}
                className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                  q.isClaimed
                    ? 'border-white/5 bg-[#0A0E18]/60 opacity-60'
                    : isCompleted
                    ? 'border-cyan-400/50 bg-[#0C1426] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)]'
                    : 'border-white/10 bg-[#0A0E1A]'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase">{q.title}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300">
                    {q.current} / {q.target}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mb-2 leading-relaxed">{q.description}</p>

                {/* Progress Bar */}
                <div className="w-full h-2 bg-black/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/10 p-0.5 mb-3">
                  <div
                    className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                      isCompleted ? 'bg-[#CCFF00]' : 'bg-cyan-400'
                    }`}
                    style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Rewards & Action */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono">
                    <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">+{q.creditsReward} Credits</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span className="text-cyan-300 font-bold">+{q.xpReward} Pass XP</span>
                  </div>

                  {q.isClaimed ? (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                      <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                      Claimed
                    </span>
                  ) : isCompleted ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleClaim(q.id)}
                      className="py-1 px-3 rounded-lg bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-mono text-[10px] font-black uppercase cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)] active:scale-95"
                    >
                      Claim Reward
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-500 font-bold">
                      In Progress
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Footer CTA to Battle Pass */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-[#0A0E18]">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              onClose();
              onOpenPass?.();
            }}
            className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/15 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-98"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
            <span>View Slam Battle Pass (50 Tiers)</span>
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-auto" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/liveops/SlamBattlePassModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Crown,
  Lock,
  CheckCircle,
  Sparkles,
  Zap,
  Coins,
  Award,
  ChevronRight,
  Shield,
  Gift,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { triggerLightImpactHaptic, triggerSuccessHaptic } from '../../../utils/haptics';

interface SlamBattlePassModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const SlamBattlePassModal: React.FC<SlamBattlePassModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { trainerName, credits, addCredits, hasExtensionPass } = useGame();

  const [currentTier, setCurrentTier] = useState<number>(() => {
    try {
      return Number(localStorage.getItem('petslam_pass_tier')) || 12;
    } catch {
      return 12;
    }
  });

  const [hasVipPass, setHasVipPass] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_pass_vip_pass') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const [claimedTiers, setClaimedTiers] = useState<Record<number, { free: boolean; vip: boolean }>>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('petslam_claimed_tiers');
      return saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : { 1: { free: true, vip: false }, 2: { free: true, vip: false } };
    } catch {
      return {};
    }
  });

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Generate 50 tiers
  const tiers = Array.from({ length: 50 }, (_, i) => {
    const tierNum = i + 1;
    const isFreeSpecial = tierNum % 5 === 0;
    const isVipSpecial = tierNum % 10 === 0;

    return {
      tier: tierNum,
      freeReward: isFreeSpecial ? `${tierNum * 100} Credits + Rare Berry` : `${tierNum * 50} Credits`,
      freeCredits: isFreeSpecial ? tierNum * 100 : tierNum * 50,
      vipReward: isVipSpecial
        ? `✦ Cyber Morph Skin + ${tierNum * 300} Credits`
        : `Holo Shard + ${tierNum * 150} Credits`,
      vipCredits: isVipSpecial ? tierNum * 300 : tierNum * 150,
    };
  });

  const handleClaimReward = (tier: number, track: 'free' | 'vip', creditAmount: number) => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerSuccessHaptic();
    addCredits(creditAmount);

    setClaimedTiers((prev) => {
      const updated = {
        ...prev,
        [tier]: {
          free: track === 'free' ? true : prev[tier]?.free || false,
          vip: track === 'vip' ? true : prev[tier]?.vip || false,
        },
      };
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('petslam_claimed_tiers', JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch {}
      return updated;
    });
  };

  const handleUnlockVip = () => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerVictoryExplosion();
    setHasVipPass(true);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('petslam_pass_vip_pass', 'true');
    } catch {}
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none font-sans">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-4xl bg-[#080C16] border border-amber-500/40 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_0_60px_rgba(251,191,36,0.25)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-white max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header Banner */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-950/40 via-[#130E1E] to-[#0A0D16]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/50 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.3)]">
              <Crown className="w-6 h-6" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-base font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                  Slam Pass · Season 1: Cyber Genesis
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-amber-400 text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black font-mono">
                  TIER {currentTier} / 50
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
                Level up by battling in Arena & completing Daily Quests · 50 Premium Tiers
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {!hasVipPass && (
              <button
                onClick={handleUnlockVip}
                className="py-2 px-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 hover:from-amber-300 hover:to-amber-400 text-black font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.4)] active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                <span>Unlock VIP Pass ($4.99)</span>
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Horizontal Scrollable Timeline */}
        <div className="p-4 flex-1 overflow-x-auto space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 min-w-max pb-4">
            {tiers.map((t) => {
              const isUnlocked = currentTier >= t.tier;
              const isFreeClaimed = claimedTiers[t.tier]?.free;
              const isVipClaimed = claimedTiers[t.tier]?.vip;

              return (
                <div
                  key={t.tier}
                  className={`w-44 rounded-2xl border p-3 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all ${
                    isUnlocked
                      ? 'border-amber-400/50 bg-[#0E1424] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.15)]'
                      : 'border-white/10 bg-[#090D18] opacity-75'
                  }`}
                >
                  {/* Tier Number & Progress */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/10 text-xs font-mono">
                    <span className="font-black text-amber-300">TIER {t.tier}</span>
                    {isUnlocked ? (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 font-bold">UNLOCKED ✓</span>
                    ) : (
                      <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-500" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* Free Track Card */}
                  <div className="my-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase">
                      Free Track
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-white truncate">{t.freeReward}</div>
                    {isUnlocked ? (
                      isFreeClaimed ? (
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                          <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Claimed
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleClaimReward(t.tier, 'free', t.freeCredits)}
                          className="w-full py-1 rounded bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-mono text-[10px] font-black uppercase cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          Claim
                        </button>
                      )
                    ) : (
                      <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-500">Locked</div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* VIP Track Card */}
                  <div
                    className={`p-2 rounded-xl border space-y-1 ${
                      hasVipPass
                        ? 'bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-500/40'
                        : 'bg-black/60 border-dashed border-white/15'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300 uppercase flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span>VIP Track</span>
                      <Crown className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-amber-400" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-amber-100 truncate">{t.vipReward}</div>
                    {hasVipPass ? (
                      isUnlocked ? (
                        isVipClaimed ? (
                          <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-amber-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Claimed
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleClaimReward(t.tier, 'vip', t.vipCredits)}
                            className="w-full py-1 rounded bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-black font-mono text-[10px] font-black uppercase cursor-pointer"
                          >
                            Claim VIP
                          </button>
                        )
                      ) : (
                        <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-500">Reach Lv.{t.tier}</div>
                      )
                    ) : (
                      <div className="text-[9px] font-mono text-amber-400/70">VIP Pass Required</div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/MatchmakingModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Swords, Shield, Trophy, Sparkles, User, Zap, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { Animal, ANIMALS_DATA } from '../../data/animals';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface MatchmakingModalProps {
  playerBeast: Animal;
  trainerName: string;
  trophies: number;
  playerLevel: number;
  onMatchFound: (opponent: Animal, opponentTrainer: string) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

const BOT_TRAINERS = [
  { name: 'ApexStriker', tag: '#CLAW99', trophiesDelta: 15 },
  { name: 'ViperKing', tag: '#VIPER7', trophiesDelta: -10 },
  { name: 'ColosseumMax', tag: '#GLAD42', trophiesDelta: 30 },
  { name: 'ShadowClaw', tag: '#NIGHT8', trophiesDelta: -5 },
  { name: 'TitanTamer', tag: '#TITAN1', trophiesDelta: 25 },
  { name: 'WildFury', tag: '#FURY88', trophiesDelta: 10 },
  { name: 'BrawlChampion', tag: '#WINNER', trophiesDelta: 40 },
];

export const MatchmakingModal: React.FC<MatchmakingModalProps> = ({
  playerBeast,
  trainerName,
  trophies,
  playerLevel,
  onMatchFound,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'searching' | 'found' | 'versus'>('searching');
  const [searchTime, setSearchTime] = useState<number>(0);
  const [displayOpponent, setDisplayOpponent] = useState<Animal>(ANIMALS_DATA[1]);
  const [displayTrainer, setDisplayTrainer] = useState<string>('Searching...');
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(3);

  // Available rivals excluding active beast
  const candidates = ANIMALS_DATA.filter((b) => b.id !== playerBeast.id);

  // Matchmaking simulation effect
  useEffect(() => {
    sound.playMatchSearch();
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setSearchTime((prev) => prev + 1);
      // Rapid shuffle of candidates
      const randomBeast = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];
      const randomTrainer = BOT_TRAINERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * BOT_TRAINERS.length)];
      setDisplayOpponent(randomBeast);
      setDisplayTrainer(randomTrainer.name);
      sound.playMatchSearch();
    }, 450);

    // Pick final match after 2.2 seconds
    const matchTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      const chosenBeast = candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)] || candidates[0];
      const chosenTrainer = BOT_TRAINERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * BOT_TRAINERS.length)];
      setDisplayOpponent(chosenBeast);
      setDisplayTrainer(chosenTrainer.name);
      setPhase('found');
      sound.playMatchFound();

      // Transition to VS clash
      setTimeout(() => {
        setPhase('versus');
      }, 900);
    }, 2200);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      clearTimeout(matchTimer);
    };
  }, []);

  // Countdown timer in versus phase
  useEffect(() => {
    if (phase !== 'versus') return;
    if (countdown > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setCountdown((c) => c - 1);
        sound.playCardSelect();
      }, 700);
      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    } else {
      // Launch match!
      onMatchFound(displayOpponent, displayTrainer);
    }
  }, [phase, countdown, displayOpponent, displayTrainer, onMatchFound]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0e111a] border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] flex flex-col">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#161a26] border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Swords className="w-5 h-5 text-[#CCFF00] animate-pulse" />
            <span className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
              {phase === 'searching'
                ? 'Apex Global Live Matchmaking'
                : phase === 'found'
                ? 'Challenger Located!'
                : 'Colosseum Arena Clash'}
            </span>
          </div>

          {phase === 'searching' && (
            <button
              onClick={onCancel}
              className="p-1 rounded-full text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Searching Phase */}
        {phase === 'searching' && (
          <div className="p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center space-y-6">
            {/* Spinning Radar Animation */}
            <div className="relative w-36 h-36 flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/30 animate-ping opacity-30" />
              <div className="absolute inset-2 rounded-full border border-dashed border-[#CCFF00]/50 animate-spin" />
              <div className="absolute inset-6 rounded-full bg-[#182032] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                <img
                  src={displayOpponent.image}
                  alt="searching"
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover scale-110 filter brightness-75 transition-all duration-300"
                  onError={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.src = displayOpponent.fallbackImage;
                  }}
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/40 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <Swords className="w-8 h-8 text-[#CCFF00] animate-bounce" />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1">
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-xl text-white tracking-wide">
                Searching for Opponent...
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
                Finding rival in <span className="text-[#CCFF00]">Apex Arena Tier III</span> ({searchTime}s)
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Scrolling Opponent Preview */}
            <div className="w-full bg-[#141824] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
                  <img
                    src={displayOpponent.image}
                    alt={displayOpponent.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      e.currentTarget.src = displayOpponent.fallbackImage;
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-left">
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase">{displayTrainer}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono">{displayOpponent.name} · Lvl {displayOpponent.level}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-400 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
                <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>{trophies + Math.floor(Math.random() * 40 - 20)}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={onCancel}
              className="px-6 py-2 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 hover:bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-300 font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all"
            >
              Cancel Search
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Found / Versus Phase */}
        {(phase === 'found' || phase === 'versus') && (
          <div className="p-6 flex flex-col items-center space-y-6">
            <div className="w-full text-center">
              <span className="inline-block px-4 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider animate-bounce shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)]">
                MATCH READY!
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Split Screen Matchup Cards */}
            <div className="w-full grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 relative">
              {/* Center VS Emblem */}
              <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-20 w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-red-600 border-2 border-white shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(239,68,68,0.8)] flex items-center justify-center font-display font-black text-lg text-white italic scale-110 animate-pulse">
                VS
              </div>

              {/* Player Side */}
              <div className="bg-[#141824] border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/50 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-lg">
                  <img
                    src={playerBeast.image}
                    alt={playerBeast.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      e.currentTarget.src = playerBeast.fallbackImage;
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white uppercase">{trainerName}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{playerBeast.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">{playerBeast.species} · {playerBeast.weightKg}kg</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-400 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
                  <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{trophies}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Opponent Side */}
              <div className="bg-[#141824] border-2 border-red-500/50 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col items-center text-center space-y-2">
                <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-red-500 shadow-lg">
                  <img
                    src={displayOpponent.image}
                    alt={displayOpponent.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      e.currentTarget.src = displayOpponent.fallbackImage;
                    }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white uppercase">{displayTrainer}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-red-400 font-bold">{displayOpponent.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">{displayOpponent.species} · {displayOpponent.weightKg}kg</p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-400 text-xs font-mono font-bold">
                  <Trophy className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{trophies + 25}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Countdown to Battle */}
            <div className="w-full text-center space-y-1">
              <p className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                Entering Arena in
              </p>
              <div className="font-display font-black text-3xl text-[#CCFF00] animate-ping">
                {countdown > 0 ? countdown : 'FIGHT!'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/MobileGameContainer.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { ArrowLeft, FileCode, Maximize2, Minimize2, Smartphone, Monitor } from 'lucide-react';
import { GameTopBar } from './GameTopBar';
import { GameBottomNav, GameTab } from './GameBottomNav';
import { ArenaScreen } from './screens/ArenaScreen';
import { BeastsScreen } from './screens/BeastsScreen';
import { PetSanctuaryScreen } from './screens/PetSanctuaryScreen';
import { MarketScreen } from './screens/MarketScreen';
import { ArmoryScreen } from './screens/ArmoryScreen';
import { ProfileScreen } from './screens/ProfileScreen';
import { FloatingPetOverlay } from './pet/FloatingPetOverlay';
import { SystemRequiredDetailsPage } from '../SystemRequiredDetailsPage';
import { AlphaQueueModal } from './AlphaQueueModal';

interface MobileGameContainerProps {
  onReturnToTitle?: () => void;
}

export const MobileGameContainer: React.FC<MobileGameContainerProps> = ({ onReturnToTitle }) => {
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<GameTab>('arena');
  const [showSystemDetails, setShowSystemDetails] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showAlphaQueue, setShowAlphaQueue] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isWideView, setIsWideView] = useState<boolean>(true);

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen w-full bg-[#07090E] text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-x-hidden select-none">
      {/* Ambient Colosseum Stadium Lights in Background (Desktop) */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-0 hidden md:block">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/3 -translate-x-1/2 w-[600px] h-[600px] bg-cyan-500/10 blur-[160px] rounded-full" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 right-1/3 translate-x-1/2 w-[600px] h-[600px] bg-amber-500/10 blur-[160px] rounded-full" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#1e293b60_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:24px_24px] opacity-40" />
      </div>

      {/* Desktop Viewport Width Toggle Pill */}
      <div className="hidden md:flex fixed top-3 right-4 z-50 items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#141A28]/90 border border-white/15 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md shadow-xl text-xs font-mono">
        <span className="text-neutral-400 text-[11px]">Display:</span>
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsWideView(false)}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-all ${
            !isWideView ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <Smartphone className="w-3 h-3" />
          <span>Phone</span>
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setIsWideView(true)}
          className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-all ${
            isWideView ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold' : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
          }`}
        >
          <Monitor className="w-3 h-3" />
          <span>Web Desktop</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Main Responsive Game Frame */}
      <div className={`relative z-10 w-full flex flex-col h-[100dvh] md:h-[min(95vh,920px)] ${
        isWideView ? 'md:max-w-2xl lg:max-w-3xl' : 'md:max-w-[440px]'
      } md:my-auto md:rounded-[36px] md:border-4 md:border-[#1E293B] md:shadow-[0_25px_80px_rgba(0,0,0,0.85)] bg-[#0B0E17] overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300`}>
        {showSystemDetails ? (
          /* System Required Details View */
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0B0C10] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-[#12141A] border-b border-white/10 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowSystemDetails(false)}
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[#CCFF00] hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Back to Game</span>
              </button>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-mono text-neutral-300">
                <FileCode className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>System Required Details</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
              <SystemRequiredDetailsPage
                onBackToLanding={() => setShowSystemDetails(false)}
                onJoinWaitlist={() => setShowAlphaQueue(true)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* Standard 5-Screen Mobile Game Experience */
          <>
            {/* Top Bar with Wallet & Status */}
            <GameTopBar
              onOpenSystemDetails={() => setShowSystemDetails(true)}
              onReturnToTitle={onReturnToTitle}
            />

            {/* Active Screen Display */}
            <main className="flex-1 overflow-hidden relative">
              {currentTab === 'arena' && <ArenaScreen />}
              {currentTab === 'buddy' && (
                <PetSanctuaryScreen onGoToArena={() => setCurrentTab('arena')} />
              )}
              {currentTab === 'beasts' && <BeastsScreen />}
              {currentTab === 'market' && <MarketScreen />}
              {currentTab === 'armory' && <ArmoryScreen />}
              {currentTab === 'profile' && (
                <ProfileScreen onOpenSystemDetails={() => setShowSystemDetails(true)} />
              )}
            </main>

            {/* Floating Desktop Screen Overlay Companion (roams on screen) */}
            {currentTab !== 'buddy' && (
              <FloatingPetOverlay onOpenSanctuary={() => setCurrentTab('buddy')} />
            )}

            {/* Fixed Bottom Navigation (Arena, Buddy, Beasts, Market, Armory, Profile) */}
            <GameBottomNav
              currentTab={currentTab}
              onTabChange={(tab) => setCurrentTab(tab)}
            />
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      <AlphaQueueModal
        isOpen={showAlphaQueue}
        onClose={() => setShowAlphaQueue(false)}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/pet/BreedingLabModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Dna,
  Sparkles,
  Heart,
  Zap,
  Egg,
  Award,
  Shield,
  ChevronRight,
  Flame,
  CheckCircle,
  Crown,
  Coins,
  ChevronDown,
  RotateCcw,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'motion/react';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { CompanionPet, PetRarity } from '../../../types/pet';
import { Animal } from '../../../data/animals';
import { animalImages } from '../../../assets/images';
import {
  breedCompanionPets,
  hatchEggToCompanionPet,
  EggEntity,
  getPetRarity,
  calculateAscensionChance,
  RARITY_BADGE_COLORS,
} from '../../../utils/Genetics';
import { ProceduralPetCanvas } from './ProceduralPetCanvas';
import { triggerHeavyImpactHaptic, triggerMediumImpactHaptic } from '../../../utils/haptics';

interface BreedingLabModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const MENTOR_PET: CompanionPet = {
  id: 'mentor_parent',
  name: 'Alpha Luna',
  title: 'Sanctuary Alpha Mentor',
  species: 'husky',
  category: 'dog',
  stage: 2,
  level: 15,
  exp: 0,
  maxExp: 100,
  affectionHearts: 5,
  affectionPoints: 100,
  hunger: 100,
  happiness: 100,
  energy: 100,
  mood: 'excited',
  rarity: 'epic',
  stats: { attack: 85, defense: 78, agility: 82, stamina: 80, cp: 580 },
  battleBuff: {
    name: 'Alpha Aura',
    description: '+15% Genetic Prowess',
    effectType: 'crit_chance',
    potency: 15,
  },
  createdAt: Date.now(),
  lastFedAt: Date.now(),
  lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
  totalPats: 10,
  totalBerriesEaten: 5,
  caughtAt: 'Sanctuary Elite Roster',
  customPalette: {
    primary: '#38BDF8',
    secondary: '#0284C7',
    belly: '#F0F9FF',
    ear: '#E0F2FE',
    eye: '#F59E0B',
    nose: '#0F172A',
  },
};

export const BreedingLabModal: React.FC<BreedingLabModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { kennelPets, pet, addCustomAvatarPet } = usePetCompanion();
  const { registerCustomFighter, credits, addCredits } = useGame();

  const [parent1, setParent1] = useState<CompanionPet | null>(null);
  const [parent2, setParent2] = useState<CompanionPet | null>(null);
  const [selectingSlot, setSelectingSlot] = useState<1 | 2 | null>(null);
  const [currentEgg, setCurrentEgg] = useState<EggEntity | null>(null);
  const [hatchCountdown, setHatchCountdown] = useState<number>(10);
  const [isHatching, setIsHatching] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [hatchedPet, setHatchedPet] = useState<CompanionPet | null>(null);
  const [feeError, setFeeError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const BREEDING_FEE_CREDITS = 500;

  // Aggregate all unique selectable pets (kennel + active pet + mentor)
  const candidatePets: CompanionPet[] = React.useMemo(() => {
    const list: CompanionPet[] = [];
    const seen = new Set<string>();

    if (pet && !seen.has(pet.id)) {
      list.push(pet);
      seen.add(pet.id);
    }
    if (kennelPets) {
      kennelPets.forEach((p) => {
        if (!seen.has(p.id)) {
          list.push(p);
          seen.add(p.id);
        }
      });
    }
    if (!seen.has(MENTOR_PET.id)) {
      list.push(MENTOR_PET);
      seen.add(MENTOR_PET.id);
    }
    return list;
  }, [kennelPets, pet]);

  // Auto-select initial parents
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!parent1 && candidatePets.length > 0) {
      setParent1(candidatePets[0]);
    }
    if (!parent2) {
      if (candidatePets.length > 1) {
        setParent2(candidatePets[1]);
      } else {
        setParent2(MENTOR_PET);
      }
    }
  }, [candidatePets, parent1, parent2]);

  // Egg Incubation countdown timer
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentEgg || currentEgg.isReadyToHatch) return;

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setHatchCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(timer);
          setCurrentEgg((egg) => (egg ? { ...egg, isReadyToHatch: true } : null));
          sound.playLevelUp();
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [currentEgg]);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleStartBreeding = () => {
    setFeeError(null);
    if (!parent1 || !parent2) return;
    if (parent1.id === parent2.id) {
      setFeeError('Select two different parents to breed!');
      sound.playClick();
      return;
    }

    if (credits < BREEDING_FEE_CREDITS) {
      setFeeError(`Insufficient Slam Credits! Need ${BREEDING_FEE_CREDITS.toLocaleString()} credits.`);
      sound.playClick();
      return;
    }

    // Deduct breeding fee
    addCredits(-BREEDING_FEE_CREDITS);
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerMediumImpactHaptic();

    const egg = breedCompanionPets(parent1, parent2);
    setCurrentEgg(egg);
    setHatchCountdown(egg.hatchDurationSeconds);
    setHatchedPet(null);
  };

  const handleHatchEgg = () => {
    if (!currentEgg) return;
    setIsHatching(true);
    sound.playAttack();
    triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();

    setTimeout(() => {
      const babyPet = hatchEggToCompanionPet(currentEgg);
      setHatchedPet(babyPet);
      setIsHatching(false);
      sound.playVictory();
      triggerVictoryExplosion();

      // Register baby pet into Companion Kennel
      addCustomAvatarPet(babyPet);

      // Register into GameContext as playable arena beast
      const fighter: Animal = {
        id: `fighter_${babyPet.id}`,
        name: babyPet.name,
        species: babyPet.species,
        breed: babyPet.breedName || babyPet.species,
        scientificName: babyPet.isChimera ? 'Chimaera Hybrid' : 'Canis / Felis Gen-2',
        category: babyPet.category === 'cat' ? 'Felines' : 'Canines',
        rarity: babyPet.rarity === 'mythic' ? 'Legendary' : babyPet.rarity === 'legendary' ? 'Legendary' : 'Rare',
        level: 5,
        health: 1100 + (babyPet.stats.defense * 2),
        damage: 180 + Math.round(babyPet.stats.attack * 0.4),
        speed: 84 + Math.round(babyPet.stats.agility * 0.2),
        weightKg: 25,
        biteForcePsi: 220,
        topSpeedKmh: 48,
        strikeJoules: 680,
        elixirCost: 3,
        strength: 84,
        endurance: 84,
        agility: 86,
        biteForce: 230,
        image: animalImages.bengalTiger,
        fallbackImage: animalImages.bengalTiger,
        acquisitionStatus: 'Available',
        currentPriceCredits: 12000,
        combatArchetype: 'Precision Striker',
        description: `Bred Gen-2 prodigy combining traits from ${currentEgg.parent1Name} & ${currentEgg.parent2Name}.`,
        signatureAbility: `${babyPet.customFeatures?.signatureMove?.name || 'Chimera Slam'}: Inherited genetic fury.`,
      };
      registerCustomFighter(fighter);
    }, 1400);
  };

  const p1Rarity = parent1 ? getPetRarity(parent1) : 'common';
  const p2Rarity = parent2 ? getPetRarity(parent2) : 'common';
  const ascensionOdds = parent1 && parent2 ? calculateAscensionChance(parent1, parent2) : 0.3;
  const isChimeraPair = parent1 && parent2 && (parent1.species !== parent2.species || parent1.category !== parent2.category);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none font-sans">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#080C16] border border-fuchsia-500/40 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(217,70,239,0.25)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-white max-h-[92vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-[#1E0F2E] via-[#120A1D] to-[#080C16]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-fuchsia-500/20 border border-fuchsia-400/50 flex items-center justify-center text-fuchsia-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(217,70,239,0.3)]">
              <Dna className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                  Breeding Genetics & Hybrid Lab
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-fuchsia-400 text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black font-mono">
                  GEN-2 PROTOCOL
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Choose Parents · 5-Tier Rarity Ladder · Chimera Hybrid Fusions
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-mono">
              <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{credits.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-4">
          {!currentEgg ? (
            /* STEP 1: SELECT PARENTS & PREVIEW GENETICS */
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {/* Parent 1 Slot */}
                <div
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playClick();
                    setSelectingSlot(1);
                  }}
                  className="bg-[#101424] hover:bg-[#131930] border-2 border-cyan-500/40 hover:border-cyan-400 rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col items-center text-center cursor-pointer transition-all group relative overflow-hidden"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 uppercase">
                      Parent 1 (Alpha)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] bg-cyan-950 text-cyan-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-cyan-500/40 group-hover:bg-cyan-500 group-hover:text-black font-mono">
                      Change ▾
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border border-white/15 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden mb-2 relative">
                    {parent1 && (
                      <ProceduralPetCanvas
                        species={parent1.species}
                        stage={1}
                        width={90}
                        height={90}
                        interactive={false}
                        customPalette={parent1.customPalette}
                        customFeatures={parent1.customFeatures}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase truncate max-w-[140px]">
                    {parent1?.name || 'Select Pet'}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                    <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p1Rarity].bg} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p1Rarity].text} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p1Rarity].border}`}>
                      {p1Rarity}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                      Lv.{parent1?.level || 1} · CP {parent1?.stats.cp || 400}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Parent 2 Slot */}
                <div
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playClick();
                    setSelectingSlot(2);
                  }}
                  className="bg-[#1A1024] hover:bg-[#221430] border-2 border-fuchsia-500/40 hover:border-fuchsia-400 rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col items-center text-center cursor-pointer transition-all group relative overflow-hidden"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-fuchsia-300 uppercase">
                      Parent 2 (Beta)
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] bg-fuchsia-950 text-fuchsia-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-fuchsia-500/40 group-hover:bg-fuchsia-500 group-hover:text-black font-mono">
                      Change ▾
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border border-white/15 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden mb-2 relative">
                    {parent2 && (
                      <ProceduralPetCanvas
                        species={parent2.species}
                        stage={1}
                        width={90}
                        height={90}
                        interactive={false}
                        customPalette={parent2.customPalette}
                        customFeatures={parent2.customFeatures}
                      />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase truncate max-w-[140px]">
                    {parent2?.name || 'Select Pet'}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1">
                    <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p2Rarity].bg} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p2Rarity].text} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[p2Rarity].border}`}>
                      {p2Rarity}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                      Lv.{parent2?.level || 1} · CP {parent2?.stats.cp || 400}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Hybrid & Rarity Fusion Prediction Banner */}
              <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-950/40 via-[#101526] to-cyan-950/40 border border-fuchsia-500/30 rounded-2xl p-3.5 space-y-2.5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono font-bold">
                  <span className="text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-fuchsia-400" />
                    <span>Genetic Fusion Compatibility</span>
                  </span>
                  {isChimeraPair ? (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-cyan-400 text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black uppercase tracking-wider animate-pulse">
                      🧬 CHIMERA HYBRID
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-[10px] bg-white/10 text-cyan-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-cyan-500/30">
                      PUREBRED GEN-2
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Rarity Ladder Tier Progression Callout */}
                <div className="bg-black/50 p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="text-neutral-400 text-[11px]">Rarity Projection:</span>
                    <span className="text-white font-bold uppercase">{p1Rarity} × {p2Rarity}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00] font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>{Math.round(ascensionOdds * 100)}% Chance to Ascend Tier! ⬆</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Projected Biometrics */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 text-center font-mono text-[10px]">
                  <div className="bg-black/40 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                    <div className="text-neutral-400">EST. ATK</div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-400">
                      {Math.round(((parent1?.stats.attack || 70) + (parent2?.stats.attack || 80)) / 2)} ±10%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-black/40 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                    <div className="text-neutral-400">EST. DEF</div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-400">
                      {Math.round(((parent1?.stats.defense || 70) + (parent2?.stats.defense || 75)) / 2)} ±10%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-black/40 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                    <div className="text-neutral-400">EST. AGI</div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">
                      {Math.round(((parent1?.stats.agility || 75) + (parent2?.stats.agility || 85)) / 2)} ±10%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-black/40 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
                    <div className="text-neutral-400">EST. CP</div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
                      {Math.round(((parent1?.stats.cp || 500) + (parent2?.stats.cp || 580)) / 2)} ±10%
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono italic">
                  Cross-breeding merges facial markings & blended coat pigments into a procedural Chimera offspring!
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Breeding Resource Fee & Action */}
              {feeError && (
                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-rose-400 bg-rose-950/40 border border-rose-500/40 p-2 rounded-xl text-center">
                  {feeError}
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-neutral-300 px-1">
                <span>Sanctuary Daycare Breeding Fee:</span>
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>500 Credits</span>
                  {credits < BREEDING_FEE_CREDITS ? (
                    <span className="text-rose-400 text-[10px] ml-1">(Need More)</span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-emerald-400 text-[10px] ml-1">✓ Available</span>
                  )}
                </span>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleStartBreeding}
                className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-cyan-400 hover:from-fuchsia-400 hover:to-cyan-300 text-black font-black text-xs py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(217,70,239,0.35)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer active:scale-98 transition-all"
              >
                <Dna className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                <span>Initiate Genetic Fusion & Incubate Egg (500 Credits)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : !hatchedPet ? (
            /* STEP 2: EGG INCUBATION & HATCHING ANIMATION */
            <div className="space-y-6 py-6 text-center animate-fadeIn">
              <div className="relative w-36 h-36 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                {/* Radiant Glow Behind Egg */}
                <div
                  className={`absolute inset-0 rounded-full blur-2xl transition-all duration-700 ${
                    currentEgg.rarity === 'mythic'
                      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 via-rose-500 to-cyan-400 opacity-90 animate-pulse'
                      : currentEgg.isMutant
                      ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-lime-400 opacity-70 animate-pulse'
                      : 'bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-fuchsia-500 opacity-40'
                  }`}
                />

                {/* Framer Motion Animated Cyber Egg */}
                <motion.div
                  animate={
                    isHatching
                      ? { rotate: [-10, 10, -15, 15, -20, 20, 0], scale: [1, 1.25, 0.9, 1.3, 0] }
                      : currentEgg.isReadyToHatch
                      ? { rotate: [-4, 4, -4], scale: [1, 1.05, 1] }
                      : { y: [0, -6, 0] }
                  }
                  transition={
                    isHatching
                      ? { duration: 1.4 }
                      : { repeat: Infinity, duration: currentEgg.isReadyToHatch ? 0.6 : 2 }
                  }
                  className="relative z-10 w-28 h-36 rounded-[50%_50%_45%_45%] border-2 border-white/30 p-2 shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer"
                  style={{
                    background: `radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #FFFFFF 0%, ${currentEgg.offspringPalette.primary} 50%, ${currentEgg.offspringPalette.secondary} 100%)`,
                  }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    if (currentEgg.isReadyToHatch && !isHatching) handleHatchEgg();
                  }}
                >
                  <Egg className="w-12 h-12 text-white/80" />
                </motion.div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider">
                  {currentEgg.isReadyToHatch ? 'EGG IS READY TO CRACK!' : 'INCUBATING GENETIC EMBRYO...'}
                </h3>
                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-fuchsia-300 mt-1">
                  Parents: {currentEgg.parent1Name} × {currentEgg.parent2Name}
                </div>
                {currentEgg.ascendedTier && (
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] font-bold mt-1">
                    ✨ Rarity Ascension Activated! Ascended to {currentEgg.rarity.toUpperCase()}!
                  </div>
                )}
                {!currentEgg.isReadyToHatch && (
                  <div className="text-2xl font-mono font-black text-[#CCFF00] mt-2">
                    {hatchCountdown}s
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {currentEgg.isReadyToHatch ? (
                <button
                  onClick={handleHatchEgg}
                  disabled={isHatching}
                  className="w-full max-w-sm mx-auto bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black text-xs py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer active:scale-98 transition-all animate-bounce"
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                  <span>Crack Egg & Reveal Offspring!</span>
                </button>
              ) : (
                <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                  Stabilizing chromosome pairs & synthesizing coat pigments...
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* STEP 3: HATCH REVEAL & BABY STATS */
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2 text-center animate-fadeIn">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 mx-auto rounded-3xl bg-[#CCFF00]/20 text-[#CCFF00] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 flex items-center justify-center shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]">
                <Crown className="w-7 h-7" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                  <span className={`text-[10px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full border ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[hatchedPet.rarity || 'common'].bg} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[hatchedPet.rarity || 'common'].text} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[hatchedPet.rarity || 'common'].border}`}>
                    {hatchedPet.rarity?.toUpperCase() || 'COMMON'}
                  </span>
                  {hatchedPet.isChimera && (
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-fuchsia-950 text-fuchsia-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-fuchsia-400">
                      CHIMERA HYBRID
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <h3 className="text-2xl font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider mt-1.5">
                  {hatchedPet.name}
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300">
                  {hatchedPet.breedName} · Combat Power: CP {hatchedPet.stats.cp}
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Baby Pet Interactive Avatar */}
              <div className="w-40 h-40 mx-auto rounded-2xl bg-black/50 border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/50 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.2)]">
                <ProceduralPetCanvas
                  species={hatchedPet.species}
                  stage={1}
                  width={150}
                  height={150}
                  interactive={true}
                  customPalette={hatchedPet.customPalette}
                  customFeatures={hatchedPet.customFeatures}
                  showAura={hatchedPet.rarity === 'mythic' || hatchedPet.rarity === 'legendary'}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Stats Grid */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 max-w-sm mx-auto font-mono text-[10px]">
                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <div className="text-neutral-400">ATK</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-400">{hatchedPet.stats.attack}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <div className="text-neutral-400">DEF</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-400">{hatchedPet.stats.defense}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <div className="text-neutral-400">AGI</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">{hatchedPet.stats.agility}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <div className="text-neutral-400">STA</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-400">{hatchedPet.stats.stamina}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {hatchedPet.customFeatures?.signatureMove && (
                <div className="bg-black/40 border border-fuchsia-500/30 rounded-xl p-2.5 max-w-sm mx-auto text-left font-mono text-[11px]">
                  <div className="text-fuchsia-400 font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{hatchedPet.customFeatures.signatureMove.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-neutral-400 text-[10px] mt-0.5">
                    {hatchedPet.customFeatures.signatureMove.description}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              <div className="flex gap-2 max-w-sm mx-auto">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setCurrentEgg(null);
                    setHatchedPet(null);
                  }}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Breed Again
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={onClose}
                  className="flex-1 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-mono text-xs font-black uppercase cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]"
                >
                  View in Sanctuary
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* PET SELECTOR DRAWER MODAL */}
        {selectingSlot && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-50 bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col p-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-white/10">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase text-white font-mono">
                  Select Parent {selectingSlot} (Candidate Roster)
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                  Pick any pet from your Sanctuary kennel
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setSelectingSlot(null)}
                className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10"
              >
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3 space-y-2">
              {candidatePets.map((candidate) => {
                const candidateRarity = getPetRarity(candidate);
                const isSelectedAsOtherParent =
                  selectingSlot === 1
                    ? parent2?.id === candidate.id
                    : parent1?.id === candidate.id;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={candidate.id}
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (isSelectedAsOtherParent) return;
                      sound.playClick();
                      if (selectingSlot === 1) {
                        setParent1(candidate);
                      } else {
                        setParent2(candidate);
                      }
                      setSelectingSlot(null);
                    }}
                    className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border flex items-center justify-between transition-all ${
                      isSelectedAsOtherParent
                        ? 'opacity-40 bg-black/30 border-white/5 cursor-not-allowed'
                        : 'bg-[#101424] hover:bg-[#182038] border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400 cursor-pointer'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-black/50 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                        <ProceduralPetCanvas
                          species={candidate.species}
                          stage={1}
                          width={55}
                          height={55}
                          interactive={false}
                          customPalette={candidate.customPalette}
                          customFeatures={candidate.customFeatures}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase">{candidate.name}</span>
                          <span className={`text-[8px] font-mono font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full border ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[candidateRarity].bg} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[candidateRarity].text} ${RARITY_BADGE_COLORS[candidateRarity].border}`}>
                            {candidateRarity}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                          {candidate.breedName || candidate.species} · Lv.{candidate.level || 1} · CP {candidate.stats.cp || 400}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      {isSelectedAsOtherParent ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-500 uppercase">
                          Selected in Slot {selectingSlot === 1 ? '2' : '1'}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <button className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-cyan-400 text-black px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl uppercase hover:bg-cyan-300">
                          Select
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
