<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { ProceduralPetCanvas } from './ProceduralPetCanvas';
import { PetAnimationState } from '../../../types/pet';
import {
  Heart,
  Utensils,
  Dumbbell,
  Sparkles,
  X,
  ChevronUp,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Home,
  Zap,
  Mic,
  Bath,
  Smile,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { voiceMimic } from '../../../utils/voiceMimic';
import { mapBeastToSpecies } from '../../../utils/petVisuals';
import { kokoroTTS } from '../../../utils/kokoroTTS';

interface FloatingPetOverlayProps {
  onOpenSanctuary?: () => void;
  containerRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
}

export const FloatingPetOverlay: React.FC<FloatingPetOverlayProps> = ({
  onOpenSanctuary,
}) => {
  const { activeBeast } = useGame();
  const { pet, isOverlayActive, toggleOverlay, feedPet, strokePet, availableBerries } =
    usePetCompanion();

  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth < 768;

  const [position, setPosition] = useState<{ x: number; y: number }>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const mobileInit = window.innerWidth < 768;
      return {
        x: mobileInit ? Math.max(10, window.innerWidth - 170) : Math.max(20, window.innerWidth - 240),
        y: mobileInit ? Math.max(50, window.innerHeight - 130) : Math.max(30, window.innerHeight - 270),
      };
    }
    return { x: 100, y: 100 };
  });
  const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false);
  const [animState, setAnimState] = useState<PetAnimationState>('idle');
  const [talkingVolume, setTalkingVolume] = useState<number>(0);
  const [showRadialMenu, setShowRadialMenu] = useState(false);
  const [speechBubble, setSpeechBubble] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isMinimized, setIsMinimized] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      return window.innerWidth < 768;
    }
    return false;
  });
  const [petScaleMode, setPetScaleMode] = useState<'normal' | 'large'>('normal');

  // Keep pet inside screen bounds on window resize
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      const mobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
      setPosition((prev) => {
        const petW = isMinimized ? 150 : (mobile ? 130 : (petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160));
        const petH = isMinimized ? 50 : (mobile ? 130 : (petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160));
        return {
          x: Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - petW - 10, prev.x)),
          y: Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - petH - (mobile ? 75 : 10), prev.y)),
        };
      });
    };
    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
  }, [petScaleMode, isMinimized]);

  // Laptop Battery & Charging Detector
  const [isCharging, setIsCharging] = useState(false);
  const [batteryLevel, setBatteryLevel] = useState<number | null>(null);

  // Screen Time & Reminders
  const [screenSeconds, setScreenSeconds] = useState(0);

  // Kokoro Local TTS State
  const [ttsEnabled, setTtsEnabled] = useState(() => kokoroTTS.getIsEnabled());

  const dragRef = useRef({
    startX: 0,
    startY: 0,
    posX: 20,
    posY: 20,
    vx: 0,
    vy: 0,
    lastTime: 0,
    isAirborne: false,
  });

  const speechTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  const showSpeech = useCallback((text: string, duration = 3500) => {
    if (speechTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(speechTimerRef.current);
    setSpeechBubble(text);
    // Silent speech bubble without loud TTS audio interruptions
    speechTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setSpeechBubble(null);
    }, duration);
  }, []);

  // 1. Laptop Battery & Charging Detector API (Silent State Tracking)
  useEffect(() => {
    let batteryObj: any = null;

    const handleBatteryUpdate = () => {
      if (!batteryObj) return;
      const charging = batteryObj.charging;
      const level = Math.round(batteryObj.level * 100);
      setIsCharging(charging);
      setBatteryLevel(level);
      // No sound effects or voice announcements on charging
    };

    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && (navigator as any).getBattery) {
      (navigator as any).getBattery().then((battery: any) => {
        batteryObj = battery;
        handleBatteryUpdate();
        battery.addEventListener('chargingchange', handleBatteryUpdate);
        battery.addEventListener('levelchange', handleBatteryUpdate);
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    return () => {
      if (batteryObj) {
        batteryObj.removeEventListener?.('chargingchange', handleBatteryUpdate);
        batteryObj.removeEventListener?.('levelchange', handleBatteryUpdate);
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // 2. Screen-Time Activity & Posture Reminders (Silent Visual Reminders)
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setScreenSeconds((prev) => {
        const next = prev + 1;
        // Trigger visual reminder every 15 minutes (900 seconds)
        if (next % 900 === 0) {
          triggerHealthReminder();
        }
        return next;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const triggerHealthReminder = () => {
    const reminders = [
      '💧 Hydration Check! Take a sip of water, human!',
      '🧘 Posture Check! Unhunch your back and stretch!',
      '👀 20-20-20 Rule! Rest your eyes on something 20 feet away!',
      '🏃 Time for a quick stretch! Roll your shoulders!',
    ];
    const picked = reminders[Math.floor(Math.random() * reminders.length)];
    setAnimState('celebrate');
    showSpeech(picked, 5000);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2000);
  };

  // 3. Autonomous Roaming AI with Playful Tricks
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOverlayActive || isMinimized || isDragging) return;

    const roamInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (isDragging || showRadialMenu) return;

      const roll = Math.random();
      if (roll < 0.35) {
        // Subtle drift around current floating coordinate (±30px)
        const moveDistX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
        const moveDistY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30;
        setAnimState('walk');
        setPosition((prev) => {
          const petW = petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160;
          const petH = petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160;
          const nextX = Math.max(15, Math.min(window.innerWidth - petW - 15, prev.x + moveDistX));
          const nextY = Math.max(15, Math.min(window.innerHeight - petH - 15, prev.y + moveDistY));
          return { x: nextX, y: nextY };
        });

        setTimeout(() => {
          setAnimState('idle');
        }, 1800);
      } else if (roll < 0.65) {
        // Playful spontaneous animated trick!
        const tricks: PetAnimationState[] = ['backflip', 'dance', 'beg', 'spin', 'zoomies', 'rollover'];
        const chosenTrick = tricks[Math.floor(Math.random() * tricks.length)];
        setAnimState(chosenTrick);
        setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 3200);
      } else if (roll < 0.85) {
        setAnimState('celebrate');
        showSpeech(`*happy ${pet.name} chirp* ❤️`, 2000);
        setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 1500);
      } else if (pet.hunger < 50) {
        setAnimState('idle');
        showSpeech(`I'm getting hungry! Feed me a treat! 🍓`, 3000);
      }
    }, 10000);

    return () => clearInterval(roamInterval);
  }, [isOverlayActive, isMinimized, isDragging, showRadialMenu, pet.name, pet.hunger, showSpeech, petScaleMode]);

  // Handle Dragging anywhere on screen freely
  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button')) return;
    setIsDragging(true);
    setAnimState('drag');
    dragRef.current.startX = e.clientX - position.x;
    dragRef.current.startY = e.clientY - position.y;
    dragRef.current.lastTime = performance.now();
    dragRef.current.vx = 0;
    dragRef.current.vy = 0;
    (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const petW = petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160;
    const petH = petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160;

    const newX = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerWidth - petW - 10, e.clientX - dragRef.current.startX));
    const newY = Math.max(10, Math.min(window.innerHeight - petH - 10, e.clientY - dragRef.current.startY));

    const now = performance.now();
    const dt = Math.max((now - dragRef.current.lastTime) / 1000, 0.001);
    dragRef.current.vx = (newX - position.x) / dt;
    dragRef.current.vy = (newY - position.y) / dt;
    dragRef.current.lastTime = now;

    setPosition({ x: newX, y: newY });
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    setIsDragging(false);
    try {
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}

    const moveDist = Math.hypot(dragRef.current.vx, dragRef.current.vy);
    // If it was just a click (low movement), toggle radial menu
    if (moveDist < 40) {
      setShowRadialMenu((prev) => !prev);
      setAnimState('idle');
      return;
    }

    // Free hover: pet remains gracefully hovering right where placed (silent)
    setAnimState('celebrate');
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 800);
  };

  // Playful Animated Tricks
  const handlePerformTrick = (trick: PetAnimationState) => {
    setAnimState(trick);
    const quotes: Record<string, string> = {
      backflip: '🤸 Backflip! Ta-da!',
      zoomies: '⚡ ZOOMIES! Super fast!',
      rollover: '🔄 Roll over! Belly rub time!',
      dance: '💃 Dance party groove! 🎵',
      beg: '🐾 Paw wave! High five!',
      spin: '💫 360 Spin! Wheee!',
    };
    if (quotes[trick]) {
      showSpeech(quotes[trick], 2500);
    }
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 3200);
  };

  // Silent Tactile Pet Reactions
  const handlePokeHead = () => {
    setAnimState('dizzy');
    showSpeech(`Ouch! My head is spinning! ⭐`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2200);
  };

  const handleTickleBelly = () => {
    setAnimState('laugh');
    showSpeech(`Hahaha! That tickles so much! ❤️`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2000);
  };

  const handleBath = () => {
    setAnimState('bath');
    showSpeech(`Squeaky clean! Pop the bubbles! 🧼✨`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2600);
  };

  const isChimera = Boolean(pet.isChimera || pet.customFeatures?.isChimera);

  const handleBark = () => {
    setAnimState('celebrate');
    showSpeech(`Woof woof! Arf! 🐶🐾`, 2200);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 1500);
  };

  const handleMeow = () => {
    setAnimState('celebrate');
    showSpeech(`Meow meow! Purrrr~ 🐱✨`, 2200);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 1500);
  };

  const handleVoiceMimic = async () => {
    showSpeech(`Listening... Say something! 🎙️`);
    const res = await voiceMimic.startListening();
    if (res.success) {
      setTimeout(async () => {
        showSpeech(`Repeating back! 📢`);
        setAnimState('talk');
        await voiceMimic.stopAndRepeat(
          (amp) => setTalkingVolume(amp),
          () => {
            setTalkingVolume(0);
            setAnimState('idle');
          }
        );
      }, 3000);
    } else {
      voiceMimic.speakPresetPhrase(
        `I am ${pet.name}! Your on-screen browser buddy!`,
        (amp) => setTalkingVolume(amp),
        () => {
          setTalkingVolume(0);
          setAnimState('idle');
        }
      );
    }
  };

  if (!isOverlayActive) return null;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        left: `${position.x}px`,
        top: `${position.y}px`,
        zIndex: 9999,
        touchAction: 'none',
      }}
      className={`select-none font-sans ${isDragging ? 'cursor-grabbing' : 'cursor-grab'}`}
    >
      {/* Speech Bubble */}
      {speechBubble && !isMinimized && (
        <div className="absolute -top-14 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 whitespace-nowrap bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md text-[#CCFF00] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-mono font-bold shadow-2xl pointer-events-none animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 z-50">
          {speechBubble}
          <div className="absolute -bottom-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-3 h-3 bg-black/90 rotate-45 border-r border-b border-[#CCFF00]/40" />
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Radial Menu & Tricks Hub */}
      {showRadialMenu && !isMinimized && (
        <div className="absolute -top-36 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-64 h-36 pointer-events-auto z-40 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-90">
          <div className="relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center">
            {/* Top: Feed Treat (Silent) */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                const b = availableBerries[0];
                if (b) {
                  feedPet(b);
                  setAnimState('eat');
                  showSpeech(`*Nom nom* Loved that ${b.name}! 🍓`);
                  setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2000);
                }
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 text-black p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
              title="Feed Treat"
            >
              <Utensils className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>

            {/* Top-Left: Backflip Trick */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('backflip');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute top-2 left-6 bg-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-300 text-black p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: Backflip 🤸"
            >
              🤸
            </button>

            {/* Top-Right: Dance Trick */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('dance');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute top-2 right-6 bg-purple-500 hover:bg-purple-400 text-white p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: Dance 💃"
            >
              💃
            </button>

            {/* Far Left: Roll Over */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('rollover');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-pink-500 hover:bg-pink-400 text-white p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: Roll Over 🔄"
            >
              🔄
            </button>

            {/* Far Right: Zoomies */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('zoomies');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300 text-black p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: Zoomies ⚡"
            >
              ⚡
            </button>

            {/* Bottom-Left: Beg / Paw Wave */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('beg');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute bottom-2 left-6 bg-rose-500 hover:bg-rose-400 text-white p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: Paw Wave 🐾"
            >
              🐾
            </button>

            {/* Bottom-Right: 360 Spin */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handlePerformTrick('spin');
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute bottom-2 right-6 bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black p-2.5 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs"
              title="Trick: 360 Spin 💫"
            >
              💫
            </button>

            {/* Bottom Center: Bath */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                handleBath();
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
              }}
              className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-400 text-white p-2 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
              title="Bubble Bath"
            >
              <Bath className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>

            {/* Center: Open Sanctuary */}
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
                onOpenSanctuary?.();
              }}
              className="bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-bold p-3 rounded-full shadow-lg border border-white/20 active:scale-95 cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center"
              title="Open Sanctuary"
            >
              <Home className="w-4 h-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Pet Canvas Container */}
      {isMinimized ? (
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playClick();
            setIsMinimized(false);
          }}
          className="bg-black/95 hover:bg-[#1E293B] border-2 border-[#CCFF00] text-white px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.35)] flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono font-bold active:scale-95 transition-all"
          title="Click to Expand Screen Buddy"
        >
          <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-black">{activeBeast.name}</span>
          <span className="text-neutral-300 font-normal">(Expand)</span>
          <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div
          onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
          onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
          onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
          onDoubleClick={(e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const tricks: PetAnimationState[] = ['backflip', 'zoomies', 'rollover', 'dance', 'beg', 'spin'];
            const picked = tricks[Math.floor(Math.random() * tricks.length)];
            handlePerformTrick(picked);
          }}
          className="relative group cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing flex flex-col items-center"
        >
          {/* Status Badge */}
          <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full border border-white/15 text-neutral-300 flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1 pointer-events-none shadow-lg">
            <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-black">{activeBeast.name}</span>
            <span className="text-neutral-400">· Drag anywhere · Double-click for trick 🐾</span>
          </div>

          {/* Cute Animated Screen Companion Buddy (Bigger Size: 160px or 200px) */}
          <div className={`relative group/canvas flex flex-col items-center ${!isDragging ? 'animate-hover-float' : ''}`}>
            {/* Ambient Base Shadow */}
            <div className="absolute bottom-1 inset-x-3 h-5 bg-black/60 rounded-full blur-md pointer-events-none" />

            <ProceduralPetCanvas
              species={mapBeastToSpecies(activeBeast.breed || activeBeast.species)}
              stage={pet.stage || 2}
              animationState={animState}
              talkingVolume={talkingVolume}
              width={isMobile ? 130 : petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160}
              height={isMobile ? 130 : petScaleMode === 'large' ? 200 : 160}
              interactive={false}
              renderMode="cute"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Mini Control Dock on hover */}
          <div className="opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-1 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-white/15 shadow-xl">
            {/* Quick Interactive Tricks */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 border-r border-white/15 pr-1.5">
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('backflip');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#CCFF00]/20 hover:bg-[#CCFF00] hover:text-black text-[#CCFF00] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Backflip"
              >
                🤸 Flip
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('zoomies');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Zoomies"
              >
                ⚡ Zoom
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('dance');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-purple-500/20 hover:bg-purple-400 hover:text-black text-purple-300 border border-purple-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Dance"
              >
                💃 Dance
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('rollover');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-pink-500/20 hover:bg-pink-400 hover:text-black text-pink-300 border border-pink-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Roll Over"
              >
                🔄 Roll
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('beg');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-black text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="Beg / Paw Wave"
              >
                🐾 Beg
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handlePerformTrick('spin');
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-400 hover:text-black text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                title="360 Spin"
              >
                💫 Spin
              </button>
            </div>
            {/* Context-Aware Voice Triggers */}
            {(pet.category === 'dog' || isChimera) && (
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleBark();
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-black text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-0.5"
                title="Bark"
              >
                <span>Bark 🐶</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {(pet.category === 'cat' || isChimera) && (
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  handleMeow();
                }}
                className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-pink-500/20 hover:bg-pink-400 hover:text-black text-pink-300 border border-pink-500/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-0.5"
                title="Meow"
              >
                <span>Meow 🐱</span>
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Kokoro Local TTS Voice Toggle */}
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                sound.playClick();
                const nowEnabled = kokoroTTS.toggle();
                setTtsEnabled(nowEnabled);
                if (nowEnabled) {
                  showSpeech('Kokoro Voice Active! 🗣️');
                }
              }}
              className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                ttsEnabled
                  ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-500/40'
                  : 'bg-white/10 text-neutral-400 border border-white/10'
              }`}
              title={ttsEnabled ? 'Kokoro Neural TTS: ON (Click to Mute)' : 'Kokoro Neural TTS: OFF (Click to Enable)'}
            >
              {ttsEnabled ? <Volume2 className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" /> : <VolumeX className="w-3 h-3" />}
              <span>TTS</span>
            </button>

            {/* Size Toggle Button */}
            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                sound.playClick();
                setPetScaleMode((prev) => (prev === 'normal' ? 'large' : 'normal'));
                showSpeech(petScaleMode === 'normal' ? 'Grown to Giant Size! 🐾' : 'Back to Normal Size.');
              }}
              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-white/10 hover:bg-[#CCFF00] hover:text-black text-neutral-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="Toggle Pet Size (160px / 200px)"
            >
              {petScaleMode === 'large' ? '200px (XL)' : '160px'}
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                sound.playClick();
                setIsMinimized(true);
                setShowRadialMenu(false);
                setSpeechBubble(null);
              }}
              className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white p-1 rounded cursor-pointer"
              title="Minimize Companion"
            >
              <EyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>

            <button
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                onOpenSanctuary?.();
              }}
              className="text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-xs cursor-pointer"
            >
              Sanctuary
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>

<source>src/components/game/pet/PetAuctionHouseModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { PetAuctionItem, CompanionPet } from '../../../types/pet';
import { getPetPhoto, getPetBreedName } from '../../../utils/petVisuals';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerConfetti, triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';
import { trackClarityEvent } from '../../../utils/clarity';
import {
  Home,
  Heart,
  X,
  Clock,
  Coins,
  CheckCircle,
  Plus,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Sparkles,
  AlertCircle,
  Tag,
  Crown,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface PetAuctionHouseModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const PetAuctionHouseModal: React.FC<PetAuctionHouseModalProps> = ({ onClose }) => {
  const { auctions, placeAuctionBid, buyoutAuction, listPetForAuction, kennelPets, cancelUserAuction } =
    usePetCompanion();
  const { credits, addCredits } = useGame();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'live' | 'create' | 'my_listings'>('live');
  const [selectedAuction, setSelectedAuction] = useState<PetAuctionItem | null>(null);
  const [bidAmountInput, setBidAmountInput] = useState<number>(0);
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<{ text: string; isError?: boolean } | null>(null);

  // Create listing form state
  const [selectedKennelPetId, setSelectedKennelPetId] = useState<string>(
    kennelPets[0]?.id || ''
  );
  const [startBid, setStartBid] = useState<number>(1200);
  const [buyoutPrice, setBuyoutPrice] = useState<number>(2500);
  const [durationHours, setDurationHours] = useState<number>(6);

  // Dynamic Simulated Rival AI Bidders State
  const [rivalBiddersEnabled, setRivalBiddersEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [liveOutbidAlert, setLiveOutbidAlert] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Simulated Dynamic Rival AI Bidders Floor (3-8s interval)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!rivalBiddersEnabled || activeTab !== 'live' || auctions.length === 0) return;

    const RIVAL_NAMES = [
      'ShadowFang',
      'ApexPredator',
      'NeonKitsune',
      'VoltHound',
      'CyberTrainer99',
      'TitanShiba',
      'ValkyrieCat',
    ];

    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      const eligible = auctions.filter((a) => !a.isUserListing && a.currentBid < a.buyoutPrice);
      if (eligible.length === 0) return;

      const target = eligible[Math.floor(Math.random() * eligible.length)];
      const rival = RIVAL_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * RIVAL_NAMES.length)];
      const increment = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3 + 1) * 50;
      const newBid = Math.min(target.buyoutPrice - 50, target.currentBid + increment);

      if (newBid > target.currentBid) {
        placeAuctionBid(target.id, newBid);

        const wasUserWinning = target.highestBidder === 'Trainer (You)';
        if (wasUserWinning) {
          sound.playLightHit();
          setLiveOutbidAlert(
            `⚠️ New Sponsor Alert! ${rival} just sponsored ${target.pet.name} with ${newBid.toLocaleString()} Credits!`
          );
          setTimeout(() => setLiveOutbidAlert(null), 4000);
        }
      }
    }, Math.floor(Math.random() * 4000 + 4000));

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [rivalBiddersEnabled, activeTab, auctions, placeAuctionBid]);

  const showToast = (text: string, isError = false) => {
    setToastMessage({ text, isError });
    setTimeout(() => setToastMessage(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleOpenBidModal = (item: PetAuctionItem) => {
    setSelectedAuction(item);
    setBidAmountInput(item.minNextBid);
  };

  const handleConfirmBid = () => {
    if (!selectedAuction) return;

    if (credits < bidAmountInput) {
      showToast('Insufficient Credits in your wallet to sponsor this pet!', true);
      sound.playClick();
      return;
    }

    const res = placeAuctionBid(selectedAuction.id, bidAmountInput);
    if (res.success) {
      // Deduct credits from user wallet
      addCredits(-bidAmountInput);
      triggerConfetti();
      showToast(res.message);
      setSelectedAuction(null);
    } else {
      showToast(res.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleBuyout = (item: PetAuctionItem) => {
    if (credits < item.buyoutPrice) {
      showToast(
        `Insufficient Credits! You need ${item.buyoutPrice.toLocaleString()} Credits for Instant Adoption.`,
        true
      );
      sound.playClick();
      return;
    }

    const res = buyoutAuction(item.id);
    if (res.success) {
      addCredits(-item.buyoutPrice);
      sound.playVictory();
      triggerVictoryExplosion();
      showToast(`🎉 Adoption Complete! ${item.pet.name} has joined your Sanctuary Kennel!`);
    } else {
      showToast(res.message, true);
    }
  };

  const handleCreateListing = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!selectedKennelPetId) {
      showToast('Please select a pet from your kennel to offer for adoption!', true);
      return;
    }

    if (buyoutPrice <= startBid) {
      showToast('Instant adoption price must be higher than starting sponsorship!', true);
      return;
    }

    const res = listPetForAuction(selectedKennelPetId, startBid, buyoutPrice, durationHours);
    if (res.success) {
      showToast(res.message);
      setActiveTab('live');
    } else {
      showToast(res.message, true);
    }
  };

  const userListings = auctions.filter((a) => a.isUserListing);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0F1420] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] overflow-hidden text-white font-sans">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#151C2C]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400">
              <Home className="w-5 h-5" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Sanctuary Adoption Shelter</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-400 text-black font-mono px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black">
                  100% Free-to-Play
                </span>
              </h2>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Adopt, re-home & sponsor companion pets using earned Slam Credits
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-black/60 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10 text-xs font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">
              <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{credits.toLocaleString()}</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="p-1 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 100% Free Community Shelter Banner */}
        <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border-b border-emerald-500/20 px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-emerald-300">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Heart className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>Community Shelter: Adopt companion pets using earned gameplay tokens!</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold">
            Fair Play
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Navigation Tabs + Rival AI Switch */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0B0E17] px-4 pt-2 gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold overflow-x-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('live')}
              className={`pb-2 px-2 border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'live'
                  ? 'border-[#CCFF00] text-[#CCFF00]'
                  : 'border-transparent text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Adoptable Pets ({auctions.length})
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('create')}
              className={`pb-2 px-2 border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'create'
                  ? 'border-[#CCFF00] text-[#CCFF00]'
                  : 'border-transparent text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              + Offer Pet
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('my_listings')}
              className={`pb-2 px-2 border-b-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                activeTab === 'my_listings'
                  ? 'border-[#CCFF00] text-[#CCFF00]'
                  : 'border-transparent text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              My Re-Homed ({userListings.length})
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Rival AI Bidders Toggle */}
          <button
            onClick={() => setRivalBiddersEnabled(!rivalBiddersEnabled)}
            className={`mb-1.5 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-1 transition-all cursor-pointer border shrink-0 ${
              rivalBiddersEnabled
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 border-emerald-400/40 text-emerald-300'
                : 'bg-white/5 border-white/10 text-neutral-400'
            }`}
            title="Toggle simulated community shelter activity"
          >
            <span>🤖 Shelter Bots:</span>
            <span className={rivalBiddersEnabled ? 'text-[#CCFF00]' : 'text-neutral-500'}>
              {rivalBiddersEnabled ? 'ON' : 'OFF'}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Live Outbid Alert Notification */}
        {liveOutbidAlert && (
          <div className="mx-4 mt-2.5 p-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-400/60 text-amber-200 flex items-center gap-2 animate-bounce">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
            <span className="font-bold">{liveOutbidAlert}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Toast Feedback */}
        {toastMessage && (
          <div
            className={`mx-4 mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono flex items-center gap-2 ${
              toastMessage.isError
                ? 'bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/40 text-red-300'
                : 'bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300'
            }`}
          >
            {toastMessage.isError ? (
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <span>{toastMessage.text}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3">
          {/* TAB 1: Live Auctions */}
          {activeTab === 'live' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {auctions.map((item) => (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="bg-[#121824] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/20 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between transition-all"
                >
                  {/* Left: Authentic Pet Portrait & Details */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden shrink-0 shadow-sm">
                      <img
                        src={getPetPhoto(item.pet)}
                        alt={item.pet.name}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white">{item.pet.name}</span>
                        <span
                          className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-mono uppercase ${
                            item.pet.category === 'cat'
                              ? 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300'
                              : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {getPetBreedName(item.pet)} · Lv.{item.pet.level}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">
                        CP {item.pet.stats.cp} · Stage {item.pet.stage}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
                        <span>Seller: {item.sellerName}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-amber-400">
                          <Clock className="w-3 h-3" />
                          <span>42m left</span>
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Right: Bidding Controls */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1.5">
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase">Current Bid</div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white font-mono flex items-center gap-1 justify-end">
                        <Coins className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />
                        <span>{item.currentBid.toLocaleString()}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleOpenBidModal(item)}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        Bid
                      </button>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleBuyout(item)}
                        className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer shadow"
                      >
                        Buyout ({item.buyoutPrice.toLocaleString()})
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* TAB 2: Create Listing Form */}
          {activeTab === 'create' && (
            <form onSubmit={handleCreateListing} className="space-y-4 text-xs font-mono">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-neutral-300 font-bold mb-1">
                  Select Pet from Your Kennel:
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {kennelPets.map((p) => (
                    <div
                      key={p.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelectedKennelPetId(p.id)}
                      className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        selectedKennelPetId === p.id
                          ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#CCFF00]/10 text-white'
                          : 'border-white/5 bg-black/40 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shrink-0 border border-white/10">
                        <img
                          src={getPetPhoto(p)}
                          alt={p.name}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="overflow-hidden">
                        <div className="font-bold truncate text-white">{p.name}</div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00]">CP {p.stats.cp}</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-neutral-300 font-bold mb-1">Starting Bid (Credits):</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="100"
                    step="50"
                    value={startBid}
                    onChange={(e) => setStartBid(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-neutral-300 font-bold mb-1">Buyout Price (Credits):</label>
                  <input
                    type="number"
                    min="200"
                    step="100"
                    value={buyoutPrice}
                    onChange={(e) => setBuyoutPrice(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full bg-black/50 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white font-mono"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-neutral-300 font-bold mb-1">Auction Duration:</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  {[2, 6, 12, 24].map((hrs) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={hrs}
                      onClick={() => setDurationHours(hrs)}
                      className={`py-1.5 rounded-xl border text-center cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                        durationHours === hrs
                          ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold border-[#CCFF00]'
                          : 'bg-black/40 text-neutral-300 border-white/10 hover:bg-white/5'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {hrs} Hours
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                type="submit"
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl cursor-pointer shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform"
              >
                Publish Pet to Auction House
              </button>
            </form>
          )}

          {/* TAB 3: My Listings */}
          {activeTab === 'my_listings' && (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {userListings.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-neutral-400 font-mono text-xs">
                  You currently have no active pet listings. Select "List Pet for Auction" to sell a companion!
                </div>
              ) : (
                userListings.map((item) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.id}
                    className="bg-[#121824] border border-[#CCFF00]/20 rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between"
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl bg-black/40 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                        <img
                          src={getPetPhoto(item.pet)}
                          alt={item.pet.name}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span>{item.pet.name}</span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] px-1 rounded bg-white/10 text-neutral-300 font-mono">
                            {getPetBreedName(item.pet)}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono">
                          Current Bid: {item.currentBid.toLocaleString()} Credits ({item.bidCount} bids)
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                          Highest Bidder: {item.highestBidder}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => cancelUserAuction(item.id)}
                      className="px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-red-500/20 hover:bg-red-500/30 text-red-300 border border-red-500/30 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-mono font-bold cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Cancel Listing
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Place Bid Modal Popover */}
        {selectedAuction && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-30 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center p-4">
            <div className="w-full max-w-xs bg-[#151C2C] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl text-white font-mono space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-2">
                <span className="font-bold text-xs uppercase">
                  Place Bid on {selectedAuction.pet.name}
                </span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setSelectedAuction(null)}
                  className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-white"
                >
                  <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="text-xs text-neutral-300">
                Minimum Next Bid:{' '}
                <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                  {selectedAuction.minNextBid.toLocaleString()} Credits
                </span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 block mb-1">Your Bid Amount:</label>
                <input
                  type="number"
                  min={selectedAuction.minNextBid}
                  step="50"
                  value={bidAmountInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setBidAmountInput(Number(e.target.value))}
                  className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white font-mono text-sm"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBidAmountInput((prev) => prev + 100)}
                  className="flex-1 py-1 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg text-[10px] text-neutral-300"
                >
                  +100
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => setBidAmountInput((prev) => prev + 500)}
                  className="flex-1 py-1 bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-lg text-[10px] text-neutral-300"
                >
                  +500
                </button>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleConfirmBid}
                className="w-full py-2 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black uppercase text-xs rounded-xl cursor-pointer"
              >
                Confirm Sponsorship ({bidAmountInput.toLocaleString()} Credits)
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/pet/PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Upload,
  Camera,
  Sparkles,
  CheckCircle,
  RefreshCw,
  Zap,
  Shield,
  Heart,
  Palette,
  Eye,
  Award,
  ChevronRight,
  Flame,
  Crown,
  CreditCard,
  Coins,
  Smile,
  Sliders,
  Check,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { ProceduralPetCanvas } from './ProceduralPetCanvas';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { createDodoCheckout } from '../../../services/dodo';
import { trackClarityEvent } from '../../../utils/clarity';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import {
  CompanionPet,
  PetSpecies,
  PetCategory,
  PetCustomPalette,
  PetCustomFeatures,
} from '../../../types/pet';
import { Animal } from '../../../data/animals';
import { animalImages } from '../../../assets/images';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';

interface PetAvatarPhotoStudioModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
}

// Built-in high quality sample photos so the user can test the avatar feature with 1 click!
const SAMPLE_PET_PHOTOS = [
  {
    id: 'sample_retriever',
    label: 'Golden Retriever',
    name: 'Max',
    image:
      'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552053831-71594a27632d?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
    category: 'dog' as PetCategory,
    species: 'retriever' as PetSpecies,
    fallbackPalette: {
      primary: '#F59E0B',
      secondary: '#D97706',
      belly: '#FEF3C7',
      ear: '#D97706',
      eye: '#451A03',
      nose: '#1C1917',
    },
  },
  {
    id: 'sample_calico',
    label: 'Calico Cat',
    name: 'Luna',
    image:
      'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514888286974-6c03e2ca1dba?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
    category: 'cat' as PetCategory,
    species: 'calico' as PetSpecies,
    fallbackPalette: {
      primary: '#F8FAFC',
      secondary: '#EA580C',
      belly: '#FFFFFF',
      ear: '#FDA4AF',
      eye: '#059669',
      nose: '#FB7185',
    },
  },
  {
    id: 'sample_bulldog',
    label: 'French Bulldog',
    name: 'Rocky',
    image:
      'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655857-d19b40a7a54e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
    category: 'dog' as PetCategory,
    species: 'bulldog' as PetSpecies,
    fallbackPalette: {
      primary: '#94A3B8',
      secondary: '#64748B',
      belly: '#E2E8F0',
      ear: '#F472B6',
      eye: '#1E293B',
      nose: '#0F172A',
    },
  },
  {
    id: 'sample_husky',
    label: 'Arctic Husky',
    name: 'Ghost',
    image:
      'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1537151625747-768eb6cf92b2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=400&q=80',
    category: 'dog' as PetCategory,
    species: 'husky' as PetSpecies,
    fallbackPalette: {
      primary: '#334155',
      secondary: '#1E293B',
      belly: '#F8FAFC',
      ear: '#CBD5E1',
      eye: '#38BDF8',
      nose: '#0F172A',
    },
  },
];

export const PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal: React.FC<PetAvatarPhotoStudioModalProps> = ({ onClose }) => {
  const { addCustomAvatarPet } = usePetCompanion();
  const { hasAvatarStudioPass, unlockPass, registerCustomFighter, credits } = useGame();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'photo' | 'builder'>('photo');

  // Photo Scan State
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [petNameInput, setPetNameInput] = useState<string>('');
  const [isAnalyzing, setIsAnalyzing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [analysisStep, setAnalysisStep] = useState<string>('');
  const [analyzedAvatar, setAnalyzedAvatar] = useState<{
    name: string;
    title: string;
    category: PetCategory;
    species: PetSpecies;
    breedName: string;
    palette: PetCustomPalette;
    features: PetCustomFeatures;
    personalityTraits: string[];
    quirk: string;
    signatureMove: { name: string; description: string };
    stats: { attack: number; defense: number; agility: number; stamina: number; cp: number };
    battleBuff: { name: string; description: string; effectType: any; potency: number };
  } | null>(null);

  const [activePalette, setActivePalette] = useState<PetCustomPalette | null>(null);
  const [isSaved, setIsSaved] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showPassModal, setShowPassModal] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [hasUsedFreeCustomPet, setHasUsedFreeCustomPet] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_used_free_custom_pet') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);

  // 3D Tilt Cyber Holo-Foil Card State
  const [cardTilt, setCardTilt] = useState<{
    rotateX: number;
    rotateY: number;
    glareX: number;
    glareY: number;
  }>({ rotateX: 0, rotateY: 0, glareX: 50, glareY: 50 });

  const handleCardPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const px = (x / rect.width) * 100;
    const py = (y / rect.height) * 100;
    const rotateY = ((x - rect.width / 2) / (rect.width / 2)) * 12;
    const rotateX = -((y - rect.height / 2) / (rect.height / 2)) * 12;
    setCardTilt({ rotateX, rotateY, glareX: px, glareY: py });
  };

  const handleCardPointerLeave = () => {
    setCardTilt({ rotateX: 0, rotateY: 0, glareX: 50, glareY: 50 });
  };

  // Manual Builder State
  const [builderCategory, setBuilderCategory] = useState<PetCategory>('dog');
  const [builderSpecies, setBuilderSpecies] = useState<PetSpecies>('shiba');
  const [builderName, setBuilderName] = useState<string>('Rex');
  const [builderBreed, setBuilderBreed] = useState<string>('Shiba Champion');
  const [builderEarType, setBuilderEarType] = useState<'pointed' | 'floppy' | 'round'>('pointed');
  const [builderHasWhiskers, setBuilderHasWhiskers] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [builderEyePatch, setBuilderEyePatch] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [builderFluffyTail, setBuilderFluffyTail] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [builderCollarColor, setBuilderCollarColor] = useState<string>('#CCFF00');
  const [builderMoveName, setBuilderMoveName] = useState<string>('Thunder Pounce');
  const [builderMoveDesc, setBuilderMoveDesc] = useState<string>('Leaps with electrifying speed, shocking targets!');
  const [builderPalette, setBuilderPalette] = useState<PetCustomPalette>({
    primary: '#E07A5F',
    secondary: '#3D405B',
    belly: '#F4F1DE',
    ear: '#F2CC8F',
    eye: '#2A9D8F',
    nose: '#1E1E24',
  });
  const [activeColorSlot, setActiveColorSlot] = useState<keyof PetCustomPalette>('primary');

  // Handle Photo Select
  const handleFileSelect = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    sound.playClick();
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const dataUrl = event.target?.result as string;
      setImagePreview(dataUrl);
      setAnalyzedAvatar(null);
      setIsSaved(false);
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const handleSelectSample = async (sample: (typeof SAMPLE_PET_PHOTOS)[0]) => {
    sound.playClick();
    setPetNameInput(sample.name);
    setAnalyzedAvatar(null);
    setIsSaved(false);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(sample.image);
      const blob = await res.blob();
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onloadend = () => {
        setImagePreview(reader.result as string);
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
    } catch {
      setImagePreview(sample.image);
    }
  };

  // Run AI Photo Scanner
  const handleAnalyzePhoto = async () => {
    if (!imagePreview) return;

    setIsAnalyzing(true);
    sound.playClick();
    setAnalysisStep('Scanning pet contours & coat colors...');

    try {
      const timer1 = setTimeout(() => {
        setAnalysisStep('Detecting breed traits & facial structure...');
      }, 800);

      const timer2 = setTimeout(() => {
        setAnalysisStep('Synthesizing color palette & arena moveset...');
      }, 1500);

      const response = await fetch('/api/pet/analyze-photo', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          imageBase64: imagePreview,
          userGivenName: petNameInput,
        }),
      });

      clearTimeout(timer1);
      clearTimeout(timer2);

      const data = await response.json();

      if (data.success && data.avatar) {
        setAnalyzedAvatar(data.avatar);
        setActivePalette(data.avatar.palette);
        sound.playVictory();
      } else {
        throw new Error(data.error || 'Failed to analyze pet');
      }
    } catch {
      // High-quality deterministic fallback
      const detectedName = petNameInput.trim() || 'Champion';
      const fallback = {
        name: detectedName,
        title: 'The Couch Champion',
        category: 'dog' as PetCategory,
        species: 'retriever' as PetSpecies,
        breedName: 'Golden Pedigree',
        palette: {
          primary: '#F59E0B',
          secondary: '#D97706',
          belly: '#FEF3C7',
          ear: '#D97706',
          eye: '#451A03',
          nose: '#1C1917',
        },
        features: {
          earType: 'floppy' as const,
          hasWhiskers: false,
          eyePatch: true,
          collarColor: '#CCFF00',
          fluffyTail: true,
        },
        personalityTraits: ['Loyal Vanguard', 'Zoomies Sprinter', 'Heart Thief'],
        quirk: 'Chases laser pointers and protects the sofa with fierce dedication.',
        signatureMove: {
          name: `${detectedName}'s Hyper Pounce`,
          description: 'A dazzling burst dash that deals 220 kinetic damage and stuns targets.',
        },
        stats: { attack: 72, defense: 68, agility: 75, stamina: 70, cp: 520 },
        battleBuff: {
          name: 'Guardian Aura',
          description: '+20% Critical Strike Multiplier from pure companion love.',
          effectType: 'crit_chance' as const,
          potency: 20,
        },
      };
      setAnalyzedAvatar(fallback);
      setActivePalette(fallback.palette);
      sound.playLevelUp();
    } finally {
      setIsAnalyzing(false);
      setAnalysisStep('');
    }
  };

  // Save pet to kennel AND register as playable fighter in Arena!
  const handleSaveToKennelAndArena = () => {
    // If user hasn't unlocked pass and has already used free starter creation, prompt pass
    if (!hasAvatarStudioPass && hasUsedFreeCustomPet) {
      setShowPassModal(true);
      return;
    }

    // Grant first starter pet completely free!
    if (!hasAvatarStudioPass && !hasUsedFreeCustomPet) {
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('petslam_used_free_custom_pet', 'true');
        setHasUsedFreeCustomPet(true);
      } catch {}
    }

    finalizeSave();
  };

  const finalizeSave = () => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerVictoryExplosion();

    let newPet: CompanionPet;

    if (activeTab === 'photo' && analyzedAvatar) {
      newPet = {
        id: `custom_${Date.now()}`,
        species: analyzedAvatar.species,
        category: analyzedAvatar.category,
        name: analyzedAvatar.name,
        title: analyzedAvatar.title,
        stage: 1,
        level: 10,
        exp: 0,
        maxExp: 100,
        affectionHearts: 4,
        affectionPoints: 100,
        hunger: 95,
        happiness: 100,
        energy: 100,
        mood: 'excited',
        stats: analyzedAvatar.stats,
        battleBuff: analyzedAvatar.battleBuff,
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastFedAt: Date.now(),
        lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
        totalPats: 5,
        totalBerriesEaten: 3,
        caughtAt: 'Personal Photo Studio',
        isFavorite: true,
        customPalette: activePalette || analyzedAvatar.palette,
        customFeatures: analyzedAvatar.features,
        avatarImageUrl: imagePreview || undefined,
        breedName: analyzedAvatar.breedName,
        personalityTraits: analyzedAvatar.personalityTraits,
        quirk: analyzedAvatar.quirk,
        isCustomAvatar: true,
      };
    } else {
      // Manual Builder Pet
      newPet = {
        id: `custom_${Date.now()}`,
        species: builderSpecies,
        category: builderCategory,
        name: builderName.trim() || 'Champion',
        title: 'Bred for Glory',
        stage: 1,
        level: 10,
        exp: 0,
        maxExp: 100,
        affectionHearts: 4,
        affectionPoints: 100,
        hunger: 95,
        happiness: 100,
        energy: 100,
        mood: 'battle_ready',
        stats: { attack: 75, defense: 70, agility: 80, stamina: 72, cp: 540 },
        battleBuff: {
          name: 'Combat Surge',
          description: '+15% Energy regeneration rate in Arena.',
          effectType: 'elixir_rate',
          potency: 15,
        },
        createdAt: Date.now(),
        lastFedAt: Date.now(),
        lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
        totalPats: 5,
        totalBerriesEaten: 3,
        caughtAt: 'Custom DNA Lab',
        isFavorite: true,
        customPalette: builderPalette,
        customFeatures: {
          earType: builderEarType,
          hasWhiskers: builderHasWhiskers,
          eyePatch: builderEyePatch,
          collarColor: builderCollarColor,
          fluffyTail: builderFluffyTail,
          signatureMove: {
            name: builderMoveName,
            description: builderMoveDesc,
          },
        },
        breedName: builderBreed,
        personalityTraits: ['Arena Fighter', 'Loyal Companion', 'Apex Instinct'],
        quirk: 'Ready for action day and night!',
        isCustomAvatar: true,
      };
    }

    // 1. Add to Companion Sanctuary
    addCustomAvatarPet(newPet);

    // 2. Register into GameContext as a Playable Arena Fighter
    const customFighter: Animal = {
      id: `fighter_${newPet.id}`,
      name: newPet.name,
      species: newPet.breedName || (newPet.category === 'cat' ? 'Domestic Feline' : 'Loyal Canine'),
      breed: newPet.breedName || (newPet.category === 'cat' ? 'Domestic Feline' : 'Loyal Canine'),
      scientificName: newPet.category === 'cat' ? 'Felis catus' : 'Canis lupus familiaris',
      category: newPet.category === 'cat' ? 'Felines' : 'Canines',
      rarity: 'Legendary',
      level: 10,
      health: 1100,
      damage: 195,
      speed: 86,
      weightKg: 28,
      biteForcePsi: 245,
      topSpeedKmh: 48,
      strikeJoules: 690,
      elixirCost: 3,
      strength: 86,
      endurance: 88,
      agility: 86,
      biteForce: 245,
      image: newPet.avatarImageUrl || animalImages.realBengalCat,

      signatureAbility: `${newPet.customFeatures?.signatureMove?.name || 'Cosmic Pounce'}: Devastating burst strike powered by trainer loyalty.`,
    };

    registerCustomFighter(customFighter);
    setIsSaved(true);

    setTimeout(() => {
      onClose();
    }, 1400);
