<source>src/components/game/pet/ProceduralPetCanvas.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
import { PetSpecies, PetStage, PetAnimationState, PetMood, PetCustomPalette, PetCustomFeatures } from '../../../types/pet';
import { PET_SPECIES_PHOTOS } from '../../../data/animals';

interface ProceduralPetCanvasProps {
  species: PetSpecies;
  stage: PetStage;
  animationState?: PetAnimationState;
  mood?: PetMood;
  talkingVolume?: number; // 0 to 1 for live lip-sync mouth movement
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  interactive?: boolean;
  onStroke?: () => void;
  onPokeHead?: () => void;
  onTickleBelly?: () => void;
  onFeedClick?: () => void;
  className?: string;
  showAura?: boolean;
  customPalette?: PetCustomPalette;
  customFeatures?: PetCustomFeatures;
  avatarImageUrl?: string;
  renderMode?: 'cute' | 'photo';
}

interface Particle {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  alpha: number;
  life: number;
  color: string;
  type: 'heart' | 'sparkle' | 'crumb' | 'sleep' | 'sweat' | 'star' | 'bubble' | 'milk';
  size: number;
  text?: string;
}

export const ProceduralPetCanvas: React.FC<ProceduralPetCanvasProps> = ({
  species = 'shiba',
  stage = 1,
  animationState = 'idle',
  mood = 'playful',
  talkingVolume = 0,
  width = 240,
  height = 240,
  interactive = true,
  onStroke,
  onPokeHead,
  onTickleBelly,
  onFeedClick,
  className = '',
  showAura = false,
  customPalette,
  customFeatures,
  avatarImageUrl,
  renderMode = 'cute',
}) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const animFrameRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const imgRef = useRef<HTMLImageElement | null>(null);
  const [imgLoaded, setImgLoaded] = useState(false);

  // Keep references to customPalette and customFeatures for 60 FPS reactive updates without re-mounting
  const customPaletteRef = useRef(customPalette);
  customPaletteRef.current = customPalette;

  const customFeaturesRef = useRef(customFeatures);
  customFeaturesRef.current = customFeatures;

  // Determine photo URL: ONLY used when renderMode is explicitly 'photo'
  const effectiveImageUrl = renderMode === 'photo' ? (avatarImageUrl || PET_SPECIES_PHOTOS[species] || '') : '';

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!effectiveImageUrl) {
      imgRef.current = null;
      setImgLoaded(false);
      return;
    }
    const img = new Image();
    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    img.onload = () => {
      imgRef.current = img;
      setImgLoaded(true);
    };
    img.onerror = () => {
      imgRef.current = null;
      setImgLoaded(false);
    };
    img.src = effectiveImageUrl;
  }, [effectiveImageUrl]);

  // Motion and physics state
  const stateRef = useRef({
    time: 0,
    blinkTimer: 0,
    isBlinking: false,
    eyeGazeX: 0,
    eyeGazeY: 0,
    currentAnimation: animationState,
    talkingVolume: talkingVolume,
    pettingIntensity: 0,
    squashX: 1,
    squashY: 1,
    bounceY: 0,
    walkCycle: 0,
    mouthOpen: 0,
    tailWag: 0,
    particles: [] as Particle[],
    isHovered: false,
    isPointerDown: false,
    pointerStartPos: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    pointerLastPos: { x: 0, y: 0 },
    strokeDistance: 0,
    dragTime: 0,
  });

  // Keep stateRef synced with props
  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current.currentAnimation = animationState;
  }, [animationState]);

  useEffect(() => {
    stateRef.current.talkingVolume = talkingVolume;
  }, [talkingVolume]);

  // Spawn particle helper
  const spawnParticle = useCallback(
    (type: Particle['type'], x: number, y: number, color?: string, text?: string) => {
      const defaultColors: Record<Particle['type'], string> = {
        heart: '#FF4D8D',
        sparkle: '#CCFF00',
        crumb: '#F59E0B',
        sleep: '#93C5FD',
        sweat: '#38BDF8',
        star: '#FBBF24',
        bubble: '#67E8F9',
        milk: '#FFFFFF',
      };

      stateRef.current.particles.push({
        x: x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20,
        y: y + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10,
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * (type === 'bubble' ? 1.2 : 2.5),
        vy:
          type === 'sleep'
            ? -0.8
            : type === 'bubble'
            ? -1.2 - Math.random() * 1.5
            : -1.5 - Math.random() * 2,
        alpha: 1,
        life: 1,
        color: color || defaultColors[type],
        type,
        size: type === 'heart' ? 14 : type === 'bubble' ? 12 : type === 'star' ? 10 : 8,
        text,
      });
    },
    []
  );

  // Mouse / Touch handlers for Talking Tom interactive zones
  const handlePointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!interactive) return;
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const clickX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const clickY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    stateRef.current.isPointerDown = true;
    stateRef.current.pointerStartPos = { x: clickX, y: clickY };
    stateRef.current.pointerLastPos = { x: clickX, y: clickY };
    stateRef.current.strokeDistance = 0;
    stateRef.current.dragTime = performance.now();
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  };

  const handlePointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const currX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const currY = e.clientY - rect.top;

    // Track gaze
    const centerX = width / 2;
    const centerY = height / 2 - 20;
    stateRef.current.eyeGazeX = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (currX - centerX) / (width * 0.4)));
    stateRef.current.eyeGazeY = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, (currY - centerY) / (height * 0.4)));

    if (stateRef.current.isPointerDown && interactive) {
      const dx = currX - stateRef.current.pointerLastPos.x;
      const dy = currY - stateRef.current.pointerLastPos.y;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      stateRef.current.strokeDistance += dist;
      stateRef.current.pointerLastPos = { x: currX, y: currY };

      // Petting stroke detected (rubbing)
      if (stateRef.current.strokeDistance > 22) {
        stateRef.current.strokeDistance = 0;
        stateRef.current.pettingIntensity = 1;
        stateRef.current.currentAnimation = 'pet';

        spawnParticle('heart', currX, currY);
        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
          spawnParticle('sparkle', currX, currY);
        }

        onStroke?.();
      }
    }
  };

  const handlePointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLCanvasElement>) => {
    if (!stateRef.current.isPointerDown) return;
    stateRef.current.isPointerDown = false;
    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}

    const rect = e.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
    const upX = e.clientX - rect.left;
    const upY = e.clientY - rect.top;
    const clickDuration = performance.now() - stateRef.current.dragTime;

    // Detect distinct tap vs stroke for Talking Tom interactions!
    if (clickDuration < 280 && stateRef.current.strokeDistance < 15) {
      // Zone 1: Head Tap / Poke (y < height * 0.42)
      if (upY < height * 0.42) {
        onPokeHead?.();
        stateRef.current.currentAnimation = 'dizzy';
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          spawnParticle('star', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40, height * 0.25);
        }
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (stateRef.current.currentAnimation === 'dizzy') {
            stateRef.current.currentAnimation = animationState;
          }
        }, 1800);
        return;
      }

      // Zone 2: Belly Tickle (height * 0.45 <= y <= height * 0.78)
      if (upY >= height * 0.42 && upY <= height * 0.8) {
        onTickleBelly?.();
        stateRef.current.currentAnimation = 'laugh';
        spawnParticle('heart', upX, upY);
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (stateRef.current.currentAnimation === 'laugh') {
            stateRef.current.currentAnimation = animationState;
          }
        }, 1600);
        return;
      }
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      if (stateRef.current.currentAnimation === 'pet') {
        stateRef.current.currentAnimation = animationState;
      }
    }, 600);
  };

  const handleDoubleClick = () => {
    if (!interactive) return;
    const tricks: PetAnimationState[] = ['backflip', 'zoomies', 'rollover', 'dance', 'beg', 'spin'];
    const randomTrick = tricks[Math.floor(Math.random() * tricks.length)];
    stateRef.current.currentAnimation = randomTrick;
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      spawnParticle('star', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, height * 0.35);
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (stateRef.current.currentAnimation === randomTrick) {
        stateRef.current.currentAnimation = animationState;
      }
    }, 2800);
  };

  // Main 60 FPS Canvas Drawing Engine
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    // Retina / High-DPI crisp rendering
    const dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;

    let lastTime = performance.now();

    const render = (now: number) => {
      const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.1);
      lastTime = now;
      const s = stateRef.current;
      s.time += dt;

      // Handle Blinking logic
      s.blinkTimer += dt;
      if (s.isBlinking) {
        if (s.blinkTimer > 0.14) {
          s.isBlinking = false;
          s.blinkTimer = 0;
        }
      } else {
        if (s.blinkTimer > 3.2 + Math.sin(s.time * 0.5) * 1.5) {
          s.isBlinking = true;
          s.blinkTimer = 0;
        }
      }

      // Handle Petting decay
      if (s.pettingIntensity > 0) {
        s.pettingIntensity = Math.max(0, s.pettingIntensity - dt * 2);
      }

      // Harmonic Animation Math (Natural Subtle Volume-Preserving Physics)
      let anim = s.currentAnimation;
      let breathCycle = Math.sin(s.time * 2.8);
      let walkBob = 0;
      let wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 6) * 0.25;
      let squashX = 1;
      let squashY = 1;
      let headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 1.4) * 0.05;
      let mouthHeight = 0;
      let bodyRotation = 0;
      let offsetX = 0;

      const curPalette = customPaletteRef.current || customPalette;
      const curFeatures = customFeaturesRef.current || customFeatures;

      // Species category check (honors customFeatures.isCat override)
      const isCat = curFeatures?.isCat !== undefined ? curFeatures.isCat : [
        'tabby',
        'calico',
        'siamese',
        'blackcat',
        'bagheera',
        'bengal',
        'mainecoon',
        'british',
        'scottish',
      ].includes(species);
      const isDog = !isCat;

      if (anim === 'idle') {
        squashX = 1 + breathCycle * 0.02;
        squashY = 1 - breathCycle * 0.02;
        s.bounceY = -breathCycle * 2.5;
        if (isDog) {
          wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 4) * 0.2; // Gentle puppy wag
        }
      } else if (anim === 'walk' || anim === 'fetch') {
        s.walkCycle += dt * 8;
        walkBob = Math.abs(Math.sin(s.walkCycle)) * 8;
        s.bounceY = -walkBob;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.walkCycle * 1.2) * 0.4;
        squashX = 1 + Math.sin(s.walkCycle) * 0.025;
        squashY = 1 - Math.sin(s.walkCycle) * 0.025;
      } else if (anim === 'pet') {
        squashX = 1.03;
        squashY = 0.97;
        s.bounceY = 3;
        headTilt = 0.08;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 0.5; // Fast happy wagging
      } else if (anim === 'eat') {
        mouthHeight = (Math.sin(s.time * 12) + 1) * 5; // Fast munching
        squashY = 1 + Math.sin(s.time * 12) * 0.03;
        squashX = 1 - Math.sin(s.time * 12) * 0.02;
        if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
          spawnParticle('crumb', width / 2, height / 2 + 10);
        }
      } else if (anim === 'drink_milk') {
        mouthHeight = (Math.sin(s.time * 14) + 1) * 6;
        squashY = 1 + Math.sin(s.time * 14) * 0.03;
        squashX = 1 - Math.sin(s.time * 14) * 0.02;
        s.bounceY = 5;
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
          spawnParticle('milk', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16, height / 2 + 30);
        }
      } else if (anim === 'bath') {
        squashX = 1 + Math.sin(s.time * 5) * 0.03;
        squashY = 1 - Math.sin(s.time * 5) * 0.03;
        s.bounceY = -Math.abs(Math.sin(s.time * 5)) * 3;
        if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
          spawnParticle('bubble', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 70, height / 2 + 10);
        }
      } else if (anim === 'fart') {
        squashX = 1.04;
        squashY = 0.96;
        s.bounceY = -4;
        headTilt = -0.1;
      } else if (anim === 'talk') {
        // Talking Tom voice mimic lip-sync!
        const vol = s.talkingVolume > 0 ? s.talkingVolume : (Math.sin(s.time * 14) + 1) * 0.45;
        mouthHeight = vol * 12;
        headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 0.08;
        s.bounceY = -vol * 4;
        squashY = 1 + vol * 0.04;
        squashX = 1 - vol * 0.02;
      } else if (anim === 'dizzy') {
        // Dizzy head wobble after poking
        headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 10) * 0.18;
        squashX = 1 + Math.cos(s.time * 10) * 0.03;
        squashY = 1 - Math.cos(s.time * 10) * 0.03;
        s.bounceY = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 4;
      } else if (anim === 'laugh') {
        // Laughing tickle bounce
        s.bounceY = -Math.abs(Math.sin(s.time * 16)) * 8;
        squashY = 1 + Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 0.04;
        squashX = 1 - Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 0.03;
        headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 0.06;
        mouthHeight = 6 + Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 3;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 20) * 0.5;
      } else if (anim === 'sleep') {
        squashX = 1.02;
        squashY = 0.98;
        s.bounceY = 4;
        if (Math.random() < 0.02) {
          spawnParticle('sleep', width / 2 + 30, height / 2 - 40, '#93C5FD', 'Z');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'celebrate') {
        const jumpPhase = Math.sin(s.time * 6);
        s.bounceY = jumpPhase < 0 ? jumpPhase * 18 : 0;
        squashY = jumpPhase > 0.8 ? 0.96 : 1.03;
        squashX = jumpPhase > 0.8 ? 1.03 : 0.97;
        if (Math.random() < 0.15) {
          spawnParticle('sparkle', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 80, height / 2);
        }
      } else if (anim === 'drag') {
        squashY = 1.04;
        squashX = 0.97;
        s.bounceY = -10;
      } else if (anim === 'backflip') {
        // High acrobatic gymnastics backflip!
        const flipSpeed = 3.6;
        const progress = (s.time * flipSpeed) % (Math.PI * 2);
        const arc = Math.sin(progress * 0.5);
        s.bounceY = -Math.max(0, arc) * 48;
        bodyRotation = -progress; // Full 360 rotation
        squashY = arc > 0.8 ? 1.18 : arc < 0.2 ? 0.86 : 1.0;
        squashX = arc > 0.8 ? 0.86 : arc < 0.2 ? 1.18 : 1.0;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 0.45;
        if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
          spawnParticle('star', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, height / 2 - 20, '#FACC15');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'zoomies') {
        // Supercharged excitement zoomies!
        s.walkCycle += dt * 26;
        offsetX = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 36;
        walkBob = Math.abs(Math.sin(s.walkCycle)) * 12;
        s.bounceY = -walkBob;
        headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 0.18;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 30) * 0.75;
        squashX = 1 + Math.sin(s.walkCycle) * 0.07;
        squashY = 1 - Math.sin(s.walkCycle) * 0.07;
        if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
          spawnParticle('sparkle', width / 2 - offsetX * 0.5 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 25, height / 2 + 20, '#CCFF00');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'rollover') {
        // Playful ground roll & belly-up!
        const rollSpeed = 2.6;
        const rollCycle = Math.sin(s.time * rollSpeed);
        bodyRotation = rollCycle * Math.PI; // Rolls smoothly side to side
        s.bounceY = 8 + Math.abs(rollCycle) * 4;
        headTilt = rollCycle * 0.2;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 14) * 0.5;
        squashX = 1.06;
        squashY = 0.94;
        if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
          spawnParticle('heart', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40, height / 2 - 10, '#EC4899');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'dance') {
        // Rhythmic funky paw-step groove!
        const beat = Math.sin(s.time * 9);
        s.bounceY = -Math.abs(beat) * 16;
        bodyRotation = Math.sin(s.time * 4.5) * 0.15;
        headTilt = Math.sin(s.time * 4.5) * 0.14;
        squashY = 1 + beat * 0.08;
        squashX = 1 - beat * 0.06;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 14) * 0.6;
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
          spawnParticle('sparkle', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 60, height / 2 - 30, '#A855F7');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'beg') {
        // Sit pretty, paws raised waving!
        s.bounceY = -8 + Math.sin(s.time * 5) * 3;
        squashY = 1.14;
        squashX = 0.9;
        headTilt = 0.14 + Math.sin(s.time * 3) * 0.06;
        wagAngle = Math.sin(s.time * 16) * 0.45;
        if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
          spawnParticle('heart', width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 30, height / 2 - 35, '#F43F5E');
        }
      } else if (anim === 'spin') {
        // Rapid 360 twirl chasing tail!
        const spinProgress = (s.time * 7) % (Math.PI * 2);
        bodyRotation = spinProgress;
        s.bounceY = -Math.abs(Math.sin(s.time * 14)) * 6;
        squashX = 0.94;
        squashY = 1.06;
        wagAngle = 0.65;
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) {
          spawnParticle('sparkle', width / 2 + Math.cos(spinProgress) * 35, height / 2 + Math.sin(spinProgress) * 20, '#38BDF8');
        }
      }

      // RESET DPR TRANSFORM AND CLEAR CANVAS
      ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);

      // PROPORTIONAL UNIFORM GEOMETRY SCALING
      // Canonical reference bounding box is 220px. Both X & Y scale by uniformScale
      // to guarantee zero skewing regardless of container dimensions.
      const baseDim = 220;
      const uniformScale = Math.min(width, height) / baseDim;
      const stageScale = stage === 1 ? 0.88 : stage === 2 ? 1.0 : 1.15;
      const totalScaleX = uniformScale * stageScale * squashX;
      const totalScaleY = uniformScale * stageScale * squashY;

      // CENTER OF CREATURE
      const cx = width / 2;
      const cy = height * 0.53 + s.bounceY * uniformScale;
      const petRenderX = cx + offsetX * uniformScale;

      // 1. SHADOW UNDER CREATURE
      const shadowWidth = 52 * uniformScale * squashX;
      const shadowHeight = 12 * uniformScale * squashY;
      const shadowY = cy + 42 * uniformScale;
      const shadowGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
        petRenderX,
        shadowY,
        0,
        petRenderX,
        shadowY,
        shadowWidth
      );
      shadowGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)');
      shadowGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = shadowGrad;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(petRenderX, shadowY, shadowWidth, shadowHeight, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // 2. AURA (FOR TITAN STAGE, MYTHIC RARITY, CHIMERA OR BUFFED)
      const isMythic = curFeatures?.isChimera || showAura || stage === 3;
      if (stage === 3 || showAura || curFeatures?.isChimera) {
        ctx.save();
        const auraRadius = 85 * uniformScale;
        const auraGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(petRenderX, cy - 8 * uniformScale, 20 * uniformScale, petRenderX, cy - 8 * uniformScale, auraRadius);
        const auraColor = curFeatures?.isChimera
          ? 'rgba(217, 70, 239, ' // Fuchsia Celestial Chimera Aura
          : isCat
          ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, '
          : isDog
          ? 'rgba(234, 179, 8, '
          : 'rgba(204, 255, 0, ';
        const pulse = 0.28 + Math.sin(s.time * 3.5) * 0.14;
        auraGrad.addColorStop(0, `${auraColor}${pulse})`);
        auraGrad.addColorStop(0.7, `${auraColor}${pulse * 0.45})`);
        auraGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = auraGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(petRenderX, cy - 8 * uniformScale, auraRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // 3. DRAW PET BODY (REALISTIC PHOTO PORTRAIT OR PROCEDURAL FALLBACK)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(petRenderX, cy);
      ctx.scale(totalScaleX, totalScaleY);
      ctx.rotate(bodyRotation + headTilt);

      if (renderMode === 'photo' && imgRef.current && imgLoaded) {
        // --- REALISTIC HIGH-FIDELITY PHOTO AVATAR ---
        const petRadius = 52;

        // Soft aura shadow
        ctx.save();
        ctx.shadowColor = isCat ? 'rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.45)' : 'rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.45)';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -6, petRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0F131D';
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Draw clipped realistic photo
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -6, petRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.clip();

        const img = imgRef.current;
        const iAspect = img.width / img.height;
        let dw = petRadius * 2;
        let dh = petRadius * 2;
        let dx = -petRadius;
        let dy = -petRadius - 6;
        if (iAspect > 1) {
          dw = dh * iAspect;
          dx = -dw / 2;
        } else {
          dh = dw / iAspect;
          dy = -dh / 2 - 6;
        }
        ctx.drawImage(img, dx, dy, dw, dh);
        ctx.restore();

        // Premium Neon Halo Ring
        ctx.strokeStyle = isCat ? '#06B6D4' : '#CCFF00';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -6, petRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Talking Tom voice acoustic ripples
        if (s.talkingVolume > 0.05) {
          const waveRadius = petRadius + 6 + s.talkingVolume * 16;
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(204, 255, 0, ${Math.min(1, s.talkingVolume * 1.6)})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, -6, waveRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Accessories: Shades & Glasses
        if (customFeatures?.glasses === 'shades') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0F172A';
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#38BDF8';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          [-16, 16].forEach((gx) => {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.roundRect(gx - 13, -16, 26, 16, 5);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();
          });
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-4, -9);
          ctx.lineTo(4, -9);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (customFeatures?.glasses === 'vr') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#1E1B4B';
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#CCFF00';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-26, -16, 52, 18, 5);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(-22, -9, 44, 5, 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }

        // Accessories: Hats & Crowns
        if (customFeatures?.hat === 'crown') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#B45309';
          ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-22, -petRadius - 2);
          ctx.lineTo(-24, -petRadius - 24);
          ctx.lineTo(-11, -petRadius - 10);
          ctx.lineTo(0, -petRadius - 28);
          ctx.lineTo(11, -petRadius - 10);
          ctx.lineTo(24, -petRadius - 24);
          ctx.lineTo(22, -petRadius - 2);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#EF4444';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, -petRadius - 12, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (customFeatures?.hat === 'party') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#EC4899';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, -petRadius - 32);
          ctx.lineTo(-16, -petRadius);
          ctx.lineTo(16, -petRadius);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#CCFF00';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, -petRadius - 34, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        } else if (customFeatures?.hat === 'detective') {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.fillStyle = '#78350F';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, -petRadius - 2, 26, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, -petRadius - 7, 16, Math.PI, 0);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        }
      } else {
        // COLOR PALETTES FOR SPECIES
        let primaryColor = '#D97706'; // Shiba Inu default
      let secondaryColor = '#B45309';
      let bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
      let earColor = '#F472B6'; // Pink inner ear
      let eyeColor = '#451A03';
      let noseColor = '#1C1917';

      // --- CATS ---
      if (species === 'tabby') {
        // Orange Tabby Cat
        primaryColor = '#EA580C';
        secondaryColor = '#C2410C';
        bellyColor = '#FFEDD5';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#15803D'; // Emerald cat eyes
        noseColor = '#FB7185'; // Pink cat nose
      } else if (species === 'bengal') {
        // Bengal Leopard Cat
        primaryColor = '#D97706';
        secondaryColor = '#78350F';
        bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#16A34A'; // Emerald green
        noseColor = '#FB7185';
      } else if (species === 'mainecoon') {
        // Maine Coon Giant Cat
        primaryColor = '#64748B';
        secondaryColor = '#334155';
        bellyColor = '#F1F5F9';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#F59E0B'; // Rich gold
        noseColor = '#FB7185';
      } else if (species === 'british') {
        // British Shorthair
        primaryColor = '#64748B';
        secondaryColor = '#475569';
        bellyColor = '#94A3B8';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#EA580C'; // Vivid copper
        noseColor = '#475569';
      } else if (species === 'scottish') {
        // Scottish Fold
        primaryColor = '#E2E8F0';
        secondaryColor = '#CBD5E1';
        bellyColor = '#FFFFFF';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#FBBF24'; // Bright amber
        noseColor = '#FB7185';
      } else if (species === 'calico') {
        // Calico Cat
        primaryColor = '#F8FAFC'; // White body
        secondaryColor = '#EA580C'; // Ginger patch
        bellyColor = '#FFFFFF';
        earColor = '#FDA4AF';
        eyeColor = '#059669';
        noseColor = '#FB7185';
      } else if (species === 'siamese') {
        // Siamese Cat
        primaryColor = '#FEF3C7'; // Cream coat
        secondaryColor = '#451A03'; // Chocolate seal point
        bellyColor = '#FFFBEB';
        earColor = '#292524';
        eyeColor = '#0284C7'; // Sapphire blue eyes
        noseColor = '#292524';
      } else if (species === 'blackcat' || species === 'bagheera') {
        // Black Cat / Shadow Panther
        primaryColor = '#0F172A';
        secondaryColor = '#1E293B';
        bellyColor = '#334155';
        earColor = '#38BDF8';
        eyeColor = '#FACC15'; // Glowing gold eyes
        noseColor = '#0F172A';
      }
      // --- DOGS ---
      else if (species === 'germanshepherd') {
        // German Shepherd
        primaryColor = '#C27803';
        secondaryColor = '#1E293B';
        bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
        earColor = '#92400E';
        eyeColor = '#78350F';
        noseColor = '#0F172A';
      } else if (species === 'rottweiler') {
        // Rottweiler
        primaryColor = '#0F172A';
        secondaryColor = '#B45309';
        bellyColor = '#1E293B';
        earColor = '#78350F';
        eyeColor = '#451A03';
        noseColor = '#020617';
      } else if (species === 'doberman') {
        // Doberman Pinscher
        primaryColor = '#0A0F1D';
        secondaryColor = '#B45309';
        bellyColor = '#1E293B';
        earColor = '#78350F';
        eyeColor = '#451A03';
        noseColor = '#020617';
      } else if (species === 'corgi') {
        // Welsh Corgi
        primaryColor = '#EA580C';
        secondaryColor = '#C2410C';
        bellyColor = '#FFFFFF';
        earColor = '#FDBA74';
        eyeColor = '#451A03';
        noseColor = '#1C1917';
      } else if (species === 'shiba') {
        // Shiba Inu
        primaryColor = '#D97706';
        secondaryColor = '#B45309';
        bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
        earColor = '#FEF3C7';
        eyeColor = '#292524';
        noseColor = '#0F172A';
      } else if (species === 'retriever') {
        // Golden Retriever
        primaryColor = '#F59E0B';
        secondaryColor = '#D97706';
        bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
        earColor = '#D97706';
        eyeColor = '#451A03';
        noseColor = '#1C1917';
      } else if (species === 'husky') {
        // Siberian Husky
        primaryColor = '#334155';
        secondaryColor = '#1E293B';
        bellyColor = '#F8FAFC';
        earColor = '#CBD5E1';
        eyeColor = '#38BDF8'; // Icy arctic blue eyes
        noseColor = '#0F172A';
      } else if (species === 'bulldog') {
        // French Bulldog
        primaryColor = '#94A3B8';
        secondaryColor = '#64748B';
        bellyColor = '#E2E8F0';
        earColor = '#F472B6';
        eyeColor = '#1E293B';
        noseColor = '#0F172A';
      }
      // --- MYTHIC BEASTS ---
      else if (species === 'kodiak') {
        primaryColor = '#854D0E';
        secondaryColor = '#A16207';
        bellyColor = '#FEF08A';
        earColor = '#713F12';
        eyeColor = '#0F172A';
        noseColor = '#1C1917';
      } else if (species === 'ignis') {
        primaryColor = '#B91C1C';
        secondaryColor = '#DC2626';
        bellyColor = '#FED7AA';
        earColor = '#7F1D1D';
        eyeColor = '#FBBF24';
        noseColor = '#450A0A';
      } else if (species === 'sultan') {
        primaryColor = '#D97706';
        secondaryColor = '#F59E0B';
        bellyColor = '#FEF3C7';
        earColor = '#92400E';
        eyeColor = '#10B981';
        noseColor = '#78350F';
      }

      const curPalette = customPaletteRef.current || customPalette;
      const curFeatures = customFeaturesRef.current || customFeatures;

      // Custom User Photo Avatar / DNA Builder Palette Override
      if (curPalette) {
        if (curPalette.primary) primaryColor = curPalette.primary;
        if (curPalette.secondary) secondaryColor = curPalette.secondary;
        if (curPalette.belly) bellyColor = curPalette.belly;
        if (curPalette.ear) earColor = curPalette.ear;
        if (curPalette.eye) eyeColor = curPalette.eye;
        if (curPalette.nose) noseColor = curPalette.nose;
      }

      // (Stage scaling is cleanly incorporated into totalScaleX / totalScaleY above)

      // A. TAIL (BEHIND BODY)
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(35, 15);
      ctx.rotate(wagAngle);
      ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
      ctx.strokeStyle = secondaryColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;

      ctx.beginPath();
      if (isCat) {
        // Long sleek curled cat tail
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(25, -15, 38, -48, 22, -58);
        ctx.bezierCurveTo(16, -48, 12, -20, 0, 0);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'shiba') {
        // Curled fluffy Shiba donut tail
        ctx.arc(0, -18, 16, 0, Math.PI * 1.6);
        ctx.lineWidth = 14;
        ctx.strokeStyle = primaryColor;
        ctx.stroke();
        // White tip
        ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(14, -26, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'bulldog') {
        // Short cute stubby corkscrew tail
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(6, -2, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        // Long bushy dog / wolf tail
        ctx.moveTo(0, 0);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(35, -10, 45, -35);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(20, -15, 0, 0);
        ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.restore();

      // B. BACK LEGS / PAWS
      ctx.fillStyle = secondaryColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(-38, 38, 16, 12, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.ellipse(38, 38, 16, 12, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // C. MAIN BODY TORSO
      const bodyGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -40, 0, 45);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(0, secondaryColor);
      bodyGrad.addColorStop(1, primaryColor);
      ctx.fillStyle = bodyGrad;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-45, 25);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(-55, -20, -35, -45, 0, -45);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(35, -45, 55, -20, 45, 25);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(40, 50, -40, 50, -45, 25);
      ctx.fill();

      // Calico patches
      if (species === 'calico') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#EA580C'; // Ginger patch
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-24, 10, 16, 14, 0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0F172A'; // Black patch
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(26, 18, 14, 12, -0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // D. BELLY PATCH
      ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, 12, 25, 26, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Tabby stripes
      if (species === 'tabby') {
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#9A3412';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        [-12, 0, 12].forEach((offsetY) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-38, offsetY);
          ctx.lineTo(-24, offsetY + 2);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(38, offsetY);
          ctx.lineTo(24, offsetY + 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
      }

      // E. HEAD
      const headGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -32, 10, 0, -32, 45);
      headGrad.addColorStop(0, secondaryColor);
      headGrad.addColorStop(1, primaryColor);
      ctx.fillStyle = headGrad;

      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(0, -32, 42, 36, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // F. EARS
      const earTwitch = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * (s.pettingIntensity > 0 ? 0.2 : 0.05);

      if (isCat) {
        if (curFeatures?.earType === 'round' || species === 'scottish') {
          // Scottish Fold flat-folded rounded ears
          [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(side * 28, -52);
            ctx.rotate(side * 0.65);
            ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 13, 11, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.ellipse(0, 2, 7, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
          });
        } else {
          // Sharp, pointed, sleek Cat Ears with Pink Inner Pocket & Fur Tufts
          [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
            ctx.save();
            ctx.translate(side * 27, -56);
            ctx.rotate(side * (0.26 - earTwitch));
            ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-15, 14);
            ctx.lineTo(0, -32);
            ctx.lineTo(15, 14);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();

            // Pink inside pocket
            ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-8, 10);
            ctx.lineTo(0, -22);
            ctx.lineTo(8, 10);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();

            // Ear edge highlight
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#FFFFFF';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(-4, 6);
            ctx.lineTo(side * 4, -8);
            ctx.stroke();

            ctx.restore();
          });
        }
      } else if (curFeatures?.earType === 'floppy' || species === 'retriever' || species === 'rottweiler') {
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(side * 36, -42);
          ctx.rotate(side * (0.15 + earTwitch));
          ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 16, 14, 26, side * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 15, 8, 17, side * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        });
      } else if (curFeatures?.earType === 'round' || species === 'bulldog') {
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(side * 30, -56);
          ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 0, 16, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(0, 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        });
      } else if (species === 'corgi') {
        // Big perky Corgi fox ears!
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(side * 30, -56);
          ctx.rotate(side * (0.22 - earTwitch));
          ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, -12, 16, 26, side * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, -10, 10, 18, side * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        });
      } else {
        // Canine alert upright ears (Shiba, German Shepherd, Husky)
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(side * 28, -58);
          ctx.rotate(side * (0.22 - earTwitch));
          ctx.fillStyle = primaryColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-16, 14);
          ctx.lineTo(0, -25);
          ctx.lineTo(16, 14);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();

          ctx.fillStyle = earColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-8, 10);
          ctx.lineTo(0, -16);
          ctx.lineTo(8, 10);
          ctx.closePath();
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        });
      }

      // DISTINCT BREED MASKS & FACIAL MARKINGS
      if (species === 'husky') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F8FAFC';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -26, 32, 22, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'siamese') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#451A03';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -28, 26, 20, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'germanshepherd') {
        // German Shepherd black muzzle mask
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1E293B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -24, 25, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'corgi') {
        // Corgi white blaze between eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-6, -14);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -42);
        ctx.lineTo(6, -14);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'rottweiler' || species === 'doberman' || curFeatures?.hasEyebrowDots) {
        // Distinct tan eyebrow dots above eyes
        ctx.fillStyle = secondaryColor || '#B45309';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-20, -50, 4.5, 3.2, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(20, -50, 4.5, 3.2, 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (species === 'bengal' || curFeatures?.hasRosettes) {
        // Leopard rosettes on cheeks
        ctx.strokeStyle = secondaryColor || '#78350F';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(side * 25, -24, 4, 0, Math.PI * 1.5);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(side * 28, -34, 3.5, 0.5, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
      }

      // Chimera Cross-Markings: if Chimera has both stripes or extra hybrid marks
      if (curFeatures?.hasStripes) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = secondaryColor || '#475569';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(side * 18, -48);
          ctx.lineTo(side * 30, -50);
          ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(side * 16, -42);
          ctx.lineTo(side * 28, -43);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
      }

      // G. MUZZLE & SNOUT
      if (isCat) {
        // Cat cheek pads (dual cute rounded feline muzzle pads)
        ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-9, -20, 13, 10, -0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(9, -20, 13, 10, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        // Dog muzzle / snout oval
        ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -20, 24, 18, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // CAT & CUSTOM WHISKERS
      const shouldDrawWhiskers = curFeatures?.hasWhiskers !== undefined ? curFeatures.hasWhiskers : isCat;
      if (shouldDrawWhiskers) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = species === 'blackcat' ? '#CBD5E1' : '#78716C';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
        // Left whiskers
        [-5, 0, 5].forEach((dy, i) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-12, -20 + dy);
          ctx.lineTo(-44, -23 + dy + i * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
        // Right whiskers
        [-5, 0, 5].forEach((dy, i) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(12, -20 + dy);
          ctx.lineTo(44, -23 + dy + i * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
      }

      // NOSE
      ctx.fillStyle = noseColor;
      if (isCat) {
        // Feline inverted triangular nose
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-6, -25);
        ctx.lineTo(6, -25);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -20);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        // Canine rounded nose with nostrils
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -26, 9.5, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(-3.5, -26, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.arc(3.5, -26, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // MOUTH & TONGUE
      ctx.strokeStyle = noseColor;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;

      if ((anim === 'eat' || anim === 'talk' || anim === 'drink_milk') && mouthHeight > 1) {
        // Open talking / eating mouth
        ctx.fillStyle = '#991B1B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -17 + mouthHeight * 0.3, 9, mouthHeight, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();

        // Pink tongue inside
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F472B6';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -14 + mouthHeight * 0.4, 6, mouthHeight * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else if (isDog && (anim === 'idle' || anim === 'pet' || anim === 'laugh')) {
        // Smiling dog mouth with panting tongue!
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-10, -18);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4, -13, 0, -17);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(4, -13, 10, -18);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Adorable sticking out pink tongue
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FB7185';
        ctx.beginPath();
        const tongueBob = Math.sin(s.time * 8) * 2;
        ctx.ellipse(0, -12 + tongueBob, 6, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#E11D48';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -14 + tongueBob);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -9 + tongueBob);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else if (anim === 'sleep') {
        // Sleeping smile
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -19, 6, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2);
        ctx.stroke();
      } else {
        // Cute cat / puppy 'w' mouth
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-9, -18);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-4, -14, 0, -18);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(4, -14, 9, -18);
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      // H. EYES & GAZE
      const eyeSpacing = 20;
      const eyeY = -36;
      const eyeRadius = stage === 1 ? 9.5 : 8.5;

      const leftEyeX = -eyeSpacing;
      const rightEyeX = eyeSpacing;

      // Custom Eye Patch
      if (curFeatures?.eyePatch) {
        ctx.fillStyle = secondaryColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(leftEyeX, eyeY, 15, 14, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Custom Collar
      if (curFeatures?.collarColor) {
        ctx.fillStyle = curFeatures.collarColor;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-22, 0, 44, 7, 3);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, 8, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      if (anim === 'dizzy') {
        // Dizzy spiral / X eyes when poked!
        [-1, 1].forEach((dir) => {
          const ex = dir * eyeSpacing;
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#0F172A';
          ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          // X eyes
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(ex - 6, eyeY - 6);
          ctx.lineTo(ex + 6, eyeY + 6);
          ctx.moveTo(ex + 6, eyeY - 6);
          ctx.lineTo(ex - 6, eyeY + 6);
          ctx.stroke();
        });

        // Circling stars above head
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          const starAngle = s.time * 6 + (i * Math.PI * 2) / 3;
          const sx = Math.cos(starAngle) * 36;
          const sy = Math.sin(starAngle) * 12 - 70;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#FBBF24';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(sx, sy, 4.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      } else if (
        s.isBlinking ||
        anim === 'pet' ||
        anim === 'sleep' ||
        anim === 'laugh'
      ) {
        // Happy closed smiling eyes ^_^
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#0F172A';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(leftEyeX, eyeY, 8, 1.2 * Math.PI, 1.8 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(rightEyeX, eyeY, 8, 1.2 * Math.PI, 1.8 * Math.PI);
        ctx.stroke();

        // Cheerful pink blush on cheeks
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(244, 63, 94, 0.45)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(-28, -24, 7, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.ellipse(28, -24, 7, 4, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      } else {
        // Open expressive eyes
        [-1, 1].forEach((dir) => {
          const ex = dir * eyeSpacing;

          // Eye base
          ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex, eyeY, eyeRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.15)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Iris
          const pupilOffsetX = s.eyeGazeX * 3.5;
          const pupilOffsetY = s.eyeGazeY * 3.5;

          ctx.fillStyle = eyeColor;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex + pupilOffsetX, eyeY + pupilOffsetY, eyeRadius * 0.75, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();

          // Cat slit pupil vs Round puppy pupil
          ctx.fillStyle = '#0F172A';
          ctx.beginPath();
          if (isCat) {
            ctx.ellipse(
              ex + pupilOffsetX,
              eyeY + pupilOffsetY,
              eyeRadius * 0.28,
              eyeRadius * 0.62,
              0,
              0,
              Math.PI * 2
            );
          } else {
            ctx.arc(ex + pupilOffsetX, eyeY + pupilOffsetY, eyeRadius * 0.45, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          }
          ctx.fill();

          // Specular high shine
          ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex + pupilOffsetX - 2.5, eyeY + pupilOffsetY - 2.5, 2.8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(ex + pupilOffsetX + 2, eyeY + pupilOffsetY + 2, 1.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        });
      }

      // I. FRONT PAWS (RESTING ON FRONT)
      let leftPawY = 28;
      let rightPawY = 28;
      let leftPawX = -20;
      let rightPawX = 20;
      let pawScale = 1;

      if (anim === 'beg') {
        // Paws up waving cute
        leftPawY = -4 + Math.sin(s.time * 12) * 8;
        rightPawY = -4 - Math.sin(s.time * 12) * 8;
        leftPawX = -16;
        rightPawX = 16;
        pawScale = 1.15;
      } else if (anim === 'dance') {
        // Tapping paws to rhythm
        leftPawY = 28 - Math.max(0, Math.sin(s.time * 9)) * 12;
        rightPawY = 28 - Math.max(0, -Math.sin(s.time * 9)) * 12;
      } else if (anim === 'rollover') {
        // Paws stick up in the air
        leftPawY = 12 + Math.sin(s.time * 10) * 4;
        rightPawY = 12 - Math.sin(s.time * 10) * 4;
      }

      ctx.fillStyle = secondaryColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.ellipse(leftPawX, leftPawY, 12 * pawScale, 10 * pawScale, -0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.ellipse(rightPawX, rightPawY, 12 * pawScale, 10 * pawScale, 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Pad details
      ctx.fillStyle = bellyColor;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(leftPawX, leftPawY + 2, 4.5 * pawScale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.arc(rightPawX, rightPawY + 2, 4.5 * pawScale, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      // Milk Bowl (if drinking milk)
      if (anim === 'drink_milk') {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#38BDF8';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 42, 28, 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 40, 22, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // Soap Bubbles on Head (if bath)
      if (anim === 'bath') {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)';
        [-12, 0, 12].forEach((bx, idx) => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(bx, -62 - (idx % 2) * 5, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        });
      }

      // Glasses / Shades Accessory
      if (curFeatures?.glasses === 'shades') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0F172A';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#38BDF8';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        [-1, 1].forEach((dir) => {
          const ex = dir * eyeSpacing;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.roundRect(ex - 12, eyeY - 8, 24, 16, 5);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();
        });
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-eyeSpacing + 12, eyeY);
        ctx.lineTo(eyeSpacing - 12, eyeY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      } else if (curFeatures?.glasses === 'vr') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#1E1B4B';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#CCFF00';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-28, eyeY - 10, 56, 20, 6);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#00F0FF';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(-24, eyeY - 3, 48, 6, 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // Hats Accessory
      if (curFeatures?.hat === 'crown') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#F59E0B';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#B45309';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(-18, -48);
        ctx.lineTo(-20, -68);
        ctx.lineTo(-10, -56);
        ctx.lineTo(0, -72);
        ctx.lineTo(10, -56);
        ctx.lineTo(20, -68);
        ctx.lineTo(18, -48);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#EF4444';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -56, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      } else if (curFeatures?.hat === 'party') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#EC4899';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -80);
        ctx.lineTo(-16, -48);
        ctx.lineTo(16, -48);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#CCFF00';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -82, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      } else if (curFeatures?.hat === 'detective') {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#78350F';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -50, 24, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(0, -55, 15, Math.PI, 0);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      // TITAN STAGE 3 CRYSTAL CREST / HORNS
      if (stage === 3) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#CCFF00';
        ctx.shadowColor = '#CCFF00';
        ctx.shadowBlur = 12;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(0, -68);
        ctx.lineTo(-6, -50);
        ctx.lineTo(6, -50);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
    }

      ctx.restore(); // Restore main transform

      // 4. PARTICLES RENDERING
      for (let i = s.particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const p = s.particles[i];
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        p.life -= dt * 1.5;
        p.alpha = Math.max(0, p.life);

        if (p.life <= 0) {
          s.particles.splice(i, 1);
          continue;
        }

        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalAlpha = p.alpha;

        if (p.type === 'heart') {
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
          ctx.beginPath();
          const hs = p.size * 0.7;
          ctx.moveTo(0, -hs * 0.4);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(-hs, -hs * 1.2, -hs * 1.6, hs * 0.4, 0, hs * 1.4);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(hs * 1.6, hs * 0.4, hs, -hs * 1.2, 0, -hs * 0.4);
          ctx.fill();
        } else if (p.type === 'bubble') {
          ctx.strokeStyle = p.color;
          ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(103, 232, 249, 0.25)';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.stroke();
          // Bubble sheen
          ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x - p.size * 0.3, p.y - p.size * 0.3, p.size * 0.25, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else if (p.type === 'star') {
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else if (p.type === 'sleep' && p.text) {
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          ctx.font = 'bold 16px monospace';
          ctx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
        } else if (p.type === 'sparkle') {
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size * p.life, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        } else if (p.type === 'crumb' || p.type === 'milk') {
          ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3.5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
        ctx.restore();
      }

      animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };

    animFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);

    return () => {
      if (animFrameRef.current) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(animFrameRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [species, stage, interactive, onStroke, spawnParticle, width, height, showAura]);

  return (
    <div
      className={`relative select-none flex items-center justify-center ${className}`}
      style={{ width, height }}
    >
      <canvas
        ref={canvasRef}
        width={width}
        height={height}
        onPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
        onPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
        onPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
        onPointerCancel={handlePointerUp}
        onDoubleClick={handleDoubleClick}
        className={`touch-none ${
          interactive ? 'cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing' : 'pointer-events-none'
        }`}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>

<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { WildPetEncounter, CompanionPet, BerryItem, BERRIES } from '../../../types/pet';
import { ProceduralPetCanvas } from './ProceduralPetCanvas';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../../utils/confetti';
import {
  X,
  Sparkles,
  Zap,
  Shield,
  Heart,
  Award,
  ChevronRight,
  Compass,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle,
  RotateCw,
} from 'lucide-react';

interface WildPetCatchModalProps {
  encounter: WildPetEncounter;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCaught: (pet: CompanionPet) => void;
}

export const WildPetCatchModal: React.FC<WildPetCatchModalProps> = ({
  encounter,
  onClose,
  onCaught,
}) => {
  const [selectedBerry, setSelectedBerry] = useState<BerryItem | null>(null);
  const [berryApplied, setBerryApplied] = useState(false);
  const [ringRadius, setRingRadius] = useState(60);
  const [ballState, setBallState] = useState<'ready' | 'thrown' | 'shaking' | 'caught' | 'escaped'>(
    'ready'
  );
  const [shakeCount, setShakeCount] = useState(0);
  const [throwQuality, setThrowQuality] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isCurveball, setIsCurveball] = useState(false);
  const [ballSpinAngle, setBallSpinAngle] = useState(0);
  const [caughtResultPet, setCaughtResultPet] = useState<CompanionPet | null>(null);
  const [ballPos, setBallPos] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 });
  const [isAiming, setIsAiming] = useState(false);
  const dragStartRef = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  // Contracting target catch ring loop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (ballState !== 'ready') return;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setRingRadius((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 24) return 60;
        return prev - 1.5;
      });
    }, 30);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [ballState]);

  // Throw Pokeball handler
  const handleBallPointerDown = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (ballState !== 'ready') return;
    setIsAiming(true);
    dragStartRef.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY };
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  };

  const handleBallPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isAiming || !dragStartRef.current) return;
    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;

    // Detect spin curve
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 30) {
      setIsCurveball(true);
      setBallSpinAngle((prev) => prev + (dx > 0 ? 15 : -15));
    }

    if (dy < 0) {
      // Pulling / aiming upwards
      setBallPos({ x: dx * 0.4, y: dy * 0.6, scale: Math.max(0.7, 1 + dy * 0.001) });
    }
  };

  const handleBallPointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    if (!isAiming || !dragStartRef.current) return;
    setIsAiming(false);
    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}

    const dy = e.clientY - dragStartRef.current.y;
    const dx = e.clientX - dragStartRef.current.x;
    dragStartRef.current = null;

    // Minimum flick threshold to throw
    if (dy < -40) {
      const detectedCurve = Math.abs(dx) > 30;
      executeThrow(detectedCurve, dx);
    } else {
      // Reset position
      setBallPos({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 });
      setIsCurveball(false);
    }
  };

  const executeThrow = (hasCurve: boolean, dxOffset: number) => {
    setBallState('thrown');
    sound.playPokeBallThrow();

    // Determine throw bonus based on contracting ring size
    let quality = 'NICE THROW!';
    let bonus = 1.15;
    if (ringRadius < 32) {
      quality = 'EXCELLENT THROW!';
      bonus = 1.75;
    } else if (ringRadius < 45) {
      quality = 'GREAT THROW!';
      bonus = 1.4;
    }

    if (hasCurve) {
      quality = `🌀 SPIN CURVEBALL! + ${quality}`;
      bonus *= 1.35;
    }

    setThrowQuality(quality);

    // Animate curved ball trajectory toward pet
    if (hasCurve) {
      setBallPos({ x: dxOffset * 0.5, y: -110, scale: 0.65 });
      setTimeout(() => {
        setBallPos({ x: 0, y: -220, scale: 0.35 });
      }, 150);
    } else {
      setBallPos({ x: 0, y: -220, scale: 0.35 });
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      // Ball hits pet
      setBallState('shaking');
      sound.playPokeBallShake();
      setShakeCount(1);

      // Shake 1
      setTimeout(() => {
        sound.playPokeBallShake();
        setShakeCount(2);

        // Shake 2
        setTimeout(() => {
          sound.playPokeBallShake();
          setShakeCount(3);

          // Final catch calculation
          const berryMult = selectedBerry?.catchBonus || 1.0;
          const catchRate = Math.min(0.95, encounter.baseCatchRate * bonus * berryMult);
          const roll = Math.random();

          setTimeout(() => {
            if (roll <= catchRate) {
              // GOTCHA!
              sound.playPokeBallCatch();
              triggerVictoryExplosion();
              setBallState('caught');

              const caught: CompanionPet = {
                id: `pet_caught_${encounter.species}_${Date.now()}`,
                species: encounter.species,
                category: encounter.category,
                name: encounter.name.replace('Wild ', ''),
                title: encounter.title,
                stage: 1,
                level: encounter.level,
                exp: 0,
                maxExp: 100,
                affectionHearts: 1,
                affectionPoints: 20,
                hunger: 75,
                happiness: 90,
                energy: 90,
                mood: 'happy',
                stats: { ...encounter.stats },
                battleBuff: {
                  name: 'Wild Instinct',
                  description: '+14% Critical Chance & Arena Speed',
                  effectType: 'crit_chance',
                  potency: 14,
                },
                createdAt: Date.now(),
                lastFedAt: Date.now(),
                lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
                totalPats: 0,
                totalBerriesEaten: selectedBerry ? 1 : 0,
                caughtAt: 'Wild Radar Grasslands',
              };

              setCaughtResultPet(caught);
              onCaught(caught);
            } else {
              // Broke free
              sound.playLightHit();
              setBallState('escaped');
              setBallPos({ x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 });
              setIsCurveball(false);
              setTimeout(() => {
                setBallState('ready');
                setShakeCount(0);
                setThrowQuality(null);
              }, 1200);
            }
          }, 600);
        }, 700);
      }, 700);
    }, 450);
  };

  const handleApplyBerry = (b: BerryItem) => {
    if (berryApplied || ballState !== 'ready') return;
    sound.playEat();
    setSelectedBerry(b);
    setBerryApplied(true);
  };

  const ringColor =
    encounter.rarity === 'common'
      ? '#22C55E'
      : encounter.rarity === 'rare'
      ? '#F59E0B'
      : '#EF4444';

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-sm bg-gradient-to-b from-[#0F172A] via-[#0B0E17] to-[#05070B] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-[640px] text-white">
        {/* Top Header */}
        <div className="p-3 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-black/40">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="p-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 text-xs">
              <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" />
            </span>
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Wild Encounter
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                {encounter.distanceMeters}m away in the wild
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-full bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
          >
            <X className="w-4 h-4" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Wild Pet Stats Badge */}
        <div className="px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#151D30]/60 border-b border-white/5 text-xs font-mono">
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>{encounter.name}</span>
              <span
                className={`text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded font-mono uppercase ${
                  encounter.category === 'cat'
                    ? 'bg-purple-500/20 text-purple-300'
                    : 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300'
                }`}
              >
                {encounter.category}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">CP {encounter.cp}</div>
          </div>

          <div className="text-right">
            <div className="text-[10px] uppercase text-neutral-400">Base Catch Rate</div>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">
              {Math.round(encounter.baseCatchRate * 100)}%
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Catch Arena Stage */}
        <div className="flex-1 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden">
          {/* Nature meadow background vignette */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(circle_at_50%_40%,#1e293b70_0%,transparent_75%)] pointer-events-none" />

          {/* Grass bushes & ambient particles */}
          <div className="absolute bottom-16 inset-x-0 h-24 bg-gradient-to-t from-emerald-950/40 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

          {/* Wild Pet Canvas */}
          <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
            {/* Target Catch Ring */}
            {ballState === 'ready' && (
              <div
                className="absolute pointer-events-none rounded-full transition-all duration-75 flex items-center justify-center"
                style={{
                  width: ringRadius * 2,
                  height: ringRadius * 2,
                  border: `3px solid ${ringColor}`,
                  boxShadow: `0 0 16px ${ringColor}60`,
                }}
              />
            )}

            {/* Throw Quality Text */}
            {throwQuality && (
              <div className="absolute -top-10 text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00] font-mono animate-bounce drop-shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(204,255,0,0.8)]">
                {throwQuality}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Pet rendered or Ball shaking */}
            {ballState !== 'shaking' && ballState !== 'caught' ? (
              <ProceduralPetCanvas
                species={encounter.species}
                stage={1}
                width={170}
                height={170}
                animationState={ballState === 'escaped' ? 'dizzy' : 'idle'}
                interactive={false}
              />
            ) : (
              /* Shaking Ball */
              <div className="relative py-8 flex flex-col items-center">
                <div
                  className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-full border-2 border-black flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl ${
                    shakeCount > 0 ? 'animate-[spin_0.3s_ease-in-out_infinite]' : ''
                  }`}
                  style={{
                    background:
                      'linear-gradient(180deg, #EF4444 0%, #EF4444 50%, #FFFFFF 50%, #FFFFFF 100%)',
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-0 right-0 h-1 bg-black -translate-y-1/2" />
                  <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-black flex items-center justify-center">
                    <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 animate-ping" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-3 text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                  {shakeCount === 1 && 'Wobble...'}
                  {shakeCount === 2 && 'Wobble... Wobble...'}
                  {shakeCount === 3 && 'Click!'}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Caught Success Overlay */}
          {ballState === 'caught' && caughtResultPet && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 z-20 bg-black/90 p-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
              <div className="text-3xl mb-1">🎉</div>
              <div className="text-base font-black uppercase text-[#CCFF00] tracking-wider mb-0.5">
                Gotcha!
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-neutral-300 font-bold mb-3">
                {encounter.name} was successfully caught!
              </div>

              {/* Pet Card */}
              <div className="w-full bg-[#121824] border border-[#CCFF00]/30 rounded-2xl p-3 mb-4 text-left font-mono">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-2">
                  <span className="font-bold text-white">{caughtResultPet.name}</span>
                  <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-black">CP {caughtResultPet.stats.cp}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                  <div>
                    ATK: <span className="text-white">{caughtResultPet.stats.attack}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    DEF: <span className="text-white">{caughtResultPet.stats.defense}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    AGI: <span className="text-white">{caughtResultPet.stats.agility}</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    STA: <span className="text-white">{caughtResultPet.stats.stamina}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                className="w-full py-2.5 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl text-xs cursor-pointer shadow-lg active:scale-95"
              >
                Send to Sanctuary & Kennel
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Interactive Throwing & Berry Tray */}
        {ballState !== 'caught' && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-black/60 border-t border-white/10 flex flex-col items-center">
            {/* Berry Selector */}
            <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mb-3">
              {BERRIES.slice(0, 3).map((berry) => (
                <button
                  key={berry.id}
                  onClick={() => handleApplyBerry(berry)}
                  disabled={berryApplied || ballState !== 'ready'}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                    selectedBerry?.id === berry.id
                      ? 'bg-amber-400 text-black shadow-md'
                      : 'bg-white/5 text-neutral-300 hover:bg-white/10'
                  } disabled:opacity-50`}
                >
                  <span>{berry.icon}</span>
                  <span>{berry.name.split(' ')[0]}</span>
                  {selectedBerry?.id === berry.id && <span>✓</span>}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* Draggable Pokeball with Spin-Curve */}
            <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
              <div
                onPointerDown={handleBallPointerDown}
                onPointerMove={handleBallPointerMove}
                onPointerUp={handleBallPointerUp}
                onPointerCancel={handleBallPointerUp}
                style={{
                  transform: `translate(${ballPos.x}px, ${ballPos.y}px) scale(${ballPos.scale}) rotate(${ballSpinAngle}deg)`,
                  transition: isAiming ? 'none' : 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)',
                }}
                className={`w-14 h-14 rounded-full border-2 border-black flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-2xl cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing touch-none select-none ${
                  ballState === 'ready' ? 'hover:scale-105 active:scale-95' : 'pointer-events-none'
                } ${isCurveball ? 'ring-2 ring-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(6,182,212,0.8)]' : ''}`}
              >
                {/* Red top */}
                <div className="flex-1 bg-red-600 border-b border-black flex items-end justify-center">
                  <div className="w-8 h-1 bg-red-400/50 rounded-full mb-1" />
                </div>
                {/* White bottom */}
                <div className="flex-1 bg-white" />
                {/* Center latch */}
                <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-black flex items-center justify-center shadow-inner">
                  <div
                    className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                      isCurveball ? 'bg-cyan-400 animate-ping' : 'bg-neutral-200'
                    }`}
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2 flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                {isCurveball ? (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 animate-pulse flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span>🌀</span> Curveball Arc Active (+35% Catch Rate!)
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    {isAiming
                      ? 'Flick Upwards (Curve Sideways for Bonus)!'
                      : 'Swipe Up to Throw · Curve for Bonus'}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
