<source>src/components/game/PetSlamIntroSplash.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Sparkles, Swords, Zap } from 'lucide-react';

interface PetSlamIntroSplashProps {
  onComplete: () => void;
}

// Synthesize a high-production Supercell / Clash Royale style intro fanfare via Web Audio API
const playIntroFanfare = () => {
  try {
    const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioContextClass) return;
    const ctx = new AudioContextClass();

    if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }

    const now = ctx.currentTime;

    // 1. Sub-bass cinematic boom
    const subOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const subGain = ctx.createGain();
    subOsc.type = 'sine';
    subOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, now);
    subOsc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(38, now + 1.2);
    subGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, now);
    subGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 1.4);
    subOsc.connect(subGain);
    subGain.connect(ctx.destination);
    subOsc.start(now);
    subOsc.stop(now + 1.5);

    // 2. High-voltage energetic chords (Supercell / Pet Slam signature fanfare)
    const notes = [
      { freq: 261.63, time: now + 0.05, dur: 0.35 },  // C4
      { freq: 392.00, time: now + 0.22, dur: 0.40 },  // G4
      { freq: 523.25, time: now + 0.45, dur: 0.50 },  // C5
      { freq: 659.25, time: now + 0.65, dur: 0.85 },  // E5
      { freq: 783.99, time: now + 0.65, dur: 0.95 },  // G5
    ];

    notes.forEach(({ freq, time, dur }) => {
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, time);

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, time);
      gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.28, time + 0.04);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, time + dur);

      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);
      osc.start(time);
      osc.stop(time + dur + 0.1);
    });

    // 3. Shimmer laser sparkle
    const sparkOsc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const sparkGain = ctx.createGain();
    sparkOsc.type = 'sine';
    sparkOsc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, now + 0.6);
    sparkOsc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(3200, now + 1.1);
    sparkGain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, now + 0.6);
    sparkGain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + 1.3);
    sparkOsc.connect(sparkGain);
    sparkGain.connect(ctx.destination);
    sparkOsc.start(now + 0.6);
    sparkOsc.stop(now + 1.4);
  } catch (e) {
    // Audio autoplay might be blocked before first user click; handled safely
  }
};

export const PetSlamIntroSplash: React.FC<PetSlamIntroSplashProps> = ({ onComplete }) => {
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(15);
  const [isFadingOut, setIsFadingOut] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Attempt audio on load
    playIntroFanfare();

    // Progress bar animation
    const timer1 = setTimeout(() => setProgress(65), 300);
    const timer2 = setTimeout(() => setProgress(100), 900);

    // Auto transition after 2.1 seconds
    const exitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      setIsFadingOut(true);
      setTimeout(onComplete, 450);
    }, 2100);

    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer1);
      clearTimeout(timer2);
      clearTimeout(exitTimer);
    };
  }, [onComplete]);

  const handleSkip = () => {
    playIntroFanfare();
    setIsFadingOut(true);
    setTimeout(onComplete, 200);
  };

  return (
    <div
      onClick={handleSkip}
      className={`fixed inset-0 z-[999] bg-[#07090F] flex flex-col items-center justify-between p-6 select-none cursor-pointer overflow-hidden transition-all duration-500 ${
        isFadingOut ? 'opacity-0 scale-105 pointer-events-none' : 'opacity-100 scale-100'
      }`}
    >
      {/* Background Radial Glow & Animated Energy Rings */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[600px] h-[600px] bg-[#CCFF00]/15 blur-[160px] rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[340px] h-[340px] bg-cyan-500/15 blur-[120px] rounded-full" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#1e293b40_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:24px_24px] opacity-60" />
      </div>

      {/* Top Studio Header */}
      <div className="relative z-10 pt-4 flex items-center gap-2 text-neutral-400 font-mono text-[11px] tracking-widest uppercase animate-in fade-in duration-700">
        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] animate-ping" />
        <span>PET SLAM ENTERTAINMENT</span>
      </div>

      {/* Center Hero Logo Emblem */}
      <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center text-center my-auto animate-in zoom-in-75 duration-700">
        {/* Neon Paw Emblem */}
        <div className="relative w-28 h-28 sm:w-36 sm:h-36 mb-6 flex items-center justify-center">
          {/* Pulsing Outer Shockwave Ring */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/40 animate-ping duration-1000" />
          <div className="absolute inset-2 rounded-full border-2 border-cyan-400/50 animate-pulse" />

          {/* Core Dark Orb */}
          <div className="relative w-24 h-24 sm:w-30 sm:h-30 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#121828] to-[#0A0D16] border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(204,255,0,0.45)] flex items-center justify-center">
            {/* SVG Official Paw Emblem */}
            <svg
              className="w-14 h-14 sm:w-16 sm:h-16 text-[#CCFF00] drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_#ccff00]"
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="currentColor"
            >
              <path d="M12 14c-2.2 0-4 1.3-4 3 0 1.2.9 2.2 2.3 2.7.5.2 1.1.3 1.7.3s1.2-.1 1.7-.3c1.4-.5 2.3-1.5 2.3-2.7 0-1.7-1.8-3-4-3zm-6-2.5c0 1.4 1.1 2.5 2.5 2.5s2.5-1.1 2.5-2.5S9.9 9 8.5 9 6 10.1 6 11.5zm9 0c0 1.4 1.1 2.5 2.5 2.5s2.5-1.1 2.5-2.5-1.1-2.5-2.5-2.5-2.5 1.1-2.5 2.5zm-8-5C7 7.9 8.1 9 9.5 9S12 7.9 12 6.5 10.9 4 9.5 4 7 5.1 7 6.5zm5 0c0 1.4 1.1 2.5 2.5 2.5s2.5-1.1 2.5-2.5S15.9 4 14.5 4 12 5.1 12 6.5z" />
            </svg>

            {/* Cyan Lightning Bolts */}
            <Zap className="absolute -top-3 -right-2 w-6 h-6 text-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_#00e5ff] animate-bounce" />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Big Game Title */}
        <h1 className="font-display font-black text-6xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl uppercase tracking-tighter text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-neutral-100 to-neutral-400 drop-shadow-[0_4px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.95)]">
          PET <span className="text-[#CCFF00] drop-shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(204,255,0,0.8)]">SLAM</span>
        </h1>

        {/* Laser Accent Bar */}
        <div className="w-48 sm:w-64 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#CCFF00] to-transparent my-2 shadow-[0_0_20px_#CCFF00]" />

        <p className="font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-300 uppercase tracking-widest mt-1">
          Real Dog & Cat Esports · Colosseum 1v1 Arena
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Loading Progress Bar & Tap to Skip */}
      <div className="relative z-10 w-full max-w-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-2 pb-4">
        <div className="w-full bg-[#121624] h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/10 p-0.5">
          <div
            className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-[#CCFF00] rounded-full transition-all duration-700 shadow-[0_0_10px_#ccff00]"
            style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[#CCFF00]">
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-[#CCFF00] animate-spin" />
            <span>INITIALIZING COMBAT ENGINE</span>
          </span>
          <span>{progress}%</span>
        </div>

        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-500 uppercase tracking-wider mt-2">
          Tap anywhere to skip
        </span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

<source>src/components/game/PetSlamTitleScreen.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Swords,
  Play,
  HelpCircle,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  User,
  Sparkles,
  Trophy,
  ChevronRight,
  Lock,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { animalImages } from '../../assets/images';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { GameGuideModal } from './GameGuideModal';
import { AccountAuthModal } from './AccountAuthModal';
import { PetSlamIntroSplash } from './PetSlamIntroSplash';
import { signInWithGoogle, isSupabaseConfigured } from '../../services/supabaseClient';

interface PetSlamTitleScreenProps {
  onEnterGame: () => void;
  onOpenSystemDetails: () => void;
}

export const PetSlamTitleScreen: React.FC<PetSlamTitleScreenProps> = ({
  onEnterGame,
}) => {
  const { trainerName, setTrainerName, activeBeast, soundEnabled, toggleSound, connectedAccount, loginAccount } = useGame();
  const { pet } = usePetCompanion();
  const [guideOpen, setGuideOpen] = useState(false);
  const [authOpen, setAuthOpen] = useState(false);
  const [showIntroSplash, setShowIntroSplash] = useState(false);
  const [glowPulse, setGlowPulse] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setGlowPulse((prev) => !prev);
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  const handleStart = () => {
    if (!connectedAccount.isLoggedIn) {
      sound.playClick();
      setAuthOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    sound.playVictory();
    onEnterGame();
  };

  const handleGoogleSignInDirect = async () => {
    sound.playClick();
    if (isSupabaseConfigured) {
      const res = await signInWithGoogle();
      if (res?.error) {
        // Show auth modal with the real error message so user knows Google OAuth needs setup
        setAuthOpen(true);
      }
      // If enabled in Supabase, browser automatically redirects to accounts.google.com
    } else {
      setAuthOpen(true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative min-h-screen w-full bg-[#080B11] text-white flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden select-none">
      {/* Background Arena Image with Atmospheric Colosseum Darkness */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
        <img
          src={animalImages.arenaColosseum}
          alt="PET SLAM Championship Arena"
          className="w-full h-full object-cover opacity-35 scale-105 filter brightness-75 contrast-125"
        />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#080B11] via-[#080B11]/70 to-[#080B11]/90" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#1e293b50_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:24px_24px] opacity-40" />

        {/* Ambient Neon Glow Flares */}
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-[550px] h-[350px] bg-cyan-500/15 blur-[140px] rounded-full pointer-events-none" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 right-1/4 w-[400px] h-[400px] bg-amber-500/15 blur-[140px] rounded-full pointer-events-none" />
      </div>

      {/* Clean Top Bar (No random developer junk) */}
      <header className="relative z-20 w-full px-3 sm:px-8 py-3 sm:py-4 flex items-center justify-between max-w-full overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 sm:gap-2.5">
          <div className="w-2 sm:w-2.5 h-2 sm:h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_10px_#CCFF00]" />
          <span className="font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-wider text-white uppercase">
            PET SLAM ARENA
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2">
          {/* Sound Toggle */}
          <button
            onClick={toggleSound}
            className="flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 sm:w-9 sm:h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/10 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm"
            title={soundEnabled ? 'Mute Sound' : 'Unmute Sound'}
          >
            {soundEnabled ? (
              <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            ) : (
              <VolumeX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 sm:w-4 sm:h-4 text-neutral-400" />
            )}
          </button>

          {/* Account Login Option (Google Hub) */}
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setAuthOpen(true);
            }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/15 text-white transition-all cursor-pointer text-[11px] sm:text-xs font-mono backdrop-blur-md shadow-sm font-bold truncate max-w-[150px] sm:max-w-none"
          >
            <User className="w-3 sm:w-3.5 h-3 sm:h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0" />
            <span className="truncate">{connectedAccount.isLoggedIn ? trainerName : 'Account Login'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Main Center Stage */}
      <main className="relative z-20 flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-3 sm:px-4 text-center my-auto w-full max-w-full overflow-hidden">
        {/* Championship Tag */}
        <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 px-2.5 sm:px-3.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/10 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider sm:tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00] mb-2 sm:mb-3 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.2)] max-w-[94vw] text-center">
          <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 sm:w-3.5 sm:h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00] animate-spin shrink-0" />
          <span className="truncate">REAL-TIME ANIMAL COMBAT ARENA</span>
        </div>

        {/* Epic Title Display */}
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center">
          <h1 className="font-display font-black text-5xl sm:text-7xl md:text-8xl uppercase tracking-tighter text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-b from-white via-neutral-100 to-neutral-400 drop-shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)]">
            PET <span className="text-[#CCFF00] drop-shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(204,255,0,0.7)]">SLAM</span>
          </h1>

          {/* Dynamic Laser Accent Bar */}
          <div className="relative w-40 sm:w-72 h-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-[#CCFF00] to-transparent my-1.5 sm:my-2 shadow-[0_0_15px_#CCFF00]">
            <div
              className={`absolute inset-0 bg-white transition-opacity duration-700 ${
                glowPulse ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-30'
              }`}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Guaranteed Crisp Active Beast Showcase Card */}
        <div className="mt-4 sm:mt-6 w-full max-w-xs bg-gradient-to-b from-[#131926]/95 to-[#0E121B]/95 border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-2xl p-3 sm:p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 backdrop-blur-md shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)]">
          <div className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-md shrink-0 bg-black">
            <img
              src={activeBeast.image}
              alt={activeBeast.name}
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
            <div className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-[#CCFF00] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_8px_#CCFF00]" />
          </div>

          <div className="text-left min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-[#CCFF00] font-bold block">
              Active Champion
            </span>
            <div className="font-display font-black text-base text-white truncate">
              {activeBeast.name}
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono truncate">
              {activeBeast.species} · Lv. {activeBeast.level || 8}
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-400">
              <span>{activeBeast.health} HP</span>
              <span className="text-neutral-600">|</span>
              <span>{activeBeast.damage} DMG</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive 2D Companion Status Chip */}
        <div className="mt-2.5 w-full max-w-xs bg-black/60 border border-[#CCFF00]/25 rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs backdrop-blur-sm shadow-md">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-neutral-300">
            <span>🐾</span>
            <span className="font-bold text-white">{pet.name}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">({pet.species})</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">
            <span>Buddy Active</span>
            <span className="text-pink-400">{'❤️'.repeat(pet.affectionHearts)}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Starting Action & Authentication Portal */}
        <div className="mt-4 w-full max-w-xs flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          {connectedAccount.isLoggedIn ? (
            <>
              {/* Authenticated Player Badge */}
              <div className="bg-black/60 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 flex items-center justify-between text-xs backdrop-blur-sm shadow-md">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] animate-pulse" />
                  <span className="text-neutral-400 font-mono text-[11px]">Logged in:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-white truncate">{trainerName}</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playClick();
                    setAuthOpen(true);
                  }}
                  className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] underline font-mono hover:text-white cursor-pointer ml-1 shrink-0"
                >
                  Switch
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Direct Play Button */}
              <button
                onClick={handleStart}
                className="group relative w-full py-3.5 px-6 rounded-2xl font-display font-black text-lg uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00] to-[#A3E600] hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_35px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 overflow-hidden"
              >
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-white/20 translate-y-full group-hover:translate-y-0 transition-transform duration-300 pointer-events-none" />
                <Play className="w-5 h-5 fill-black" />
                <span>ENTER ARENA</span>
                <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
              </button>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Option 1: Prominent Sign in with Google */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleGoogleSignInDirect}
                className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-white hover:bg-neutral-100 active:scale-[0.98] text-neutral-900 font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2.5 transition shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.2)] cursor-pointer border border-neutral-300"
              >
                <svg className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path fill="#4285F4" d="M22.56 12.25c0-.78-.07-1.53-.2-2.25H12v4.26h5.92c-.26 1.37-1.04 2.53-2.21 3.31v2.77h3.57c2.08-1.92 3.28-4.74 3.28-8.09z" />
                  <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 23c2.97 0 5.46-.98 7.28-2.66l-3.57-2.77c-.98.66-2.23 1.06-3.71 1.06-2.86 0-5.29-1.93-6.16-4.53H2.18v2.84C3.99 20.53 7.7 23 12 23z" />
                  <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.84 14.09c-.22-.66-.35-1.36-.35-2.09s.13-1.43.35-2.09V7.06H2.18C1.43 8.55 1 10.22 1 12s.43 3.45 1.18 4.94l2.85-2.22.81-.63z" />
                  <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 5.38c1.62 0 3.06.56 4.21 1.64l3.15-3.15C17.45 2.09 14.97 1 12 1 7.7 1 3.99 3.47 2.18 7.06l3.66 2.84c.87-2.6 3.3-4.52 6.16-4.52z" />
                </svg>
                <span>Sign in with Google</span>
              </button>

              {/* Option 2: Arena ID & Password */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  setAuthOpen(true);
                }}
                className="w-full py-3 px-4 rounded-xl bg-[#131926] hover:bg-[#1c2436] border border-[#CCFF00]/50 text-[#CCFF00] font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.15)] active:scale-[0.98]"
              >
                <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>Create Login ID / Password</span>
              </button>

              {/* Instant Guest / Preview */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleStart}
                className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 hover:text-white transition cursor-pointer underline text-center pt-0.5"
              >
                Continue as Guest / Enter Directly →
              </button>
            </>
          )}

          <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                sound.playClick();
                setGuideOpen(true);
              }}
              className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 border border-white/15 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 backdrop-blur-md"
            >
              <HelpCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Guide</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setShowIntroSplash(true);
              }}
              className="flex-1 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] bg-[#CCFF00]/10 hover:bg-[#CCFF00]/20 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 backdrop-blur-md"
            >
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Intro FX</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* Cinematic Intro Animation Overlay */}
      {showIntroSplash && (
        <PetSlamIntroSplash onComplete={() => setShowIntroSplash(false)} />
      )}

      {/* Account Login Modal */}
      {authOpen && (
        <AccountAuthModal
          currentTrainerName={trainerName}
          onUpdateTrainerName={setTrainerName}
          onClose={() => setAuthOpen(false)}
          onAuthSuccess={onEnterGame}
        />
      )}

      {/* Trainer Guide Modal */}
      <GameGuideModal isOpen={guideOpen} onClose={() => setGuideOpen(false)} />
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/RankedMatchmakingModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Swords,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Flame,
  Award,
  Crown,
  Wifi,
  WifiOff,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Trophy,
  Activity,
  ArrowRight,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../utils/confetti';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import {
  multiplayerNetcode,
  MatchFoundData,
  TickUpdateData,
  MatchFinishedData,
  NetFighterSnapshot,
} from '../../services/multiplayerNetcode';
import { triggerHeavyImpactHaptic, triggerMediumImpactHaptic } from '../../utils/haptics';

interface RankedMatchmakingModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const RankedMatchmakingModal: React.FC<RankedMatchmakingModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const { trainerName, playerTag, activeBeast, addCredits } = useGame();
  const { pet } = usePetCompanion();

  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'idle' | 'queuing' | 'matched' | 'fighting' | 'finished'>('idle');
  const [latency, setLatency] = useState<number>(multiplayerNetcode.latencyMs || 25);
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(3);
  const [matchData, setMatchData] = useState<MatchFoundData | null>(null);
  const [tickData, setTickData] = useState<TickUpdateData | null>(null);
  const [resultData, setResultData] = useState<MatchFinishedData | null>(null);
  const [combatLogs, setCombatLogs] = useState<Array<{ text: string; type: string }>>([]);

  const fallbackTimerRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const botCombatIntervalRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
  const isBotMatchRef = useRef<boolean>(false);

  const isPlayer1 = matchData?.p1.id === (playerTag || 'player_1');
  const myFighter = isPlayer1 ? matchData?.p1.fighter : matchData?.p2.fighter;
  const opponentFighter = isPlayer1 ? matchData?.p2.fighter : matchData?.p1.fighter;
  const opponentName = isPlayer1 ? matchData?.p2.name : matchData?.p1.name;

  const myHp = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p1.hp : tickData.p2.hp) : myFighter?.hp || 1000;
  const myMaxHp = myFighter?.maxHp || 1000;
  const myEnergy = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p1.energy : tickData.p2.energy) : 3;
  const myOverdrive = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p1.isOverdrive : tickData.p2.isOverdrive) : false;

  const oppHp = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p2.hp : tickData.p1.hp) : opponentFighter?.hp || 1000;
  const oppMaxHp = opponentFighter?.maxHp || 1000;
  const oppEnergy = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p2.energy : tickData.p1.energy) : 3;
  const oppOverdrive = tickData ? (isPlayer1 ? tickData.p2.isOverdrive : tickData.p1.isOverdrive) : false;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isOpen) {
      if (fallbackTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fallbackTimerRef.current);
        fallbackTimerRef.current = null;
      }
      if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) {
        clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
        botCombatIntervalRef.current = null;
      }
      isBotMatchRef.current = false;
      if (phase === 'fighting' || phase === 'queuing') {
        multiplayerNetcode.leaveRoom();
        multiplayerNetcode.cancelQueue();
      }
      setPhase('idle');
      return;
    }

    multiplayerNetcode.connect();

    const unsubscribe = multiplayerNetcode.subscribe((event, data) => {
      if (event === 'latency') {
        setLatency(data.latencyMs);
      } else if (event === 'queue_confirmed') {
        setPhase('queuing');
      } else if (event === 'match_found') {
        if (fallbackTimerRef.current) {
          clearTimeout(fallbackTimerRef.current);
          fallbackTimerRef.current = null;
        }
        isBotMatchRef.current = false;
        setMatchData(data);
        setPhase('matched');
        sound.playVictory();
      } else if (event === 'countdown_tick') {
        setCountdown(data);
        if (data <= 0) {
          setPhase('fighting');
        }
      } else if (event === 'tick_update') {
        setTickData(data);
        if (data.logs && data.logs.length > 0) {
          setCombatLogs((prev) => [...prev, ...data.logs].slice(-5));
        }
      } else if (event === 'match_finished') {
        setResultData(data);
        setPhase('finished');
        const won = (isPlayer1 && data.winnerId === data.p1Result.id) || (!isPlayer1 && data.winnerId === data.p2Result.id);
        if (won) {
          sound.playVictory();
          triggerVictoryExplosion();
          triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();
          addCredits(350);
        } else {
          sound.playDefeat();
          addCredits(100);
        }
      }
    });

    return () => {
      unsubscribe();
    };
  }, [isOpen, phase, isPlayer1]);

  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (fallbackTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(fallbackTimerRef.current);
      if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
    };
  }, []);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const startBotMatch = (effectivePet: any) => {
    isBotMatchRef.current = true;
    const botOpponents = [
      { name: 'Apex Buster', trainer: 'Rival Kira', breed: 'Husky Storm', cp: 1180, hp: 1050, image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1537151625747-768eb6cf92b2?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80' },
      { name: 'Shadow Saber', trainer: 'Grandmaster Kaito', breed: 'Bengal Stealth', cp: 1240, hp: 980, image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514888286974-6c03e2ca1dba?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80' },
      { name: 'Titan Corgi', trainer: 'Champion Luna', breed: 'Corgi Alpha', cp: 1120, hp: 1100, image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543466835-00a7907e9de1?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80' },
      { name: 'Solar Shiba', trainer: 'Sensei Kenji', breed: 'Shiba Blaze', cp: 1290, hp: 1020, image: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655857-d19b40a7a54e?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80' },
    ];
    const bot = botOpponents[Math.floor(Math.random() * botOpponents.length)];

    const myFighterSnap: NetFighterSnapshot = {
      id: playerTag || 'player_1',
      name: effectivePet.name,
      species: effectivePet.species,
      level: effectivePet.level,
      hp: effectivePet.health || 1000,
      maxHp: effectivePet.health || 1000,
      energy: 3,
      maxEnergy: 10,
      damage: effectivePet.damage || 80,
      defense: effectivePet.defense || 40,
      speed: effectivePet.speed || 50,
      cp: effectivePet.cp || 1200,
      image: effectivePet.image || activeBeast.image,
    };

    const oppFighterSnap: NetFighterSnapshot = {
      id: 'bot_rival',
      name: bot.name,
      species: bot.breed,
      level: effectivePet.level,
      hp: bot.hp,
      maxHp: bot.hp,
      energy: 3,
      maxEnergy: 10,
      damage: 85,
      defense: 45,
      speed: 60,
      cp: bot.cp,
      image: bot.image,
    };

    const simulatedMatch: MatchFoundData = {
      roomId: `sim_${Date.now()}`,
      p1: { id: playerTag || 'player_1', name: trainerName || 'Trainer', cp: myFighterSnap.cp, rating: 1200, fighter: myFighterSnap },
      p2: { id: 'bot_rival', name: bot.trainer, cp: bot.cp, rating: 1210, fighter: oppFighterSnap },
      countdown: 3,
    };

    setMatchData(simulatedMatch);
    setPhase('matched');
    sound.playVictory();

    let cd = 3;
    setCountdown(3);
    const cdTimer = setInterval(() => {
      cd -= 1;
      setCountdown(cd);
      if (cd <= 0) {
        clearInterval(cdTimer);
        setPhase('fighting');
        initBotFighting(myFighterSnap, oppFighterSnap, bot.name);
      }
    }, 1000);
  };

  const initBotFighting = (p1Snap: NetFighterSnapshot, p2Snap: NetFighterSnapshot, botName: string) => {
    let p1HpCur = p1Snap.hp;
    let p2HpCur = p2Snap.hp;
    let p1EnergyCur = 3.0;
    let p2EnergyCur = 3.0;
    let p1Over = false;
    let p2Over = false;

    setTickData({
      roomId: 'sim_room',
      tick: 1,
      p1: { id: p1Snap.id, hp: p1HpCur, maxHp: p1Snap.maxHp, energy: p1EnergyCur, isOverdrive: p1Over },
      p2: { id: p2Snap.id, hp: p2HpCur, maxHp: p2Snap.maxHp, energy: p2EnergyCur, isOverdrive: p2Over },
      logs: [{ tick: 1, text: `⚔️ Ranked Match Engaged vs ${botName}!`, type: 'info' }],
    });

    if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
    botCombatIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {
      p1EnergyCur = Math.min(10, p1EnergyCur + 0.35);
      p2EnergyCur = Math.min(10, p2EnergyCur + 0.35);

      const newLogs: Array<{ tick: number; text: string; type: string }> = [];

      if (p2EnergyCur >= 6 && !p2Over && Math.random() < 0.25) {
        p2EnergyCur -= 6;
        p2Over = true;
        const dmg = Math.round(180 + Math.random() * 60);
        p1HpCur = Math.max(0, p1HpCur - dmg);
        newLogs.push({ tick: Date.now(), text: `🔥 ${botName} activated OVERDRIVE for ${dmg} DMG!`, type: 'overdrive' });
      } else if (p2EnergyCur >= 3 && Math.random() < 0.35) {
        p2EnergyCur -= 3;
        const dmg = Math.round(75 + Math.random() * 45);
        p1HpCur = Math.max(0, p1HpCur - dmg);
        newLogs.push({ tick: Date.now(), text: `💥 ${botName} struck with Pounce for ${dmg} DMG!`, type: 'strike' });
      }

      setTickData({
        roomId: 'sim_room',
        tick: Date.now(),
        p1: { id: p1Snap.id, hp: p1HpCur, maxHp: p1Snap.maxHp, energy: p1EnergyCur, isOverdrive: p1Over },
        p2: { id: p2Snap.id, hp: p2HpCur, maxHp: p2Snap.maxHp, energy: p2EnergyCur, isOverdrive: p2Over },
        logs: newLogs,
      });

      if (newLogs.length > 0) {
        setCombatLogs((prev) => [...prev, ...newLogs].slice(-5));
      }

      if (p1HpCur <= 0 || p2HpCur <= 0) {
        if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) {
          clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
          botCombatIntervalRef.current = null;
        }
        const won = p1HpCur > 0;
        setResultData({
          roomId: 'sim_room',
          winnerId: won ? p1Snap.id : p2Snap.id,
          p1Result: { id: p1Snap.id, won, ratingDelta: won ? 24 : -16, rewardCredits: won ? 350 : 100, rewardExp: won ? 150 : 50 },
          p2Result: { id: p2Snap.id, won: !won, ratingDelta: !won ? 24 : -16, rewardCredits: 0, rewardExp: 0 },
          finalTick: 100,
        });
        setPhase('finished');
        if (won) {
          sound.playVictory();
          triggerVictoryExplosion();
          triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();
          addCredits(350);
        } else {
          sound.playDefeat();
          addCredits(100);
        }
      }
    }, 600);
  };

  const handleStartQueue = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    const effectivePet = pet || {
      id: activeBeast.id,
      name: activeBeast.name,
      species: activeBeast.species,
      level: activeBeast.level,
      health: activeBeast.health,
      damage: activeBeast.damage,
      defense: activeBeast.strength,
      speed: activeBeast.speed,
      cp: Math.round(activeBeast.health * 0.4 + activeBeast.damage * 1.5),
      image: activeBeast.image,
    };

    setPhase('queuing');
    if (fallbackTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(fallbackTimerRef.current);
    fallbackTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      startBotMatch(effectivePet);
    }, 3800);

    multiplayerNetcode.queueRanked({
      playerId: playerTag || 'player_1',
      playerName: trainerName || 'Trainer',
      rating: 1200,
      pet: effectivePet,
    });
  };

  const handleCancelQueue = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    if (fallbackTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(fallbackTimerRef.current);
      fallbackTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) {
      clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
      botCombatIntervalRef.current = null;
    }
    isBotMatchRef.current = false;
    multiplayerNetcode.cancelQueue();
    setPhase('idle');
  };

  const handleExecuteMove = (moveId: string) => {
    sound.playAttack();
    triggerMediumImpactHaptic();
    if (isBotMatchRef.current && tickData) {
      const costs: Record<string, { cost: number; dmg: number; name: string }> = {
        strike: { cost: 2, dmg: 85, name: 'Strike' },
        pounce: { cost: 3, dmg: 140, name: 'Pounce' },
        rend: { cost: 4, dmg: 210, name: 'Fang Rend' },
      };
      const move = costs[moveId];
      if (move && tickData.p1.energy >= move.cost) {
        const nextEnergy = tickData.p1.energy - move.cost;
        const nextOppHp = Math.max(0, tickData.p2.hp - move.dmg);
        const log = { tick: Date.now(), text: `⚡ You unleashed ${move.name} for ${move.dmg} DMG!`, type: 'crit' };
        setCombatLogs((prev) => [...prev, log].slice(-5));
        setTickData((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          p1: { ...prev.p1, energy: nextEnergy },
          p2: { ...prev.p2, hp: nextOppHp },
        } : null);
        if (nextOppHp <= 0) {
          if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) {
            clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
            botCombatIntervalRef.current = null;
          }
          setPhase('finished');
          sound.playVictory();
          triggerVictoryExplosion();
          triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();
          addCredits(350);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    multiplayerNetcode.sendMove(moveId);
  };

  const handleExecuteOverdrive = () => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();
    if (isBotMatchRef.current && tickData) {
      if (tickData.p1.energy >= 6 && !tickData.p1.isOverdrive) {
        const nextEnergy = tickData.p1.energy - 6;
        const nextOppHp = Math.max(0, tickData.p2.hp - 290);
        const log = { tick: Date.now(), text: `🔥 OVERDRIVE UNLEASHED! Crushing 290 DMG!`, type: 'overdrive' };
        setCombatLogs((prev) => [...prev, log].slice(-5));
        setTickData((prev) => prev ? {
          ...prev,
          p1: { ...prev.p1, energy: nextEnergy, isOverdrive: true },
          p2: { ...prev.p2, hp: nextOppHp },
        } : null);
        if (nextOppHp <= 0) {
          if (botCombatIntervalRef.current) {
            clearInterval(botCombatIntervalRef.current);
            botCombatIntervalRef.current = null;
          }
          setPhase('finished');
          sound.playVictory();
          triggerVictoryExplosion();
          triggerHeavyImpactHaptic();
          addCredits(350);
        }
      }
      return;
    }
    multiplayerNetcode.sendOverdrive();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none font-sans">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl bg-[#080C16] border border-cyan-500/40 rounded-3xl shadow-[0_0_50px_rgba(0,240,255,0.25)] flex flex-col overflow-hidden text-white">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0C1222] via-[#090D18] to-[#06080E]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-cyan-500/15 border border-cyan-400/40 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]">
              <Swords className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                  Ranked 1v1 Live Multiplayer
                </h2>
                <span className="text-[10px] bg-cyan-400 text-black px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-black font-mono">
                  20 TICKS/SEC
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                Authoritative Netcode · Strict ±150 CP Matchmaking · Real-Time Combat Sync
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 bg-white/5 border border-white/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl">
              {multiplayerNetcode.isConnected ? (
                <>
                  <Wifi className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
                  <span className="text-emerald-300 font-bold">{latency}ms</span>
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <WifiOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-400" />
                  <span className="text-rose-400">Connecting...</span>
                </>
              )}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                if (phase === 'fighting') multiplayerNetcode.leaveRoom();
                onClose();
              }}
              className="p-1.5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <X className="w-5 h-5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Body */}
        <div className="p-4">
          {/* STATE 1: IDLE / READY TO QUEUE */}
          {phase === 'idle' && (
            <div className="space-y-4 py-2 text-center">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 mx-auto rounded-3xl bg-cyan-500/10 border-2 border-cyan-400/50 flex items-center justify-center text-cyan-400 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,240,255,0.25)] animate-pulse">
                <Trophy className="w-10 h-10" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider">
                  Enter Ranked Arena Queue
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 max-w-sm mx-auto mt-1">
                  Queue with your active beast or companion avatar. The server pairs you with trainers within ±150 CP!
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Player Fighter Card Preview */}
              <div className="bg-[#0D1424] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 max-w-md mx-auto flex items-center gap-3 text-left">
                <img
                  src={pet?.avatarImageUrl || activeBeast.image}
                  alt="Beast"
                  className="w-14 h-14 rounded-xl object-cover border border-cyan-400/40 shrink-0"
                />
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase">{pet?.name || activeBeast.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-300">
                    Lv.{pet?.level || activeBeast.level} · {pet?.species || activeBeast.species}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1 text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                    <span>HP {pet?.stats?.stamina ? pet.stats.stamina * 15 : activeBeast.health}</span>
                    <span>·</span>
                    <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                      CP {pet?.stats?.cp || Math.round(activeBeast.health * 0.4 + activeBeast.damage * 1.5)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#CCFF00]/20 text-[#CCFF00] border border-[#CCFF00]/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                    READY ✓
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleStartQueue}
                className="w-full max-w-md mx-auto bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black font-black text-xs py-3.5 px-4 rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 font-mono uppercase tracking-wider cursor-pointer active:scale-98 transition-all"
              >
                <Swords className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                <span>Find Ranked Match (±150 CP)</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* STATE 2: QUEUING / SEARCHING */}
          {phase === 'queuing' && (
            <div className="space-y-6 py-8 text-center">
              <div className="relative w-24 h-24 mx-auto flex items-center justify-center">
                <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-2 border-cyan-400/20 border-t-cyan-400 animate-spin" />
                <div className="absolute inset-2 rounded-full border border-cyan-400/40 animate-ping opacity-25" />
                <Activity className="w-8 h-8 text-cyan-400" />
              </div>

              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider animate-pulse">
                  Searching for Ranked Opponent...
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-mono text-cyan-300 mt-1">
                  Authoritative Netcode Filter: Band ±150 Combat Power
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">
                  Connecting across edge nodes · Ping: {latency}ms
                </p>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={handleCancelQueue}
                className="py-2.5 px-6 rounded-xl bg-rose-600/90 hover:bg-rose-500 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase cursor-pointer border border-rose-400 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mx-auto"
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>Cancel Search</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* STATE 3: MATCH FOUND & COUNTDOWN */}
          {phase === 'matched' && matchData && (
            <div className="space-y-4 py-4 text-center animate-fadeIn">
              <div className="text-3xl font-display font-black text-cyan-300 animate-bounce">
                {countdown > 0 ? `STARTING IN ${countdown}...` : 'BATTLE ENGAGED!'}
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-w-lg mx-auto">
                {/* Player 1 */}
                <div className="bg-[#0C1222] border-2 border-cyan-400/60 rounded-2xl p-3 text-center">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 uppercase">You</div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">{myFighter?.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-[#CCFF00] mt-0.5">
                    CP {myFighter?.cp}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Player 2 */}
                <div className="bg-[#0C1222] border-2 border-rose-500/60 rounded-2xl p-3 text-center">
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-rose-400 uppercase">Rival</div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-bold text-white truncate">{opponentFighter?.name}</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-rose-400 mt-0.5">
                    CP {opponentFighter?.cp}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* STATE 4: AUTHORITATIVE 20-TICK COMBAT ARENA */}
          {phase === 'fighting' && (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Dual Combatant Telemetry Bars */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {/* Left: You */}
                <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${myOverdrive ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-950/20 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.3)]' : 'border-cyan-400/40 bg-[#0C1424]'}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold mb-1">
                    <span className="text-white truncate">{myFighter?.name} (You)</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-cyan-300">{Math.round(myHp)} HP</span>
                  </div>
                  {/* HP Bar */}
                  <div className="w-full h-3 bg-black/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/20 p-0.5 mb-2">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-emerald-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-100"
                      style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (myHp / myMaxHp) * 100))}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {/* Energy Bar */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono">
                    <span className="text-cyan-300 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Zap className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
                      <span>{myEnergy.toFixed(1)} / 10.0</span>
                    </span>
                    {myOverdrive && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-300 animate-pulse">⚡ OVERDRIVE</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Right: Rival */}
                <div className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${oppOverdrive ? 'border-amber-400 bg-amber-950/20 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.3)]' : 'border-rose-500/40 bg-[#160D1A]'}`}>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold mb-1">
                    <span className="text-white truncate">{opponentFighter?.name}</span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-rose-300">{Math.round(oppHp)} HP</span>
                  </div>
                  {/* HP Bar */}
                  <div className="w-full h-3 bg-black/60 rounded-full overflow-hidden border border-white/20 p-0.5 mb-2">
                    <div
                      className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-rose-500 to-amber-500 rounded-full transition-all duration-100"
                      style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (oppHp / oppMaxHp) * 100))}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  {/* Energy Bar */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono">
                    <span className="text-rose-300 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Zap className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-400" />
                      <span>{oppEnergy.toFixed(1)} / 10.0</span>
                    </span>
                    {oppOverdrive && (
                      <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-amber-300 animate-pulse">⚡ OVERDRIVE</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Combat Log Ticker */}
              <div className="bg-black/60 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2.5 h-20 overflow-y-auto font-mono text-[11px] space-y-1">
                {combatLogs.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-neutral-500 italic text-center py-4">Waiting for first strike...</div>
                ) : (
                  combatLogs.map((log, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className={
                        log.type === 'crit'
                          ? 'text-amber-300 font-bold'
                          : log.type === 'overdrive'
                          ? 'text-fuchsia-300 font-bold'
                          : log.type === 'ko'
                          ? 'text-rose-400 font-black'
                          : 'text-neutral-200'
                      }
                    >
                      {log.text}
                    </div>
                  ))
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Authoritative Action Dock */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleExecuteMove('strike')}
                  disabled={myEnergy < 2}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-[#0C1222] hover:bg-[#121A30] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300">2 ENERGY</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase mt-0.5">Strike</div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">75 DMG</div>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleExecuteMove('pounce')}
                  disabled={myEnergy < 3}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-[#0C1222] hover:bg-[#121A30] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300">3 ENERGY</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase mt-0.5">Pounce</div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">130 DMG</div>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleExecuteMove('rend')}
                  disabled={myEnergy < 4}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-white/15 bg-[#0C1222] hover:bg-[#121A30] disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300">4 ENERGY</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white uppercase mt-0.5">Fang Rend</div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] text-rose-300 font-mono">195 DMG</div>
                </button>

                <button
                  onClick={handleExecuteOverdrive}
                  disabled={myEnergy < 6 || myOverdrive}
                  className="p-2.5 rounded-xl border border-amber-500/40 bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-500/20 to-black hover:from-amber-500/30 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed text-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(251,191,36,0.2)]"
                >
                  <div className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300">6 ENERGY</div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-black text-amber-200 uppercase mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                    <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
                    <span>Overdrive</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[9px] text-amber-300 font-mono">+50% DMG</div>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* STATE 5: MATCH FINISHED / ELO REWARD SCREEN */}
          {phase === 'finished' && resultData && (
            <div className="space-y-4 py-4 text-center animate-fadeIn">
              {(isPlayer1 ? resultData.winnerId === resultData.p1Result.id : resultData.winnerId === resultData.p2Result.id) ? (
                <div>
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-3xl bg-emerald-500/20 border-2 border-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center text-emerald-300 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(52,211,153,0.4)] mb-2">
                    <Crown className="w-8 h-8" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider">
                    VICTORY!
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">
                    Opponent Defeated · Authoritative Win Confirmed
                  </p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div>
                  <div className="w-16 h-16 mx-auto rounded-3xl bg-rose-500/20 border-2 border-rose-400 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-300 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(244,63,94,0.4)] mb-2">
                    <AlertCircle className="w-8 h-8" />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="text-2xl font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider">
                    DEFEATED
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs font-mono text-rose-400 mt-0.5">
                    Your beast fought valiantly!
                  </p>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Rewards Summary */}
              <div className="bg-[#0D1424] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-sm mx-auto grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 font-mono text-center">
                <div className="p-2 bg-black/40 rounded-xl">
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">RATING</div>
                  <div className={`text-sm font-black ${(isPlayer1 ? resultData.winnerId === resultData.p1Result.id : resultData.winnerId === resultData.p2Result.id) ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-rose-400'}`}>
                    {(isPlayer1 ? resultData.winnerId === resultData.p1Result.id : resultData.winnerId === resultData.p2Result.id) ? '+25 ELO' : '-18 ELO'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-2 bg-black/40 rounded-xl">
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">CREDITS</div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-black text-[#CCFF00]">
                    +{(isPlayer1 ? resultData.winnerId === resultData.p1Result.id : resultData.winnerId === resultData.p2Result.id) ? 350 : 100}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  setPhase('idle');
                }}
                className="py-2.5 px-6 rounded-xl bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black font-black text-xs uppercase font-mono cursor-pointer transition-all active:scale-95"
              >
                Play Another Match
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/RivalDeckModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import { X, Swords, Trophy, Zap, Shield, Flame, Skull, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Animal, ANIMALS_DATA } from '../../data/animals';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface RivalDeckModalProps {
  playerBeast: Animal;
  onSelectOpponent: (opponent: Animal) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const RivalDeckModal: React.FC<RivalDeckModalProps> = ({
  playerBeast,
  onSelectOpponent,
  onClose,
}) => {
  const rivals = ANIMALS_DATA.filter((b) => b.id !== playerBeast.id);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0e111a] border-2 border-white/10 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[85vh]">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="bg-[#161a26] border-b border-white/10 px-5 py-4 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Swords className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Choose Arena Rival
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                Select an opponent to battle in the Colosseum
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="p-1 rounded-full text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Rival Cards List */}
        <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3 flex-1">
          {rivals.map((rival) => {
            const isBoss = rival.rarity === 'Legendary';
            const difficultyLabel = isBoss
              ? 'Apex Boss'
              : rival.rarity === 'Apex'
              ? 'Hard'
              : 'Normal';
            const diffColor = isBoss
              ? 'text-red-400 bg-red-500/10 border-red-500/30'
              : rival.rarity === 'Apex'
              ? 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/10 border-amber-500/30'
              : 'text-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10 border-cyan-500/30';

            return (
              <div
                key={rival.id}
                className="bg-[#131622] hover:bg-[#181d2c] border border-white/10 hover:border-[#CCFF00]/50 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between transition-all duration-200 group"
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5">
                  {/* Avatar with Rarity Ring */}
                  <div className="relative w-16 h-16 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-white/20 shrink-0 shadow-md">
                    <img
                      src={rival.image}
                      alt={rival.name}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200"
                      onError={(e) => {
                        e.currentTarget.src = rival.fallbackImage;
                      }}
                    />
                    <div className="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-black/80 px-1 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-white">
                      L{rival.level}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Info */}
                  <div className="text-left space-y-1">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-white tracking-wide">
                        {rival.name}
                      </span>
                      <span className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border ${diffColor}`}>
                        {difficultyLabel}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono italic">
                      {rival.species} · {rival.scientificName}
                    </p>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-300">
                      <span className="text-white font-semibold">
                        {rival.weightKg} kg
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-500">·</span>
                      <span className="text-red-400 font-semibold">
                        {rival.biteForcePsi} PSI
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-500">·</span>
                      <span className="text-cyan-400 font-semibold">
                        {rival.topSpeedKmh} km/h
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Battle CTA */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playCardPlay();
                    onSelectOpponent(rival);
                  }}
                  className="ml-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-red-600 hover:from-amber-400 hover:to-red-500 text-white font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0 shadow-md flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform"
                >
                  <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>Fight</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
