<source>src/components/game/screens/ArmoryScreen.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Shield,
  Sparkles,
  Plus,
  Check,
  ShoppingCart,
  Zap,
  Flame,
  HeartPulse,
  ChevronRight,
  X,
  CheckCircle2,
  Gift,
  Crown,
  Heart,
  Award,
  ShieldCheck,
  ArrowRight,
  Utensils,
  Smile,
  Coffee,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { GEAR_ITEMS, GearItem } from '../../../data/armory';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';

export const ArmoryScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    activeBeast,
    equippedGear,
    inventoryGear,
    equipGear,
    unequipGear,
    buyGear,
    credits,
    getEffectiveStats,
    refillEnergy,
  } = useGame();
  const { pet, strokePet } = usePetCompanion();

  const [armoryTab, setArmoryTab] = useState<'loadout' | 'store'>('loadout');
  const [storeFilter, setStoreFilter] = useState<'all' | 'free' | 'cosmetics' | 'tactical'>('all');
  const [feedbackMsg, setFeedbackMsg] = useState<{ text: string; type: 'success' | 'error' } | null>(null);

  // Daily Free Supply Drops (State saved in memory/localStorage)
  const [dailyClaimed, setDailyClaimed] = useState<{ kibble: boolean; drill: boolean; chew: boolean }>({
    kibble: false,
    drill: false,
    chew: false,
  });

  const effectiveStats = getEffectiveStats(activeBeast);

  const handleClaimFreeDaily = (type: 'kibble' | 'drill' | 'chew', label: string) => {
    if (dailyClaimed[type]) {
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: `Already claimed today's ${label}! Resets at midnight.`, type: 'error' });
      setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 2500);
      return;
    }
    sound.playVictory();
    setDailyClaimed((prev) => ({ ...prev, [type]: true }));
    if (type === 'kibble') {
      refillEnergy();
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: `Claimed Daily Free Kibble! Restored +25 conditioning energy!`, type: 'success' });
    } else if (type === 'drill') {
      sound.playLevelUp();
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: `Completed Daily Free Agility Drill! +20 Speed & Reflex XP granted to ${activeBeast.name}!`, type: 'success' });
    } else {
      strokePet();
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: `Claimed Daily Free Vitamin Chew! +20 Vitality & max morale for ${activeBeast.name}!`, type: 'success' });
    }
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 3500);
  };

  const handleBuy = (item: GearItem) => {
    if (credits < item.price) {
      sound.playClick();
      setFeedbackMsg({ text: 'Insufficient credits to procure this equipment!', type: 'error' });
      setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 2500);
      return;
    }
    const success = buyGear(item);
    if (success) {
      setFeedbackMsg({
        text: `Procured ${item.name}! Added to Inventory. Tap 'Equip' to attach to ${activeBeast.name}.`,
        type: 'success',
      });
      setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 3500);
    }
  };

  const handleEquip = (item: GearItem) => {
    equipGear(item);
    sound.playClick();
    const statBonusSummary = Object.entries(item.statBonus)
      .map(([k, v]) => `+${v} ${k.toUpperCase()}`)
      .join(', ');
    setFeedbackMsg({
      text: `Equipped ${item.name} onto ${activeBeast.name}! (${statBonusSummary}) applied to combat!`,
      type: 'success',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 3200);
  };

  const handleUnequip = (slot: 'collar' | 'armor' | 'paws' | 'serum', name: string) => {
    unequipGear(slot);
    sound.playClick();
    setFeedbackMsg({
      text: `Unequipped ${name} from ${activeBeast.name}. Returned to Inventory.`,
      type: 'success',
    });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 2500);
  };

  const slots: { slot: 'collar' | 'armor' | 'paws' | 'serum'; label: string; desc: string }[] = [
    { slot: 'collar', label: 'Tactical Collar', desc: 'Neck reinforcement & sensor targeting' },
    { slot: 'armor', label: 'Body Exo-Rig Armor', desc: 'Ballistic torso protection & impact dissipation' },
    { slot: 'paws', label: 'Paw Grip Sleeves', desc: 'Lateral friction & kinetic claw strikes' },
    { slot: 'serum', label: 'Bio-Stim Serum', desc: 'Adrenaline metabolic accelerator' },
  ];

  // Fair Play Cosmetic Outfits ($0.49 / 50¢ or 500 Credits)
  const COSMETIC_ITEMS = [
    {
      id: 'cosm_crown',
      name: 'Royal Sovereign Crown',
      price: 500,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      category: 'Headwear',
      icon: Crown,
      description: 'Gilded monarch crown with ruby gems. Visible in arena duels, sanctuary, and browser extension buddy.',
    },
    {
      id: 'cosm_shades',
      name: 'Cyber Matrix Shades',
      price: 500,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      category: 'Eyewear',
      icon: Sparkles,
      description: 'Ultraviolet polarized cyber shades. Equips directly to your dog or cat avatar.',
    },
    {
      id: 'cosm_detective',
      name: 'Sherlock Tweed Cap',
      price: 500,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      category: 'Headwear',
      icon: Award,
      description: 'Classic British houndstooth detective cap. Stylish and charming for both canines and felines.',
    },
    {
      id: 'cosm_party',
      name: 'Festive Party Cone',
      price: 500,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      category: 'Headwear',
      icon: Smile,
      description: 'Neon confetti party hat with sparkler tassel. Makes your companion celebrate with cheerful bobs.',
    },
  ];

  // Gourmet Treats ($0.49 / 50¢ or 300 Credits)
  const GOURMET_TREATS = [
    {
      id: 'treat_salmon',
      name: 'Alaskan Wild Salmon Filet',
      price: 300,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      icon: '🐟',
      bonus: '+30 Happiness & Lustrous Fur',
      description: 'Fresh omega-rich wild salmon steak. A favorite gourmet delicacy for cats and athletic dogs.',
    },
    {
      id: 'treat_wagyu',
      name: 'A5 Wagyu Beef Cube',
      price: 300,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      icon: '🥩',
      bonus: '+35 Morale & Full Satiety',
      description: 'Tender gourmet beef morsel. Boosts buddy loyalty hearts instantly.',
    },
    {
      id: 'treat_bacon',
      name: 'Crispy Honey Bacon Chew',
      price: 300,
      priceUsd: '$0.49',
      icon: '🥓',
      bonus: '+25 Energy & Playfulness',
      description: 'Slow-smoked artisan bacon strip. Dogs go wild and cats eagerly purr.',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#08090D] overflow-y-auto pb-32 select-none max-w-xl mx-auto w-full overscroll-contain">
      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0E1017]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
              <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Tactical Rigging & Fair Shop</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl uppercase tracking-wider text-white mt-0.5">
              Armory & Dojo · {activeBeast.name}
            </h2>
          </div>

          <div className="flex bg-[#161822] p-1 rounded-xl border border-white/10">
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setArmoryTab('loadout');
                sound.playClick();
              }}
              className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                armoryTab === 'loadout'
                  ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow font-black'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Loadout
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => {
                setArmoryTab('store');
                sound.playClick();
              }}
              className={`px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1 ${
                armoryTab === 'store'
                  ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow font-black'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              <ShoppingCart className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>Dojo & Shop</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Action Toast */}
        {feedbackMsg && (
          <div
            className={`mt-3 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-fadeIn ${
              feedbackMsg.type === 'success'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00]/10 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 text-[#CCFF00]'
                : 'bg-red-500/10 border border-red-500/40 text-red-400'
            }`}
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
            <span>{feedbackMsg.text}</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
        {armoryTab === 'loadout' ? (
          <>
            {/* Active Rig Status Card */}
            <div className="bg-[#12141C] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-4 shadow-xl">
              <div className="relative w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 shadow-lg">
                <img
                  src={activeBeast.image}
                  alt={activeBeast.name}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                />
                <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-black/85 text-center py-0.5 text-[9px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                  Active Fighter
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1 w-full text-center sm:text-left">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  Equipment Target
                </span>
                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-lg uppercase text-white">
                  {activeBeast.name} ({activeBeast.species})
                </h3>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                  Gear equipped below directly amplifies {activeBeast.name}'s battle ratings in the arena!
                </p>

                <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center">
                  <div className="bg-[#181B26] p-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">Bite Force</span>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-[#CCFF00]">
                      {effectiveStats.biteForce} PSI
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-[#181B26] p-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">Armor</span>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-cyan-300">
                      +{effectiveStats.armor} DEF
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-[#181B26] p-2 rounded-xl border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">Agility</span>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono font-black text-amber-300">
                      {effectiveStats.agility}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 4 Gear Slots */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {slots.map(({ slot, label, desc }) => {
                const item = equippedGear[slot];

                return (
                  <div
                    key={slot}
                    className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                      item
                        ? 'bg-[#141722] border-emerald-500/40 shadow-lg ring-1 ring-emerald-500/20'
                        : 'bg-[#10121A] border-white/10 border-dashed'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-white/5">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]" />
                        <span className="font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wide text-neutral-200">
                          {label}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      {item ? (
                        <button
                          onClick={() => handleUnequip(slot, item.name)}
                          className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 hover:text-red-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer transition-colors"
                        >
                          Unequip
                        </button>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-500 uppercase">
                          Empty
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {item ? (
                      <div className="mt-2.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white">
                            {item.name}
                          </span>
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]/10 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 text-[9px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                            EQUIPPED
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                          {item.description}
                        </p>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono">
                          {Object.entries(item.statBonus).map(([k, v]) => (
                            <span
                              key={k}
                              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-bold"
                            >
                              +{v} {k.toUpperCase()}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="py-3 text-center">
                        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-400">Slot Available</span>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mt-0.5">{desc}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Owned Gear Inventory */}
            <div className="bg-[#12141C] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                  Armory Inventory ({inventoryGear.length})
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                  Tap 'Equip' to attach to {activeBeast.name}
                </span>
              </div>

              {inventoryGear.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-6 text-center text-xs text-neutral-500">
                  Inventory empty. Visit the <strong className="text-[#CCFF00]">Store</strong> tab above to procure tactical equipment.
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {inventoryGear.map((item) => (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/5 hover:border-white/15 rounded-xl p-3 flex items-center justify-between transition-all"
                    >
                      <div className="pr-2">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-white">
                            {item.name}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] uppercase bg-[#CCFF00]/10 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded">
                            {item.slot}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">
                          {item.description}
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-1 flex gap-1.5 text-[9px] font-mono">
                          {Object.entries(item.statBonus).map(([k, v]) => (
                            <span key={k} className="text-emerald-400 font-bold">
                              +{v} {k}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleEquip(item)}
                        className="px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-display font-black uppercase text-black bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer shrink-0 shadow-md shadow-[#CCFF00]/20 flex items-center gap-1"
                      >
                        <span>Equip</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          /* =========================================================================
             ARMORY DOJO & STORE (FREE SUPPLIES + FAIR PLAY COSMETICS + TACTICAL GEAR)
             ========================================================================= */
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* 100% FAIR PLAY GUARANTEE BADGE */}
            <div className="bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-950/40 via-[#121A24] to-[#12141C] border border-emerald-500/40 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-lg">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6 text-emerald-400 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-emerald-400">
                    100% Fair Play Guarantee
                  </span>
                  <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded bg-emerald-500/20 text-[9px] font-mono text-emerald-300 font-bold">
                    ZERO PAY-TO-WIN
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-300 mt-1 leading-snug">
                  Pet Slam is strictly skill-based. Outfits, crowns, and gourmet treats are purely aesthetic customizations or accessible at micro-prices ($0.49). Battle outcomes depend 100% on elixir management and timing!
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* SECTION 1: FREE DAILY SUPPLY DROPS (100% FREE DAILY) */}
            <div className="bg-[#12141C] border border-amber-400/30 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Gift className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                  <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                    Free Daily Supply Drops
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400/15 border border-amber-400/30 text-[9px] font-mono text-amber-300 font-bold">
                  Refreshes Daily · 100% Free
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                {/* Free Drop 1 */}
                <div className="bg-[#181B26] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xl mb-1">🥣</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs text-white">Kibble Energy Bowl</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 mt-0.5">+25 Free Energy</div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">Full bowl of organic conditioning kibble.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleClaimFreeDaily('kibble', 'Kibble Bowl')}
                    disabled={dailyClaimed.kibble}
                    className={`mt-2.5 w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      dailyClaimed.kibble
                        ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                        : 'bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black shadow font-black'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {dailyClaimed.kibble ? 'Claimed ✓' : 'Claim Free'}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Free Drop 2 */}
                <div className="bg-[#181B26] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xl mb-1">⚡</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs text-white">Agility Sprint Drill</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-400 mt-0.5">+20 Speed Drill XP</div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">Free 15-minute agility cone workout.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleClaimFreeDaily('drill', 'Agility Drill')}
                    disabled={dailyClaimed.drill}
                    className={`mt-2.5 w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      dailyClaimed.drill
                        ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                        : 'bg-cyan-400 hover:bg-cyan-300 text-black shadow font-black'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {dailyClaimed.drill ? 'Claimed ✓' : 'Start Drill'}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Free Drop 3 */}
                <div className="bg-[#181B26] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-xl mb-1">💊</div>
                    <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs text-white">Daily Vitamin Chew</div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-pink-400 mt-0.5">+20 Vitality & Morale</div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">Multivitamin chew for immune health.</p>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleClaimFreeDaily('chew', 'Vitamin Chew')}
                    disabled={dailyClaimed.chew}
                    className={`mt-2.5 w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      dailyClaimed.chew
                        ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 cursor-not-allowed'
                        : 'bg-pink-400 hover:bg-pink-300 text-black shadow font-black'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {dailyClaimed.chew ? 'Claimed ✓' : 'Claim Free'}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* SECTION 2: FAIR PLAY COSMETIC WARDROBE ($0.49 / 50¢ OR 500 CR) */}
            <div className="bg-[#12141C] border border-purple-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-400" />
                  <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                    Cosmetic Wardrobe (Hats & Glasses)
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-purple-300">
                  Micro-Price $0.49 (or 500 Cr)
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                {COSMETIC_ITEMS.map((cosm) => {
                  const IconComp = cosm.icon;
                  return (
                    <div
                      key={cosm.id}
                      className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/5 hover:border-purple-500/40 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[9px] font-mono uppercase text-purple-400 font-bold">
                            {cosm.category}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300 bg-amber-500/10 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                            {cosm.priceUsd} or {cosm.price} Cr
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                          <IconComp className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                          <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs text-white uppercase">
                            {cosm.name}
                          </h4>
                        </div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                          {cosm.description}
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => {
                          sound.playCoin();
                          setFeedbackMsg({
                            text: `Unlocked ${cosm.name}! Wearable on ${activeBeast.name} in arena & sanctuary!`,
                            type: 'success',
                          });
                          setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 3000);
                        }}
                        className="mt-3 w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 text-white transition-all cursor-pointer shadow"
                      >
                        Unlock ({cosm.priceUsd})
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* SECTION 3: GOURMET PET TREATS ($0.49 OR 300 CR) */}
            <div className="bg-[#12141C] border border-cyan-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-xl space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Utensils className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-400" />
                  <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                    Gourmet Treats & Nutrition
                  </h3>
                </div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-300">
                  Micro-Price $0.49 (or 300 Cr)
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                {GOURMET_TREATS.map((treat) => (
                  <div
                    key={treat.id}
                    className="bg-[#161822] border border-white/5 rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col justify-between"
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-xl mb-1">{treat.icon}</div>
                      <div className="font-display font-bold text-xs text-white">{treat.name}</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-400 mt-0.5">{treat.bonus}</div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 mt-1">{treat.description}</p>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => {
                        sound.playChew();
                        setFeedbackMsg({
                          text: `Fed ${treat.name} to ${activeBeast.name}! Happiness restored!`,
                          type: 'success',
                        });
                        setTimeout(() => setFeedbackMsg(null), 3000);
                      }}
                      className="mt-2.5 w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold uppercase bg-cyan-500 hover:bg-cyan-400 text-black transition-all cursor-pointer shadow"
                    >
                      Feed ({treat.priceUsd})
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* SECTION 4: TACTICAL COMBAT GEAR (EARNABLE VIA BATTLE CREDITS) */}
            <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                  Tactical Body Rigs & Armor (Battle Credits)
                </h3>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                  Earned via Ranked Arena Victories
                </span>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                {GEAR_ITEMS.map((item) => {
                  const isEquipped = Object.values(equippedGear).some((g) => g?.id === item.id);
                  const isInInventory = inventoryGear.some((g) => g.id === item.id);

                  return (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      className="bg-[#12141C] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-white/20 transition-all shadow-lg"
                    >
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                            {item.rarity} · {item.slot}
                          </span>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-xs font-bold text-amber-300">
                            {item.price.toLocaleString()} Credits
                          </div>
                        </div>

                        <h4 className="font-display font-black text-base text-white mt-1">
                          {item.name}
                        </h4>
                        <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 mt-1 leading-snug">
                          {item.description}
                        </p>

                        <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono">
                          {Object.entries(item.statBonus).map(([k, v]) => (
                            <span
                              key={k}
                              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-bold"
                            >
                              +{v} {k.toUpperCase()}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-4">
                        {isEquipped ? (
                          <div className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-center bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-400 font-mono">
                            Currently Equipped on {activeBeast.name}
                          </div>
                        ) : isInInventory ? (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => {
                              handleEquip(item);
                              setArmoryTab('loadout');
                            }}
                            className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wide bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-md shadow-[#CCFF00]/20"
                          >
                            Equip to {activeBeast.name} Now
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <button
                            onClick={() => handleBuy(item)}
                            disabled={credits < item.price}
                            className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black shadow-lg shadow-[#CCFF00]/15 disabled:opacity-40 transition-all cursor-pointer font-display uppercase tracking-wide"
                          >
                            Procure Item ({item.price.toLocaleString()} Cr)
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  PawPrint,
  Dumbbell,
  Zap,
  Flame,
  Shield,
  CheckCircle2,
  Sparkles,
  Search,
  Filter,
  Coins,
  ChevronRight,
  Award,
  Swords,
  Plus,
  Check,
  Activity,
  Layers,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { Animal, ANIMALS_DATA } from '../../../data/animals';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { getRarityBadgeClasses } from '../../../utils/petVisuals';

export const BeastsScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const {
    ownedBeasts,
    activeBeastId,
    selectActiveBeast,
    battleDeckIds,
    setDeckSlot,
    trainBeast,
    getEffectiveStats,
    energy,
    refillEnergy,
    credits,
  } = useGame();

  const [inspectedBeastId, setInspectedBeastId] = useState<string>(activeBeastId);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [statDeltaToast, setStatDeltaToast] = useState<{ stat: string; delta: string } | null>(null);
  const [trainingAnim, setTrainingAnim] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Retrieve selected beast from ownedBeasts or fallback
  const currentBeast =
    ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === inspectedBeastId) ||
    ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === activeBeastId) ||
    ownedBeasts[0];

  const effectiveStats = getEffectiveStats(currentBeast);
  const isActiveFighter = currentBeast.id === activeBeastId;

  // Categories
  const categories = ['All Pets', 'Dogs', 'Cats'];

  // All animals from game roster, marking owned vs available
  const filteredAnimals = ANIMALS_DATA.filter((animal) => {
    const matchesCat =
      selectedCategory === 'All Pets' ||
      selectedCategory === 'All' ||
      (selectedCategory === 'Dogs' && animal.category === 'Canines') ||
      (selectedCategory === 'Cats' && animal.category === 'Felines');
    const matchesQuery =
      animal.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      animal.species.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
      animal.breed.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCat && matchesQuery;
  });

  // Conditioning Drills
  const handleTrain = (type: 'nutrition' | 'agility' | 'biteForce') => {
    sound.playCardPlay();
    setTrainingAnim(true);
    const result = trainBeast(currentBeast.id, type);

    if (result.success) {
      if (type === 'nutrition') {
        sound.playCoin();
        setStatDeltaToast({
          stat: 'Nutrition Feeding',
          delta: '+45 Vitality HP, +1.2 kg Muscle Mass',
        });
      } else if (type === 'agility') {
        sound.playAttack();
        setStatDeltaToast({
          stat: 'Agility Sprint',
          delta: '+4 km/h Speed, +2 Evasion Rating',
        });
      } else if (type === 'biteForce') {
        sound.playCrit();
        setStatDeltaToast({
          stat: 'Combat Sparring',
          delta: '+25 Jaw PSI, +140J Strike Force',
        });
      }
    } else {
      sound.playClick();
      setStatDeltaToast({
        stat: 'Exhausted Energy',
        delta: 'Refill conditioning energy using the + button above.',
      });
    }

    setTimeout(() => {
      setTrainingAnim(false);
    }, 400);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setStatDeltaToast(null);
    }, 3200);
  };

  const handleSelectActive = (beastId: string) => {
    sound.playVictory();
    selectActiveBeast(beastId);
    setStatDeltaToast({
      stat: 'Champion Assigned',
      delta: `${currentBeast.name} is now your primary arena battle pet!`,
    });
    setTimeout(() => setStatDeltaToast(null), 3000);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#07090e] text-white select-none overflow-y-auto pb-32 max-w-xl mx-auto w-full overscroll-contain">
      {/* Top Header Bar */}
      <div className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0e121a]/95 backdrop-blur-md sticky top-0 z-30 shadow-md">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
              <PawPrint className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Pet Slam Arena Roster</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
              Battle Deck & Roster ({ownedBeasts.length}/{ANIMALS_DATA.length})
            </h1>
          </div>

          {/* Energy Widget */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#141926] border border-white/10 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow">
            <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-white">{energy}/100</span>
            <button
              onClick={refillEnergy}
              className="text-[#CCFF00] hover:text-white cursor-pointer ml-1"
              title="Refill Energy"
            >
              <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dynamic Feedback Toast */}
      {statDeltaToast && (
        <div className="mx-4 mt-3 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00]/20 to-emerald-500/20 border border-[#CCFF00]/50 text-center animate-in fade-in z-20 shadow-lg">
          <p className="text-xs font-display font-black text-[#CCFF00] uppercase">
            {statDeltaToast.stat}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-200 mt-0.5">{statDeltaToast.delta}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 4-BEAST ACTIVE BATTLE DECK (CLASH ROYALE STYLE) */}
      <div className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 pt-3 pb-1">
        <div className="bg-[#0e121a] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3 shadow-lg space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-display font-black uppercase text-white tracking-wider">
              <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Active 4-Animal Battle Deck</span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-purple-400 font-bold">
              Clash Royale Tag-In Deck
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
            {battleDeckIds.map((id, idx) => {
              const beast = ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === id) || ownedBeasts[idx] || ownedBeasts[0];
              const isSelected = beast.id === currentBeast.id;
              const isLead = beast.id === activeBeastId;
              const slotRoles = ['Slot 1 (Lead)', 'Slot 2 (Striker)', 'Slot 3 (Assassin)', 'Slot 4 (Tank)'];
              const slotElixir = ['0 💧 Lead', '2 💧 Tag', '3 💧 Tag', '4 💧 Tag'];

              return (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playClick();
                    setInspectedBeastId(beast.id);
                  }}
                  className={`p-1.5 rounded-xl border flex flex-col items-center text-center cursor-pointer transition-all relative ${
                    isSelected
                      ? 'bg-[#182030] border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)] scale-[1.02]'
                      : 'bg-[#121622] border-white/10 hover:border-white/20'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isLead && (
                    <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-display font-black text-[8px] px-1 rounded uppercase shadow">
                      LEAD
                    </span>
                  )}
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-white/15 bg-black relative">
                    <img
                      src={beast.image}
                      alt={beast.name}
                      className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                      onError={(e) => {
                        e.currentTarget.src = beast.fallbackImage;
                      }}
                    />
                    <span className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-black/80 text-[8px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">
                      L{beast.level}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-display font-black text-[10px] text-white uppercase mt-1 truncate max-w-full">
                    {beast.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-neutral-400 truncate max-w-full">
                    {slotRoles[idx]}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold text-purple-300 mt-0.5">
                    {slotElixir[idx]}
                  </span>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <p className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 text-center pt-0.5">
            Tap a card to inspect. Use "Assign to Deck Slot" below to swap any pet into your 4-animal team!
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------
          SECTION 1: ACTIVE FIGHTER CARD INSPECTOR & TRAINING DECK
          ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <div className="p-3.5 sm:p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="bg-gradient-to-b from-[#121724] to-[#0c0f17] border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/40 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-xl relative overflow-hidden">
          {/* Card Ambient Glow */}
          <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 w-44 h-44 bg-[#CCFF00]/10 blur-[60px] pointer-events-none rounded-full" />

          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-4 relative z-10">
            {/* 3D Card Artwork Portrait */}
            <div className="relative w-32 h-40 sm:w-36 sm:h-44 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] shrink-0 bg-black group">
              <img
                src={currentBeast.image}
                alt={currentBeast.name}
                className={`w-full h-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:scale-105 ${
                  trainingAnim ? 'animate-pulse scale-105' : ''
                }`}
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.src = currentBeast.fallbackImage;
                }}
              />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-transparent to-transparent" />

              {/* Rarity & Level Badges */}
              <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-black/80 border border-[#CCFF00]/50 font-mono font-bold text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00]">
                LVL {currentBeast.level}
              </div>

              <div className={`absolute top-2 right-2 ${getRarityBadgeClasses(currentBeast.rarity)}`}>
                {currentBeast.rarity}
              </div>

              <div className="absolute bottom-2 left-2 right-2 text-center">
                <span className="font-display font-black text-xs text-white uppercase tracking-wider block truncate">
                  {currentBeast.name}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono block truncate">
                  {currentBeast.breed}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Quick Stats & Equip Button */}
            <div className="flex-1 w-full space-y-2.5 text-left">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="font-display font-black text-lg text-white uppercase">
                    {currentBeast.name}
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
                    {currentBeast.breed} · {currentBeast.combatArchetype}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {isActiveFighter ? (
                  <span className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-display font-black text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1 shadow">
                    <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 stroke-[3]" />
                    <span>Equipped</span>
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleSelectActive(currentBeast.id)}
                    className="px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-400 hover:from-[#d4ff1a] hover:to-emerald-300 text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer shadow active:scale-95"
                  >
                    EQUIP CHAMPION
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* 3 Core Combat Metrics (Esports Pet Combat style) */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-center font-mono">
                <div className="bg-[#141926] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-emerald-400 uppercase font-bold block">
                    Health
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white">
                    {effectiveStats.endurance * 12}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-[#141926] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-red-400 uppercase font-bold block">
                    Damage
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white">
                    {effectiveStats.strength * 2.8}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-[#141926] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-2">
                  <span className="text-[9px] text-cyan-400 uppercase font-bold block">
                    Speed
                  </span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-white">
                    {effectiveStats.speed}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 3 Direct Conditioning Drills */}
              <div className="pt-1">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                  Gym Training Drills (-15 Energy):
                </span>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleTrain('nutrition')}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#161d2d] hover:bg-[#1e273d] border border-emerald-400/30 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow"
                  >
                    <Activity className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400 mb-0.5" />
                    <span className="font-display font-black text-[10px] uppercase">Feed</span>
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-emerald-400">+HP</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleTrain('biteForce')}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#161d2d] hover:bg-[#1e273d] border border-red-500/30 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow"
                  >
                    <Flame className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-red-400 mb-0.5" />
                    <span className="font-display font-black text-[10px] uppercase">Spar</span>
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-red-400">+DMG</span>
                  </button>

                  <button
                    onClick={() => handleTrain('agility')}
                    className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-[#161d2d] hover:bg-[#1e273d] border border-cyan-400/30 text-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow"
                  >
                    <Zap className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 mb-0.5" />
                    <span className="font-display font-black text-[10px] uppercase">Sprint</span>
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-cyan-400">+SPD</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Quick Assign to Battle Deck Slots */}
              <div className="pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-purple-300 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">
                  Assign {currentBeast.name} to 4-Animal Deck:
                </span>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1">
                  {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((slotIdx) => {
                    const isCurrentSlot = battleDeckIds[slotIdx] === currentBeast.id;
                    const slotLabels = ['Slot 1 (Lead)', 'Slot 2 (Atk)', 'Slot 3 (Spd)', 'Slot 4 (Tank)'];
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={slotIdx}
                        onClick={() => {
                          setDeckSlot(slotIdx, currentBeast.id);
                          if (slotIdx === 0) selectActiveBeast(currentBeast.id);
                          sound.playVictory();
                          setStatDeltaToast({
                            stat: 'Battle Deck Updated',
                            delta: `${currentBeast.name} assigned to ${slotLabels[slotIdx]}!`,
                          });
                          setTimeout(() => setStatDeltaToast(null), 2500);
                        }}
                        className={`py-1.5 px-1 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                          isCurrentSlot
                            ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                            : 'bg-[#182030] hover:bg-[#222c42] text-neutral-300 border border-white/10'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {isCurrentSlot ? '✓ ' : '+ '}
                        {slotLabels[slotIdx]}
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------
          SECTION 2: FULL SCROLLABLE ANIMAL ROSTER (ALL 16 ANIMALS)
         ------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <div className="px-3.5 sm:px-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Layers className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
              Full Animal Collection ({filteredAnimals.length})
            </h3>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
            Tap any card to inspect or equip
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Search & Category Filter Pills */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {/* Search Bar */}
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="w-4 h-4 text-neutral-400 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2" />
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search pets by name or breed (Shepherd, Husky, Bengal, Maine Coon)..."
              className="w-full bg-[#121622] border border-white/10 rounded-xl pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-xs font-mono text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00]"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Category Chips with Horizontal Scroll */}
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  setSelectedCategory(cat);
                }}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                    : 'bg-[#121622] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/10'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2-Column Responsive Card Grid (Clash Royale Style) */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-1">
          {filteredAnimals.map((animal) => {
            const isOwned = ownedBeasts.some((b) => b.id === animal.id);
            const isSelected = animal.id === currentBeast.id;
            const isLead = animal.id === activeBeastId;

            return (
              <button
                key={animal.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  setInspectedBeastId(animal.id);
                }}
                className={`group relative rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 text-left transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer flex flex-col justify-between p-2.5 ${
                  isSelected
                    ? 'border-[#CCFF00] bg-[#161e30] shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)] scale-[1.02]'
                    : isLead
                    ? 'border-emerald-400 bg-[#121a24]'
                    : 'border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 bg-[#0e121a]'
                }`}
              >
                {/* 3D Animal Artwork */}
                <div className="relative w-full aspect-square rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-black/60 mb-2 border border-white/10">
                  <img
                    src={animal.image}
                    alt={animal.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-300"
                    onError={(e) => {
                      e.currentTarget.src = animal.fallbackImage;
                    }}
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-transparent to-transparent" />

                  {/* Level & Rarity Tags */}
                  <span className="absolute top-1.5 left-1.5 bg-black/80 border border-white/20 font-mono font-bold text-[9px] text-[#CCFF00] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                    L{animal.level}
                  </span>

                  {isLead && (
                    <span className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-black text-[8px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded uppercase">
                      ACTIVE
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Info Text */}
                <div className="space-y-0.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="font-display font-black text-xs uppercase text-white truncate">
                      {animal.name}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-purple-400 font-bold">
                      {animal.rarity.substring(0, 3)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block truncate">
                    {animal.species}
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Elixir & Status Bar */}
                <div className="mt-2 pt-1.5 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono">
                  <span className={getRarityBadgeClasses(animal.rarity)}>{animal.rarity}</span>
                  <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{animal.elixirCost} Elixir</span>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/screens/MarketScreen.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  ShoppingBag,
  Shield,
  Coins,
  Check,
  Zap,
  Flame,
  Award,
  Filter,
  ArrowRight,
  PackageCheck,
  Sparkles,
  HeartPulse,
  Gavel,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { Animal, ANIMALS_DATA } from '../../../data/animals';
import { GEAR_ITEMS, GearItem } from '../../../data/armory';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { getRarityBadgeClasses } from '../../../utils/petVisuals';
import { PetAuctionHouseModal } from '../pet/PetAuctionHouseModal';

export const MarketScreen: React.FC = () => {
  const { credits, buyBeast, ownedBeasts, trainerName, buyGear, equipGear, activeBeast } = useGame();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'animals' | 'supplies'>('animals');
  const [showPetAuctions, setShowPetAuctions] = useState(false);
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('All');
  const [purchaseToast, setPurchaseToast] = useState<{ title: string; subtitle: string } | null>(null);

  const categories = ['All Pets', 'Dogs', 'Cats'];

  const filteredAnimals = ANIMALS_DATA.filter((animal) => {
    if (selectedCategory === 'All Pets' || selectedCategory === 'All') return true;
    if (selectedCategory === 'Dogs') return animal.category === 'Canines';
    if (selectedCategory === 'Cats') return animal.category === 'Felines';
    return true;
  });

  const handleAcquireAnimal = (animal: Animal) => {
    if (credits < animal.currentPriceCredits) {
      sound.playClick();
      setPurchaseToast({
        title: 'Insufficient Credits',
        subtitle: `You need ${animal.currentPriceCredits.toLocaleString()} Credits to procure ${animal.name}.`,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 3000);
      return;
    }

    const success = buyBeast(animal);
    if (success) {
      sound.playVictory();
      setPurchaseToast({
        title: 'Pedigree Ownership Transfer Complete!',
        subtitle: `${animal.name} (${animal.species}) is now in your kennel facility.`,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 3500);
    }
  };

  const handleBuySupply = (item: GearItem) => {
    if (credits < item.price) {
      sound.playClick();
      setPurchaseToast({
        title: 'Insufficient Credits',
        subtitle: `You need ${item.price.toLocaleString()} Credits for ${item.name}.`,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 3000);
      return;
    }

    const success = buyGear(item);
    if (success) {
      sound.playCoin();
      equipGear(item);
      setPurchaseToast({
        title: 'Equipment Procured & Equipped!',
        subtitle: `${item.name} attached to active fighter ${activeBeast.name}.`,
      });
      setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 3500);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#080a0f] text-white select-none overflow-y-auto pb-32 max-w-xl mx-auto w-full overscroll-contain">
      {/* Top Header */}
      <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0e121a] sticky top-0 z-20 shadow-md">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
              <ShoppingBag className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>Official Apex Exchange & Store</span>
            </div>
            <h1 className="font-display font-black text-lg text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
              Breeders & Tactical Supply
            </h1>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-[#141926] border border-amber-400/30 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl shadow">
            <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
            <span className="font-mono font-bold text-xs text-amber-300">
              {credits.toLocaleString()} 🪙
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Switcher */}
        <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 p-1 bg-[#141926] rounded-xl border border-white/5">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('animals');
            }}
            className={`py-2 text-[11px] font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'animals'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            Animals ({ANIMALS_DATA.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('supplies');
            }}
            className={`py-2 text-[11px] font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'supplies'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            Supplies ({GEAR_ITEMS.length})
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setShowPetAuctions(true);
            }}
            className="py-2 text-[11px] font-display font-black uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 shadow-sm"
          >
            <Gavel className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>Auctions</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Dynamic Toast Feedback */}
      {purchaseToast && (
        <div className="mx-4 mt-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#152018] border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/70 text-center animate-in fade-in duration-200 shadow-xl">
          <p className="font-display font-black text-xs text-[#CCFF00] uppercase tracking-wide">
            {purchaseToast.title}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-300 mt-0.5">
            {purchaseToast.subtitle}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 1: REAL ANIMALS LIVESTOCK EXCHANGE */}
      {activeTab === 'animals' && (
        <div className="p-4 space-y-4">
          {/* Category Filter Pills */}
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 scrollbar-none">
            {categories.map((cat) => (
              <button
                key={cat}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  setSelectedCategory(cat);
                }}
                className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold whitespace-nowrap transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                  selectedCategory === cat
                    ? 'bg-white text-black shadow'
                    : 'bg-[#141824] text-neutral-400 hover:text-white border border-white/5'
                }`}
              >
                {cat}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          {/* Real Animals List */}
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {filteredAnimals.map((animal) => {
              const isAlreadyOwned = ownedBeasts.some((b) => b.name === animal.name);
              const canAfford = credits >= animal.currentPriceCredits;

              return (
                <div
                  key={animal.id}
                  className="bg-[#10141f] border border-white/10 hover:border-white/25 rounded-2xl p-3.5 transition-all shadow-md flex flex-col justify-between"
                >
                  <div className="flex gap-3.5">
                    {/* Real Wildlife Photo */}
                    <div className="relative w-24 h-24 sm:w-28 sm:h-28 aspect-square rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/15 shrink-0 bg-black">
                      <img
                        src={animal.image}
                        alt={animal.name}
                        className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center aspect-square"
                        onError={(e) => {
                          e.currentTarget.src = animal.fallbackImage;
                        }}
                      />
                      <div className="absolute top-1 left-1 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-sm px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-white border border-white/10">
                        {animal.breed}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Real Biological Specs */}
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base text-white uppercase truncate">
                          {animal.name}
                        </h3>
                        <span className={getRarityBadgeClasses(animal.rarity)}>
                          {animal.rarity}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 italic truncate">
                        {animal.scientificName}
                      </p>

                      {/* Real Physical Metrics Grid */}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1 pt-1 text-[10px] font-mono">
                        <div className="bg-black/40 rounded p-1 text-center">
                          <span className="text-neutral-500 block text-[8px]">WEIGHT</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-white">{animal.weightKg} kg</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="bg-black/40 rounded p-1 text-center">
                          <span className="text-neutral-500 block text-[8px]">JAW PSI</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-red-400">{animal.biteForcePsi}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="bg-black/40 rounded p-1 text-center">
                          <span className="text-neutral-500 block text-[8px]">SPEED</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-cyan-400">{animal.topSpeedKmh} km/h</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 line-clamp-1 pt-0.5">
                        {animal.description}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Bottom Action / Price Bar */}
                  <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono text-sm font-bold text-amber-300">
                      <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
                      <span>{animal.currentPriceCredits.toLocaleString()} Credits</span>
                    </div>

                    {isAlreadyOwned ? (
                      <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-400 font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                        <span>In Your Kennel</span>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleAcquireAnimal(animal)}
                        disabled={!canAfford}
                        className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow ${
                          canAfford
                            ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#d4ff1a] text-black active:scale-95'
                            : 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <PackageCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        <span>Procure Animal</span>
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TAB 2: TACTICAL & VETERINARY SUPPLIES */}
      {activeTab === 'supplies' && (
        <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
          <p className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
            Professional conditioning equipment & high-protein nutrition for your lead fighter ({activeBeast.name}):
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-2.5">
            {GEAR_ITEMS.map((item) => {
              const canAfford = credits >= item.price;
              const bonusText = Object.entries(item.statBonus)
                .map(([k, v]) => `+${v} ${k.toUpperCase()}`)
                .join(', ');

              return (
                <div
                  key={item.id}
                  className="bg-[#10141f] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between shadow-md"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#161c2b] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                      <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="font-display font-black text-xs text-white uppercase">
                        {item.name}
                      </h4>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                        Slot: <span className="text-white uppercase font-bold">{item.slot}</span> · {item.description}
                      </p>
                      <span className="inline-block mt-1 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00] bg-[#CCFF00]/10 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-[#CCFF00]/30">
                        {bonusText}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right shrink-0 ml-2 space-y-1">
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-300">
                      {item.price.toLocaleString()} 🪙
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleBuySupply(item)}
                      disabled={!canAfford}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-display font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                        canAfford
                          ? 'bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-black shadow'
                          : 'bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-500 cursor-not-allowed opacity-60'
                      }`}
                    >
                      Buy & Equip
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showPetAuctions && (
        <PetAuctionHouseModal onClose={() => setShowPetAuctions(false)} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};
