<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion, SPECIES_CONFIG } from '../../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import {
  PetAnimationState,
  BERRIES,
  WildPetEncounter,
} from '../../../types/pet';
import {
  Heart,
  Utensils,
  Sparkles,
  RotateCcw,
  Camera,
  Mic,
  MicOff,
  Gavel,
  Compass,
  Moon,
  Sun,
  Coffee,
  Bath,
  Tv,
  Layers,
  Sparkle,
  Smile,
  Droplets,
  Flame,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { voiceMimic } from '../../../utils/voiceMimic';
import { ProceduralPetCanvas } from '../pet/ProceduralPetCanvas';
import { mapBeastToSpecies, getPetPhoto, getRarityBadgeClasses } from '../../../utils/petVisuals';
import { ExtensionExporterModal } from '../pet/ExtensionExporterModal';
import { WildPetCatchModal } from '../pet/WildPetCatchModal';
import { PetAuctionHouseModal } from '../pet/PetAuctionHouseModal';
import { PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal } from '../pet/PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal';
import { PetWorldMapView } from '../pet/PetWorldMapView';
import { triggerConfetti } from '../../../utils/confetti';

interface PetSanctuaryScreenProps {
  onGoToArena?: () => void;
}

interface DraggableCareTool {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  type: 'food' | 'sponge' | 'milk' | 'treat';
  emoji: string;
  label: string;
  bgClass: string;
  borderClass: string;
}

const CARE_TOOLS: DraggableCareTool[] = [
  {
    id: 'steak',
    name: 'Prime Steak',
    type: 'food',
    emoji: '🥩',
    label: 'Steak',
    bgClass: 'bg-rose-500/20 hover:bg-rose-500/30 text-rose-300',
    borderClass: 'border-rose-400/40',
  },
  {
    id: 'kibble',
    name: 'Kibble Feast',
    type: 'food',
    emoji: '🥣',
    label: 'Kibble',
    bgClass: 'bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 text-amber-300',
    borderClass: 'border-amber-400/40',
  },
  {
    id: 'berry',
    name: 'Oran Berry',
    type: 'treat',
    emoji: '🫐',
    label: 'Berries',
    bgClass: 'bg-blue-500/20 hover:bg-blue-500/30 text-blue-300',
    borderClass: 'border-blue-400/40',
  },
  {
    id: 'milk',
    name: 'Milk Bowl',
    type: 'milk',
    emoji: '🥛',
    label: 'Milk',
    bgClass: 'bg-cyan-500/20 hover:bg-cyan-500/30 text-cyan-300',
    borderClass: 'border-cyan-400/40',
  },
  {
    id: 'sponge',
    name: 'Soapy Sponge',
    type: 'sponge',
    emoji: '🧽',
    label: 'Sponge',
    bgClass: 'bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 text-emerald-300',
    borderClass: 'border-emerald-400/40',
  },
];

export const PetSanctuaryScreen: React.FC<PetSanctuaryScreenProps> = ({ onGoToArena }) => {
  const { activeBeast, ownedBeasts, selectActiveBeast } = useGame();
  const {
    feedPet,
    strokePet,
    isOverlayActive,
    toggleOverlay,
    wildEncounters,
    refreshWildSpawns,
  } = usePetCompanion();

  // Avatar Display Mode: 'cute' (Animated Talking Tom Buddy) vs 'card' (Realistic Photo Card)
  const [displayMode, setDisplayMode] = useState<'cute' | 'card'>('cute');

  // Animation & Visual State
  const [animState, setAnimState] = useState<PetAnimationState>('idle');
  const [talkingVolume, setTalkingVolume] = useState<number>(0);
  const [isRecordingVoice, setIsRecordingVoice] = useState(false);
  const [roomLighting, setRoomLighting] = useState<'day' | 'night'>('day');
  const [heartsCount, setHeartsCount] = useState<number>(4);
  const [hungerLevel, setHungerLevel] = useState<number>(85);
  const [cleanlinessLevel, setCleanlinessLevel] = useState<number>(90);
  const [pettingHearts, setPettingHearts] = useState<{ id: number; x: number; y: number }[]>([]);
  const [bubbleParticles, setBubbleParticles] = useState<
    { id: number; x: number; y: number; size: number }[]
  >([]);

  // Drag & Drop Physics State
  const [activeDragTool, setActiveDragTool] = useState<DraggableCareTool | null>(null);
  const [dragPointerPos, setDragPointerPos] = useState<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const [isHoveringPetStage, setIsHoveringPetStage] = useState(false);
  const petStageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  // Modals
  const [showExtensionModal, setShowExtensionModal] = useState(false);
  const [showAuctionModal, setShowAuctionModal] = useState(false);
  const [showPhotoStudioModal, setShowPhotoStudioModal] = useState(false);
  const [showWorldMap, setShowWorldMap] = useState(false);

  // Status & Speech
  const [speechBubbleText, setSpeechBubbleText] = useState<string | null>(
    `Hi Trainer! I'm ${activeBeast.name}! Drag treats or the soapy sponge onto me, or tap below!`
  );

  // Keep speech in sync when pet changes
  useEffect(() => {
    setSpeechBubbleText(
      `Ready to train, Trainer! I'm ${activeBeast.name} (${activeBeast.breed || activeBeast.species})!`
    );
  }, [activeBeast.id, activeBeast.name, activeBeast.breed, activeBeast.species]);

  const showSpeech = (text: string, duration = 3000) => {
    setSpeechBubbleText(text);
    setTimeout(() => setSpeechBubbleText(null), duration);
  };

  // Trigger floating heart particles
  const spawnHearts = (x?: number, y?: number) => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    const spawnX = x !== undefined ? x : window.innerWidth / 2;
    const spawnY = y !== undefined ? y : window.innerHeight / 2;
    setPettingHearts((prev) => [...prev, { id, x: spawnX, y: spawnY }]);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setPettingHearts((prev) => prev.filter((h) => h.id !== id));
    }, 1400);
  };

  // Trigger floating bubble particles for bath / scrubbing
  const spawnBubblesAt = (relXPercent: number, relYPercent: number, count = 4) => {
    const newBubbles = Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, i) => ({
      id: Date.now() + Math.random() + i,
      x: Math.max(10, Math.min(90, relXPercent + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15)),
      y: Math.max(10, Math.min(90, relYPercent + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15)),
      size: 10 + Math.random() * 16,
    }));
    setBubbleParticles((prev) => [...prev, ...newBubbles]);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setBubbleParticles((prev) => prev.filter((b) => !newBubbles.some((nb) => nb.id === b.id)));
    }, 1800);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Petting (Stroke) - Silent visual feedback
  const handlePetTheBeast = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    setAnimState('pet');
    spawnHearts(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    strokePet();
    setHeartsCount((prev) => Math.min(5, prev + 1));
    showSpeech(`*Purrrrr!* You give the best pets! ❤️`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 1600);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Feeding - Silent visual feedback
  const handleFeedKibble = (treatName = 'kibble', bonus = 20) => {
    setAnimState('eat');
    setHungerLevel((prev) => Math.min(100, prev + bonus));
    feedPet(BERRIES[0]);
    spawnHearts();
    showSpeech(`*Nom nom nom!* Loved that ${treatName}! Hunger -${bonus}%! 😋`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2000);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Bubble Bath - Silent visual feedback
  const handleBubbleBath = () => {
    setAnimState('bath');
    spawnBubblesAt(50, 50, 10);
    setCleanlinessLevel(100);
    showSpeech(`Splish splash! Squeaky clean bubble bath! 🧼✨`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2400);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Milk / Water Bowl - Silent visual feedback
  const handlePourMilk = () => {
    setAnimState('drink_milk');
    setHungerLevel((prev) => Math.min(100, prev + 15));
    showSpeech(`*Slurp slurp* Fresh cold milk! Satiety +15! 🥛`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2200);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Prank / Playful
  const handlePlayfulToot = () => {
    setAnimState('fart');
    showSpeech(`Oops! Excuse me! Hehehe! 💨😹`);
    setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 1800);
  };

  // Interactive Care: Pet Tricks & Acrobatics
  const handlePerformTrick = (trick: PetAnimationState) => {
    setAnimState(trick);
    const trickMessages: Record<string, string> = {
      backflip: `🤸 Look at that somersault backflip! High agility!`,
      zoomies: `⚡ ZOOMIES! Running at supersonic speed!`,
      rollover: `🔄 Belly up! Rolling over playfully!`,
      dance: `💃 Tapping paws to the rhythm! Let's dance!`,
      beg: `🐾 Sitting up and waving paws! So cute!`,
      spin: `💫 360-degree whirlwind spin! Whoosh!`,
    };
    showSpeech(trickMessages[trick] || `Ta-da! Amazing trick! ✨`, 3200);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setAnimState('idle');
    }, 3200);
  };

  // --- DRAGGABLE TOOLS TOUCH & POINTER PHYSICS ---
  const handleToolPointerDown = (tool: DraggableCareTool, e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    sound.playClick();
    setActiveDragTool(tool);
    setDragPointerPos({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });
    (e.target as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);

    if (tool.type === 'food' || tool.type === 'treat' || tool.type === 'milk') {
      showSpeech(`Drag ${tool.name} into ${activeBeast.name}'s mouth!`);
    } else if (tool.type === 'sponge') {
      showSpeech(`Rub the soapy sponge all over ${activeBeast.name}! 🧽`);
    }
  };

  const handleGlobalPointerMove = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!activeDragTool) return;
    setDragPointerPos({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY });

    // Check if pointer is over the pet stage
    if (petStageRef.current) {
      const rect = petStageRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      const isInside =
        e.clientX >= rect.left &&
        e.clientX <= rect.right &&
        e.clientY >= rect.top &&
        e.clientY <= rect.bottom;

      setIsHoveringPetStage(isInside);

      if (isInside && activeDragTool.type === 'sponge') {
        // Scrubbing physics: spawn dynamic bubbles as sponge is dragged across pet
        const relX = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100;
        const relY = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;
        if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
          spawnBubblesAt(relX, relY, 2);
          setCleanlinessLevel((prev) => Math.min(100, prev + 2));
        }
      }
    }
  };

  const handleGlobalPointerUp = (e: React.PointerEvent) => {
    if (!activeDragTool) return;
    try {
      (e.target as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    } catch {}

    const wasHovering = isHoveringPetStage;
    const tool = activeDragTool;
    setActiveDragTool(null);
    setDragPointerPos(null);
    setIsHoveringPetStage(false);

    // If dropped inside pet stage, execute targeted drop reaction
    if (wasHovering) {
      if (tool.type === 'food' || tool.type === 'treat') {
        handleFeedKibble(tool.name, tool.id === 'steak' ? 30 : 20);
        triggerConfetti();
      } else if (tool.type === 'milk') {
        handlePourMilk();
      } else if (tool.type === 'sponge') {
        setAnimState('bath');
        setCleanlinessLevel(100);
        showSpeech(`✨ Super clean! ${activeBeast.name} is squeaky clean and sparkling!`);
        setTimeout(() => setAnimState('idle'), 2000);
      }
    } else {
      // Direct click fallback (if released without dragging far)
      if (tool.type === 'food' || tool.type === 'treat') {
        handleFeedKibble(tool.name, 20);
      } else if (tool.type === 'milk') {
        handlePourMilk();
      } else if (tool.type === 'sponge') {
        handleBubbleBath();
      }
    }
  };

  // Talking Tom Voice Mimic (Repeater)
  const handleToggleVoiceRecord = async () => {
    if (isRecordingVoice) {
      setIsRecordingVoice(false);
      showSpeech('Repeating what you said! 📢');
      setAnimState('talk');

      await voiceMimic.stopAndRepeat(
        (amp) => setTalkingVolume(amp),
        () => {
          setTalkingVolume(0);
          setAnimState('idle');
          showSpeech(`Hehe! That was hilarious!`);
        }
      );
    } else {
      const res = await voiceMimic.startListening(() => {});
      if (res.success) {
        setIsRecordingVoice(true);
        showSpeech('Listening... Speak now into your mic! 🎙️');
      } else {
        showSpeech(`Mic unavailable, speaking preset!`);
        setAnimState('talk');
        voiceMimic.speakPresetPhrase(
          `Hello Trainer! I am ${activeBeast.name}! Ready to clash in the arena!`,
          (amp) => setTalkingVolume(amp),
          () => {
            setTalkingVolume(0);
            setAnimState('idle');
          }
        );
      }
    }
  };

  const handleToggleRoomLights = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    if (roomLighting === 'day') {
      setRoomLighting('night');
      setAnimState('sleep');
      showSpeech(`Goodnight Trainer... Zzz 😴🌙`);
    } else {
      setRoomLighting('day');
      setAnimState('idle');
      showSpeech(`Good morning! Ready for battle! ☀️`);
    }
  };

  const speciesKey = mapBeastToSpecies(activeBeast.breed || activeBeast.species);

  return (
    <div
      onPointerMove={handleGlobalPointerMove}
      onPointerUp={handleGlobalPointerUp}
      className={`h-full w-full flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden p-2 sm:p-2.5 transition-colors duration-500 select-none ${
        roomLighting === 'night' ? 'bg-[#05070D]' : 'bg-[#080B12]'
      } text-white`}
    >
      {/* Active Floating Dragged Tool Physics Ghost */}
      {activeDragTool && dragPointerPos && (
        <div
          className="fixed pointer-events-none z-50 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-black/90 border border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.6)] backdrop-blur-md transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 scale-125 transition-transform"
          style={{ left: `${dragPointerPos.x}px`, top: `${dragPointerPos.y}px` }}
        >
          <span className="text-2xl animate-bounce">{activeDragTool.emoji}</span>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
            {isHoveringPetStage ? 'Drop to Apply!' : activeDragTool.name}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Floating Petting Hearts Animation */}
      {pettingHearts.map((h) => (
        <div
          key={h.id}
          className="fixed pointer-events-none z-50 text-xl animate-bounce"
          style={{ left: `${h.x}px`, top: `${h.y - 30}px` }}
        >
          ❤️
        </div>
      ))}

      {/* Floating Bath Bubbles Animation */}
      {bubbleParticles.map((b) => (
        <div
          key={b.id}
          className="absolute pointer-events-none z-40 rounded-full bg-cyan-300/30 border border-cyan-200/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-ping"
          style={{
            left: `${b.x}%`,
            top: `${b.y}%`,
            width: `${b.size}px`,
            height: `${b.size}px`,
          }}
        />
      ))}

      {/* SECTION 1: COMPACT TOP BAR */}
      <div className="shrink-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#141C2E] to-[#0D121F] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-1 shadow-sm">
        {/* Active Pet Identity */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 shrink">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 bg-black shadow-xs">
            <img
              src={getPetPhoto(activeBeast)}
              alt={activeBeast.name}
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="leading-tight min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 truncate">
              <span className="font-display font-black text-xs text-white uppercase truncate">
                {activeBeast.name}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#CCFF00]/15 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 text-[#CCFF00] px-1 py-0.2 rounded">
                LVL {activeBeast.level}
              </span>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] truncate block">
              {activeBeast.breed || activeBeast.species}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Center: Pet Condition Indicators (Hunger & Cleanliness) */}
        <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-3 bg-black/40 border border-white/10 rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1 shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Utensils className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-400" />
            <div className="w-16 h-1.5 bg-neutral-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 to-yellow-400 transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: `${hungerLevel}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-amber-300">{hungerLevel}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Droplets className="w-3 h-3 text-cyan-400" />
            <div className="w-16 h-1.5 bg-neutral-800 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-400 transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: `${cleanlinessLevel}%` }}
              />
            </div>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-cyan-300">{cleanlinessLevel}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Cute Buddy vs Photo Card Switcher */}
        <div className="flex items-center bg-black/60 border border-white/15 rounded-xl p-0.5 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => setDisplayMode('cute')}
            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              displayMode === 'cute'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
            title="Interactive Animated Talking Tom Buddy"
          >
            🐾 Buddy
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setDisplayMode('card')}
            className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              displayMode === 'card'
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
            title="Authentic Champion Breed Card"
          >
            📷 Card
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Right Tools (Photo Studio, Auction, Map Radar, Day/Night) */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowPhotoStudioModal(true)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-purple-500/20 hover:bg-purple-500/30 border border-purple-400/40 text-purple-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="AI Pet Photo Studio & Card Creator"
          >
            <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAuctionModal(true)}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 hover:bg-amber-500/30 border border-amber-400/40 text-amber-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Live Auction House Floor"
          >
            <Gavel className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowWorldMap(true)}
            className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/30 border border-emerald-400/40 text-emerald-300 transition-colors cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono font-bold shadow-xs"
            title="Real-Time GPS Pet Radar"
          >
            <Compass className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">Radar</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleToggleRoomLights}
            className={`p-1.5 rounded-xl border transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
              roomLighting === 'night'
                ? 'bg-neutral-800 text-yellow-300 border-yellow-500/30'
                : 'bg-yellow-400 text-black border-yellow-300'
            }`}
            title="Toggle Day / Night"
          >
            {roomLighting === 'night' ? (
              <Moon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            ) : (
              <Sun className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            )}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SECTION 2: LIVING STAGE WITH DRAG & DROP TARGET RECEPTOR */}
      <div
        ref={petStageRef}
        className={`flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative min-h-0 my-1 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl transition-all duration-300 ${
          isHoveringPetStage
            ? 'ring-2 ring-[#CCFF00] bg-[#CCFF00]/5 scale-[1.01]'
            : 'border border-transparent'
        }`}
      >
        {/* Ambient Stage Lighting Background */}
        <div
          className={`absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none transition-opacity duration-700 ${
            roomLighting === 'night'
              ? 'bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,#1e1b4b_0%,#05070D_80%)] opacity-80'
              : 'bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,#1e293b_0%,#080B12_80%)] opacity-70'
          }`}
        />

        {/* Speech Bubble (Floating above pet) */}
        {speechBubbleText && (
          <div className="relative z-20 mb-1 px-3 py-1 rounded-xl bg-black/90 backdrop-blur-md text-[#CCFF00] text-[11px] font-mono font-bold shadow-lg animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 max-w-[320px] text-center border border-[#CCFF00]/50">
            {speechBubbleText}
            <div className="absolute -bottom-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-black/90 rotate-45 border-r border-b border-[#CCFF00]/50" />
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Hover Target Indicator */}
        {isHoveringPetStage && (
          <div className="absolute top-2 z-30 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-mono font-bold text-[10px] animate-pulse">
            🎯 Release to Care for {activeBeast.name}!
          </div>
        )}

        {/* THE LIVING PET AVATAR DISPLAY */}
        <div className="relative z-10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
          {displayMode === 'cute' ? (
            /* 🐾 CUTE PROCEDURAL ANIMATED BUDDY */
            <div
              className="relative cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center group"
              onClick={handlePetTheBeast}
              onDoubleClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const tricks: PetAnimationState[] = ['backflip', 'zoomies', 'rollover', 'dance', 'beg', 'spin'];
                const picked = tricks[Math.floor(Math.random() * tricks.length)];
                handlePerformTrick(picked);
              }}
              title="Tap to pet · Double-click to perform trick! 🤸"
            >
              {/* Pedestal Glow Shadow */}
              <div
                className={`absolute -bottom-2 inset-x-2 h-6 rounded-full blur-md transition-colors ${
                  isHoveringPetStage ? 'bg-[#CCFF00]/40 scale-125' : 'bg-[#CCFF00]/15'
                }`}
              />

              <ProceduralPetCanvas
                species={speciesKey}
                stage={2}
                animationState={animState}
                talkingVolume={talkingVolume}
                width={190}
                height={175}
                interactive={true}
                onStroke={() => {
                  showSpeech(`*Purrrrr!* Keep petting! ❤️`);
                }}
                onPokeHead={() => {
                  showSpeech(`Ouch! Dizzy stars! ⭐😵`);
                }}
                onTickleBelly={() => {
                  showSpeech(`*Tee-hee-hee!* That tickles! 😸`);
                }}
                renderMode="cute"
              />

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] mt-0.5 text-pink-400 font-bold">
                {'❤️'.repeat(heartsCount)}
                <span className="text-neutral-400 text-[9px] font-mono ml-1">
                  (Drag treats or sponge onto pet · Tap to tickle)
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* 📷 REALISTIC HIGH-RES BREED CARD */
            <div
              className="relative cursor-pointer group"
              onClick={handlePetTheBeast}
              title="Tap to inspect"
            >
              <div className="relative w-40 h-48 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] bg-black transition-transform group-hover:scale-102">
                <img
                  src={getPetPhoto(activeBeast)}
                  alt={activeBeast.name}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center"
                />
                <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/85 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none" />

                <div className="absolute top-2 left-2 bg-black/80 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-white/20 text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
                  LVL {activeBeast.level}
                </div>

                <div className="absolute top-2 right-2">
                  <span className={getRarityBadgeClasses(activeBeast.rarity)}>
                    {activeBeast.rarity}
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="absolute bottom-2 inset-x-2 text-center">
                  <span className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white uppercase truncate block">
                    {activeBeast.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-mono font-bold truncate block">
                    {activeBeast.breed || activeBeast.species}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SECTION 3: TACTILE DRAGGABLE CARE TRAY & VOICE DOCK */}
      <div className="shrink-0 w-full space-y-1.5 my-1">
        {/* Tray Label */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 px-1">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-neutral-300">
            <span>✨ Tactile Care Tray</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-[#CCFF00] font-normal">(Drag onto pet or tap)</span>
          </span>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-[9px]">Satiety: {hungerLevel}%</span>
            <span>·</span>
            <span className="text-[9px]">Clean: {cleanlinessLevel}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Care Tools Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1 sm:gap-1.5">
          {CARE_TOOLS.map((tool) => (
            <button
              key={tool.id}
              onPointerDown={(e) => handleToolPointerDown(tool, e)}
              className={`h-11 rounded-xl border flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1 transition-all cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing active:scale-95 shadow-xs ${tool.bgClass} ${tool.borderClass}`}
              title={`Drag ${tool.name} onto pet or click to use`}
            >
              <span className="text-base leading-none select-none">{tool.emoji}</span>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5 truncate max-w-full">
                {tool.label}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}

          {/* Talking Tom Voice Mimic */}
          <button
            onClick={handleToggleVoiceRecord}
            className={`h-11 rounded-xl border border-purple-400/40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-1 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs ${
              isRecordingVoice
                ? 'bg-red-500 text-white animate-pulse'
                : 'bg-purple-600/30 hover:bg-purple-600/40 text-purple-200'
            }`}
            title="Record voice to repeat in chipmunk pitch"
          >
            {isRecordingVoice ? (
              <MicOff className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
            ) : (
              <Mic className="w-4 h-4 text-purple-300" />
            )}
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">
              {isRecordingVoice ? 'Echoing' : 'Mimic'}
            </span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Tricks & Acrobatics Row */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 px-1 pt-1">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
            <span>🤸 Pet Tricks & Acrobatics</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Tap trick or double-click buddy)</span>
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Tricks Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-6 gap-1 sm:gap-1.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('backflip')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-yellow-400/30 bg-yellow-400/10 hover:bg-yellow-400 hover:text-black text-yellow-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="Perform Backflip"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">🤸</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Flip</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('zoomies')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-cyan-400/30 bg-cyan-400/10 hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black text-cyan-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="Zoomies Sprint"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">⚡</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Zoom</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('rollover')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-pink-400/30 bg-pink-400/10 hover:bg-pink-400 hover:text-black text-pink-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="Roll Over"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">🔄</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Roll</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('dance')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-purple-400/30 bg-purple-400/10 hover:bg-purple-400 hover:text-black text-purple-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="Dance"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">💃</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Dance</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('beg')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-amber-400/30 bg-amber-400/10 hover:bg-amber-400 hover:text-black text-amber-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="Beg & Paw Wave"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">🐾</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Beg</span>
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => handlePerformTrick('spin')}
            className="h-9 rounded-xl border border-emerald-400/30 bg-emerald-400/10 hover:bg-emerald-400 hover:text-black text-emerald-300 flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-0.5 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-xs"
            title="360 Spin"
          >
            <span className="text-sm leading-none">💫</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold leading-none mt-0.5">Spin</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SECTION 4: COMPACT COMPANION KENNEL */}
      <div className="shrink-0 bg-[#0E131F] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-1.5 space-y-1">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-1">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-display font-black uppercase text-white">
            <Layers className="w-3 h-3 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            <span>Companion Kennel ({ownedBeasts.length})</span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={toggleOverlay}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              isOverlayActive
                ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow'
                : 'bg-white/10 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white'
            }`}
            title="Toggle Desktop Screen Buddy"
          >
            <Tv className="w-3 h-3" />
            <span>{isOverlayActive ? 'Buddy ON ✓' : 'Buddy OFF'}</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none py-0.5">
          {ownedBeasts.map((beast) => {
            const isActive = beast.id === activeBeast.id;
            return (
              <div
                key={beast.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playVictory();
                  selectActiveBeast(beast.id);
                  showSpeech(`Switched active buddy to ${beast.name}!`);
                }}
                className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1 rounded-xl border cursor-pointer transition-all shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#182030] border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)]'
                    : 'bg-[#121622] border-white/10 hover:border-white/20 opacity-75 hover:opacity-100'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-white/20 bg-black shrink-0">
                  <img
                    src={getPetPhoto(beast)}
                    alt={beast.name}
                    className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="leading-tight pr-1">
                  <div className="font-display font-black text-[10px] text-white uppercase truncate max-w-[80px]">
                    {beast.name}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[8px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00] truncate max-w-[80px]">
                    {beast.breed || beast.species}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* POPUP MODALS */}
      {showPhotoStudioModal && (
        <PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal onClose={() => setShowPhotoStudioModal(false)} />
      )}
      {showAuctionModal && <PetAuctionHouseModal onClose={() => setShowAuctionModal(false)} />}
      {showExtensionModal && (
        <ExtensionExporterModal onClose={() => setShowExtensionModal(false)} />
      )}
      {showWorldMap && <PetWorldMapView onClose={() => setShowWorldMap(false)} />}
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/screens/ProfileScreen.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  User,
  Trophy,
  Swords,
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Sparkles,
  RefreshCw,
  LogOut,
  Edit2,
  Check,
  Volume2,
  VolumeX,
  Lock,
  Camera,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../../context/GameContext';
import { sound } from '../../../utils/audio';
import { AccountAuthModal } from '../AccountAuthModal';

interface ProfileScreenProps {
  onOpenSystemDetails?: () => void;
}

export const ProfileScreen: React.FC<ProfileScreenProps> = () => {
  const {
    trainerName,
    setTrainerName,
    playerTag,
    connectedAccount,
    trophies,
    playerLevel,
    wins,
    losses,
    credits,
    battleDeckIds,
    ownedBeasts,
    soundEnabled,
    toggleSound,
    updateUserAvatar,
  } = useGame();

  const [isEditingName, setIsEditingName] = useState(false);
  const [nameInput, setNameInput] = useState(trainerName);
  const [showAuthModal, setShowAuthModal] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState(false);
  const [syncFeedback, setSyncFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handlePhotoUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const dataUrl = event.target?.result as string;
      if (dataUrl) {
        updateUserAvatar(dataUrl);
        sound.playLevelUp();
        setSyncFeedback('Profile photo updated successfully!');
        setTimeout(() => setSyncFeedback(null), 3000);
      }
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  };

  const totalMatches = wins + losses;
  const winRate = totalMatches > 0 ? Math.round((wins / totalMatches) * 100) : 0;

  const handleSaveName = () => {
    if (nameInput.trim()) {
      setTrainerName(nameInput.trim());
      sound.playClick();
    }
    setIsEditingName(false);
  };

  const handleManualSync = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    setIsSyncing(true);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setIsSyncing(false);
      sound.playLevelUp();
      setSyncFeedback('Cloud save synchronized successfully ✓');
      setTimeout(() => setSyncFeedback(null), 3000);
    }, 600);
  };

  // Active 4-Pet Squad
  const squadPets = battleDeckIds
    .map((id) => ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === id))
    .filter((b): b is typeof ownedBeasts[0] => !!b);

  const safeSquad = squadPets.length > 0 ? squadPets : ownedBeasts.slice(0, 4);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col h-full bg-[#080B12] text-white select-none overflow-y-auto pb-24 max-w-md mx-auto w-full">
      {/* Dynamic Toast Feedback */}
      {syncFeedback && (
        <div className="sticky top-2 z-50 mx-4 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-400/50 text-center animate-in fade-in">
          <p className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-300">{syncFeedback}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* TOP TRAINER CARD HERO */}
      <div className="p-4 bg-gradient-to-b from-[#141C2E] to-[#0D121F] border-b border-white/10">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          {/* Avatar Profile Photo with 1-Click Upload */}
          <div
            onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
            className="relative w-18 h-18 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.35)] bg-[#121622] shrink-0 aspect-square group cursor-pointer"
            title="Tap to Upload Custom Profile Photo"
          >
            <input
              ref={fileInputRef}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*"
              onChange={handlePhotoUpload}
              className="hidden"
            />
            {connectedAccount.avatarUrl ? (
              <img
                src={connectedAccount.avatarUrl}
                alt={trainerName}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center aspect-square"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center text-[#CCFF00] font-black text-2xl font-display">
                {trainerName.charAt(0)}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Hover Camera Overlay */}
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-white">
              <Camera className="w-5 h-5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span className="text-[8px] font-mono font-bold mt-0.5">Upload</span>
            </div>

            <div className="absolute -bottom-0.5 inset-x-0 bg-black/80 text-[#CCFF00] font-mono font-black text-[9px] text-center py-0.5 border-t border-white/10">
              LVL {playerLevel}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Name & Player Tag */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            {isEditingName ? (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={nameInput}
                  onChange={(e) => setNameInput(e.target.value)}
                  className="bg-[#1A2234] border border-[#CCFF00] rounded-xl px-2.5 py-1 text-sm font-bold text-white outline-none w-full"
                  maxLength={18}
                  autoFocus
                />
                <button
                  onClick={handleSaveName}
                  className="p-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#CCFF00] text-black cursor-pointer font-bold shrink-0"
                >
                  <Check className="w-4 h-4" />
                </button>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl text-white uppercase tracking-wider truncate">
                  {trainerName}
                </h2>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    sound.playClick();
                    setIsEditingName(true);
                  }}
                  className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-[#CCFF00] cursor-pointer"
                  title="Edit Name"
                >
                  <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
              <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">{playerTag}</span>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono bg-white/10 text-neutral-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full border border-white/15">
                {connectedAccount.isLoggedIn
                  ? `${connectedAccount.provider === 'Apple' ? 'Google' : connectedAccount.provider} ✓`
                  : 'Guest'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 4 Quick Stat Badges */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mt-4 text-center">
          <div className="bg-[#101422] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2.5">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Trophies</span>
            <span className="font-display font-black text-base text-amber-300">{trophies}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#101422] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2.5">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Wins</span>
            <span className="font-display font-black text-base text-[#CCFF00]">{wins}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#101422] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2.5">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Losses</span>
            <span className="font-display font-black text-base text-red-400">{losses}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-[#101422] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2.5">
            <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-neutral-400 block uppercase">Win Rate</span>
            <span className="font-display font-black text-base text-cyan-300">{winRate}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* SQUAD SHOWCASE */}
      <div className="p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
          <span className="font-bold text-white uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
            <span>Active Battle Squad</span>
          </span>
          <span>4 Dogs & Cats</span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
          {safeSquad.map((beast, idx) => (
            <div
              key={beast.id}
              className="bg-[#121622] border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-2 flex flex-col items-center text-center shadow"
            >
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden aspect-square border border-white/15 bg-black mb-1.5">
                <img
                  src={beast.image}
                  alt={beast.name}
                  className="w-full h-full object-cover object-center aspect-square"
                />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-white truncate w-full">
                {beast.name}
              </span>
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono text-cyan-400">
                LV.{beast.level || 10}
              </span>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ACCOUNT & CLOUD SAVE ACTIONS */}
      <div className="px-4 space-y-2.5">
        <div className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-neutral-400 uppercase">
          Account & Device Sync
        </div>

        {/* Google Hub Card */}
        <div
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playClick();
            setShowAuthModal(true);
          }}
          className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-[#121622] hover:bg-[#182030] border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between cursor-pointer transition-all"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/10 flex items-center justify-center">
              {connectedAccount.provider === 'Google' ? (
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                  <path fill="#4285F4" d="M23.745 12.27c0-.7-.06-1.4-.19-2.07H12v4.51h6.6c-.29 1.52-1.14 2.82-2.4 3.68v3.05h3.88c2.27-2.09 3.665-5.17 3.665-9.17z"/>
                  <path fill="#34A853" d="M12 24c3.24 0 5.95-1.08 7.93-2.91l-3.88-3.05c-1.08.72-2.45 1.16-4.05 1.16-3.12 0-5.77-2.1-6.72-4.93H1.25v3.15C3.26 21.36 7.33 24 12 24z"/>
                  <path fill="#FBBC05" d="M5.28 14.27c-.25-.72-.38-1.49-.38-2.27s.13-1.55.38-2.27V6.58H1.25C.45 8.18 0 10.04 0 12s.45 3.82 1.25 5.42l4.03-3.15z"/>
                  <path fill="#EA4335" d="M12 4.75c1.77 0 3.35.61 4.6 1.8l3.42-3.42C17.95 1.19 15.24 0 12 0 7.33 0 3.26 2.64 1.25 6.58l4.03 3.15c.95-2.83 3.6-4.98 6.72-4.98z"/>
                </svg>
              ) : (
                <User className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              )}
            </div>
            <div>
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-white">Google Cloud Player Hub</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                {connectedAccount.isLoggedIn ? `${connectedAccount.email} (Synced)` : 'Link Google Account for Cloud Saves'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">Manage →</span>
        </div>

        {/* Force Sync Button */}
        <button
          onClick={handleManualSync}
          disabled={isSyncing}
          className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#121622] hover:bg-[#182030] border border-white/10 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer"
        >
          <RefreshCw className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 ${isSyncing ? 'animate-spin text-[#CCFF00]' : ''}`} />
          <span>{isSyncing ? 'Synchronizing Cloud Progress...' : 'Sync Cloud Save Now'}</span>
        </button>

        {/* Audio Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playClick();
            toggleSound();
          }}
          className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl bg-[#121622] hover:bg-[#182030] border border-white/10 text-white font-mono text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer"
        >
          {soundEnabled ? (
            <>
              <Volume2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
              <span>Game SFX & Sounds: ON</span>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <VolumeX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-neutral-400" />
              <span>Game SFX & Sounds: MUTED</span>
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Account Auth Modal */}
      {showAuthModal && (
        <AccountAuthModal
          currentTrainerName={trainerName}
          onUpdateTrainerName={setTrainerName}
          onClose={() => setShowAuthModal(false)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>

<source>src/components/game/ThreeArenaSimulation.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { Animal } from '../../data/animals';

export type CombatActionType = 'idle' | 'jab' | 'maul' | 'takedown' | 'guard' | 'hit' | 'victory' | 'defeat' | 'tag_in';

interface ThreeArenaSimulationProps {
  playerBeast: Animal;
  opponentBeast: Animal;
  actionState: {
    playerMove: CombatActionType;
    opponentMove: CombatActionType;
  };
  screenShake: boolean;
  is2v2?: boolean;
  allyBeast?: Animal | null;
  opponentAlly?: Animal | null;
  playerHpPercent?: number;
  opponentHpPercent?: number;
  allyHpPercent?: number;
  opponentAllyHpPercent?: number;
  targetedOpponentIndex?: 0 | 1;
  onTapArena?: () => void;
  onSelectTarget?: (index: 0 | 1) => void;
}

interface FighterNode {
  id: string;
  group: THREE.Group;
  standeeMesh: THREE.Mesh;
  standeeMat: THREE.MeshBasicMaterial;
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
  texture: THREE.CanvasTexture;
  auraRing: THREE.Mesh;
  pedestal: THREE.Mesh;
  hpFill: THREE.Mesh;
  targetReticle?: THREE.Group;
  origPos: THREE.Vector3;
  targetPos: THREE.Vector3;
  isPlayerSide: boolean;
  colorHex: number;
  recoilOffset: number;
}

// Generates a guaranteed crisp, high-resolution 2.5D character card texture
function renderBeastCardTexture(
  animal: Animal,
  teamColorHex: string,
  isPlayerSide: boolean,
  canvas?: HTMLCanvasElement,
  existingTexture?: THREE.CanvasTexture
): { canvas: HTMLCanvasElement; texture: THREE.CanvasTexture } {
  const c = canvas || document.createElement('canvas');
  c.width = 512;
  c.height = 640;
  const ctx = c.getContext('2d');

  const tex = existingTexture || new THREE.CanvasTexture(c);
  tex.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
  tex.generateMipmaps = false;
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  tex.magFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;

  const redraw = (loadedImg?: HTMLImageElement) => {
    if (!ctx) return;
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 512, 640);

    // 1. Ornate Champion Card Shield Outer Glow
    ctx.shadowColor = teamColorHex;
    ctx.shadowBlur = 24;

    // 2. Rounded Champion Frame
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0F1524';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(24, 24, 464, 592, 40);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.shadowBlur = 0; // reset shadow

    // 3. Golden Metallic Border
    ctx.lineWidth = 10;
    ctx.strokeStyle = isPlayerSide ? '#38BDF8' : '#EF4444';
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';
    ctx.stroke();

    // 4. Animal Photo (Guaranteed rendering with crop & rounded corners)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(36, 36, 440, 450, 28);
    ctx.clip();

    if (loadedImg && loadedImg.complete && loadedImg.naturalWidth > 0) {
      // Draw actual photo centered
      const aspect = loadedImg.naturalWidth / loadedImg.naturalHeight;
      let drawW = 440;
      let drawH = 440 / aspect;
      if (drawH < 450) {
        drawH = 450;
        drawW = 450 * aspect;
      }
      const offsetX = 36 - (drawW - 440) / 2;
      const offsetY = 36 - (drawH - 450) / 2;
      ctx.drawImage(loadedImg, offsetX, offsetY, drawW, drawH);
    } else {
      // High-contrast gradient fallback while image loads
      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(36, 36, 476, 486);
      grad.addColorStop(0, isPlayerSide ? '#1E293B' : '#3F171A');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#0B0F19');
      ctx.fillStyle = grad;
      ctx.fillRect(36, 36, 440, 450);

      ctx.fillStyle = teamColorHex;
      ctx.font = 'bold 36px sans-serif';
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.fillText(animal.species, 256, 260);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // Inner subtle vignette over image
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(36, 36, 440, 450, 28);
    ctx.clip();
    const vigGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 300, 0, 486);
    vigGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    vigGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.85)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vigGrad;
    ctx.fillRect(36, 36, 440, 450);
    ctx.restore();

    // 5. Beast Name Banner
    ctx.fillStyle = '#080C14';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.roundRect(40, 496, 432, 104, 20);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#F59E0B';
    ctx.stroke();

    // Level Badge Star Circle
    ctx.fillStyle = isPlayerSide ? '#0284C7' : '#DC2626';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(88, 548, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();

    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#FCD34D';
    ctx.stroke();

    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.font = '900 24px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(`${animal.level || 8}`, 88, 548);

    // Name Text
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.font = '900 36px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'left';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(animal.name.toUpperCase().slice(0, 11), 136, 536);

    // Species / Role subtitle
    ctx.fillStyle = teamColorHex;
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillText(`${animal.species.slice(0, 18)} · ${animal.health} HP`, 136, 568);

    tex.needsUpdate = true;
  };

  // Preload real image
  const img = new Image();
  img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
  img.src = animal.image;
  if (img.complete) {
    redraw(img);
  } else {
    redraw(); // draw placeholder immediately
    img.onload = () => redraw(img);
    img.onerror = () => redraw();
  }

  return { canvas: c, texture: tex };
}

export const ThreeArenaSimulation: React.FC<ThreeArenaSimulationProps> = ({
  playerBeast,
  opponentBeast,
  actionState,
  screenShake,
  is2v2 = false,
  allyBeast = null,
  opponentAlly = null,
  playerHpPercent = 100,
  opponentHpPercent = 100,
  allyHpPercent = 100,
  opponentAllyHpPercent = 100,
  targetedOpponentIndex = 0,
  onTapArena,
  onSelectTarget,
}) => {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const actionStateRef = useRef(actionState);
  actionStateRef.current = actionState;

  const screenShakeRef = useRef(screenShake);
  screenShakeRef.current = screenShake;

  const playerHpRef = useRef(playerHpPercent);
  playerHpRef.current = playerHpPercent;

  const opponentHpRef = useRef(opponentHpPercent);
  opponentHpRef.current = opponentHpPercent;

  const allyHpRef = useRef(allyHpPercent);
  allyHpRef.current = allyHpPercent;

  const opponentAllyHpRef = useRef(opponentAllyHpPercent);
  opponentAllyHpRef.current = opponentAllyHpPercent;

  const targetedOpponentRef = useRef(targetedOpponentIndex);
  targetedOpponentRef.current = targetedOpponentIndex;

  const playerBeastRef = useRef(playerBeast);
  playerBeastRef.current = playerBeast;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;
    const container = containerRef.current;

    const width = container.clientWidth || 360;
    const height = container.clientHeight || 340;

    // 1. Dark Colosseum Scene, Camera & Renderer
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x080c14); // Deep night stadium sky
    scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(0x080c14, 0.035);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(44, width / height, 0.1, 100);
    camera.position.set(0, 7.6, 9.4);
    camera.lookAt(0, 0.4, 0);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true, alpha: false, powerPreference: 'high-performance' });
    renderer.setSize(width, height);
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;

    container.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // 2. Majestic Dark Esports Stadium Lighting
    const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.95);
    scene.add(ambientLight);

    // Main Overhead Stadium Spot
    const spotLight = new THREE.SpotLight(0xfffae6, 3.2);
    spotLight.position.set(0, 14, 2);
    spotLight.angle = Math.PI / 3.4;
    spotLight.penumbra = 0.5;
    spotLight.castShadow = true;
    spotLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 1024;
    spotLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 1024;
    scene.add(spotLight);

    // Dual Rim Lights (Cyan on Player Side, Crimson on Opponent Side)
    const cyanRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x00e5ff, 2.2);
    cyanRim.position.set(-8, 5, -4);
    scene.add(cyanRim);

    const crimsonRim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xff2244, 2.5);
    crimsonRim.position.set(8, 5, -4);
    scene.add(crimsonRim);

    // 3. Dark Colosseum Octagonal Arena Floor
    const floorGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(7.6, 8.0, 0.5, 48);
    const floorMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
      color: 0x111622, // Dark arena slate
      roughness: 0.75,
      metalness: 0.2,
    });
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(floorGeo, floorMat);
    floor.position.y = -0.25;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // Outer Neon Ring (Cyan/Lime Inlay)
    const neonRingGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(5.2, 5.38, 48);
    const neonRingMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xccff00,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.8,
    });
    const neonRing = new THREE.Mesh(neonRingGeo, neonRingMat);
    neonRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    neonRing.position.y = 0.015;
    scene.add(neonRing);

    // Inner Battle Circle
    const innerRingGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(2.1, 2.22, 36);
    const innerRingMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x00e5ff,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.65,
    });
    const innerRing = new THREE.Mesh(innerRingGeo, innerRingMat);
    innerRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    innerRing.position.y = 0.018;
    scene.add(innerRing);

    // Colosseum Columns with Glowing Torches
    const columnGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.28, 0.32, 4.2, 12);
    const columnMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x181e2b, roughness: 0.8 });
    const torchLights: THREE.PointLight[] = [];

    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const angle = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3;
      const x = Math.cos(angle) * 7.0;
      const z = Math.sin(angle) * 7.0;

      const col = new THREE.Mesh(columnGeo, columnMat);
      col.position.set(x, 2.1, z);
      scene.add(col);

      // Flame sphere
      const flameGeo = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.18, 8, 8);
      const flameMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffaa22 });
      const flame = new THREE.Mesh(flameGeo, flameMat);
      flame.position.set(x, 4.3, z);
      scene.add(flame);

      const torch = new THREE.PointLight(0xff7711, 1.4, 7);
      torch.position.set(x, 4.3, z);
      scene.add(torch);
      torchLights.push(torch);
    }

    // Dynamic Attack Slash Mesh
    const slashGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(1.2, 0.12, 8, 28, Math.PI * 0.95);
    const slashMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0x00e5ff,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
    });
    const slashMesh = new THREE.Mesh(slashGeo, slashMat);
    slashMesh.position.set(0, 1.2, 0);
    scene.add(slashMesh);

    // Ground Shockwave Mesh
    const shockwaveGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.3, 0.65, 32);
    const shockwaveMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
      color: 0xccff00,
      side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0,
    });
    const shockwaveMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shockwaveGeo, shockwaveMat);
    shockwaveMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    shockwaveMesh.position.y = 0.025;
    scene.add(shockwaveMesh);

    // Spark Particles
    const sparkCount = 45;
    const sparkGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
    const sparkPositions = new Float32Array(sparkCount * 3);
    const sparkVelocities: THREE.Vector3[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < sparkCount; i++) {
      sparkPositions[i * 3] = 0;
      sparkPositions[i * 3 + 1] = -10;
      sparkPositions[i * 3 + 2] = 0;
      sparkVelocities.push(new THREE.Vector3());
    }
    sparkGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(sparkPositions, 3));
    const sparkMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
      color: 0xffdd33,
      size: 0.22,
      transparent: true,
      opacity: 0.95,
    });
    const sparkMesh = new THREE.Points(sparkGeo, sparkMat);
    scene.add(sparkMesh);

    let sparkTimer = 0;
    const triggerSparksAt = (x: number, y: number, z: number, color = 0xffdd33) => {
      sparkMat.color.setHex(color);
      sparkTimer = 0.45;
      const pos = sparkGeo.attributes.position.array as Float32Array;
      for (let i = 0; i < sparkCount; i++) {
        pos[i * 3] = x;
        pos[i * 3 + 1] = y;
        pos[i * 3 + 2] = z;
        sparkVelocities[i].set(
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
          Math.random() * 5 + 2,
          (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6
        );
      }
      sparkGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
    };

    let shockwaveTimer = 0;
    const triggerShockwaveAt = (x: number, z: number) => {
      shockwaveMesh.position.set(x, 0.025, z);
      shockwaveMesh.scale.setScalar(0.4);
      shockwaveMat.opacity = 0.95;
      shockwaveTimer = 0.5;
    };

    // 4. Create High-Fidelity Guaranteed Beast Standee
    const createFighterNode = (
      animal: Animal,
      isPlayerSide: boolean,
      spawnX: number,
      spawnZ: number,
      accentColor: number,
      teamColorHex: string
    ): FighterNode => {
      const group = new THREE.Group();

      // Shadow Decal on Arena Floor
      const shadowGeo = new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.95, 24);
      const shadowMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: 0x000000,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.65,
      });
      const shadowMesh = new THREE.Mesh(shadowGeo, shadowMat);
      shadowMesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      shadowMesh.position.y = 0.02;
      group.add(shadowMesh);

      // 3D Sculpted Team Pedestal Base
      const pedGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.95, 1.05, 0.24, 28);
      const pedMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: isPlayerSide ? 0x0f2744 : 0x451216,
        metalness: 0.5,
        roughness: 0.35,
      });
      const pedestal = new THREE.Mesh(pedGeo, pedMat);
      pedestal.position.y = 0.12;
      pedestal.castShadow = true;
      group.add(pedestal);

      // Golden Bevel Ring on Pedestal
      const pedRimGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.98, 0.06, 8, 28);
      const pedRimMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xf59e0b,
        metalness: 0.8,
        roughness: 0.2,
      });
      const pedRim = new THREE.Mesh(pedRimGeo, pedRimMat);
      pedRim.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
      pedRim.position.y = 0.24;
      group.add(pedRim);

      // Ground Neon Aura Ring
      const auraGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(1.05, 1.22, 32);
      const auraMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: accentColor,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
        transparent: true,
        opacity: 0.85,
      });
      const auraRing = new THREE.Mesh(auraGeo, auraMat);
      auraRing.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      auraRing.position.y = 0.03;
      group.add(auraRing);

      // Guaranteed Crisp Photo Standee Billboard
      const { canvas, texture } = renderBeastCardTexture(animal, teamColorHex, isPlayerSide);
      const standeeGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.7, 2.15);
      const standeeMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        map: texture,
        transparent: true,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      });
      const standeeMesh = new THREE.Mesh(standeeGeo, standeeMat);
      standeeMesh.position.y = 1.35;
      standeeMesh.castShadow = true;
      group.add(standeeMesh);

      // Overhead 3D HP Bar
      const hpBgGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.35, 0.16);
      const hpBgMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x05070a, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
      const hpBg = new THREE.Mesh(hpBgGeo, hpBgMat);
      hpBg.position.set(0, 2.65, 0);

      const hpFillGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1.28, 0.11);
      const hpFillMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
        color: isPlayerSide ? 0xccff00 : 0xff3b30,
        side: THREE.DoubleSide,
      });
      const hpFill = new THREE.Mesh(hpFillGeo, hpFillMat);
      hpFill.position.set(0, 0, 0.01);
      hpBg.add(hpFill);
      group.add(hpBg);

      // 2v2 Target Crosshairs Reticle (for enemy beasts)
      let targetReticle: THREE.Group | undefined;
      if (!isPlayerSide) {
        targetReticle = new THREE.Group();
        targetReticle.position.set(0, 3.05, 0);

        const retRingGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.35, 0.45, 24);
        const retRingMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
          color: 0xf59e0b,
          side: THREE.DoubleSide,
          transparent: true,
          opacity: 0.95,
        });
        const retRing = new THREE.Mesh(retRingGeo, retRingMat);
        targetReticle.add(retRing);

        const arrowGeo = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.12, 0.28, 3);
        const arrow1 = new THREE.Mesh(arrowGeo, retRingMat);
        arrow1.position.y = 0.55;
        arrow1.rotation.z = Math.PI;
        targetReticle.add(arrow1);

        targetReticle.visible = false;
        group.add(targetReticle);
      }

      group.position.set(spawnX, 0, spawnZ);
      scene.add(group);

      return {
        id: animal.id,
        group,
        standeeMesh,
        standeeMat,
        canvas,
        texture,
        auraRing,
        pedestal,
        hpFill,
        targetReticle,
        origPos: new THREE.Vector3(spawnX, 0, spawnZ),
        targetPos: new THREE.Vector3(spawnX, 0, spawnZ),
        isPlayerSide,
        colorHex: accentColor,
        recoilOffset: 0,
      };
    };

    // Instantiate Fighters
    const fighters: FighterNode[] = [];

    // Player 1 (Bottom Left)
    const playerNode = createFighterNode(playerBeast, true, -2.1, 1.4, 0x00e5ff, '#00E5FF');
    fighters.push(playerNode);

    // Opponent 1 (Top Right)
    const opponentNode = createFighterNode(opponentBeast, false, 2.1, -1.4, 0xff3b30, '#FF3B30');
    fighters.push(opponentNode);

    // 2v2 Tag Team: Player Ally & Opponent Ally (4 Full Beasts on Screen)
    let allyNode: FighterNode | null = null;
    let oppAllyNode: FighterNode | null = null;

    if (is2v2 && allyBeast && opponentAlly) {
      allyNode = createFighterNode(allyBeast, true, -3.4, -0.6, 0xccff00, '#CCFF00');
      fighters.push(allyNode);

      oppAllyNode = createFighterNode(opponentAlly, false, 3.4, 0.6, 0xf97316, '#F97316');
      fighters.push(oppAllyNode);
    }

    // Tap-to-select target in 2v2
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

    const handlePointerDown = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      const rect = renderer.domElement.getBoundingClientRect();
      mouse.x = ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 2 - 1;
      mouse.y = -((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 2 + 1;

      raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);

      if (is2v2 && onSelectTarget && oppAllyNode) {
        const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects([opponentNode.group, oppAllyNode.group], true);
        if (intersects.length > 0) {
          let obj: THREE.Object3D | null = intersects[0].object;
          while (obj && obj.parent !== scene) {
            if (obj === oppAllyNode.group) {
              onSelectTarget(1);
              return;
            }
            if (obj === opponentNode.group) {
              onSelectTarget(0);
              return;
            }
            obj = obj.parent;
          }
        }
      }

      if (onTapArena) {
        onTapArena();
      }
    };

    renderer.domElement.addEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown);

    // 5. High-Energy Animation & Physics Loop
    let animId: number;
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    let attackProgress = 0;
    let activeAttackType: CombatActionType = 'idle';

    const animate = () => {
      animId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.1);
      const elapsed = clock.getElapsedTime();

      // Read dynamic state refs
      const currentAction = actionStateRef.current;
      const isShaking = screenShakeRef.current;
      const pBeast = playerBeastRef.current;
      const targetedOpp = targetedOpponentRef.current;

      // Update Player Beast Card Texture if swapped in deck
      if (playerNode.id !== pBeast.id) {
        playerNode.id = pBeast.id;
        renderBeastCardTexture(pBeast, '#00E5FF', true, playerNode.canvas, playerNode.texture);
        triggerShockwaveAt(playerNode.origPos.x, playerNode.origPos.z);
        triggerSparksAt(playerNode.origPos.x, 1.2, playerNode.origPos.z, 0x00e5ff);
      }

      // Torch flicker
      torchLights.forEach((light, i) => {
        light.intensity = 1.3 + Math.sin(elapsed * 7.5 + i * 1.5) * 0.35;
      });

      // Spark Physics
      if (sparkTimer > 0) {
        sparkTimer -= delta;
        const pos = sparkGeo.attributes.position.array as Float32Array;
        for (let i = 0; i < sparkCount; i++) {
          pos[i * 3] += sparkVelocities[i].x * delta;
          pos[i * 3 + 1] += sparkVelocities[i].y * delta;
          pos[i * 3 + 2] += sparkVelocities[i].z * delta;
          sparkVelocities[i].y -= 9.8 * delta;
        }
        sparkGeo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
      }

      // Shockwave Physics
      if (shockwaveTimer > 0) {
        shockwaveTimer -= delta;
        shockwaveMesh.scale.addScalar(delta * 7.5);
        shockwaveMat.opacity = Math.max(0, shockwaveTimer * 2.0);
      } else {
        shockwaveMat.opacity = 0;
      }

      // Update 3D HP Bars
      playerNode.hpFill.scale.x = Math.max(0.001, playerHpRef.current / 100);
      playerNode.hpFill.position.x = -0.64 * (1 - playerNode.hpFill.scale.x);

      opponentNode.hpFill.scale.x = Math.max(0.001, opponentHpRef.current / 100);
      opponentNode.hpFill.position.x = -0.64 * (1 - opponentNode.hpFill.scale.x);

      if (allyNode) {
        allyNode.hpFill.scale.x = Math.max(0.001, allyHpRef.current / 100);
        allyNode.hpFill.position.x = -0.64 * (1 - allyNode.hpFill.scale.x);
      }

      if (oppAllyNode) {
        oppAllyNode.hpFill.scale.x = Math.max(0.001, opponentAllyHpRef.current / 100);
        oppAllyNode.hpFill.position.x = -0.64 * (1 - oppAllyNode.hpFill.scale.x);
      }

      // 2v2 Target Crosshairs
      if (is2v2 && oppAllyNode) {
        if (targetedOpp === 1) {
          if (oppAllyNode.targetReticle) {
            oppAllyNode.targetReticle.visible = true;
            oppAllyNode.targetReticle.rotation.z += delta * 3.5;
            oppAllyNode.targetReticle.scale.setScalar(1.0 + Math.sin(elapsed * 8) * 0.12);
          }
          if (opponentNode.targetReticle) opponentNode.targetReticle.visible = false;
        } else {
          if (opponentNode.targetReticle) {
            opponentNode.targetReticle.visible = true;
            opponentNode.targetReticle.rotation.z += delta * 3.5;
            opponentNode.targetReticle.scale.setScalar(1.0 + Math.sin(elapsed * 8) * 0.12);
          }
          if (oppAllyNode.targetReticle) oppAllyNode.targetReticle.visible = false;
        }
      }

      // Target node for player's current attacks
      const currentTargetNode = (is2v2 && targetedOpp === 1 && oppAllyNode) ? oppAllyNode : opponentNode;

      // ------------------------------------------------------------------
      // COMBAT MOVEMENT KINEMATICS (PHYSICAL CHARGING & LUNGING ATTACKS)
      // ------------------------------------------------------------------
      const pMove = currentAction.playerMove;
      const pGroup = playerNode.group;

      if (pMove !== 'idle' && activeAttackType === 'idle') {
        activeAttackType = pMove;
        attackProgress = 0;
      }

      if (activeAttackType !== 'idle') {
        attackProgress += delta * 2.8;

        if (activeAttackType === 'jab') {
          // QUICK STRIKE: Sprints across the field to strike, then springs back
          if (attackProgress < 0.5) {
            const t = attackProgress / 0.5;
            const chargePos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
              playerNode.origPos,
              currentTargetNode.group.position,
              0.8 * t
            );
            pGroup.position.copy(chargePos);
            pGroup.position.y = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.4;
          } else if (attackProgress < 0.7) {
            // Impact
            slashMesh.material.opacity = 0.95;
            const impactX = (pGroup.position.x + currentTargetNode.group.position.x) / 2;
            const impactZ = (pGroup.position.z + currentTargetNode.group.position.z) / 2;
            slashMesh.position.set(impactX, 1.2, impactZ);
            slashMesh.rotation.z += 0.4;
            triggerSparksAt(impactX, 1.2, impactZ, 0x00e5ff);

            currentTargetNode.recoilOffset = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(currentTargetNode.recoilOffset, 1.1, 0.4);
          } else if (attackProgress < 1.0) {
            const t = (attackProgress - 0.7) / 0.3;
            pGroup.position.lerpVectors(pGroup.position, playerNode.origPos, t);
            pGroup.position.y = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.3;
            slashMesh.material.opacity = Math.max(0, slashMesh.material.opacity - delta * 4);
          } else {
            pGroup.position.copy(playerNode.origPos);
            pGroup.position.y = 0;
            activeAttackType = 'idle';
          }
        } else if (activeAttackType === 'maul' || activeAttackType === 'takedown') {
          // BEAST SLAM: High airborne parabolic arc leap and ground-pound slam!
          if (attackProgress < 0.5) {
            const t = attackProgress / 0.5;
            const leapPos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(
              playerNode.origPos,
              currentTargetNode.group.position,
              0.85 * t
            );
            pGroup.position.copy(leapPos);
            pGroup.position.y = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 2.4;
          } else if (attackProgress < 0.65) {
            // Slam impact
            pGroup.position.y = 0.05;
            triggerShockwaveAt(pGroup.position.x, pGroup.position.z);
            triggerSparksAt(pGroup.position.x, 1.0, pGroup.position.z, 0xccff00);
            currentTargetNode.recoilOffset = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(currentTargetNode.recoilOffset, 1.4, 0.5);
          } else if (attackProgress < 1.0) {
            const t = (attackProgress - 0.65) / 0.35;
            pGroup.position.lerpVectors(pGroup.position, playerNode.origPos, t);
            pGroup.position.y = Math.sin(t * Math.PI) * 0.4;
          } else {
            pGroup.position.copy(playerNode.origPos);
            pGroup.position.y = 0;
            activeAttackType = 'idle';
          }
        } else {
          pGroup.position.lerp(playerNode.origPos, 0.15);
          activeAttackType = 'idle';
        }
      } else {
        // Idle breathing bob
        pGroup.position.lerp(playerNode.origPos, 0.1);
        pGroup.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 4.2) * 0.07;
      }

      // Opponent Recoil Decay
      if (currentTargetNode.recoilOffset > 0.01) {
        currentTargetNode.recoilOffset = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(currentTargetNode.recoilOffset, 0, delta * 4);
        const recoilDir = currentTargetNode.group.position.clone().sub(playerNode.origPos).normalize();
        currentTargetNode.group.position.copy(currentTargetNode.origPos).addScaledVector(recoilDir, currentTargetNode.recoilOffset);
        currentTargetNode.standeeMesh.rotation.z = currentTargetNode.recoilOffset * -0.3;
      } else {
        currentTargetNode.group.position.lerp(currentTargetNode.origPos, 0.1);
        currentTargetNode.standeeMesh.rotation.z = 0;
      }

      // Opponent attacks
      const oMove = currentAction.opponentMove;
      const oGroup = opponentNode.group;

      if (oMove === 'jab' || oMove === 'maul') {
        const oChargePos = new THREE.Vector3().lerpVectors(opponentNode.origPos, playerNode.origPos, 0.7);
        oGroup.position.lerp(oChargePos, 0.28);
        oGroup.position.y = 0.3;
        triggerSparksAt(oChargePos.x - 0.3, 1.1, oChargePos.z, 0xff2244);
      } else if (oMove === 'hit') {
        const oRecoil = opponentNode.origPos.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0.9, 0, -0.4));
        oGroup.position.lerp(oRecoil, 0.3);
      } else {
        oGroup.position.lerp(opponentNode.origPos, 0.1);
        oGroup.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 4.2 + 1.2) * 0.07;
      }

      // Ally & Opponent Ally Idle Movement in 2v2
      if (allyNode) {
        allyNode.group.position.lerp(allyNode.origPos, 0.1);
        allyNode.group.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 4.0 + 0.6) * 0.06;
        allyNode.auraRing.rotation.z += delta * 1.2;
      }

      if (oppAllyNode) {
        oppAllyNode.group.position.lerp(oppAllyNode.origPos, 0.1);
        oppAllyNode.group.position.y = Math.sin(elapsed * 4.0 + 1.8) * 0.06;
        oppAllyNode.auraRing.rotation.z -= delta * 1.2;
      }

      // Rotate ground aura rings
      playerNode.auraRing.rotation.z += delta * 1.5;
      opponentNode.auraRing.rotation.z -= delta * 1.5;

      // Keep Billboards and HP bars facing camera
      fighters.forEach((f) => {
        f.standeeMesh.lookAt(camera.position.x, f.standeeMesh.position.y, camera.position.z);
        const hpPlate = f.group.children[f.group.children.length - 2];
        if (hpPlate) hpPlate.lookAt(camera.position);
      });

      // Camera Tracking & Shake
      if (isShaking) {
        camera.position.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45;
        camera.position.y = 7.6 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.45;
      } else {
        camera.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.x, Math.sin(elapsed * 0.3) * 0.3, 0.05);
        camera.position.y = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(camera.position.y, 7.6, 0.05);
      }

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    };

    animate();

    const handleResize = () => {
      if (!container) return;
      const w = container.clientWidth;
      const h = container.clientHeight;
      camera.aspect = w / h;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(w, h);
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animId);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      renderer.domElement.removeEventListener('pointerdown', handlePointerDown);
      if (container && renderer.domElement) {
        container.removeChild(renderer.domElement);
      }
      renderer.dispose();
      floorGeo.dispose();
      floorMat.dispose();
      neonRingGeo.dispose();
      neonRingMat.dispose();
      innerRingGeo.dispose();
      innerRingMat.dispose();
      slashGeo.dispose();
      slashMat.dispose();
      shockwaveGeo.dispose();
      shockwaveMat.dispose();
      sparkGeo.dispose();
      sparkMat.dispose();
    };
  }, [is2v2, allyBeast, opponentAlly]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className="relative w-full h-full min-h-[290px] sm:min-h-[360px] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#080C14] cursor-crosshair select-none border border-white/10 shadow-2xl"
    />
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
