<source>src/components/game/TokenRefillModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  Coins,
  X,
  Sparkles,
  Zap,
  CheckCircle,
  ShieldCheck,
  TrendingUp,
  Award,
  Swords,
  Target,
  Compass,
  Gift,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../utils/confetti';
import { createDodoCheckout } from '../../services/dodo';
import { trackClarityEvent } from '../../utils/clarity';

interface TokenRefillModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenArena?: () => void;
  onOpenQuests?: () => void;
  onOpenRadar?: () => void;
}

interface TokenPack {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  coins: number;
  bonus: string;
  priceUsd: string;
  priceCents: number;
  badge?: string;
  popular?: boolean;
  iconBg: string;
}

const TOKEN_PACKS: TokenPack[] = [
  {
    id: 'pack_starter',
    name: 'Pouch of Coins',
    coins: 5000,
    bonus: '+500 Bonus',
    priceUsd: '$0.99',
    priceCents: 99,
    iconBg: 'from-amber-500/20 to-yellow-500/10',
  },
  {
    id: 'pack_champion',
    name: 'Chest of Coins',
    coins: 25000,
    bonus: '+5,000 Bonus (5x Value)',
    priceUsd: '$2.99',
    priceCents: 299,
    badge: 'MOST POPULAR',
    popular: true,
    iconBg: 'from-cyan-500/20 to-blue-500/10',
  },
  {
    id: 'pack_legend',
    name: 'Vault of Champions',
    coins: 100000,
    bonus: '+30,000 Bonus (20x Value)',
    priceUsd: '$7.99',
    priceCents: 799,
    badge: 'BEST VALUE',
    iconBg: 'from-emerald-500/20 to-[#CCFF00]/15',
  },
];

export const TokenRefillModal: React.FC<TokenRefillModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenArena,
  onOpenQuests,
  onOpenRadar,
}) => {
  const { credits, addCredits } = useGame();
  const [processingPackId, setProcessingPackId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [faucetClaimed, setFaucetClaimed] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
    const lastClaim = localStorage.getItem('petslam_faucet_last_claim');
    if (!lastClaim) return false;
    // Allow claim every 24 hours
    return Date.now() - parseInt(lastClaim, 10) < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  });
  const [purchaseToast, setPurchaseToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleClaimDailyFaucet = () => {
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerVictoryExplosion();
    addCredits(500);
    localStorage.setItem('petslam_faucet_last_claim', Date.now().toString());
    setFaucetClaimed(true);
    setPurchaseToast('🎉 +500 Free Daily Tokens Claimed!');
    trackClarityEvent('claim_daily_faucet');
    setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 4000);
  };

  const handlePurchasePack = async (pack: TokenPack) => {
    setProcessingPackId(pack.id);
    sound.playClick();
    trackClarityEvent('initiate_token_checkout');

    try {
      const checkoutResult = await createDodoCheckout({
        passType: 'credits_5000',
        returnUrl: `${window.location.origin}/?payment_success=true&pack=${pack.id}`,
      });

      if (checkoutResult && checkoutResult.checkoutUrl && !checkoutResult.simulated) {
        // Redirect to live Dodo Checkout page
        window.location.href = checkoutResult.checkoutUrl;
      } else {
        // Instant Sandbox / Local verification grant
        addCredits(pack.coins);
        sound.playVictory();
        triggerVictoryExplosion();
        setPurchaseToast(`🎉 +${pack.coins.toLocaleString()} Coins Added to your Balance!`);
        trackClarityEvent('token_pack_granted_sandbox');
        setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 4500);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Checkout fallback triggered:', err);
      // Fallback sandbox fulfillment
      addCredits(pack.coins);
      sound.playVictory();
      triggerVictoryExplosion();
      setPurchaseToast(`🎉 Sandbox Grant: +${pack.coins.toLocaleString()} Coins added!`);
      setTimeout(() => setPurchaseToast(null), 4500);
    } finally {
      setProcessingPackId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md select-none animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xl bg-slate-900 border border-white/20 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[92vh] text-white">
        {/* Toast */}
        {purchaseToast && (
          <div className="absolute top-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 animate-in slide-in-from-top-3 duration-200 pointer-events-none">
            <div className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 text-white font-mono font-black text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-xl border border-white/40 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span>{purchaseToast}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 border-b border-white/10 bg-slate-950/80 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-yellow-400 p-0.5 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)] flex items-center justify-center">
              <div className="w-full h-full bg-slate-950 rounded-[14px] flex items-center justify-center">
                <Coins className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-400" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>Slam Tokens Hub</span>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                  Instant Refill
                </span>
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-mono">
                Current Balance:{' '}
                <span className="text-amber-400 font-black">{credits.toLocaleString()} Coins</span>
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="p-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Close"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Body Content */}
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5 overflow-y-auto space-y-5 scrollbar-thin">
          {/* Daily Free Faucet Banner */}
          <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/15 via-yellow-500/10 to-transparent border border-amber-500/30 p-3.5 sm:p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 border border-amber-500/40 flex items-center justify-center text-amber-400 shrink-0">
                <Gift className="w-5 h-5" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-display font-bold uppercase text-white flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <span>Daily Free Faucet</span>
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-sm">
                    FREE
                  </span>
                </h4>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-300 font-mono">
                  Claim +500 free Slam Coins every 24 hours to keep your companion energized.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              onClick={handleClaimDailyFaucet}
              disabled={faucetClaimed}
              className={`px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-black uppercase transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-md ${
                faucetClaimed
                  ? 'bg-slate-800 text-slate-500 border border-slate-700 cursor-not-allowed'
                  : 'bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)]'
              }`}
            >
              {faucetClaimed ? 'Claimed Today ✓' : 'Claim +500 🪙'}
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Dodo Payments Instant Token Bundles */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <h4 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <TrendingUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>Instant Token Packs (Dodo Payments)</span>
              </h4>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                <span>256-Bit SSL Encrypted</span>
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
              {TOKEN_PACKS.map((pack) => {
                const isProcessing = processingPackId === pack.id;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={pack.id}
                    className={`relative rounded-2xl border p-3.5 flex flex-col justify-between transition-all bg-slate-950/60 ${
                      pack.popular
                        ? 'border-cyan-400/60 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.2)]'
                        : 'border-white/10 hover:border-white/20'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {pack.badge && (
                      <span className="absolute -top-2.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-500 text-black font-mono font-black text-[9px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider shadow">
                        {pack.badge}
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <div className="space-y-1 mb-3">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                        <Coins className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400 shrink-0" />
                        <span className="font-display font-black text-sm text-white truncate">
                          {pack.coins.toLocaleString()}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-300">
                        {pack.name}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-emerald-400">
                        {pack.bonus}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      onClick={() => handlePurchasePack(pack)}
                      disabled={isProcessing}
                      className={`w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-black uppercase transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md ${
                        pack.popular
                          ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black active:scale-95'
                          : 'bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white active:scale-95'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isProcessing ? (
                        <span className="animate-pulse">Processing...</span>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <span>Buy {pack.priceUsd}</span>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* In-Game Free Ways to Earn Tokens */}
          <div className="space-y-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-white/10">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Award className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
              <span>How to Earn Free Tokens In-Game</span>
            </h4>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  onClose();
                  onOpenArena?.();
                }}
                className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/50 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2.5"
              >
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-red-500/15 text-red-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Swords className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>PvP Arena Wins</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">+1,800 - 2,600 🪙</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                    Battle trainer opponents in live combat
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  onClose();
                  onOpenQuests?.();
                }}
                className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/50 border border-white/10 hover:border-cyan-400/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2.5"
              >
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Target className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Daily Directives</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">+3,000 - 12,000 🪙</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                    Complete 3 daily trainer mission quests
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  onClose();
                  onOpenRadar?.();
                }}
                className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/50 border border-white/10 hover:border-emerald-400/40 transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2.5"
              >
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Compass className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>World Map Catches</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">+450 🪙 / catch</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                    Track & capture wild purebreds on GPS radar
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-950/50 border border-white/10 flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-purple-500/15 text-purple-400 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                  <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="font-bold text-white text-[11px] flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span>Buddy Interactions</span>
                    <span className="text-amber-400 font-mono">+35 - 50 🪙</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 truncate">
                    Feed berries and play catch with your screen companion
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-slate-950/90 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] text-slate-400 font-mono shrink-0">
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-ping" />
            <span>Secure Dodo Payments Integration</span>
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-bold cursor-pointer"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

<source>src/components/game/VersusMatchupScreen.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Swords, Zap, Shield, Flame, Trophy, AlertTriangle, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Animal } from '../../data/animals';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface VersusMatchupScreenProps {
  playerBeast: Animal;
  playerStats: {
    strength: number;
    speed: number;
    endurance: number;
    agility: number;
    biteForce: number;
    armor: number;
  };
  opponent: Animal;
  isRanked: boolean;
  onFightStart: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export const VersusMatchupScreen: React.FC<VersusMatchupScreenProps> = ({
  playerBeast,
  playerStats,
  opponent,
  isRanked,
  onFightStart,
  onCancel,
}) => {
  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState<number>(3);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    sound.playClick();
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCountdown((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 1) {
          clearInterval(interval);
          setReady(true);
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 900);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[#06070A] text-white flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden select-none animate-fadeIn">
      {/* Background Volumetric Clash Lighting */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-[400px] h-[400px] bg-[#CCFF00]/15 blur-[120px] rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 right-1/4 w-[400px] h-[400px] bg-red-600/15 blur-[120px] rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(#ffffff0a_1px,transparent_1px)] [background-size:20px_20px] opacity-40" />
      </div>

      {/* Top Banner */}
      <div className="relative z-20 px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Trophy className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
          <span className="font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
            {isRanked ? 'Ranked Championship Clash (+45 MMR)' : 'Casual Arena Sparring'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400 hover:text-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer"
        >
          Retreat to Staging
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* Center Matchup Stage */}
      <div className="relative z-20 flex-1 flex flex-col justify-around px-4 py-2 max-w-lg mx-auto w-full">
        {/* Player Beast Card (Top / Left in portrait) */}
        <div className="relative bg-gradient-to-r from-[#121620] to-[#0A0D14] border-2 border-[#CCFF00]/60 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.15)] flex items-center justify-between transform transition-all duration-500 translate-x-0 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="relative w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-lg shrink-0">
              <img
                src={playerBeast.image}
                alt={playerBeast.name}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover scale-105"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.src = playerBeast.fallbackImage || playerBeast.image;
                }}
              />
              <div className="absolute top-1 left-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded shadow">
                You
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-[#CCFF00] font-bold tracking-wider">
                L{playerBeast.level} · {playerBeast.combatArchetype}
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl uppercase tracking-tight text-white">
                {playerBeast.name}
              </h2>
              <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                {playerBeast.species}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2 text-[10px] font-mono">
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-neutral-300">
                  PWR {playerStats.strength}
                </span>
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-cyan-300">
                  SPD {playerStats.speed}
                </span>
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-[#CCFF00]">
                  {playerStats.biteForce} PSI
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Dynamic Animated VS Emblem */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center justify-center my-3">
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00]/40 via-red-500/40 to-transparent" />
          <div className="relative z-10 w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-neutral-900 to-black border-2 border-white/20 shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.4)] flex items-center justify-center font-display font-black text-xl italic tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] scale-110 animate-bounce">
            VS
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Challenger Card (Bottom / Right) */}
        <div className="relative bg-gradient-to-l from-[#201216] to-[#0D0A0C] border-2 border-red-500/60 rounded-3xl p-4 shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(239,68,68,0.15)] flex items-center justify-between flex-row-reverse transform transition-all duration-500 animate-fadeIn">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 flex-row-reverse">
            <div className="relative w-20 h-20 sm:w-24 sm:h-24 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-red-500 shadow-lg shrink-0">
              <img
                src={opponent.image}
                alt={opponent.name}
                className="w-full h-full object-cover scale-105"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.currentTarget.src = opponent.fallbackImage || opponent.image;
                }}
              />
              <div className="absolute top-1 right-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-red-600 text-white text-[9px] font-black uppercase rounded shadow">
                Rival
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase text-red-400 font-bold tracking-wider">
                L{opponent.level} · {opponent.combatArchetype}
              </div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl uppercase tracking-tight text-white">
                {opponent.name}
              </h2>
              <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                {opponent.species}
              </div>

              <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2 justify-end text-[10px] font-mono">
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-neutral-300">
                  PWR {opponent.strength}
                </span>
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-cyan-300">
                  SPD {opponent.speed}
                </span>
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-white/5 text-red-400">
                  {opponent.biteForce || Math.round(opponent.strength * 3.5)} PSI
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom Fight Trigger with Countdown */}
      <div className="relative z-20 p-4 border-t border-white/10 bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center">
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playHeavyHit();
            onFightStart();
          }}
          className="w-full max-w-sm py-4 px-6 rounded-2xl font-display font-black text-base uppercase tracking-wider text-black bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
        >
          <Swords className="w-5 h-5 fill-black" />
          <span>
            {countdown > 0 ? `START CLASH IN ${countdown}...` : 'FIGHT! ENTER RING'}
          </span>
          <ArrowRight className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/game/VipPassesModal.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  X,
  Sparkles,
  Shield,
  Check,
  Flame,
  Award,
  Crown,
  Coins,
  CreditCard,
  Gavel,
  Camera,
  Tv,
  Zap,
  BatteryCharging,
  ArrowRight,
  CheckCircle2,
  ExternalLink,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { createDodoCheckout } from '../../services/dodo';
import { trackClarityEvent } from '../../utils/clarity';

interface VipPassesModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  defaultPass?: 'extension' | 'avatar' | 'bundle';
}

export const VipPassesModal: React.FC<VipPassesModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  defaultPass = 'extension',
}) => {
  const {
    credits,
    hasAuctionPass,
    hasAvatarStudioPass,
    hasExtensionPass,
    unlockPass,
  } = useGame();

  const [paymentMethod, setPaymentMethod] = useState<'usd' | 'credits'>('usd');
  const [selectedPass, setSelectedPass] = useState<'extension' | 'avatar' | 'bundle'>(defaultPass);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [successToast, setSuccessToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const passes = [
    {
      id: 'extension' as const,
      title: 'Desktop & Browser Companion License',
      priceUsd: '$2.99',
      creditsCost: 1500,
      icon: Tv,
      color: 'lime',
      accentBorder: 'border-[#CCFF00]',
      badge: 'Software Utility',
      isOwned: hasExtensionPass,
      features: [
        'Screen-roaming companion on bottom & sidebars',
        'Laptop battery & charging detector alerts ⚡',
        'Posture, hydration & 20-20-20 screen reminders 💧',
        'Natural pet voice mimic & poke interactions',
        'Full Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) ZIP download',
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 'avatar' as const,
      title: 'AI Pet Photo Studio Scanner Pass',
      priceUsd: '$0.99',
      creditsCost: 1000,
      icon: Camera,
      color: 'cyan',
      accentBorder: 'border-cyan-400',
      badge: 'Generative AI Tool',
      isOwned: hasAvatarStudioPass,
      features: [
        'Turn your real dog or cat photo into a 2D avatar',
        'Extract coat colors, ears, and personality traits',
        'Deploy your real pet directly into the Battle Arena',
        'Custom signature move & battle stats generator',
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 'bundle' as const,
      title: 'Genesis Founder Supporter Pack',
      priceUsd: '$4.99',
      creditsCost: 4000,
      icon: Crown,
      color: 'fuchsia',
      accentBorder: 'border-fuchsia-400',
      badge: 'Best Value · Supporter',
      isOwned: hasExtensionPass && hasAvatarStudioPass,
      features: [
        'Instant unlock for Browser Extension Lifetime ($2.99 value)',
        'Instant unlock for Custom Avatar Pass ($0.99 value)',
        'Exclusive Genesis Gold profile card & arena theme',
        '+5,000 Bonus In-Game Slam Credits',
        '100% Fair Play: Cosmetic flair only, 0% stat advantage',
      ],
    },
  ];

  const handlePurchase = async (passId: 'extension' | 'avatar' | 'bundle') => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    sound.playClick();
    trackClarityEvent(`pass_unlock_attempt_${passId}_${paymentMethod}`);

    if (paymentMethod === 'usd') {
      try {
        const checkout = await createDodoCheckout({ passType: passId });
        setIsProcessing(false);

        if (checkout.simulated) {
          // In test/sandbox simulation mode, immediately fulfill pass
          const res = unlockPass(passId, false);
          sound.playVictory();
          setSuccessToast(`[Dodo Sandbox] ${res.message}`);
          trackClarityEvent(`dodo_checkout_simulated_success_${passId}`);
          setTimeout(() => setSuccessToast(null), 3500);
        } else if (checkout.checkoutUrl) {
          // In official live/test mode, redirect to Dodo Payments hosted checkout
          trackClarityEvent(`dodo_redirect_hosted_${passId}`);
          window.location.href = checkout.checkoutUrl;
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        setIsProcessing(false);
        sound.playClick();
        alert(err?.message || 'Failed to connect to Dodo Payments checkout.');
      }
      return;
    }

    // Credits Flow
    setTimeout(() => {
      const res = unlockPass(passId, true);
      setIsProcessing(false);

      if (res.success) {
        sound.playVictory();
        setSuccessToast(res.message);
        trackClarityEvent(`credits_pass_unlocked_${passId}`);
        setTimeout(() => {
          setSuccessToast(null);
        }, 3000);
      } else {
        sound.playClick();
        alert(res.message);
      }
    }, 500);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-4 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-fadeIn select-none">
      <div className="w-full max-w-lg bg-[#0E121C] border border-white/15 rounded-3xl p-4 sm:p-6 shadow-2xl relative max-h-[92vh] overflow-y-auto text-white">
        {/* Close Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onClose}
          className="absolute top-4 right-4 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white p-2 rounded-xl bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
        >
          <X className="w-5 h-5" />
        </button>

        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[#CCFF00] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1">
          <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
          <span>VIP Licenses & Upgrades</span>
        </div>

        <h2 className="font-display font-black text-2xl uppercase tracking-tight text-white">
          Software & AI Passes
        </h2>
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
          Upgrade your experience with the Chrome companion extension, generative AI pet photo scans, and exclusive cosmetic supporter flair.
        </p>

        {/* 100% Fair Play Non-Wagering Badge */}
        <div className="mt-3 p-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-emerald-300">
          <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400 shrink-0" />
          <span><strong>Fair-Play Pledge:</strong> 100% non-wagering. No real-money auctions. Zero pay-to-win stat advantages.</span>
        </div>

        {/* Currency Switcher: USD or Credits */}
        <div className="mt-4 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-[#141A28] border border-white/10 grid grid-cols-2 gap-1">
          <button
            onClick={() => setPaymentMethod('usd')}
            className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              paymentMethod === 'usd'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-400 text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <CreditCard className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Direct Payment (USD)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => setPaymentMethod('credits')}
            className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              paymentMethod === 'credits'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-600 text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Coins className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>Pay with Credits ({credits.toLocaleString()})</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Pass Cards */}
        <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
          {passes.map((pass) => {
            const Icon = pass.icon;
            const isSelected = selectedPass === pass.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={pass.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedPass(pass.id)}
                className={`p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all cursor-pointer relative ${
                  pass.isOwned
                    ? 'bg-[#101724]/60 border-emerald-500/40 opacity-85'
                    : isSelected
                    ? `bg-[#161F32] ${pass.accentBorder} ring-2 ring-white/20 shadow-lg`
                    : 'bg-[#121824] border-white/10 hover:border-white/25'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                    <div
                      className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                        pass.color === 'amber'
                          ? 'bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-400'
                          : pass.color === 'cyan'
                          ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-400'
                          : pass.color === 'lime'
                          ? 'bg-[#CCFF00]/20 text-[#CCFF00]'
                          : 'bg-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-400'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <h3 className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-white tracking-wide">
                          {pass.title}
                        </h3>
                        <span
                          className={`text-[9px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full uppercase ${
                            pass.color === 'fuchsia'
                              ? 'bg-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-300 border border-fuchsia-500/30'
                              : 'bg-white/10 text-neutral-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {pass.badge}
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
                        <span className="text-base font-display font-black text-white">
                          {paymentMethod === 'usd' ? pass.priceUsd : `${pass.creditsCost.toLocaleString()} Credits`}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-mono">
                          {paymentMethod === 'usd' ? `or ${pass.creditsCost.toLocaleString()} Credits` : `(${pass.priceUsd})`}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {pass.isOwned ? (
                    <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-black flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      <span>UNLOCKED</span>
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      disabled={isProcessing}
                      onClick={(e) => {
                        e.stopPropagation();
                        handlePurchase(pass.id);
                      }}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wide shadow-md transition-all shrink-0 cursor-pointer ${
                        pass.color === 'fuchsia'
                          ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500 to-pink-500 hover:brightness-110 text-white'
                          : 'bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {isProcessing ? 'Unlocking...' : 'Unlock Now'}
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Features List */}
                <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-1 text-[11px] text-neutral-300 font-sans">
                  {pass.features.map((feat, i) => (
                    <div key={i} className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{feat}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Success Alert */}
        {successToast && (
          <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/40 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-mono font-bold flex items-center gap-2 animate-fadeIn">
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0 text-emerald-400" />
            <span>{successToast}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/10 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 gap-1.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse"></span>
            <span>Powered by <strong className="text-white">Dodo Payments</strong> (MoR)</span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">Cards · Apple Pay · Google Pay · Instant Fulfillment</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

function CrownIcon({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <svg className={className} viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
      <path d="M2 4l3 12h14l3-12-6 7-4-7-4 7-6-7zm3 16h14" />
    </svg>
  );
}

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Mic, MicOff, Volume2, VolumeX, Radio, Sparkles, Send } from 'lucide-react';
import { voiceChat, VoiceChatState } from '../../utils/voiceChat';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface VoiceChatBarProps {
  onTacticalCallout?: (callout: string, reply: string) => void;
}

export const VoiceChatBar: React.FC<VoiceChatBarProps> = ({ onTacticalCallout }) => {
  const [vcState, setVcState] = useState<VoiceChatState>({
    isMicActive: false,
    isMuted: false,
    volumeLevel: 0,
    isSpeaking: false,
    isTeammateSpeaking: false,
    lastTeammateMessage: 'Radio connected. Awaiting tactical orders.',
    teammateVolume: 0.85,
    error: null,
  });

  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsub = voiceChat.subscribe((s) => setVcState(s));
    return () => unsub();
  }, []);

  const handleToggleMic = async () => {
    sound.playClick();
    if (!vcState.isMicActive) {
      await voiceChat.enableMicrophone();
    } else {
      voiceChat.toggleMute();
    }
  };

  const handleQuickRadio = (callout: string, reply: string) => {
    sound.playClick();
    voiceChat.speakTeammate(reply);
    if (onTacticalCallout) {
      onTacticalCallout(callout, reply);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="w-full bg-[#0F1420]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-cyan-500/30 px-3 py-2 flex flex-col gap-1.5 z-30 select-none shadow-lg">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        {/* Left: Real Mic Toggle & Equalizer Waveform */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleToggleMic}
            className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-sm ${
              !vcState.isMicActive
                ? 'bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-300 border border-cyan-400/50 hover:bg-cyan-500/30'
                : vcState.isMuted
                ? 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border border-red-500/50'
                : 'bg-emerald-500 text-black border border-emerald-300 shadow-[0_0_12px_#10B981]'
            }`}
            title="Toggle Live Microphone"
          >
            {vcState.isMuted || !vcState.isMicActive ? (
              <MicOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            ) : (
              <Mic className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse" />
            )}
            <span>
              {!vcState.isMicActive
                ? 'JOIN VOICE'
                : vcState.isMuted
                ? 'MUTED'
                : 'MIC ACTIVE'}
            </span>
          </button>

          {/* Real Audio Meter (Bounces according to actual mic volume) */}
          {vcState.isMicActive && !vcState.isMuted && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 h-3.5 px-1 bg-black/40 rounded-md border border-emerald-500/30">
              {[15, 30, 45, 60, 75, 90].map((threshold, idx) => (
                <span
                  key={idx}
                  className={`w-1 rounded-full transition-all duration-75 ${
                    vcState.volumeLevel >= threshold
                      ? 'h-3 bg-emerald-400 shadow-[0_0_4px_#10B981]'
                      : 'h-1 bg-neutral-700'
                  }`}
                />
              ))}
              <span className="text-[9px] font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 ml-1">
                {vcState.isSpeaking ? 'SPEAKING' : 'IDLE'}
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Center/Right: Teammate Status & Audio Toggle */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <span className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${vcState.isTeammateSpeaking ? 'bg-cyan-400 animate-ping' : 'bg-emerald-500'}`} />
            <span className="text-[11px] font-display font-bold uppercase text-neutral-300 hidden sm:inline">
              Devon (Teammate)
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => setExpanded(!expanded)}
            className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 border border-white/10 text-[10px] font-mono text-cyan-300 font-bold cursor-pointer"
          >
            {expanded ? 'HIDE RADIO' : 'RADIO TACTICS'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Teammate Audible Transmission Bubble */}
      {vcState.lastTeammateMessage && (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-black/50 border border-cyan-500/20 text-[11px] font-mono">
          <Radio className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 text-cyan-400 shrink-0 ${vcState.isTeammateSpeaking ? 'animate-bounce' : ''}`} />
          <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold shrink-0">Devon:</span>
          <span className="text-neutral-200 truncate">{vcState.lastTeammateMessage}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Expanded Tactical Radio Callouts */}
      {expanded && (
        <div className="pt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 border-t border-white/5 mt-0.5 animate-fadeIn">
          <button
            onClick={() => handleQuickRadio('Focus Leader!', 'Roger! Focusing Leader now with high-impact attacks!')}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-950/80 hover:bg-cyan-900 border border-cyan-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            🎯 Focus Leader
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => handleQuickRadio('Focus Partner!', 'Switching to Partner beast! Lock them down!')}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-cyan-950/80 hover:bg-cyan-900 border border-cyan-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-cyan-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            🎯 Focus Partner
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => handleQuickRadio('Shield Up, Guarding!', 'Shielding you! Hold position while I strike!')}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-amber-950/80 hover:bg-amber-900 border border-amber-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-amber-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            🛡️ Guard & Counter
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => handleQuickRadio('Push Together!', 'All in! Launching our beast combo right now!')}
            className="px-2 py-1 rounded-lg bg-purple-950/80 hover:bg-purple-900 border border-purple-500/40 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-purple-300 cursor-pointer"
          >
            💥 Push Together
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

import React from 'react';

interface HeroProps {

}

export const Hero: React.FC<HeroProps> = ({ onJoinWaitlist, onExploreGame }) => {

              <button

              >
                <span>Join The Waitlist</span>

              <button
                onClick={onExploreGame}

              >
                <span>Explore The Game</span>
                <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Clean Proof Bar - No Pills */}
            <div className="mt-12 pt-8 border-t border-white/10 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-6 text-xs text-neutral-400">
              <div>
                <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-black text-white">100% REAL</span>
                <span className="text-neutral-400">Species Biology</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-black text-white">SKILL-BASED</span>
                <span className="text-neutral-400">No Pay-To-Win</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-black text-white">SANCTIONED</span>
                <span className="text-neutral-400">Global PvP Circuit</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="block font-display text-2xl font-black text-white">AUCTIONS</span>
                <span className="text-neutral-400">Player Economy</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right Column: Dramatic Cinematic Real Beast Visual */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-5 relative">
            <div className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-none border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] shadow-2xl group">

              </div>

              {/* Beast Card Overlay Details */}
              <div className="p-6 bg-[#14161E] border-t border-white/5">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-display text-xl font-bold uppercase text-white tracking-wide">
                      Apex Predators · Arena Division
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mt-0.5">
                      Bengal Tiger (Khan) · Grey Wolf (Fenrir)
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right">
                    <span className="font-display text-lg font-black text-[#CCFF00]">TIER I</span>
                    <span className="block text-[11px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider">Alpha Registry</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-white/5 text-center text-xs">
                  <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Strength</span>
                    <span className="font-display font-bold text-white text-base">98/100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Speed</span>
                    <span className="font-display font-bold text-white text-base">92/100</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-black/40 py-2 border border-white/5">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">Endurance</span>
                    <span className="font-display font-bold text-white text-base">96/100</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Corner Decorative Esports Mark */}
            <div className="absolute -bottom-4 -left-4 hidden sm:flex items-center gap-3 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 bg-[#0B0C10] px-4 py-2.5 shadow-xl">
              <Zap className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
              <span className="font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white">
                Championship Ranked Season 01
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Compass, Layers, Dumbbell, Swords } from 'lucide-react';

export const HowItWorks: React.FC = () => {
  const steps = [
    {
      num: '01',
      title: 'Choose Your Animal',
      icon: Compass,
      description:
        'Explore an authentic global roster across domestic and wildlife species—from elite working dogs like German Shepherds and Rottweilers to raw apex predators like lions, tigers, and wolves. Every species carries genuine anatomical strengths, instinctive behaviors, and distinct attribute baselines.',
      highlight: 'Diverse real-world biological archetypes',
    },
    {
      num: '02',
      title: 'Build Your Collection',
      icon: Layers,
      description:
        'Acquire high-potential animals through direct marketplace sales or bid in competitive weekly live player auctions. Expand your personal stable, cross-specialize across combat weight classes, and secure rare generational bloodlines.',
      highlight: 'Player-to-player verified ownership',
    },
    {
      num: '03',
      title: 'Train And Upgrade',
      icon: Dumbbell,
      description:
        'Condition your animals with nutritional feeding schedules, physical stamina drills, agility courses, and tactical discipline training. Level up core stats—strength, reflex velocity, and endurance—while unlocking battle maneuvers without pay-to-win stat skewing.',
      highlight: 'Merit-driven progression mechanics',
    },
    {
      num: '04',
      title: 'Enter The Arena',
      icon: Swords,
      description:
        'Deploy your beast into competitive ranked matchmaking. Challenge global players in sanctioned bouts where tactical stance selection, training depth, and attribute synergy decide the victor. Win bouts, collect seasonal bounties, and climb the global leaderboard.',
      highlight: 'Pure esports competitive glory',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <section id="how-it-works" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0F1015] py-20 lg:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Header */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
            Core Ecosystem Loop
          </div>
          <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
            HOW PET SLAM WORKS
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-400">
            A comprehensive competitive cycle designed for serious collectors and esports competitors.
            Four defined stages transform wild potential into championship legacy.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Steps Grid */}
        <div className="mt-16 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {steps.map((step) => {
            const IconComponent = step.icon;
            return (
              <div
                key={step.num}
                className="group relative flex flex-col justify-between border border-white/10 bg-[#14161E] p-8 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#CCFF00]/40 hover:bg-[#181B26]"
              >
                <div>
                  {/* Step Top Bar: Editorial Index & Icon */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-6">
                    <span className="font-display text-3xl font-black text-[#CCFF00]/90">
                      {step.num}
                    </span>
                    <div className="p-2.5 bg-white/5 text-[#CCFF00] border border-white/10 group-hover:bg-[#CCFF00] group-hover:text-black transition-colors">
                      <IconComponent className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Title & Description */}
                  <h3 className="mt-6 font-display text-2xl font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                    {step.title}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
                    {step.description}
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Bottom Highlight */}
                <div className="mt-8 pt-4 border-t border-white/5">
                  <span className="text-xs font-medium text-neutral-400">
                    {step.highlight}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Radio, ShieldAlert, MapPin, Users, Send, Check, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';

interface NearbyTrainer {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  distance: string;
  animalName: string;
  species: string;
  level: number;
  strength: number;
  status: 'Ready for Bout' | 'Sparring' | 'Cooldown';
  avatarInitials: string;
}

export const IrlModeSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [selectedTrainer, setSelectedTrainer] = useState<NearbyTrainer | null>(null);
  const [challengeSent, setChallengeSent] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const nearbyTrainers: NearbyTrainer[] = [
    {
      id: 'nt_1',
      name: 'Jordan_K9',
      distance: '~180m away',
      animalName: 'Kaiser Jr',
      species: 'German Shepherd',
      level: 11,
      strength: 81,
      status: 'Ready for Bout',
      avatarInitials: 'JK',
    },
    {
      id: 'nt_2',
      name: 'Maya_Apex',
      distance: '~340m away',
      animalName: 'Simba',
      species: 'African Lion',
      level: 14,
      strength: 92,
      status: 'Ready for Bout',
      avatarInitials: 'MA',
    },
    {
      id: 'nt_3',
      name: 'Devon_Claw',
      distance: '~510m away',
      animalName: 'Brutus',
      species: 'Rottweiler',
      level: 9,
      strength: 77,
      status: 'Cooldown',
      avatarInitials: 'DC',
    },
  ];

  const handleSendChallenge = (trainer: NearbyTrainer) => {
    setSelectedTrainer(trainer);
    setChallengeSent(`Proximity battle challenge dispatched to ${trainer.name}! In full release, both players must confirm the mutual handshake before the arena match triggers.`);
  };

  const irlProtocols = [
    {
      step: '01',
      title: 'Explicit Opt-In Only',
      text: 'IRL Mode is completely disabled by default. Active discovery only broadcasts when you explicitly toggle it on.',
    },
    {
      step: '02',
      title: 'Fuzzy Proximity Radar',
      text: 'Exact GPS coordinates are never stored or displayed to rivals. Only general randomized perimeter bands are shown.',
    },
    {
      step: '03',
      title: 'Dual-Handshake Consent',
      text: 'No surprise skirmishes. Both trainers must independently accept the challenge ticket before combat commences.',
    },
    {
      step: '04',
      title: 'Stealth & Safety Zones',
      text: 'Instant one-tap stealth cloaking, customizable safety bubbles around schools/residences, and permanent player blocking.',
    },
  ];

  return (
    <section id="irl-mode" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0F1015] py-20 lg:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Heading */}
        <div className="max-w-3xl">
          {/* Prominent Roadmap Badge */}
          <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 bg-[#CCFF00]/10 px-3 py-1 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] mb-4">
            <Radio className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-pulse" />
            <span>Future Feature · Roadmap Preview</span>
          </div>

          <h2 className="font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
            THE ARENA DOESN'T END AT YOUR SCREEN.
          </h2>
          <p className="mt-4 text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-400">
            What if your next opponent was just around the corner?
            Inspired by location-based discovery mechanics, IRL MODE will allow PET SLAM players to discover other players nearby and challenge their animals in the physical world.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Interactive Mock Proximity Scanner */}
        <div className="mt-12 border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-10 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center">
            {/* Visual Radar Scope Mockup */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 bg-black/60 border border-white/10 overflow-hidden min-h-[380px]">
              {/* Radar Circles */}
              <div className="relative w-64 h-64 sm:w-72 sm:h-72 rounded-full border border-[#CCFF00]/20 flex items-center justify-center">
                <div className="w-48 h-48 rounded-full border border-[#CCFF00]/15 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <div className="w-32 h-32 rounded-full border border-[#CCFF00]/15 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full border border-[#CCFF00]/30 flex items-center justify-center bg-[#CCFF00]/5">
                      {/* Center User Marker */}
                      <div className="h-4 w-4 bg-[#CCFF00] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_15px_#CCFF00]" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Radar Sweep Effect */}
                <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full border-t border-[#CCFF00]/60 animate-spin [animation-duration:6s]" />

                {/* Simulated Target 1 */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleSendChallenge(nearbyTrainers[0])}
                  className="absolute top-10 right-12 p-1.5 bg-[#14161E] border border-[#CCFF00] text-xs hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer"
                  title="Jordan_K9 (German Shepherd)"
                >
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">180m</span>
                </button>

                {/* Simulated Target 2 */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleSendChallenge(nearbyTrainers[1])}
                  className="absolute bottom-12 right-16 p-1.5 bg-[#14161E] border border-white/40 text-xs hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer"
                  title="Maya_Apex (African Lion)"
                >
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-white font-bold">340m</span>
                </button>

                {/* Simulated Target 3 */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleSendChallenge(nearbyTrainers[2])}
                  className="absolute bottom-14 left-10 p-1.5 bg-[#14161E] border border-white/20 text-xs hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer"
                  title="Devon_Claw (Rottweiler)"
                >
                  <span className="font-mono text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-bold">510m</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Scope Footer Status */}
              <div className="mt-4 text-center">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider block">
                  Simulated Radius: 800m Zone
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00]">
                  3 Opponents Located in Approximate Vicinity
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right: Nearby Opponents List & Challenge Card */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-7 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-6">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-3">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-300">
                    Discovered Nearby Beast Challengers
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">
                    Proximity: Active
                  </span>
                </div>

                <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                  {nearbyTrainers.map((tr) => (
                    <div
                      key={tr.id}
                      className="border border-white/10 bg-[#161822] p-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 hover:border-white/25 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="h-10 w-10 bg-neutral-800 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center font-display font-bold text-white text-xs">
                          {tr.avatarInitials}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-display font-bold text-white text-base">
                              {tr.name}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#CCFF00]">
                              {tr.distance}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
                            {tr.animalName} ({tr.species}) · <span className="text-white font-mono font-medium">LVL {tr.level}</span> · <span className="text-neutral-400 font-mono">STR {tr.strength}</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSendChallenge(tr)}
                        disabled={tr.status === 'Cooldown'}
                        className={`inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-2 font-display text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                          tr.status === 'Cooldown'
                            ? 'bg-white/5 text-neutral-400 border border-white/5 cursor-not-allowed'
                            : 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black hover:bg-[#b8e600]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <Send className="h-3 w-3" />
                        <span>{tr.status === 'Cooldown' ? 'On Cooldown' : 'Send Challenge'}</span>
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>

                {challengeSent && (
                  <div className="mt-4 p-4 border border-[#CCFF00]/40 bg-[#CCFF00]/10 text-xs text-neutral-200 flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <span>{challengeSent}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Privacy Notice Box */}
              <div className="border border-white/10 bg-black/40 p-4 text-xs text-neutral-300">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-white font-bold mb-1">
                  <ShieldAlert className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                  <span>Privacy & Safety Safeguards (Future Protocol)</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
                  Zero raw GPS data exposure. All presence is hashed into approximate geo-fence cells. Features strict age-verification gating, parental boundary controls, and instant anonymous reporting.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 4 Architectural Safeguards Grid */}
          <div className="mt-10 pt-8 border-t border-white/10 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            {irlProtocols.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.step} className="p-4 bg-white/[0.02] border border-white/5">
                <span className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-[#CCFF00]">
                  {p.step}
                </span>
                <h4 className="mt-1 font-display text-base font-bold uppercase text-white">
                  {p.title}
                </h4>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  {p.text}
                </p>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/layout/DesktopNavRail.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import {
  Swords,
  Heart,
  Camera,
  Home,
  Tv,
  PawPrint,
  ShoppingBag,
  Users,
  Compass,
  Maximize2,
  Minimize2,
  Info,
  Dna,
  Crown,
  Target,
  Trophy,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../context/PetCompanionContext';

export type MainNavId =
  | 'arena'
  | 'sanctuary'
  | 'studio'
  | 'auctions'
  | 'extension'
  | 'beasts'
  | 'market'
  | 'multiplayer'
  | 'ranked'
  | 'genetics'
  | 'pass'
  | 'quests'
  | 'leaderboard'
  | 'radar';

interface DesktopNavRailProps {
  currentTab: MainNavId;
  onTabChange: (tab: MainNavId) => void;
  onOpenInfoDrawer: () => void;
  onOpenDiagnostics?: () => void;
  soundEnabled: boolean;
  onToggleSound: () => void;
  isFullscreen: boolean;
  onToggleFullscreen: () => void;
}

export const DesktopNavRail: React.FC<DesktopNavRailProps> = ({
  currentTab,
  onTabChange,
  onOpenInfoDrawer,
  isFullscreen,
  onToggleFullscreen,
}) => {
  const { isOverlayActive, toggleOverlay } = usePetCompanion();

  const navItems = [
    { id: 'arena' as const, label: 'Arena', icon: Swords },
    { id: 'ranked' as const, label: '1v1 Ranked', icon: Swords },
    { id: 'leaderboard' as const, label: 'Hall of Fame', icon: Trophy },
    { id: 'radar' as const, label: 'World Map', icon: Compass },
    { id: 'sanctuary' as const, label: 'Sanctuary', icon: Heart },
    { id: 'genetics' as const, label: 'Breeding Lab', icon: Dna },
    { id: 'pass' as const, label: 'Slam Pass', icon: Crown },
    { id: 'quests' as const, label: 'Daily Quests', icon: Target },
    { id: 'studio' as const, label: 'AI Studio', icon: Camera },
    { id: 'auctions' as const, label: 'Adoption', icon: Home },
    { id: 'extension' as const, label: 'Buddy Hub', icon: Tv },
    { id: 'beasts' as const, label: 'Squad Deck', icon: PawPrint },
    { id: 'market' as const, label: 'Armory Shop', icon: ShoppingBag },
    { id: 'multiplayer' as const, label: 'Multiplayer', icon: Users },
  ];

  const handleSelect = (id: MainNavId) => {
    sound.playClick();
    onTabChange(id);
  };

  return (
    <aside className="hidden lg:flex flex-col w-[88px] xl:w-[250px] h-full bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#090D17]/98 backdrop-blur-xl border-r border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 select-none z-30 shrink-0 transition-all duration-300 shadow-2xl">
      {/* Brand Header */}
      <div className="h-16 flex items-center justify-center xl:justify-start px-3 xl:px-5 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 gap-3 bg-slate-100/80 dark:bg-slate-950/60">
        <div className="relative w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#CCFF00] to-emerald-400 p-0.5 shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(204,255,0,0.45)] shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="w-full h-full bg-slate-900 rounded-[10px] flex items-center justify-center">
            <Swords className="w-5 h-5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="hidden xl:flex flex-col leading-none">
          <span className="font-display font-black text-xl tracking-wider text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase flex items-center gap-1.5 drop-shadow-xs">
            PET SLAM
            <span className="text-xs font-mono font-black bg-[#CCFF00] text-black px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm shadow-xs">2.0</span>
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">
            Command Center
          </span>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Primary Navigation Rail */}
      <nav className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto py-3.5 px-2 xl:px-3 space-y-1.5 scrollbar-thin">
        {navItems.map((item) => {
          const Icon = item.icon;
          const isActive = currentTab === item.id;

          return (
            <button
              key={item.id}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(item.id)}
              className={`w-full group relative flex items-center justify-center xl:justify-start gap-3 px-2.5 xl:px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 ${
                isActive
                  ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00]/25 via-[#CCFF00]/15 to-transparent text-slate-950 dark:text-white border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)]'
                  : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 border border-transparent'
              }`}
              title={item.label}
            >
              {/* Active neon spine indicator */}
              {isActive && (
                <div className="absolute left-0 top-2 bottom-2 w-1.5 bg-[#CCFF00] rounded-r-full shadow-[0_0_12px_#CCFF00]" />
              )}

              <div
                className={`p-2 rounded-xl transition-all duration-200 shrink-0 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-md'
                    : 'bg-slate-200/80 dark:bg-white/10 group-hover:bg-slate-300 dark:group-hover:bg-white/15 text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 group-hover:text-black dark:group-hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                <Icon className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>

              <span
                className={`hidden xl:inline text-sm font-display uppercase tracking-wider font-extrabold whitespace-nowrap ${
                  isActive ? 'text-slate-950 dark:text-white' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-100 group-hover:text-slate-950 dark:group-hover:text-white'
                }`}
              >
                {item.label}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </nav>

      {/* Bottom Utility Controls */}
      <div className="p-2.5 xl:p-3 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 space-y-1.5 bg-slate-50/95 dark:bg-[#070A12]/95">
        {/* Live Buddy Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playClick();
            toggleOverlay();
          }}
          className={`w-full flex items-center justify-center xl:justify-start gap-2.5 px-2.5 xl:px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all border ${
            isOverlayActive
              ? 'bg-cyan-100 dark:bg-cyan-950/90 border-2 border-cyan-500 dark:border-cyan-400 text-cyan-900 dark:text-cyan-200 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.4)]'
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/15'
          }`}
          title={isOverlayActive ? 'Companion Roaming Screen (Click to Dock)' : 'Summon Desktop Buddy on Screen'}
        >
          <span className="text-sm">🐾</span>
          <span className="hidden xl:inline text-xs font-black">
            {isOverlayActive ? 'Buddy Live 🟢' : 'Summon Buddy'}
          </span>
        </button>

        {/* Fullscreen Toggle */}
        <button
          onClick={onToggleFullscreen}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center xl:justify-start gap-2.5 px-2.5 xl:px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white/10 cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono font-semibold transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/10"
          title={isFullscreen ? 'Exit Fullscreen' : 'Fullscreen (F11)'}
        >
          {isFullscreen ? (
            <Minimize2 className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300" />
          ) : (
            <Maximize2 className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300" />
          )}
          <span className="hidden xl:inline text-xs font-medium">
            {isFullscreen ? 'Windowed' : 'Fullscreen'}
          </span>
        </button>

        {/* Showcase Drawer Button */}
        <button
          onClick={onOpenInfoDrawer}
          className="w-full flex items-center justify-center xl:justify-start gap-2.5 px-2.5 xl:px-3.5 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-900 dark:text-white cursor-pointer text-xs font-mono font-bold transition-all border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 shadow-xs"
          title="Project Specs & Info Drawer"
        >
          <Info className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00]" />
          <span className="hidden xl:inline text-xs font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            Specs & Guide
          </span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>
