<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import {
  Shield,
  Zap,
  Home,
  Tv,
  Sparkles,
  Crown,
  ChevronRight,
  TrendingUp,
  Flame,
  CheckCircle2,
  Lock,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { Animal } from '../../data/animals';
import { getPetPhoto } from '../../utils/petVisuals';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';

interface DesktopTelemetryDockProps {
  onOpenAuctions: () => void;
  onOpenBuddyHub: () => void;
  onOpenVipStore: () => void;
  onOpenStudio: () => void;
  onOpenRanked?: () => void;
  onOpenBreeding?: () => void;
  onOpenPass?: () => void;
  onOpenQuests?: () => void;
}

export const DesktopTelemetryDock: React.FC<DesktopTelemetryDockProps> = ({
  onOpenAuctions,
  onOpenBuddyHub,
  onOpenVipStore,
  onOpenStudio,
  onOpenRanked,
  onOpenBreeding,
  onOpenPass,
  onOpenQuests,
}) => {
  const {
    ownedBeasts,
    battleDeckIds,
    activeBeast,
    selectActiveBeast,
    hasAuctionPass,
    hasAvatarStudioPass,
    hasExtensionPass,
  } = useGame();

  const { isOverlayActive, toggleOverlay, pet } = usePetCompanion();

  // Active squad beasts resolved from deck IDs
  const battleDeck: Animal[] = battleDeckIds
    .map((id) => ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === id))
    .filter((b): b is Animal => Boolean(b));

  // Simulated live sanctuary adoption ticker
  const liveTickers = [
    { pet: 'Cyber Bengal Cat', bid: '1,850 CR', time: '2m left', rare: 'EPIC' },
    { pet: 'Apex Husky Alpha', bid: '2,500 CR', time: '5m left', rare: 'LEGENDARY' },
    { pet: 'Titan Rottweiler', bid: '950 CR', time: '12m left', rare: 'RARE' },
  ];

  return (
    <aside className="hidden xl:flex flex-col w-[320px] h-full bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#090D17]/98 backdrop-blur-xl border-l border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 select-none z-30 shrink-0 p-4 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto scrollbar-thin text-slate-900 dark:text-white shadow-2xl transition-colors duration-300">
      {/* Dock Header */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00] animate-pulse shadow-[0_0_8px_#CCFF00]" />
          <span className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
            Combat Telemetry
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300 font-black bg-emerald-500/15 border border-emerald-400/40 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow-xs">
          60 FPS LIVE
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* 1. Active Battle Deck (Squad Roster) */}
      <div className="bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#0E1424] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-md dark:shadow-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00]" />
            Active Squad Deck (4)
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">Tag-In Ready</span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
          {battleDeck.slice(0, 4).map((beast: Animal, idx: number) => {
            const isActive = activeBeast?.id === beast.id;
            const photo = getPetPhoto(beast);
            const cp = Math.round((beast.health || 800) * 0.8 + (beast.damage || 150) * 2.5);

            return (
              <button
                key={beast.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  sound.playClick();
                  selectActiveBeast(beast.id);
                }}
                className={`relative flex items-center gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl text-left border cursor-pointer transition-all duration-200 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-[#CCFF00]/30 to-transparent border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.3)]'
                    : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-white/30 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/10'
                }`}
              >
                <div className="relative w-9 h-9 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-black/60 shrink-0 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20">
                  <img src={photo} alt={beast.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                  {isActive && (
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[#CCFF00]/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                      <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div className="text-xs font-display font-black uppercase text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                    {beast.name}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00] font-black">
                    CP {cp}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <span className="absolute top-1 right-1 text-[9px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-bold">
                  #{idx + 1}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 2. Desktop Companion Sync Status */}
      <div className="bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#0E1424] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-md dark:shadow-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Tv className="w-4 h-4 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-400" />
            Companion Buddy Bridge
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={onOpenBuddyHub}
            className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-0.5"
          >
            Hub <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-white dark:bg-black/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 rounded-xl p-3">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-cyan-500/20 border border-cyan-400/50 text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
              <Tv className="w-4 h-4" />
            </div>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                {pet.name} ({pet.species})
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs font-mono text-cyan-600 dark:text-cyan-300 font-semibold">
                {isOverlayActive ? '🟢 Roaming Screen' : '⚪ Asleep in Kennel'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              toggleOverlay();
            }}
            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-mono font-black cursor-pointer transition-all ${
              isOverlayActive
                ? 'bg-cyan-500 dark:bg-cyan-400 text-black shadow-md'
                : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/15 text-slate-800 dark:text-white hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/25 border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20'
            }`}
          >
            {isOverlayActive ? 'Dock' : 'Summon'}
          </button>
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => {
            sound.playClick();
            toggleOverlay();
          }}
          className={`w-full mt-2.5 py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer border shadow-xs ${
            isOverlayActive
              ? 'bg-cyan-100 dark:bg-cyan-950/80 border-2 border-cyan-500 dark:border-cyan-400 text-cyan-950 dark:text-cyan-200 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]'
              : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10 border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-white/15'
          }`}
        >
          <span className="text-sm">🐾</span>
          <span>{isOverlayActive ? 'Buddy Roaming Active 🟢' : 'Preview Desktop Buddy on Screen'}</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 3. Sanctuary Pet Adoption Ticker */}
      <div className="bg-slate-100/90 dark:bg-[#0E1424] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/15 rounded-2xl p-3.5 shadow-md dark:shadow-lg">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2.5">
          <span className="text-xs font-mono font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Home className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500 dark:text-emerald-400" />
            Adoption Shelter Stream
          </span>
          <button
            onClick={onOpenAuctions}
            className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 hover:underline cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-0.5"
          >
            Enter <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          {liveTickers.map((item, idx) => (
            <div
              key={idx}
              className="flex items-center justify-between p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white dark:bg-black/60 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 text-xs font-mono"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-ping shrink-0" />
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate max-w-[120px]">{item.pet}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                <span className="text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-300 font-black">{item.bid}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">{item.time}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* LiveOps & Netcode Shortcuts */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenRanked}
          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-100/70 dark:bg-cyan-950/60 border border-cyan-400/50 hover:border-cyan-400 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95 group"
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400 font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>NETCODE</span>
            <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-400 animate-ping" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase mt-0.5 group-hover:text-cyan-600 dark:group-hover:text-cyan-200">
            1v1 Ranked
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400">±150 CP Match</div>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={onOpenBreeding}
          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-fuchsia-100/70 dark:bg-fuchsia-950/60 border border-fuchsia-400/50 hover:border-fuchsia-400 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95 group"
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-fuchsia-700 dark:text-fuchsia-400 font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>GENETICS</span>
            <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 text-fuchsia-500 dark:text-fuchsia-300" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase mt-0.5 group-hover:text-fuchsia-600 dark:group-hover:text-fuchsia-200">
            Breeding Lab
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400">5% Mutant Roll</div>
        </button>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenPass}
          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-100/70 dark:bg-amber-950/60 border border-amber-400/50 hover:border-amber-400 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95 group"
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400 font-bold">50 TIERS</div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase mt-0.5 group-hover:text-amber-600 dark:group-hover:text-amber-200">
            Slam Pass
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400">Season 1 Live</div>
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={onOpenQuests}
          className="p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-lime-100/70 dark:bg-lime-950/60 border border-lime-400/50 hover:border-lime-400 text-left transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-xs active:scale-95 group"
        >
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-lime-700 dark:text-lime-400 font-bold">3 ACTIVE</div>
          <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase mt-0.5 group-hover:text-lime-600 dark:group-hover:text-lime-200">
            Daily Quests
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400">XP & Credits</div>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 4. VIP Genesis Store Promotion */}
      <div className="mt-auto pt-2">
        <button
          onClick={onOpenVipStore}
          className="w-full relative overflow-hidden group p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-500/15 via-pink-500/15 to-purple-500/15 dark:from-fuchsia-600/30 dark:via-pink-600/30 dark:to-purple-600/30 border-2 border-fuchsia-400/60 hover:border-fuchsia-500 cursor-pointer shadow-lg transition-all"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-fuchsia-500 text-white shadow-sm">
                <Crown className="w-4 h-4" />
              </div>
              <div className="text-left">
                <div className="font-display font-black text-sm uppercase text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wider flex items-center gap-1">
                  Genesis VIP Passes
                  <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-lime-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00]" />
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-200 font-medium">
                  Dodo Payments · Cards & Apple Pay
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-fuchsia-600 dark:text-fuchsia-300 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform" />
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>
    </aside>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/layout/DualOrientationShell.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';
import { usePetCompanion } from '../../context/PetCompanionContext';
import { GameTopBar } from '../game/GameTopBar';
import { DesktopNavRail, MainNavId } from './DesktopNavRail';
import { DesktopTelemetryDock } from './DesktopTelemetryDock';
import { MobileBottomDock } from './MobileBottomDock';
import { HeroLandingDrawer } from './HeroLandingDrawer';
import { FloatingPetOverlay } from '../game/pet/FloatingPetOverlay';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../utils/confetti';

// Screens & Modals
import { ArenaScreen } from '../game/screens/ArenaScreen';
import { PetSanctuaryScreen } from '../game/screens/PetSanctuaryScreen';
import { BeastsScreen } from '../game/screens/BeastsScreen';
import { MarketScreen } from '../game/screens/MarketScreen';
import { ProfileScreen } from '../game/screens/ProfileScreen';
import { PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal } from '../game/pet/PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal';
import { PetAuctionHouseModal } from '../game/pet/PetAuctionHouseModal';
import { ExtensionExporterModal } from '../game/pet/ExtensionExporterModal';
import { FriendsHubModal } from '../game/FriendsHubModal';
import { VipPassesModal } from '../game/VipPassesModal';
import { SystemDiagnosticsModal } from '../diagnostic/SystemDiagnosticsModal';
import { RankedMatchmakingModal } from '../game/RankedMatchmakingModal';
import { BreedingLabModal } from '../game/pet/BreedingLabModal';
import { SlamBattlePassModal } from '../game/liveops/SlamBattlePassModal';
import { DailyQuestsDrawer } from '../game/liveops/DailyQuestsDrawer';
import { LeaderboardModal } from '../Leaderboards/LeaderboardModal';
import { PetWorldMapView } from '../game/pet/PetWorldMapView';
import { RotateCw, Smartphone, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';

interface DualOrientationShellProps {
  onReturnToTitle?: () => void;
  onOpenSystemDetails?: () => void;
}

export const DualOrientationShell: React.FC<DualOrientationShellProps> = ({
  onReturnToTitle,
  onOpenSystemDetails,
}) => {
  const { soundEnabled, toggleSound, addCredits } = useGame();
  const { pet } = usePetCompanion();

  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<MainNavId>('arena');
  const [showInfoDrawer, setShowInfoDrawer] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [showVipStore, setShowVipStore] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [companionToast, setCompanionToast] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Dedicated Modal States
  const [studioModalOpen, setStudioModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [auctionsModalOpen, setAuctionsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [buddyModalOpen, setBuddyModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [friendsModalOpen, setFriendsModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [rankedModalOpen, setRankedModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [breedingModalOpen, setBreedingModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [passModalOpen, setPassModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [questsDrawerOpen, setQuestsDrawerOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [leaderboardModalOpen, setLeaderboardModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [radarModalOpen, setRadarModalOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Fullscreen State
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isDiagnosticsOpen, setIsDiagnosticsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Admin query param and Global Hotkey Listener (Ctrl + Shift + D / Cmd + Shift + D)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.search.includes('admin=true')) {
      setIsDiagnosticsOpen(true);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'D' || e.key === 'd')) {
        e.preventDefault();
        setIsDiagnosticsOpen((prev) => !prev);
        sound.playClick();
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, []);

  // Mobile Orientation Detection
  const [isPortrait, setIsPortrait] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      return window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth;
    }
    return false;
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleResize = () => {
      setIsPortrait(window.innerHeight > window.innerWidth);
      setIsFullscreen(Boolean(document.fullscreenElement));
    };

    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize);
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleResize);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', handleResize);
    };
  }, []);

  // Chrome Extension Companion Bridge (postMessage Handshake)
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleExtensionMessage = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (
        event.data?.type === 'PET_SLAM_EXTENSION_HANDSHAKE' ||
        event.data?.type === 'PET_SLAM_BUDDY_CONNECTED'
      ) {
        const hasClaimed = localStorage.getItem('petslam_extension_linked') === 'true';
        if (!hasClaimed) {
          localStorage.setItem('petslam_extension_linked', 'true');
          addCredits(500);
          sound.playVictory();
          triggerVictoryExplosion();
          setCompanionToast('🎉 Companion Linked! +500 Slam Credits Awarded!');
          setTimeout(() => setCompanionToast(null), 5000);
        } else {
          sound.playClick();
          setCompanionToast('✓ Desktop Companion Synced!');
          setTimeout(() => setCompanionToast(null), 3000);
        }

        window.postMessage(
          {
            type: 'PET_SLAM_COMPANION_ACK',
            version: '2.0',
            pet,
            timestamp: Date.now(),
          },
          '*'
        );
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('message', handleExtensionMessage);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('message', handleExtensionMessage);
  }, [addCredits, pet]);

  const handleToggleFullscreen = () => {
    if (!document.fullscreenElement) {
      document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    } else {
      document.exitFullscreen().catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  // Route tab selections
  const handleNavSelect = (tab: MainNavId) => {
    if (tab === 'studio') {
      setStudioModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'auctions') {
      setAuctionsModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'extension') {
      setBuddyModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'multiplayer') {
      setFriendsModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'ranked') {
      setRankedModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'genetics') {
      setBreedingModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'pass') {
      setPassModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'quests') {
      setQuestsDrawerOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'leaderboard') {
      setLeaderboardModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    if (tab === 'radar') {
      setRadarModalOpen(true);
      return;
    }
    setCurrentTab(tab);
  };

  return (
    <div className="relative w-full h-[100dvh] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#07090E] text-slate-900 dark:text-white flex overflow-hidden select-none transition-colors duration-300">
      {/* Floating Extension Companion Linked Toast */}
      {companionToast && (
        <div className="fixed top-14 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 animate-in slide-in-from-top-4 duration-300 pointer-events-none">
          <div className="px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-600 via-cyan-600 to-emerald-600 text-white font-mono font-black text-xs sm:text-sm shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,229,255,0.6)] border-2 border-white flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-[#CCFF00] animate-spin" />
            <span>{companionToast}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 1. Left Glassmorphic Rail (Desktop min-width: 1024px) */}
      <DesktopNavRail
        currentTab={currentTab}
        onTabChange={handleNavSelect}
        onOpenInfoDrawer={() => setShowInfoDrawer(true)}
        soundEnabled={soundEnabled}
        onToggleSound={toggleSound}
        isFullscreen={isFullscreen}
        onToggleFullscreen={handleToggleFullscreen}
      />

      {/* 2. Center Primary Viewport (Zero Page Scroll on Desktop, Safe Area on Mobile) */}
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col h-full min-w-0 overflow-hidden relative bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0E17] transition-colors duration-300">
        {/* Universal Top Bar */}
        <GameTopBar
          onOpenSystemDetails={onOpenSystemDetails || (() => setShowInfoDrawer(true))}
          onReturnToTitle={onReturnToTitle}
          onStartPracticeDrill={() => setCurrentTab('arena')}
          onOpenQuests={() => setQuestsDrawerOpen(true)}
          onOpenLeaderboard={() => setLeaderboardModalOpen(true)}
          onOpenRadar={() => setRadarModalOpen(true)}
        />

        {/* Mobile Orientation Suggestion Banner in Arena */}
        {currentTab === 'arena' && isPortrait && (
          <div className="lg:hidden bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-950/90 via-black to-cyan-950/90 border-b border-cyan-500/30 px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-cyan-300 text-[11px]">
              <Smartphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-bounce" />
              <span>Tip: Rotate to Landscape for Wide Arena</span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleToggleFullscreen}
              className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-cyan-400 text-black font-bold text-[10px] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <RotateCw className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>Fullscreen</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Active Screen Frame */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto relative pb-[70px] lg:pb-0 scrollbar-thin">
          {currentTab === 'arena' && <ArenaScreen />}
          {currentTab === 'sanctuary' && (
            <PetSanctuaryScreen onGoToArena={() => setCurrentTab('arena')} />
          )}
          {currentTab === 'beasts' && <BeastsScreen />}
          {currentTab === 'market' && <MarketScreen />}
        </div>
      </main>

      {/* 3. Right Telemetry & Social Dock (Desktop min-width: 1280px) */}
      <DesktopTelemetryDock
        onOpenAuctions={() => setAuctionsModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenBuddyHub={() => setBuddyModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenVipStore={() => setShowVipStore(true)}
        onOpenStudio={() => setStudioModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenRanked={() => setRankedModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenBreeding={() => setBreedingModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenPass={() => setPassModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenQuests={() => setQuestsDrawerOpen(true)}
      />

      {/* 4. Mobile Bottom Navigation Dock (< 1024px) */}
      <MobileBottomDock currentTab={currentTab} onTabChange={handleNavSelect} />

      {/* 5. Modals & Hubs */}
      {studioModalOpen && (
        <PetAvatarPhotoStudioModal onClose={() => setStudioModalOpen(false)} />
      )}
      {auctionsModalOpen && (
        <PetAuctionHouseModal onClose={() => setAuctionsModalOpen(false)} />
      )}
      {buddyModalOpen && (
        <ExtensionExporterModal onClose={() => setBuddyModalOpen(false)} />
      )}
      {friendsModalOpen && (
        <FriendsHubModal
          onClose={() => setFriendsModalOpen(false)}
          onChallengeFriend={() => setFriendsModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {showVipStore && (
        <VipPassesModal isOpen={showVipStore} onClose={() => setShowVipStore(false)} />
      )}
      {isDiagnosticsOpen && (
        <SystemDiagnosticsModal
          isOpen={isDiagnosticsOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsDiagnosticsOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {rankedModalOpen && (
        <RankedMatchmakingModal
          isOpen={rankedModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setRankedModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {breedingModalOpen && (
        <BreedingLabModal
          isOpen={breedingModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setBreedingModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {passModalOpen && (
        <SlamBattlePassModal
          isOpen={passModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setPassModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}
      {questsDrawerOpen && (
        <DailyQuestsDrawer
          isOpen={questsDrawerOpen}
          onClose={() => setQuestsDrawerOpen(false)}
          onOpenPass={() => setPassModalOpen(true)}
        />
      )}
      {leaderboardModalOpen && (
        <LeaderboardModal
          isOpen={leaderboardModalOpen}
          onClose={() => setLeaderboardModalOpen(false)}
          onOpenUpload={() => setStudioModalOpen(true)}
        />
      )}
      {radarModalOpen && (
        <PetWorldMapView onClose={() => setRadarModalOpen(false)} />
      )}

      {/* 6. High-Converting Hero/Landing Drawer */}
      <HeroLandingDrawer
        isOpen={showInfoDrawer}
        onClose={() => setShowInfoDrawer(false)}
        onEnterArena={() => {
          setCurrentTab('arena');
          setShowInfoDrawer(false);
        }}
      />

      {/* 7. Screen Companion Pet Overlay */}
      <FloatingPetOverlay />
    </div>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

};

<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import { Swords, Heart, Camera, Home, PawPrint, Compass } from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { MainNavId } from './DesktopNavRail';

interface MobileBottomDockProps {
  currentTab: MainNavId;
  onTabChange: (tab: MainNavId) => void;
}

export const MobileBottomDock: React.FC<MobileBottomDockProps> = ({
  currentTab,
  onTabChange,
}) => {
  const tabs = [
    { id: 'arena' as const, label: 'Arena', icon: Swords },
    { id: 'sanctuary' as const, label: 'Sanctuary', icon: Heart },
    { id: 'radar' as const, label: 'Map', icon: Compass },
    { id: 'studio' as const, label: 'Studio', icon: Camera },
    { id: 'auctions' as const, label: 'Adoption', icon: Home },
    { id: 'beasts' as const, label: 'Squad', icon: PawPrint },
  ];

  const handleSelect = (tab: MainNavId) => {
    sound.playClick();
    onTabChange(tab);
  };

  return (
    <nav className="lg:hidden fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 w-full max-w-full overflow-hidden bg-white/95 dark:bg-[#080C16]/98 backdrop-blur-2xl border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] dark:shadow-[0_-8px_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.7)] select-none px-1 pt-1 pb-[max(0.4rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] flex items-center justify-between transition-colors duration-300">
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const Icon = tab.icon;
        const isActive = currentTab === tab.id;

        return (
          <button
            key={tab.id}
            onClick={() => handleSelect(tab.id)}
            className={`relative flex-1 min-w-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[46px] px-0.5 py-1 rounded-xl transition-all duration-150 active:scale-90 cursor-pointer ${
              isActive ? 'text-slate-900 dark:text-[#CCFF00]' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            {/* Active Pill Glow */}
            {isActive && (
              <div className="absolute -top-1 w-6 sm:w-8 h-1 bg-[#CCFF00] rounded-full shadow-[0_0_10px_#CCFF00]" />
            )}

            <div
              className={`p-0.5 rounded-lg transition-transform duration-200 ${
                isActive ? 'scale-110 text-emerald-600 dark:text-[#CCFF00] drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(204,255,0,0.6)]' : 'text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300'
              }`}
            >
              <Icon className="w-4 h-4 sm:w-5 sm:h-5" />
            </div>

            <span
              className={`text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-mono uppercase leading-tight mt-0.5 truncate w-full text-center ${
                isActive ? 'text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-black tracking-wider' : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 font-bold'
              }`}
            >
              {tab.label}
            </span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </nav>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React, { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import {
  Trophy,
  Crown,
  Flame,
  Swords,
  DollarSign,
  TrendingUp,
  X,
  Camera,
  Upload,
  Sparkles,
  ShieldAlert,
  ArrowUpRight,
  Zap,
  CheckCircle2,
  Image as ImageIcon,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../../utils/audio';
import { trackClarityEvent } from '../../utils/clarity';
import { triggerVictoryExplosion } from '../../utils/confetti';
import { useGame } from '../../context/GameContext';

interface LeaderboardModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onOpenUpload?: () => void;
}

interface ArenaKingPlayer {
  rank: number;
  name: string;
  elo: number;
  wins: number;
  losses: number;
  leadPet: string;
  breed: string;
  tier: 'Grandmaster' | 'Master' | 'Diamond' | 'Platinum';
  avatarUrl: string;
}

interface OutbidPetEntry {
  rank: number;
  petName: string;
  trainerName: string;
  currentBidUsd: number;
  photoUrl: string;
  heldSince: string;
  isAiVerified: boolean;
}

const INITIAL_OUTBID_HOLDERS: OutbidPetEntry[] = [
  {
    rank: 1,
    petName: 'Barnaby the Sovereign',
    trainerName: 'LordSterling',
    currentBidUsd: 42.0,
    photoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1543466835-00a7907e9de1?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    heldSince: '4h ago',
    isAiVerified: true,
  },
  {
    rank: 2,
    petName: 'Cleo Golden Empress',
    trainerName: 'CairoKing',
    currentBidUsd: 28.0,
    photoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1573865526739-10659fec78a5?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    heldSince: '7h ago',
    isAiVerified: true,
  },
  {
    rank: 3,
    petName: 'Diesel Mountain Dog',
    trainerName: 'ApexRuler',
    currentBidUsd: 19.0,
    photoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1552053831-71594a27632d?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    heldSince: '1d ago',
    isAiVerified: true,
  },
  {
    rank: 4,
    petName: 'Mochi Marshmallow',
    trainerName: 'SugarBytes',
    currentBidUsd: 12.0,
    photoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1518791841217-8f162f1e1131?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    heldSince: '2d ago',
    isAiVerified: true,
  },
  {
    rank: 5,
    petName: 'Ghost Samurai Cat',
    trainerName: 'TokyoRonin',
    currentBidUsd: 8.0,
    photoUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1513360309081-36f20ca48f22?w=400&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    heldSince: '3d ago',
    isAiVerified: true,
  },
];

export const LeaderboardModal: React.FC<LeaderboardModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onOpenUpload,
}) => {
  const { trainerName } = useGame();
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'arena' | 'outbid'>('outbid');
  const [outbidToast, setOutbidToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [holders, setHolders] = useState<OutbidPetEntry[]>(INITIAL_OUTBID_HOLDERS);

  // Photo Upload & Direct Camera Snap State
  const [showUploadForm, setShowUploadForm] = useState(false);
  const [previewPhoto, setPreviewPhoto] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [inputPetName, setInputPetName] = useState<string>('');
  const [inputTrainerName, setInputTrainerName] = useState<string>(trainerName || 'Champion Trainer');
  const [inputBidUsd, setInputBidUsd] = useState<number>(43.0);

  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const cameraInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const formRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // Arena Kings (Skill / Elo)
  const arenaKings: ArenaKingPlayer[] = [
    {
      rank: 1,
      name: 'VortexSlammer',
      elo: 2840,
      wins: 142,
      losses: 18,
      leadPet: 'Apex Husky Alpha',
      breed: 'Siberian Husky',
      tier: 'Grandmaster',
      avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1537151625747-768eb6cf92b2?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    },
    {
      rank: 2,
      name: 'CyberKagero',
      elo: 2715,
      wins: 128,
      losses: 24,
      leadPet: 'Bengal Shadow',
      breed: 'Bengal Cat',
      tier: 'Grandmaster',
      avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1514888286974-6c03e2ca1dba?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    },
    {
      rank: 3,
      name: 'DogeOverdrive',
      elo: 2650,
      wins: 119,
      losses: 31,
      leadPet: 'Titan Shiba',
      breed: 'Shiba Inu',
      tier: 'Master',
      avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1583511655857-d19b40a7a54e?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    },
    {
      rank: 4,
      name: 'NovaStrike',
      elo: 2540,
      wins: 104,
      losses: 29,
      leadPet: 'Iron Rottweiler',
      breed: 'Rottweiler',
      tier: 'Master',
      avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1567752881298-894bb81f9379?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    },
    {
      rank: 5,
      name: 'PixelPaws',
      elo: 2480,
      wins: 96,
      losses: 34,
      leadPet: 'Maine Coon Titan',
      breed: 'Maine Coon',
      tier: 'Diamond',
      avatarUrl: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1533738363-b7f9aef128ce?w=150&auto=format&fit=crop&q=80',
    },
  ];

  const handlePhotoFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (file) {
      const reader = new FileReader();
      reader.onload = () => {
        if (typeof reader.result === 'string') {
          setPreviewPhoto(reader.result);
          sound.playClick();
        }
      };
      reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenPhotoForm = (suggestedBid?: number) => {
    sound.playClick();
    setShowUploadForm(true);
    if (suggestedBid) {
      setInputBidUsd(suggestedBid);
    } else {
      const topBid = holders[0]?.currentBidUsd || 42.0;
      setInputBidUsd(topBid + 1.0);
    }
    setTimeout(() => {
      formRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }, 100);
  };

  const handleSubmitNewOutbid = () => {
    if (!previewPhoto) {
      setOutbidToast('⚠️ Please snap or select a photo of your pet first!');
      sound.playClick();
      return;
    }

    const petName = inputPetName.trim() || 'My Crown Pet';
    sound.playVictory();
    triggerVictoryExplosion();
    trackClarityEvent('outbid_photo_submitted');

    const newBidAmount = Math.max(1, Number(inputBidUsd) || 43.0);
    const newEntry: OutbidPetEntry = {
      rank: 1,
      petName,
      trainerName: inputTrainerName.trim() || 'Trainer',
      currentBidUsd: newBidAmount,
      photoUrl: previewPhoto,
      heldSince: 'Just now',
      isAiVerified: true,
    };

    setHolders((prev) => {
      const filtered = prev.filter((p) => p.petName !== petName);
      const updated = [newEntry, ...filtered].map((item, idx) => ({
        ...item,
        rank: idx + 1,
      }));
      return updated.slice(0, 10);
    });

    setOutbidToast(`👑 ${petName} is now Sovereign #1 on the Outbid Hall of Fame!`);
    setShowUploadForm(false);
    setPreviewPhoto(null);
    setInputPetName('');

    setTimeout(() => {
      setOutbidToast(null);
    }, 4500);
  };

  const handleOutbidClick = (entry: OutbidPetEntry) => {
    sound.playClick();
    const nextBid = entry.currentBidUsd + 1.0;
    handleOpenPhotoForm(nextBid);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-3 sm:p-5 bg-black/85 backdrop-blur-md animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[92vh] flex flex-col bg-white dark:bg-[#0B0F19] border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/20 rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden transition-colors duration-300">
        
        {/* Toast Alert */}
        {outbidToast && (
          <div className="absolute top-16 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-mono font-black text-xs sm:text-sm rounded-xl shadow-2xl border-2 border-black animate-in slide-in-from-top-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
            <span>{outbidToast}</span>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Modal Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-5 py-4 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#090D17]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400 border border-amber-400/40">
              <Trophy className="w-5 h-5" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="font-display font-black text-xl sm:text-2xl uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-900 dark:text-white">
                Pet Slam Hall of Fame
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                PvP Elo Kings & Real-Money Clout Leaderboards
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              onClose();
            }}
            className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 hover:text-slate-950 dark:hover:text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            title="Close Leaderboard"
          >
            <X className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Dual Mode Switcher Tabs */}
        <div className="flex p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-[#070A12] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('outbid');
            }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'outbid'
                ? 'bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500 via-yellow-400 to-amber-500 text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>OutbidPet (Wealth Clout)</span>
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={() => {
              sound.playClick();
              setActiveTab('arena');
            }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 px-4 rounded-2xl font-display font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all cursor-pointer ${
              activeTab === 'arena'
                ? 'bg-slate-900 text-white dark:bg-[#CCFF00] dark:text-black shadow-md'
                : 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white'
            }`}
          >
            <Swords className="w-4 h-4" />
            <span>The Arena Kings (Skill PvP)</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab Content Body */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4 scrollbar-thin">
          {activeTab === 'arena' ? (
            /* TAB 1: THE ARENA KINGS */
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <div className="p-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/5 border border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400">
                <span>Ranked strictly by Authoritative 20-Tick Netcode PvP Elo</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 dark:text-white">Season 1 Active</span>
              </div>

              {arenaKings.map((player) => (
                <div
                  key={player.rank}
                  className={`flex items-center justify-between p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                    player.rank === 1
                      ? 'bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-950/20 border-amber-400/80 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(251,191,36,0.15)]'
                      : player.rank === 2
                      ? 'bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/40 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-500'
                      : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3.5 min-w-0">
                    {/* Rank Badge */}
                    <div
                      className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center font-display font-black text-base shrink-0 shadow-xs ${
                        player.rank === 1
                          ? 'bg-amber-400 text-black'
                          : player.rank === 2
                          ? 'bg-slate-300 text-slate-900'
                          : player.rank === 3
                          ? 'bg-amber-700 text-white'
                          : 'bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {player.rank === 1 ? '👑' : `#${player.rank}`}
                    </div>

                    {/* Avatar */}
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 shrink-0">
                      <img src={player.avatarUrl} alt={player.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                    </div>

                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 truncate">
                        <span className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-900 dark:text-white truncate">
                          {player.name}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs font-mono font-bold bg-cyan-500/15 text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                          {player.tier}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                        Lead: {player.leadPet} ({player.breed})
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Elo & Record */}
                  <div className="text-right shrink-0">
                    <div className="font-mono font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-emerald-700 dark:text-[#CCFF00]">
                      {player.elo} <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">ELO</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
                      <span className="text-emerald-600 font-bold">{player.wins}W</span> /{' '}
                      <span className="text-red-500 font-bold">{player.losses}L</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          ) : (
            /* TAB 2: OUTBIDPET (REAL-MONEY CLOUT) */
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Header Action Banner with Instant Camera Trigger */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-500/20 via-yellow-400/15 to-amber-500/20 border-2 border-amber-400/80 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-md">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-2xl bg-amber-400 text-black flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-black shadow-md shrink-0">
                    👑
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-display font-black text-base sm:text-lg uppercase text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wide">
                      Hold The Clout Crown With Your Pet
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-neutral-300 mt-0.5">
                      Upload or snap a photo of your pet to outbid the top spot!
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <button
                  onClick={() => handleOpenPhotoForm()}
                  className="w-full sm:w-auto px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-black hover:bg-slate-900 text-[#CCFF00] dark:bg-[#CCFF00] dark:text-black dark:hover:bg-[#b8e600] font-display font-black uppercase text-xs tracking-wider transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shrink-0"
                >
                  <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                  <span>Add / Snap Pet Photo 📸</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Inline Direct Upload & Camera Sheet */}
              {showUploadForm && (
                <div
                  ref={formRef}
                  className="p-5 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#111726] border-2 border-amber-400 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-in fade-in zoom-in-98 duration-200"
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 pb-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                      <h4 className="font-display font-black text-base uppercase text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wide">
                        Claim Your Outbid Hall of Fame Rank
                      </h4>
                    </div>
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setShowUploadForm(false)}
                      className="p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 dark:hover:bg-white/10 text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  {/* Hidden native file and camera inputs */}
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    ref={fileInputRef}
                    accept="image/*"
                    onChange={handlePhotoFileChange}
                    className="hidden"
                  />
                  <input
                    type="file"
                    ref={cameraInputRef}
                    accept="image/*"
                    capture="environment"
                    onChange={handlePhotoFileChange}
                    className="hidden"
                  />

                  {/* Photo Preview & Capture Buttons */}
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-4">
                    {previewPhoto ? (
                      <div className="relative w-28 h-28 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-[#CCFF00] shadow-xl shrink-0 group">
                        <img
                          src={previewPhoto}
                          alt="Pet Preview"
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                        <button
                          onClick={() => setPreviewPhoto(null)}
                          className="absolute top-1 right-1 bg-black/80 text-white rounded-full p-1 opacity-80 hover:opacity-100"
                          title="Remove photo"
                        >
                          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </button>
                        <div className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-emerald-600/90 text-white text-[9px] font-mono font-black text-center py-0.5">
                          ✓ PHOTO READY
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-28 h-28 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-amber-400/60 bg-amber-500/10 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-amber-500 dark:text-amber-400 p-2 text-center shrink-0">
                        <ImageIcon className="w-8 h-8 mb-1" />
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold leading-tight">
                          No Photo Selected
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    )}

                    {/* Capture Options */}
                    <div className="flex-1 w-full space-y-2">
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => cameraInputRef.current?.click()}
                          className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-400 hover:bg-amber-300 text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-transform"
                        >
                          <Camera className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Snap Camera 📷</span>
                        </button>

                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
                          className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/20 text-slate-800 dark:text-white font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-transform"
                        >
                          <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />
                          <span>Upload File 📁</span>
                        </button>
                      </div>

                      <p className="text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-neutral-400">
                        Upload an unedited photo of your dog or cat. Gemini AI verifies real pets automatically!
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Pet Name & Bid Inputs */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                        Pet Name:
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        value={inputPetName}
                        onChange={(e) => setInputPetName(e.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Barnaby The Great"
                        className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 bg-white dark:bg-black/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-sm focus:outline-hidden focus:border-amber-400"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 mb-1">
                        Outbid Amount ($ USD):
                      </label>
                      <div className="relative">
                        <span className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500 font-mono font-bold">
                          $
                        </span>
                        <input
                          type="number"
                          step="1.00"
                          min="1"
                          value={inputBidUsd}
                          onChange={(e) => setInputBidUsd(parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0)}
                          className="w-full pl-7 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 dark:border-white/20 bg-white dark:bg-black/50 text-slate-900 dark:text-white font-mono text-sm font-bold focus:outline-hidden focus:border-amber-400"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowUploadForm(false)}
                      className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-slate-600 dark:text-neutral-400 hover:text-slate-900 dark:hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      Cancel
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleSubmitNewOutbid}
                      className="px-6 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <Crown className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                      <span>Submit Outbid & Claim #1 ($ {inputBidUsd.toFixed(2)})</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Spacious, Highly Legible Outbid Pet Cards */}
              <div className="space-y-3.5">
                {holders.map((entry) => (
                  <div
                    key={entry.rank}
                    className={`flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border gap-4 shadow-sm transition-all ${
                      entry.rank === 1
                        ? 'bg-amber-50/70 dark:bg-gradient-to-r dark:from-amber-950/30 dark:to-black/50 border-amber-400/90 shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(251,191,36,0.2)]'
                        : 'bg-white dark:bg-white/5 border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 hover:border-amber-400/50'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-4 min-w-0">
                      {/* Rank Badge */}
                      <div
                        className={`w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center font-display font-black text-xl shrink-0 border ${
                          entry.rank === 1
                            ? 'bg-amber-400 text-black border-amber-300 shadow-md'
                            : 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-900 dark:text-white border-slate-300 dark:border-white/10'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {entry.rank === 1 ? '👑' : `#${entry.rank}`}
                      </div>

                      {/* Raw Pet Photo */}
                      <div className="relative w-16 h-16 sm:w-20 sm:h-20 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-amber-400/80 shrink-0 bg-black shadow-md">
                        <img
                          src={entry.photoUrl}
                          alt={entry.petName}
                          className="w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                        {entry.isAiVerified && (
                          <div
                            className="absolute bottom-0 inset-x-0 bg-emerald-600/95 text-white text-[9px] font-mono font-black text-center py-0.5 tracking-tight"
                            title="Verified real photograph by Gemini AI Bouncer"
                          >
                            ✓ REAL PET
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      {/* Pet Information with Generous Spacing & High-Contrast Typography */}
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="font-display font-black text-lg sm:text-xl text-slate-900 dark:text-white tracking-wide truncate">
                          {entry.petName}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 mt-1 leading-normal">
                          Held by <span className="font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white">{entry.trainerName}</span> · {entry.heldSince}
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-base sm:text-lg font-mono font-black text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <DollarSign className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                          <span>${entry.currentBidUsd.toFixed(2)} USD</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Outbid Action Button */}
                    <button
                      onClick={() => handleOutbidClick(entry)}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto py-3 px-5 rounded-xl bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-black text-xs sm:text-sm uppercase tracking-wider shadow-md hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.5)] transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-95 shrink-0"
                    >
                      <span>Outbid (+${(1.0).toFixed(2)})</span>
                      <ArrowUpRight className="w-4 h-4 text-black" />
                    </button>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Modal Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-white/10 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#070A12] flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          <span>Protected by Google Identity & Dodo MoR Payments</span>
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-200 dark:bg-white/10 text-slate-800 dark:text-white font-bold hover:bg-slate-300 dark:hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
</document_content>
</document>

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import {
  LEADERBOARD_WEEKLY,
  LEADERBOARD_MONTHLY,
  LEADERBOARD_ALL_TIME,
  LeaderboardPlayer,
} from '../data/leaderboard';
import { Trophy, Medal, Flame } from 'lucide-react';

export const LeaderboardSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [timeframe, setTimeframe] = useState<'weekly' | 'monthly' | 'allTime'>('weekly');

  const players: LeaderboardPlayer[] =
    timeframe === 'weekly'
      ? LEADERBOARD_WEEKLY
      : timeframe === 'monthly'
      ? LEADERBOARD_MONTHLY
      : LEADERBOARD_ALL_TIME;

  return (
    <section id="leaderboard" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0C10] py-20 lg:py-28">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6">
        {/* Section Heading & Filter Tabs */}
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between gap-6">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00]">
              <span>Global Sanctioned Rankings</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-neutral-600">·</span>
              <span className="text-neutral-400">Competitive Standings</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-2 font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
              THE ARENA REMEMBERS THE BEST.
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-base text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
              Ascend through regional qualifiers to claim a position on the global stage. Points are recalibrated at the close of every competitive season cycle.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Timeframe Tabs (Interactive Functional Controls per Constitution) */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-[#14161E] p-1 border border-white/10 shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={() => setTimeframe('weekly')}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold font-display uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                timeframe === 'weekly'
                  ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Weekly Circuit
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setTimeframe('monthly')}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold font-display uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                timeframe === 'monthly'
                  ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              Monthly Masters
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setTimeframe('allTime')}
              className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold font-display uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                timeframe === 'allTime'
                  ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-sm'
                  : 'text-neutral-400 hover:text-white'
              }`}
            >
              All-Time Hall
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Leaderboard Table Container */}
        <div className="mt-12 overflow-x-auto border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A]">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-white/10 bg-[#161822] text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 font-display">
                <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center w-16">Rank</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Competitor Profile</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Primary Champion Beast</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Record (W / L)</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6 text-center">Win Rate</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6 text-right">Arena Points</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-white/5 text-sm">
              {players.map((player) => {
                const isFirst = player.rank === 1;
                const isSecond = player.rank === 2;
                const isThird = player.rank === 3;

                return (
                  <tr
                    key={player.playerName}
                    className={`transition-colors hover:bg-white/[0.03] ${
                      isFirst ? 'bg-[#CCFF00]/[0.02]' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    {/* Rank Badge */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-center">
                        {isFirst ? (
                          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-display font-black text-sm">
                            #1
                          </div>
                        ) : isSecond ? (
                          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center bg-neutral-300 text-black font-display font-bold text-sm">
                            #2
                          </div>
                        ) : isThird ? (
                          <div className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center bg-amber-600 text-white font-display font-bold text-sm">
                            #3
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-mono text-neutral-400 text-xs">
                            #{player.rank}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Competitor Profile */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="h-9 w-9 bg-neutral-800 border border-white/10 flex items-center justify-center font-display font-bold text-white text-xs uppercase">
                          {player.playerName.slice(0, 2)}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-display font-bold text-base text-white tracking-wide">
                              {player.playerName}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                              {player.tag}
                            </span>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase">
                              [{player.country}]
                            </span>
                          </div>
                          {player.currentStreak >= 5 && (
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00]">
                              <Flame className="h-3 w-3" />
                              <span>{player.currentStreak} Win Streak</span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Primary Beast */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6">
                      <div>
                        <span className="font-display font-bold text-white text-base block">
                          {player.mainAnimal.name}
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-neutral-400">
                          <span>{player.mainAnimal.species}</span>
                          <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                          <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-mono font-medium">
                            LVL {player.mainAnimal.level}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </td>

                    {/* Record */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center font-mono text-xs tabular-nums">
                      <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">{player.totalWins}W</span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-600 mx-1.5">/</span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">{player.totalLosses}L</span>
                    </td>

                    {/* Win Rate */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-center font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white tabular-nums">
                      {player.winRate}%
                    </td>

                    {/* Points */}
                    <td className="py-4 px-6 text-right font-mono text-base font-bold text-[#CCFF00] tabular-nums">
                      {player.points.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* Bottom Qualifier note */}
        <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-neutral-400">
          <span>*Live leaderboard synchronized with sanctioned arena bouts. Minimum 20 ranked matches for placement.</span>
          <span className="font-mono text-neutral-300">Seasonal Reset: 14 Days</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/Marketplace.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { ANIMALS_DATA, Animal } from '../data/animals';
import { AnimalDetailModal } from './AnimalDetailModal';
import { Eye, ArrowUpDown, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';

interface MarketplaceProps {
  onJoinWaitlist: () => void;
}

type CategoryFilter = 'All Animals' | 'Dogs' | 'Cats';
type SortOption = 'Highest Level' | 'Highest Strength' | 'Rarest' | 'Recently Added';

export const Marketplace: React.FC<MarketplaceProps> = ({ onJoinWaitlist }) => {
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<CategoryFilter>('All Animals');
  const [sortBy, setSortBy] = useState<SortOption>('Highest Level');
  const [selectedAnimal, setSelectedAnimal] = useState<Animal | null>(null);

  const categories: CategoryFilter[] = [
    'All Animals',
    'Dogs',
    'Cats',
  ];

  const rarityWeights: Record<string, number> = {
    Legendary: 5,
    Apex: 4,
    Alpha: 3,
    Vanguard: 2,
    Common: 1,
  };

  const filteredAndSortedAnimals = useMemo(() => {
    let result = [...ANIMALS_DATA];

    if (selectedCategory === 'Dogs') {
      result = result.filter((a) => a.category === 'Canines');
    } else if (selectedCategory === 'Cats') {
      result = result.filter((a) => a.category === 'Felines');
    }

    result.sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'Highest Level') {
        return b.level - a.level;
      }
      if (sortBy === 'Highest Strength') {
        return b.strength - a.strength;
      }
      if (sortBy === 'Rarest') {
        return (rarityWeights[b.rarity] || 0) - (rarityWeights[a.rarity] || 0);
      }
      if (sortBy === 'Recently Added') {
        return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
      }
      return 0;
    });

    return result;
  }, [selectedCategory, sortBy]);

  return (
    <section id="marketplace" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0C10] py-20 lg:py-28">
