              YOUR NEXT CHAMPION IS OUT THERE.
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-3 max-w-2xl text-base text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
              Explore authentic registered beasts. Inspect biological telemetry, review combat archetypes, and preview acquisition terms ahead of genesis deployment.
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="shrink-0 flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase text-neutral-400 font-medium">Sort By:</span>
            <div className="relative">
              <select
                value={sortBy}
                onChange={(e) => setSortBy(e.target.value as SortOption)}
                className="bg-[#14161E] border border-white/10 px-3.5 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-white uppercase focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="Highest Level">Highest Level</option>
                <option value="Highest Strength">Highest Strength</option>
                <option value="Rarest">Rarest Tier</option>
                <option value="Recently Added">Recently Added</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Category Filters (Interactive Functional Buttons per Constitution) */}
        <div className="mt-10 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 border-b border-white/10 pb-6">
          {categories.map((category) => {
            const isActive = selectedCategory === category;
            return (
              <button
                key={category}
                onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(category)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors duration-150 cursor-pointer ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(204,255,0,0.2)]'
                    : 'bg-[#14161E] text-neutral-300 hover:text-white hover:bg-[#1E222E] border border-white/5'
                }`}
              >
                {category}
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>

        {/* Animals Grid */}
        <div className="mt-10 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
          {filteredAndSortedAnimals.map((animal) => {
            return (
              <div
                key={animal.id}
                className="group relative flex flex-col justify-between border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-white/30 hover:bg-[#161822]"
              >
                {/* Animal Photo with Scrim */}
                <div className="relative aspect-[4/3] w-full overflow-hidden bg-black">
                  <img
                    src={animal.image}
                    alt={`${animal.name} - ${animal.species}`}
                    className="h-full w-full object-cover object-center transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105"
                    referrerPolicy="no-referrer"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#12141A] via-transparent to-black/30" />

                  {/* Top Clean Badges */}
                  <div className="absolute top-3 left-3 right-3 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                    <span className="bg-black/80 px-2 py-0.5 text-white font-mono font-bold border border-white/10">
                      LVL {animal.level}
                    </span>
                    <span className="bg-black/80 px-2 py-0.5 text-[#CCFF00] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border border-white/10">
                      {animal.rarity}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  {/* Bottom Image Info */}
                  <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-3 right-3">
                    <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] block">
                      {animal.combatArchetype}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white leading-tight">
                      {animal.name}
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Content Details */}
                <div className="p-5 flex flex-col flex-1 justify-between">
                  <div>
                    {/* Unboxed Metadata per Constitution */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-neutral-400">
                      <span className="text-white font-medium">{animal.species}</span>
                      <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                      <span>{animal.category}</span>
                      <span aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">{animal.acquisitionStatus}</span>
                    </div>

                    {/* Stat Progress Bars */}
                    <div className="mt-4 space-y-2 pt-3 border-t border-white/5">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] mb-0.5">
                          <span className="text-neutral-400">Strength</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-white">{animal.strength}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1 w-full bg-white/10">
                          <div className="h-full bg-[#CCFF00]" style={{ width: `${animal.strength}%` }} />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] mb-0.5">
                          <span className="text-neutral-400">Speed</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-white">{animal.speed}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1 w-full bg-white/10">
                          <div className="h-full bg-[#00E5FF]" style={{ width: `${animal.speed}%` }} />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] mb-0.5">
                          <span className="text-neutral-400">Endurance</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-white">{animal.endurance}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="h-1 w-full bg-white/10">
                          <div className="h-full bg-[#FF5500]" style={{ width: `${animal.endurance}%` }} />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Card Bottom CTA */}
                  <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 uppercase block tracking-wider">Estimate</span>
                      <span className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-white">
                        {animal.currentPriceCredits.toLocaleString()}{' '}
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 font-normal">CR</span>
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setSelectedAnimal(animal)}
                      className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white/10 hover:bg-[#CCFF00] hover:text-black border border-white/15 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-display font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>Inspect</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Detail Dossier Modal */}
      {selectedAnimal && (
        <AnimalDetailModal
          animal={selectedAnimal}
          onClose={() => setSelectedAnimal(null)}
          onJoinWaitlist={onJoinWaitlist}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>

                  <li className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                    <span className="text-purple-400 font-bold">›</span>
                    <span>Esports outreach target: 500 paying users / $10k initial revenue</span>
                  </li>
                </ul>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-white/10 text-[11px] font-mono text-purple-400">
                Status: Genesis Target Milestones
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2-Column Comparison Layout: Week 8 vs Post-Launch */}
        <div id="deferred-features" className="mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 items-start">
          {/* Column 1: Week 8 Genesis MVP (In-Scope) */}
          <div className="border border-[#CCFF00]/30 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-5 mb-6">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00]">
                  <Calendar className="h-4 w-4" />
                  <span>Phase 01 · Week 8 Genesis Launch</span>
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                  Genesis Core MVP (In Scope)
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase px-3 py-1 tracking-wider">
                Active Sprint
              </span>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mb-6">
              Everything required to acquire, house, feed, and condition your first beast. Every player receives their 10,000 starter credits on day one.
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {week8Features.map((item, index) => {
                const IconComponent = item.icon;
                return (
                  <div key={index} className="border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                      <span className="font-display text-base font-bold uppercase text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <IconComponent className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                        <span>{item.title}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#CCFF00] font-semibold shrink-0">
                        Week 8
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                      {item.category}
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                      {item.detail}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-neutral-400">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-neutral-300">
                <Check className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>Single-player training + marketplace UI active in Week 8</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Column 2: Deferred Features (Post-Launch Roadmap) */}
          <div className="border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-8">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-5 mb-6">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                  <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-400" />
                  <span>Phase 02 & Beyond · Competitive Rollout</span>
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                  Deferred Post-Launch Roadmap
                </h3>
              </div>
              <span className="bg-white/10 text-neutral-300 font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase px-3 py-1 tracking-wider border border-white/10">
                Post-Launch
              </span>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mb-6">
              Features intentionally held for subsequent rollout to safeguard competitive balance, network latency, and economy liquidity.
            </p>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {postLaunchFeatures.map((item, index) => (
                <div key={index} className="border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                    <span className="font-display text-base font-bold uppercase text-white">
                      {item.title}
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-amber-400 font-semibold shrink-0">
                      {item.target}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">
                    {item.category}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                    {item.detail}
                  </p>
                  <div className="mt-2 pt-2 border-t border-white/5 text-[11px] text-neutral-400 italic">
                    Why deferred: {item.rationale}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-white/10 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-neutral-400">
              <span className="text-neutral-400">
                All roadmap updates tested with priority Alpha waitlist cohorts first.
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* SECTION: Dedicated Go-To-Market & 8-Week Outreach Sequence */}
        <div id="gtm-sequence" className="mt-16 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 bg-[#12141A] p-6 lg:p-10 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-6 mb-8 gap-4">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00]">
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>Go-To-Market & Commercial Strategy</span>
              </div>
              <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black uppercase text-white">
                8-WEEK AUDIENCE ACQUISITION & MONETISATION ROADMAP
              </h3>
              <p className="mt-2 text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-300 max-w-3xl leading-relaxed">
                A concrete, phased outreach plan designed to acquire our first 5,000 players and 500 paying customers ($10,000 revenue) by partnering directly with established competitive gaming hubs.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <span className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-400">First-Customer Path:</span>
              <span className="bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-mono font-bold text-xs uppercase px-3 py-1">
                Free Alpha First → Cosmetics
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* First Customer Path Rationale Banner */}
          <div className="border border-white/10 bg-black/40 p-5 mb-8">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-[#CCFF00] shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                <div>
                  <span className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-white block">
                    Strategic First-Customer Execution: Free Playable Alpha Before Any Monetisation
                  </span>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                    Competitive esports players reject games that demand upfront payment without proven mechanics. We launch a <strong>100% free playable single-player alpha</strong> to competitive Discord communities in Weeks 3–4. Once players experience the biological training depth and gameplay loop, we introduce <strong>optional Genesis Founder cosmetic packs ($19.99)</strong> with zero stat advantages in Weeks 5–8.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 4 Named Target Communities Grid */}
          <div id="target-communities" className="mb-10">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                <MessageSquare className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>4 Primary Target Communities (Week 1–2 Channel Outreach)</span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-xs font-mono text-neutral-500 hidden sm:inline">
                Audience: ~615,000 Total Reach
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {targetCommunities.map((comm, idx) => (
                <div
                  key={idx}
                  className="border border-white/10 bg-[#161822] p-5 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-[#CCFF00]/40 transition-colors"
                >
                  <div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">
                        {comm.tag}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400">
                        {comm.scale}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <h4 className="font-display text-lg font-bold uppercase text-white leading-tight">
                      {comm.name}
                    </h4>
                    <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 mb-2">
                      {comm.channel}
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed mb-3">
                      {comm.profile}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/5 text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                    <strong className="text-neutral-200">Angle:</strong> {comm.outreachAngle}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 8-Week Sequential Timeline Breakdown */}
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400">
                <Calendar className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>Concrete 8-Week Timeline & Outreach Milestones</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                {(['all', 'w1-2', 'w3-4', 'w5-6', 'w7-8'] as const).map((tab) => (
                  <button
                    key={tab}
                    onClick={() => setActiveWeekTab(tab)}
                    className={`px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-mono font-semibold uppercase transition-colors cursor-pointer ${
                      activeWeekTab === tab
                        ? 'bg-[#CCFF00] text-black font-bold'
                        : 'bg-white/5 text-neutral-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {tab === 'all' ? 'View All' : tab.toUpperCase()}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              {outreachPhases
                .filter((phase) => activeWeekTab === 'all' || activeWeekTab === phase.id)
                .map((phase) => (
                  <div
                    key={phase.id}
                    className={`border ${phase.borderColor} ${phase.bgColor} p-5 flex flex-col justify-between`}
                  >
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <span className={`font-mono text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${phase.color}`}>
                          {phase.phase}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-neutral-400 uppercase">
                          Milestone
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <h4 className="font-display text-lg font-black uppercase text-white leading-tight mb-1">
                        {phase.title}
                      </h4>

                      <div className="text-[11px] font-mono text-neutral-400 mb-3 pb-2 border-b border-white/10">
                        {phase.focus}
                      </div>

                      <ul className="space-y-2 mb-4">
                        {phase.bullets.map((bullet, bIdx) => (
                          <li key={bIdx} className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed flex items-start gap-1.5">
                            <span className={`${phase.color} font-bold`}>›</span>
                            <span>{bullet}</span>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </div>

                    <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
                      <div className="text-[10px] font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 mb-0.5">
                        Target Funnel Stage
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-mono text-xs font-bold text-white">
                        {phase.funnelState}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Conversion Funnel & Commercial Economics Summary */}
          <div className="mt-8 pt-8 border-t border-white/10 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            <div className="border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-white mb-2">
                <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>1. Community Top-of-Funnel</span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black text-white mb-1">
                5,000 Alpha Signups
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
                Generated across Smogon VGC, TFT Competitive, Auto-Chess hubs, and <code>r/CompetitiveGaming</code> via free playable alpha access.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-white mb-2">
                <Flame className="h-4 w-4 text-cyan-400" />
                <span>2. Active Conditioning Cohort</span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black text-cyan-400 mb-1">
                1,500 Active Weekly Trainers
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
                Engaged daily in single-player feeding, agility sprint drills, and local sandbox stat clashing with starter beasts.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="border border-white/5 bg-[#161822] p-5">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-white mb-2">
                <DollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>3. Week 8 Commercial Target</span>
              </div>
              <div className="font-display text-2xl font-black text-[#CCFF00] mb-1">
                500 Paying Users · $10,000
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
                10% conversion of engaged players purchasing the $19.99 Genesis Founder Cosmetic Pack. Strictly zero pay-to-win mechanics.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Bottom CTA Strip */}
        <div className="mt-12 border border-white/10 bg-[#14161E] p-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <span className="font-display text-lg font-bold uppercase text-white block">
              Want priority testing access to the Week 8 Genesis Build?
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-neutral-400">
              Join the waitlist to receive your guaranteed 10,000 credits voucher and Wave 1 free alpha access.
            </span>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onJoinWaitlist}
            className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black px-6 py-3 font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition-colors shrink-0 cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)]"
          >
            <span>Lock In Week 8 Alpha Access</span>
            <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>

<source>src/components/Navbar.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Menu, X, FileCode } from 'lucide-react';

interface NavbarProps {
  onOpenWaitlist: () => void;
  currentPage?: 'landing' | 'system-details';
  onNavigate?: (page: 'landing' | 'system-details', href?: string) => void;
}

export const Navbar: React.FC<NavbarProps> = ({
  onOpenWaitlist,
  currentPage = 'landing',
  onNavigate,
}) => {
  const [mobileMenuOpen, setMobileMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  const navLinks = [
    { label: 'How It Works', href: '#how-it-works', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    { label: 'Marketplace', href: '#marketplace', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    { label: 'Evolution', href: '#evolution', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    { label: 'Battle Arena', href: '#arena', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    { label: 'Auctions', href: '#auctions', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    { label: 'IRL Mode', href: '#irl-mode', targetPage: 'landing' as const },
    {
      label: 'System Required Details',
      href: '#system-required-details',
      targetPage: 'system-details' as const,
      isSpecial: true,
    },
  ];

  const handleNavClick = (link: (typeof navLinks)[0]) => {
    setMobileMenuOpen(false);
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate(link.targetPage, link.href);
    } else {
      const element = document.querySelector(link.href);
      if (element) {
        element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }
    }
  };

  const handleBrandClick = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (onNavigate) {
      onNavigate('landing', '#');
    } else {
      window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 w-full border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0C10]/95 backdrop-blur-md transition-colors">
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-6 px-6 py-4">
        {/* Zone 1: Single text element wordmark */}
        <a
          href="#"
          onClick={handleBrandClick}
          className="font-display text-2xl font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-white whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"
        >
          PET<span className="text-[#CCFF00]"> SLAM</span>
        </a>

        {/* Zone 2: Single-line concise nav links */}
        <nav className="hidden xl:flex items-center gap-6 text-sm font-medium text-neutral-300">
          {navLinks.map((link) => {
            const isSystemPageLink = link.targetPage === 'system-details';
            const isActive = isSystemPageLink
              ? currentPage === 'system-details'
              : false;

            return (
              <a
                key={link.label}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleNavClick(link);
                }}
                className={`whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 transition-all flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-[#CCFF00] font-bold border-b-2 border-[#CCFF00]'
                    : isSystemPageLink
                    ? 'text-cyan-400 hover:text-[#CCFF00] font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 border border-cyan-400/30 hover:border-[#CCFF00]/60 bg-cyan-950/20'
                    : 'text-neutral-300 hover:text-[#CCFF00]'
                }`}
              >
                {isSystemPageLink && <FileCode className="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />}
                <span>{link.label}</span>
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Medium-screen compact fallback if not xl */}
        <nav className="hidden lg:flex xl:hidden items-center gap-4 text-xs font-medium text-neutral-300">
          {navLinks.map((link) => {
            const isSystemPageLink = link.targetPage === 'system-details';
            const isActive = isSystemPageLink
              ? currentPage === 'system-details'
              : false;

            return (
              <a
                key={link.label}
                href={link.href}
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  handleNavClick(link);
                }}
                className={`whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 transition-all flex items-center gap-1 py-1 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-[#CCFF00] font-bold'
                    : isSystemPageLink
                    ? 'text-cyan-400 font-semibold hover:text-[#CCFF00]'
                    : 'text-neutral-300 hover:text-[#CCFF00]'
                }`}
              >
                {isSystemPageLink && <FileCode className="h-3 w-3" />}
                <span>{link.label}</span>
              </a>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Zone 3: 1 Primary CTA */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
          <button
            onClick={onOpenWaitlist}
            className="hidden sm:inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-none bg-[#CCFF00] px-5 py-2.5 font-display text-sm font-bold tracking-wider text-black uppercase transition-all duration-200 hover:bg-[#b8e600] active:scale-[0.98] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0 cursor-pointer"
          >
            Join The Waitlist
          </button>

          {/* Mobile hamburger toggle */}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(!mobileMenuOpen)}
            className="lg:hidden p-2 text-neutral-300 hover:text-white cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Toggle Navigation Menu"
          >
            {mobileMenuOpen ? <X className="h-6 w-6" /> : <Menu className="h-6 w-6" />}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Mobile Drawer */}
      {mobileMenuOpen && (
        <div className="lg:hidden border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0F1117] px-6 py-6 shadow-2xl">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 text-base font-medium text-neutral-300">
            {navLinks.map((link) => {
              const isSystemPageLink = link.targetPage === 'system-details';
              const isActive = isSystemPageLink && currentPage === 'system-details';

              return (
                <a
                  key={link.label}
                  href={link.href}
                  onClick={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    handleNavClick(link);
                  }}
                  className={`py-2 transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'text-[#CCFF00] font-bold'
                      : isSystemPageLink
                      ? 'text-cyan-400 font-semibold'
                      : 'hover:text-[#CCFF00]'
                  }`}
                >
                  {isSystemPageLink && <FileCode className="h-4 w-4 text-[#CCFF00]" />}
                  <span>{link.label}</span>
                  {isSystemPageLink && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-[10px] font-mono uppercase bg-[#CCFF00]/10 text-[#CCFF00] px-1.5 py-0.5 border border-[#CCFF00]/30">
                      Page
                    </span>
                  )}
                </a>
              );
            })}
            <div className="pt-3 border-t border-white/10">
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setMobileMenuOpen(false);
                  onOpenWaitlist();
                }}
                className="w-full rounded-none bg-[#CCFF00] py-3 text-center font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black cursor-pointer"
              >
                Join The Waitlist
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<document_content>
import React from 'react';
import {
  ArrowLeft,
  FileCode,
  Server,
  Users,
  ShieldAlert,
  Layers,
  Sparkles,
  TrendingUp,
  Target,
  Terminal,
  ExternalLink,
  Cpu,
  Calendar,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { MvpScopeSection } from './MvpScopeSection';
import { TeamSection } from './TeamSection';

interface SystemRequiredDetailsPageProps {
  onBackToLanding: () => void;
  onJoinWaitlist: () => void;
}

export const SystemRequiredDetailsPage: React.FC<SystemRequiredDetailsPageProps> = ({
  onBackToLanding,
  onJoinWaitlist,
}) => {
  const scrollToAnchor = (id: string) => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) {
      el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#0B0C10] text-neutral-100 flex flex-col">
      {/* Top Banner / Breadcrumb Bar */}
      <div className="sticky top-[69px] z-40 border-b border-white/10 bg-[#0F1117]/95 backdrop-blur-md px-6 py-3.5">
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-7xl items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              onClick={onBackToLanding}
              className="group inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-neutral-400 hover:text-[#CCFF00] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4 transition-transform group-hover:-translate-x-1" />
              <span>Back to Main Game</span>
            </button>
            <span className="text-neutral-600 hidden sm:inline" aria-hidden="true">/</span>
            <div className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-mono text-[#CCFF00] font-semibold uppercase">
              <FileCode className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              <span>System Required Details</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Sun, Moon } from 'lucide-react';
import { sound } from '../utils/audio';

export const ThemeToggle: React.FC<{ className?: string }> = ({ className = '' }) => {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<'light' | 'dark'>(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme');
      if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') return saved;
      return document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') ? 'dark' : 'light';
    } catch {
      return 'dark';
    }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    if (theme === 'dark') {
      root.classList.add('dark');
      root.classList.remove('light');
    } else {
      root.classList.remove('dark');
      root.classList.add('light');
    }
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
    } catch {}
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    sound.playClick();
    setTheme((prev) => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  };

  const isDark = theme === 'dark';

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={toggleTheme}
      className={`relative flex items-center justify-center p-2 rounded-xl transition-all duration-300 cursor-pointer border shadow-sm active:scale-95 ${
        isDark
          ? 'bg-slate-900/90 hover:bg-slate-800 border-amber-400/40 text-amber-300 shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(251,191,36,0.25)]'
          : 'bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 border-slate-300 text-slate-800 shadow-md'
      } ${className}`}
      title={isDark ? 'Switch to Light Mode ☀️' : 'Switch to Dark Mode 🌙'}
      aria-label="Toggle Light / Dark Theme"
    >
      {isDark ? (
        <Sun className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300 animate-spin-slow transition-transform hover:rotate-90 duration-300" />
      ) : (
        <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 transition-transform hover:-rotate-12 duration-300" />
      )}
      <span className="sr-only">{isDark ? 'Switch to Light Mode' : 'Switch to Dark Mode'}</span>
    </button>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/components/WaitlistSection.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import {
  Mail,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertCircle,
  ArrowRight,
  Loader2,
  Database,
  Send,
  Zap,
  Award,
  Shield,
  Eye,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { EmailPreviewModal } from './EmailPreviewModal';
import { submitWaitlist, getWaitlistStats } from '../services/waitlist';

export const WaitlistSection: React.FC = () => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [previewModalOpen, setPreviewModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [successData, setSuccessData] = useState<{
    entry?: {
      id: string;
      email: string;
      created_at: string;
      signup_status: string;
      perks?: { credits: number; founder_badge: boolean; alpha_access: boolean };
    };
    totalSignups?: number;
    emailStatus?: { sent: boolean; message: string; template?: any };
    perksAwarded?: { credits: number; founderBadge: string; alphaTesting: string };
    mode?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const [backendStats, setBackendStats] = useState<{
    totalSignups: number;
    provider?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Fetch live stats from backend or Supabase
  const fetchStatus = async () => {
    try {
      const stats = await getWaitlistStats();
      setBackendStats({ totalSignups: stats.totalSignups, provider: stats.provider });
    } catch {
      // stats optional
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchStatus();
  }, []);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMessage(null);

    const trimmed = email.trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!trimmed || !emailRegex.test(trimmed)) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter a valid email address.');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const result = await submitWaitlist(trimmed);

      if (result.success) {
        setSuccessData(result);
        setEmail('');
        fetchStatus();
      } else if (result.duplicate) {
        setErrorMessage(result.message || 'This email address is already on the PET SLAM waitlist.');
      } else {
        setErrorMessage(result.error || 'Unable to register at this moment. Please check your connection and retry.');
      }
    } catch {
      setErrorMessage('Network error: Unable to contact the registration server. Please try again.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <section id="waitlist" className="relative border-b border-white/5 bg-[#0B0C10] py-20 lg:py-28 overflow-hidden">
      {/* Ambient glow highlight */}
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0">
        <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-[600px] h-[500px] bg-[#CCFF00]/5 blur-[160px]" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative mx-auto max-w-4xl px-6">
        <div className="border border-white/10 bg-[#12141A] p-8 sm:p-12 lg:p-16 shadow-2xl">
          {/* Header */}
          <div className="text-center">
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#CCFF00] mb-3">
              <span>Priority Genesis Cohort</span>
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="text-neutral-600">·</span>
              <span>10,000 Credits Grant Active</span>
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-display text-4xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight text-white sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-balance">
              THE ARENA IS CALLING.
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-4 max-w-xl mx-auto text-base sm:text-lg leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
              Launching free playable alpha access directly to competitive gaming communities on Discord (Smogon VGC, TFT Competitive) and Reddit, with Genesis Founder cosmetic packs available at launch. Reserve your place now for guaranteed starter credits and Founder status.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Guaranteed Genesis Perks Callout Banner */}
          <div className="mt-8 border border-[#CCFF00]/30 bg-[#161922] p-6 text-left">
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between border-b border-white/10 pb-4 mb-4 gap-2">
              <span className="font-display text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#CCFF00]" />
                <span>Guaranteed Early Applicant Privileges</span>
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setPreviewModalOpen(true)}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#CCFF00] hover:underline font-mono uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Eye className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                <span>Preview Confirmation Email</span>
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="p-3 bg-black/40 border border-white/5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-[#CCFF00] mb-1">
                  <Zap className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>10,000 Credits</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Automatic credit grant deposited for beast marketplace buying, bidding, and stat training.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-black/40 border border-white/5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-amber-400 mb-1">
                  <Award className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Founder Badge</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Permanent genesis insignia displayed across your arena card and global ranking.
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="p-3 bg-black/40 border border-white/5">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold uppercase text-cyan-400 mb-1">
                  <Shield className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                  <span>Free Playable Alpha Wave 1</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-neutral-300 leading-relaxed">
                  Priority invite wave to access single-player training, diet conditioning, and local combat sandbox.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Real Form or Success State */}
          <div className="mt-8 max-w-xl mx-auto">
            {successData ? (
              <div className="border border-[#CCFF00]/30 bg-[#CCFF00]/5 p-8 text-center transition-all">
                <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center bg-[#CCFF00] text-black">
                  <CheckCircle className="h-8 w-8" />
                </div>
                <h3 className="mt-5 font-display text-3xl font-black uppercase tracking-wide text-white">
                  YOU'RE IN. WELCOME TO PET SLAM.
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-relaxed text-neutral-300">
                  Your application has been received and verified. 10,000 Arena Credits and your Founder Beast Badge have been assigned to your registration voucher.
                </p>

                {/* Entry Receipt Details */}
                {successData.entry && (
                  <div className="mt-6 border border-white/10 bg-black/60 p-4 text-xs font-mono text-left space-y-2 text-neutral-300">
                    <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Application Voucher:</span>
                      <span className="text-white font-bold">{successData.entry.id}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Account Email:</span>
                      <span className="text-[#CCFF00]">{successData.entry.email}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Granted Credits:</span>
                      <span className="text-[#CCFF00] font-bold">10,000 Arena Credits</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between border-b border-white/5 pb-1.5">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Cosmetic Honor:</span>
                      <span className="text-amber-400 font-bold">Founder Beast Badge</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between">
                      <span className="text-neutral-400">Feature Testing:</span>
                      <span className="text-cyan-400 font-bold">Priority Closed Alpha</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Transactional Email Dispatch Note */}
                <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-white/5 border border-white/5 text-[11px] text-neutral-400 text-left">
                  {successData.emailStatus?.sent ? (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-400">
                      <Send className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>{successData.emailStatus.message}</span>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="text-neutral-400 space-y-1">
                      <span className="text-neutral-300 font-medium block">Confirmation Dispatch Status:</span>
                      <span>
                        {successData.emailStatus?.message ||
                          'Application safely stored in database. Transactional email triggers automatically once RESEND_API_KEY is configured.'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* Buttons: Inspect Email & Register Another */}
                <div className="mt-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setPreviewModalOpen(true)}
                    className="flex-1 bg-[#CCFF00] hover:bg-[#b8e600] text-black font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase py-3 tracking-wider transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Inspect Confirmation Email
                  </button>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setSuccessData(null)}
                    className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white font-display font-bold text-xs uppercase px-5 py-3 tracking-wider border border-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Register Another
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
                  <div className="relative flex-1">
                    <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex items-center pl-4 text-neutral-400">
                      <Mail className="h-5 w-5" />
                    </div>
                    <input
                      type="email"
                      value={email}
                      onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Enter your email address"
                      disabled={loading}
                      required
                      aria-label="Email address for waitlist"
                      className="w-full bg-black/60 border border-white/15 py-4 pl-12 pr-4 text-sm text-white placeholder-neutral-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#CCFF00] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#CCFF00] transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={loading}
                    className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-[#CCFF00] px-8 py-4 font-display text-base font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-black transition-all hover:bg-[#b8e600] active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-60 cursor-pointer shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(204,255,0,0.25)] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0"
                  >
                    {loading ? (
                      <>
                        <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                        <span>Registering...</span>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <span>Join The Waitlist</span>
                        <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>

                {errorMessage && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-3 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-500/30 text-xs text-red-200">
                    <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-400" />
                    <span>{errorMessage}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Subtext info */}
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between text-xs text-neutral-400 pt-2 gap-2">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Database className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-[#CCFF00]" />
                    <span>Instant database record · 10,000 Credits locked to voucher</span>
                  </span>
                  {backendStats && (
                    <span className="font-mono text-neutral-300">
                      <strong className="text-white">{backendStats.totalSignups}</strong> verified collectors on waitlist
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Confirmation Email Preview Inspector Modal */}
      <EmailPreviewModal
        isOpen={previewModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setPreviewModalOpen(false)}
        email={successData?.entry?.email || email || 'candidate@petslam.gg'}
        voucherId={successData?.entry?.id || 'ps_genesis_alpha'}
        resendStatus={successData?.emailStatus}
      />
    </section>
  );
};

</document_content>
</document>

<source>src/context/GameContext.tsx</source>
<document_content>
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Animal, ANIMALS_DATA } from '../data/animals';
import { GearItem, GEAR_ITEMS } from '../data/armory';
import { sound } from '../utils/audio';
import { trackClarityEvent, setClarityTag } from '../utils/clarity';
import { supabase } from '../services/supabaseClient';

export interface MatchHistoryEntry {
  id: string;
  timestamp: number;
  beastName: string;
  opponentName: string;
  result: 'VICTORY' | 'DEFEAT';
  rounds: number;
  creditsEarned: number;
  trophiesChange: number;
}

export interface Achievement {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  desc: string;
  rewardCredits: number;
  claimed: boolean;
  progress: number;
  target: number;
}

export interface EquippedGear {
  collar?: GearItem;
  armor?: GearItem;
  paws?: GearItem;
  serum?: GearItem;
}

export interface ConnectedAccountData {
  isLoggedIn: boolean;
  provider: 'Google' | 'Apple' | 'Guest' | string;
  email: string;
  name?: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  sub?: string;
  lastSyncedAt?: string;
}

interface GameContextType {
  // Wallet & Profile
  trainerName: string;
  setTrainerName: (name: string) => void;
  playerTag: string;
  connectedAccount: ConnectedAccountData;
  loginAccount: (provider: string, email?: string, name?: string, avatarUrl?: string, sub?: string) => void;
  logoutAccount: () => void;
  updateUserAvatar: (avatarUrl: string) => void;
  credits: number;
  addCredits: (amount: number) => void;
  energy: number;
  maxEnergy: number;
  trophies: number;
  playerLevel: number;
  playerExp: number;
  playerMaxExp: number;
  wins: number;
  losses: number;
  soundEnabled: boolean;
  toggleSound: () => void;

  // Beasts & 4-Pet Squad Battle Deck
  ownedBeasts: Animal[];
  activeBeast: Animal;
  activeBeastId: string;
  selectActiveBeast: (id: string) => void;
  battleDeckIds: string[];
  setBattleDeckIds: (ids: string[]) => void;
  setDeckSlot: (slotIndex: number, beastId: string) => void;
  trainBeast: (beastId: string, trainingType: 'nutrition' | 'agility' | 'biteForce') => { success: boolean; message: string; leveledUp?: boolean };
  buyBeast: (beast: Animal) => boolean;

  // Custom Pet Champion Registration
  registerCustomFighter: (fighter: Animal) => void;

  // VIP Monetization Passes
  hasAuctionPass: boolean;
  hasAvatarStudioPass: boolean;
  hasExtensionPass: boolean;
  unlockPass: (passType: 'auction' | 'avatar' | 'extension' | 'bundle', useCredits?: boolean) => { success: boolean; message: string };

  // Armory
  equippedGear: EquippedGear;
  inventoryGear: GearItem[];
  buyGear: (item: GearItem) => boolean;
  equipGear: (item: GearItem) => void;
  unequipGear: (slot: 'collar' | 'armor' | 'paws' | 'serum') => void;

  // Combat Outcomes
  recordMatchResult: (won: boolean, opponent: Animal, rounds: number) => { creditsEarned: number; trophiesChange: number; leveledUp?: boolean };
  matchHistory: MatchHistoryEntry[];

  // Achievements
  achievements: Achievement[];
  claimAchievement: (id: string) => void;

  // Utilities
  refillEnergy: () => boolean;
  resetProgress: () => void;
  getEffectiveStats: (beast: Animal) => {
    strength: number;
    speed: number;
    endurance: number;
    agility: number;
    biteForce: number;
    armor: number;
  };
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'petslam_v2_gamestate';

const INITIAL_ACHIEVEMENTS: Achievement[] = [
  {
    id: 'ach_first_blood',
    title: 'First Arena Blood',
    desc: 'Win your first real-time championship combat bout.',
    rewardCredits: 3000,
    claimed: false,
    progress: 1,
    target: 1,
  },
  {
    id: 'ach_apex_trainer',
    title: 'Conditioning Specialist',
    desc: 'Complete 5 training sessions across nutrition or agility.',
    rewardCredits: 4500,
    claimed: false,
    progress: 2,
    target: 5,
  },
  {
    id: 'ach_high_roller',
    title: 'Apex Collector',
    desc: 'Acquire at least 3 distinct animal species in your kennel.',
    rewardCredits: 8000,
    claimed: false,
    progress: 3,
    target: 3,
  },
  {
    id: 'ach_gear_master',
    title: 'Tactical Outfitter',
    desc: 'Equip your active beast with collar, harness, and paw claws.',
    rewardCredits: 5000,
    claimed: false,
    progress: 2,
    target: 3,
  },
  {
    id: 'ach_grandmaster',
    title: 'Championship Contender',
    desc: 'Reach 1,500 MMR trophy rating in the Arena.',
    rewardCredits: 12000,
    claimed: false,
    progress: 1240,
    target: 1500,
  },
];

export const GameContext = createContext<GameContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const GameProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // Starter dogs and cats
  const defaultOwnedBeasts: Animal[] = [
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[0], level: 12 }, // Kaiser (German Shepherd)
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[8], level: 13 }, // Leonidas (Bengal Cat)
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[3], level: 11 }, // Ghost (Siberian Husky)
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[10], level: 11 }, // Mochi (Siamese Cat)
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[1], level: 12 }, // Vulkan (Rottweiler)
    { ...ANIMALS_DATA[11], level: 10 }, // Ginger (Orange Tabby)
  ];

  const [trainerName, setTrainerName] = useState<string>('Nirn');
  const [playerTag] = useState<string>('#SLAM-7749');
  const [connectedAccount, setConnectedAccount] = useState<ConnectedAccountData>(() => {
    try {
      const savedAuth = localStorage.getItem('petslam_auth_account');
      if (savedAuth) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(savedAuth);
        if (parsed.provider === 'Apple') {
          parsed.provider = 'Google';
          try { localStorage.setItem('petslam_auth_account', JSON.stringify(parsed)); } catch {}
        }
        return parsed;
      }
    } catch {}
    return { isLoggedIn: false, provider: 'Guest', email: '' };
  });

  const updateUserAvatar = (avatarUrl: string) => {
    setConnectedAccount((prev) => {
      const next: ConnectedAccountData = {
        ...prev,
        isLoggedIn: true,
        avatarUrl,
        provider: prev.provider === 'Apple' ? 'Google' : prev.provider,
      };
      try {
        localStorage.setItem('petslam_auth_account', JSON.stringify(next));
      } catch {}
      return next;
    });
  };

  const loginAccount = (
    provider: string,
    email?: string,
    name?: string,
    avatarUrl?: string,
    sub?: string
  ) => {
    const acc: ConnectedAccountData = {
      isLoggedIn: true,
      provider,
      email: email || `${provider.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '')}.user@petslam.net`,
      name: name || trainerName,
      avatarUrl: avatarUrl || (provider === 'Google' ? 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=120&q=80' : undefined),
      sub: sub || `usr_${Date.now()}`,
      lastSyncedAt: new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }),
    };
    setConnectedAccount(acc);
    if (name) setTrainerName(name);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('petslam_auth_account', JSON.stringify(acc));
    } catch {}
  };

  const logoutAccount = () => {
    const acc: ConnectedAccountData = { isLoggedIn: false, provider: 'Guest', email: '' };
    setConnectedAccount(acc);
    try {
      localStorage.removeItem('petslam_auth_account');
    } catch {}
    if (supabase) {
      supabase.auth.signOut().catch(() => {});
    }
  };

  // Sync Supabase Auth State (OAuth Redirect & Session Restoration)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!supabase) return;

    // Check active session on initial page mount (e.g. returning from Google OAuth)
    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      if (session?.user) {
        const u = session.user;
        const gName =
          u.user_metadata?.full_name ||
          u.user_metadata?.name ||
          u.user_metadata?.username ||
          u.email?.split('@')[0] ||
          'Trainer';
        const gAvatar = u.user_metadata?.avatar_url || u.user_metadata?.picture;
        loginAccount('Google', u.email, gName, gAvatar, u.id);
      }
    });

    const {
      data: { subscription },
    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event, session) => {
      if (session?.user) {
        const u = session.user;
        const gName =
          u.user_metadata?.full_name ||
          u.user_metadata?.name ||
          u.user_metadata?.username ||
          u.email?.split('@')[0] ||
          'Trainer';
        const gAvatar = u.user_metadata?.avatar_url || u.user_metadata?.picture;
        loginAccount('Google', u.email, gName, gAvatar, u.id);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      subscription.unsubscribe();
    };
  }, []);

  const [credits, setCredits] = useState<number>(24500);
  const addCredits = (amount: number) => {
    setCredits((prev) => Math.max(0, prev + amount));
  };
  const [energy, setEnergy] = useState<number>(85);
  const maxEnergy = 100;
  const [trophies, setTrophies] = useState<number>(1240);
  const [playerLevel, setPlayerLevel] = useState<number>(14);
  const [playerExp, setPlayerExp] = useState<number>(450);
  const playerMaxExp = 1000;
  const [wins, setWins] = useState<number>(18);
  const [losses, setLosses] = useState<number>(4);
  const [soundEnabled, setSoundEnabled] = useState<boolean>(true);

  const [ownedBeasts, setOwnedBeasts] = useState<Animal[]>(defaultOwnedBeasts);
  const [activeBeastId, setActiveBeastId] = useState<string>('dog_01');
  const [battleDeckIds, setBattleDeckIds] = useState<string[]>([
    'dog_01', // Kaiser (German Shepherd) - Slot 1 (Lead Vanguard)
    'cat_01', // Leonidas (Bengal Cat) - Slot 2 (Agile Striker)
    'dog_04', // Ghost (Husky) - Slot 3 (Speed Blitz)
    'cat_03', // Mochi (Siamese) - Slot 4 (Shadow Assassin)
  ]);

  const setDeckSlot = (slotIndex: number, beastId: string) => {
    sound.playClick();
    setBattleDeckIds((prev) => {
      const copy = [...prev];
      copy[slotIndex] = beastId;
      return copy;
    });
  };

  const [hasAuctionPass, setHasAuctionPass] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_pass_auction') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const [hasAvatarStudioPass, setHasAvatarStudioPass] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_pass_avatar') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const [hasExtensionPass, setHasExtensionPass] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    try {
      return localStorage.getItem('petslam_pass_extension') === 'true';
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  });

  const unlockPass = (passType: 'auction' | 'avatar' | 'extension' | 'bundle', useCredits = false) => {
    const creditPrices: Record<string, number> = {
      auction: 1500, // Reduced to $1.99 / 1,500 credits
      avatar: 1000,
      extension: 1500,
      bundle: 3500,
    };

    if (useCredits) {
      const price = creditPrices[passType] || 2500;
      if (credits < price) {
        sound.playClick();
        return { success: false, message: `Need ${price.toLocaleString()} Credits to unlock this pass!` };
      }
      setCredits((prev) => prev - price);
    }

    sound.playLevelUp();

    if (passType === 'auction' || passType === 'bundle') {
      setHasAuctionPass(true);
      try { localStorage.setItem('petslam_pass_auction', 'true'); } catch {}
    }
    if (passType === 'avatar' || passType === 'bundle') {
      setHasAvatarStudioPass(true);
      try { localStorage.setItem('petslam_pass_avatar', 'true'); } catch {}
    }
    if (passType === 'extension' || passType === 'bundle') {
      setHasExtensionPass(true);
      try { localStorage.setItem('petslam_pass_extension', 'true'); } catch {}
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: passType === 'bundle' ? 'All-Access Genesis VIP Bundle Activated!' : `${passType.toUpperCase()} VIP Pass Activated!`,
    };
  };

  // Listen for Dodo Payments success redirects: /?dodo_payment=success&pass=[type]
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    try {
      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const paymentStatus = urlParams.get('dodo_payment');
      const pass = urlParams.get('pass');

      if (paymentStatus === 'success' && pass) {
        unlockPass(pass as any, false);
        trackClarityEvent(`dodo_payment_success_${pass}`);
        setClarityTag('vip_pass_' + pass, 'active');

        // Clean query params from address bar without reloading
        const cleanUrl = window.location.pathname + window.location.hash;
        window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, cleanUrl);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[GameContext] Error parsing payment redirect params:', e);
    }
  }, []);

  const registerCustomFighter = (fighter: Animal) => {
    setOwnedBeasts((prev) => {
      const idx = prev.findIndex((b) => b.id === fighter.id);
      if (idx >= 0) {
        const copy = [...prev];
        copy[idx] = fighter;
        return copy;
      }
      return [fighter, ...prev];
    });

    setActiveBeastId(fighter.id);

    setBattleDeckIds((prev) => {
      const filtered = prev.filter((id) => id !== fighter.id);
      return [fighter.id, ...filtered.slice(0, 3)];
    });

    sound.playVictory();
  };

  const [equippedGear, setEquippedGear] = useState<EquippedGear>({
    collar: GEAR_ITEMS[0], // Titanium Spike Collar
    armor: GEAR_ITEMS[3],  // Kevlar Ballistic Harness
  });

  const [inventoryGear, setInventoryGear] = useState<GearItem[]>([
    GEAR_ITEMS[1], // Carbon Micro-Sensor Collar
    GEAR_ITEMS[6], // Agility Traction Claws
    GEAR_ITEMS[8], // Adrenaline Bio-Stim
  ]);

  const [achievements, setAchievements] = useState<Achievement[]>(INITIAL_ACHIEVEMENTS);

  const [matchHistory, setMatchHistory] = useState<MatchHistoryEntry[]>([
    {
      id: 'match_01',
      timestamp: Date.now() - 3600000 * 2,
      beastName: 'Kaiser',
      opponentName: 'Vulkan (Alex)',
      result: 'VICTORY',
      rounds: 3,
      creditsEarned: 1800,
      trophiesChange: +32,
    },
    {
      id: 'match_02',
      timestamp: Date.now() - 3600000 * 5,
      beastName: 'Fenrir',
      opponentName: 'Sultan (Devon)',
      result: 'VICTORY',
      rounds: 4,
      creditsEarned: 2400,
      trophiesChange: +45,
    },
    {
      id: 'match_03',
      timestamp: Date.now() - 3600000 * 12,
      beastName: 'Kaiser',
      opponentName: 'Khan (Soren)',
      result: 'DEFEAT',
      rounds: 2,
      creditsEarned: 400,
      trophiesChange: -18,
    },
  ]);

  // Load from localStorage if present
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved) {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
        if (parsed.credits !== undefined) setCredits(parsed.credits);
        if (parsed.energy !== undefined) setEnergy(parsed.energy);
        if (parsed.trophies !== undefined) setTrophies(parsed.trophies);
        if (parsed.trainerName) setTrainerName(parsed.trainerName);
        if (parsed.playerLevel) setPlayerLevel(parsed.playerLevel);
        if (parsed.playerExp !== undefined) setPlayerExp(parsed.playerExp);
        if (parsed.wins !== undefined) setWins(parsed.wins);
        if (parsed.losses !== undefined) setLosses(parsed.losses);
        if (parsed.activeBeastId) setActiveBeastId(parsed.activeBeastId);
        const validAnimalIds = new Set(ANIMALS_DATA.map((a) => a.id));
        if (parsed.battleDeckIds && Array.isArray(parsed.battleDeckIds) && parsed.battleDeckIds.length === 4) {
          const cleanDeck = parsed.battleDeckIds.map((id: string, i: number) =>
            validAnimalIds.has(id) ? id : ['dog_01', 'cat_01', 'dog_04', 'cat_03'][i] || 'dog_01'
          );
          setBattleDeckIds(cleanDeck);
        }
        if (parsed.ownedBeasts && parsed.ownedBeasts.length > 0) {
          const cleanOwned = parsed.ownedBeasts.map((b: Animal, i: number) => {
            const matched = ANIMALS_DATA.find((a) => a.id === b.id);
            if (matched) return { ...matched, level: b.level || matched.level };
            return { ...ANIMALS_DATA[i % ANIMALS_DATA.length], level: b.level || 10 };
          });
          setOwnedBeasts(cleanOwned);
        }
        if (parsed.equippedGear) setEquippedGear(parsed.equippedGear);
        if (parsed.inventoryGear) setInventoryGear(parsed.inventoryGear);
        if (parsed.achievements) setAchievements(parsed.achievements);
        if (parsed.matchHistory) setMatchHistory(parsed.matchHistory);
      }
    } catch {
      // Local storage read fallback
    }
  }, []);

  // Save changes
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const state = {
        credits,
        energy,
        trophies,
        trainerName,
        playerLevel,
        playerExp,
        wins,
        losses,
        activeBeastId,
        battleDeckIds,
        ownedBeasts,
        equippedGear,
        inventoryGear,
        achievements,
        matchHistory,
      };
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
    } catch {}
  }, [
    credits,
    energy,
    trophies,
    trainerName,
    playerLevel,
    playerExp,
    wins,
    losses,
    activeBeastId,
    battleDeckIds,
    ownedBeasts,
    equippedGear,
    inventoryGear,
    achievements,
    matchHistory,
  ]);

  // Sound sync
  const toggleSound = () => {
    const next = !soundEnabled;
    setSoundEnabled(next);
    sound.enabled = next;
    if (next) sound.playClick();
  };

  const activeBeast = ownedBeasts.find((b) => b.id === activeBeastId) || ownedBeasts[0];

  const selectActiveBeast = (id: string) => {
    sound.playClick();
    setActiveBeastId(id);
  };

  const getEffectiveStats = (beast: Animal) => {
    let strength = beast.strength;
    let speed = beast.speed;
    let endurance = beast.endurance;
    let agility = beast.agility;
    let biteForce = beast.biteForce || Math.round(beast.strength * 3.5);
    let armor = 0;

    Object.values(equippedGear).forEach((gear) => {
      if (!gear) return;
      if (gear.statBonus.strength) strength += gear.statBonus.strength;
      if (gear.statBonus.speed) speed += gear.statBonus.speed;
      if (gear.statBonus.endurance) endurance += gear.statBonus.endurance;
      if (gear.statBonus.agility) agility += gear.statBonus.agility;
      if (gear.statBonus.biteForce) biteForce += gear.statBonus.biteForce;
      if (gear.statBonus.armor) armor += gear.statBonus.armor;
    });

    return { strength, speed, endurance, agility, biteForce, armor };
  };

  const trainBeast = (beastId: string, type: 'nutrition' | 'agility' | 'biteForce') => {
    const energyCost = 15;
    const creditCost = 800;

    if (energy < energyCost) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Insufficient energy! Refill or await recovery.' };
    }
    if (credits < creditCost) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Insufficient credits! Win arena bouts to earn credits.' };
    }

    setEnergy((prev) => Math.max(0, prev - energyCost));
    setCredits((prev) => prev - creditCost);

    let leveledUp = false;
    let statMessage = '';

    setOwnedBeasts((prev) =>
      prev.map((b) => {
        if (b.id !== beastId) return b;

        const updated = { ...b };
        if (type === 'nutrition') {
          updated.endurance = Math.min(100, updated.endurance + 2);
          statMessage = '+2 Endurance & Vitality conditioning!';
        } else if (type === 'agility') {
          updated.agility = Math.min(100, updated.agility + 2);
          updated.speed = Math.min(100, updated.speed + 1);
          statMessage = '+2 Agility & +1 Sprint reaction!';
        } else if (type === 'biteForce') {
          updated.strength = Math.min(100, updated.strength + 2);
          updated.biteForce = (updated.biteForce || 200) + 15;
          statMessage = '+2 Strength & +15 PSI Bite Force!';
        }

        // Random chance or threshold to level up beast
        if (Math.random() > 0.4) {
          updated.level += 1;
          leveledUp = true;
        }
        return updated;
      })
    );

    if (leveledUp) {
      sound.playLevelUp();
      // Update achievements
      setAchievements((prev) =>
        prev.map((ach) =>
          ach.id === 'ach_apex_trainer' ? { ...ach, progress: Math.min(ach.target, ach.progress + 1) } : ach
        )
      );
      return { success: true, message: `${statMessage} Beast advanced to Level ${activeBeast.level + 1}!`, leveledUp: true };
    } else {
      sound.playClick();
      return { success: true, message: statMessage, leveledUp: false };
    }
  };

  const buyBeast = (beast: Animal) => {
    if (credits < beast.currentPriceCredits) {
      return false;
    }
    setCredits((prev) => prev - beast.currentPriceCredits);
    const newBeast: Animal = {
      ...beast,
      id: `beast_${Date.now()}`,
      acquisitionStatus: 'Reserved',
    };
    setOwnedBeasts((prev) => [...prev, newBeast]);
    setActiveBeastId(newBeast.id);
    sound.playVictory();

    // Update achievement
    setAchievements((prev) =>
      prev.map((ach) =>
        ach.id === 'ach_high_roller' ? { ...ach, progress: Math.min(ach.target, prev.length + 1) } : ach
      )
    );
    return true;
  };

  const buyGear = (item: GearItem) => {
    if (credits < item.price) return false;
    setCredits((prev) => prev - item.price);
    setInventoryGear((prev) => [...prev, item]);
    sound.playClick();
    return true;
  };

  const equipGear = (item: GearItem) => {
    sound.playClick();
    // If something was already equipped in that slot, put it back in inventory
    const existing = equippedGear[item.slot];
    setEquippedGear((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [item.slot]: item,
    }));
    setInventoryGear((prev) => {
      const filtered = prev.filter((g) => g.id !== item.id);
      return existing ? [...filtered, existing] : filtered;
    });

    // Check gear master achievement
    const count = Object.values({ ...equippedGear, [item.slot]: item }).filter(Boolean).length;
    setAchievements((prev) =>
      prev.map((ach) =>
        ach.id === 'ach_gear_master' ? { ...ach, progress: Math.min(ach.target, count) } : ach
      )
    );
  };

  const unequipGear = (slot: 'collar' | 'armor' | 'paws' | 'serum') => {
    const item = equippedGear[slot];
    if (!item) return;
    sound.playClick();
    setEquippedGear((prev) => {
      const copy = { ...prev };
      delete copy[slot];
      return copy;
    });
    setInventoryGear((prev) => [...prev, item]);
  };

  const recordMatchResult = (won: boolean, opponent: Animal, rounds: number) => {
    const rewardCredits = won ? Math.floor(1800 + Math.random() * 800) : 400;
    const trophiesChange = won ? +35 : -15;
    const expGained = won ? 250 : 80;

    setCredits((prev) => prev + rewardCredits);
    setTrophies((prev) => Math.max(0, prev + trophiesChange));
    if (won) {
      setWins((prev) => prev + 1);
      sound.playVictory();
    } else {
      setLosses((prev) => prev + 1);
    }

    let leveledUp = false;
    setPlayerExp((prev) => {
      const total = prev + expGained;
      if (total >= playerMaxExp) {
        setPlayerLevel((lvl) => lvl + 1);
        leveledUp = true;
        sound.playLevelUp();
        return total - playerMaxExp;
      }
      return total;
    });

    const entry: MatchHistoryEntry = {
      id: `match_${Date.now()}`,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      beastName: activeBeast.name,
      opponentName: opponent.name,
      result: won ? 'VICTORY' : 'DEFEAT',
      rounds,
      creditsEarned: rewardCredits,
      trophiesChange,
    };

    setMatchHistory((prev) => [entry, ...prev.slice(0, 19)]);

    // Check First Blood achievement
    if (won) {
      setAchievements((prev) =>
        prev.map((ach) =>
          ach.id === 'ach_first_blood' ? { ...ach, progress: 1 } : ach
        )
      );
    }

    return { creditsEarned: rewardCredits, trophiesChange, leveledUp };
  };

  const claimAchievement = (id: string) => {
    const target = achievements.find((a) => a.id === id);
    if (!target || target.claimed || target.progress < target.target) return;
    sound.playVictory();
    setCredits((prev) => prev + target.rewardCredits);
    setAchievements((prev) =>
      prev.map((a) => (a.id === id ? { ...a, claimed: true } : a))
    );
  };

  const refillEnergy = () => {
    const cost = 1200;
    if (credits < cost || energy >= maxEnergy) return false;
    sound.playClick();
    setCredits((prev) => prev - cost);
    setEnergy(maxEnergy);
    return true;
  };

  const resetProgress = () => {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    window.location.reload();
  };

  return (
    <GameContext.Provider
      value={{
        trainerName,
        setTrainerName,
        playerTag,
        connectedAccount,
        loginAccount,
        logoutAccount,
        updateUserAvatar,
        credits,
        addCredits,
        energy,
        maxEnergy,
        trophies,
        playerLevel,
        playerExp,
        playerMaxExp,
        wins,
        losses,
        soundEnabled,
        toggleSound,
        ownedBeasts,
        activeBeast,
        activeBeastId,
        selectActiveBeast,
        battleDeckIds,
        setBattleDeckIds,
        setDeckSlot,
        trainBeast,
        buyBeast,
        equippedGear,
        inventoryGear,
        buyGear,
        equipGear,
        unequipGear,
        recordMatchResult,
        matchHistory,
        achievements,
        claimAchievement,
        refillEnergy,
        resetProgress,
        getEffectiveStats,
        hasAuctionPass,
        hasAvatarStudioPass,
        hasExtensionPass,
        unlockPass,
        registerCustomFighter,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </GameContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useGame = () => {
  const context = useContext(GameContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useGame must be used within a GameProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

</document_content>
</document>

  // Backwards Compatibility Aliases
  kodiak: {

    category: 'dog',
    baseStats: { attack: 52, defense: 64, agility: 34, stamina: 65, cp: 390 },
    buff: {
      name: 'Bulldog Tenacity',
      description: '+18% Battle Damage Reduction',
      effectType: 'damage_shield',
      potency: 18,
    },
  },
  bagheera: {
    name: 'Midnight',
    title: 'Shadow Whiskers',
    category: 'cat',
    baseStats: { attack: 62, defense: 35, agility: 68, stamina: 45, cp: 450 },
    buff: {
      name: 'Night Stalker',
      description: '+18% Stealth Ambush Damage',
      effectType: 'crit_chance',
      potency: 18,
    },
  },
  ignis: {
    name: 'Vulkan',
    title: 'Crushing Enforcer',
    category: 'dog',
    baseStats: { attack: 62, defense: 64, agility: 42, stamina: 70, cp: 460 },
    buff: {
      name: 'Bone Crusher',
      description: '+18% Heavy Strike Stun Impact',
      effectType: 'crit_chance',
