    },
  },
  sultan: {
    name: 'Kaiser',
    title: 'Tactical Vanguard',
    category: 'dog',
    baseStats: { attack: 54, defense: 52, agility: 58, stamina: 64, cp: 440 },
    buff: {
      name: 'Tactical Clamp',
      description: '+15% Damage Shield & Disarm',
      effectType: 'damage_shield',
      potency: 15,
    },
  },
};

export const createInitialPet = (species: PetSpecies = 'shiba'): CompanionPet => {
  const config = SPECIES_CONFIG[species] || SPECIES_CONFIG.shiba;
  return {
    id: `pet_${species}_${Date.now()}`,
    species,
    category: config.category,
    name: config.name,
    title: config.title,
    stage: 1, // Baby Cub / Kitten / Puppy
    level: 1,
    exp: 0,
    maxExp: 100,
    affectionHearts: 1, // Good Buddy
    affectionPoints: 25,
    hunger: 80,
    happiness: 90,
    energy: 95,
    mood: 'playful',
    stats: { ...config.baseStats },
    battleBuff: { ...config.buff },
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    lastFedAt: Date.now(),
    lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
    totalPats: 0,
    totalBerriesEaten: 0,
    caughtAt: 'Sanctuary Meadow',
  };
};

interface PetCompanionContextType {
  pet: CompanionPet;
  kennelPets: CompanionPet[];
  isOverlayActive: boolean;
  setOverlayActive: (active: boolean) => void;
  toggleOverlay: () => void;
  feedPet: (berry: BerryItem) => { success: boolean; message: string };
  strokePet: () => { heartsEarned: number; leveledUpHeart: boolean };
  trainPet: (attribute: 'attack' | 'defense' | 'agility') => { success: boolean; expGained: number };
  playFetch: () => void;
  evolvePet: () => { success: boolean; newStage: PetStage };
  switchSpecies: (species: PetSpecies) => void;
  switchActivePet: (petId: string) => void;
  renamePet: (name: string) => void;
  resetPet: () => void;
  availableBerries: BerryItem[];

  // Pokemon GO Wild Catch System
  wildEncounters: WildPetEncounter[];
  activeEncounter: WildPetEncounter | null;
  startEncounter: (encounter: WildPetEncounter) => void;
  exitEncounter: () => void;
  catchWildPet: (
    encounter: WildPetEncounter,
    ballBonus: number,
    usedBerry?: BerryItem
  ) => { outcome: 'caught' | 'broke_free' | 'fled'; caughtPet?: CompanionPet };
  refreshWildSpawns: () => void;

  // Pet Auction House & Marketplace
  auctions: PetAuctionItem[];
  marketFeedEvents: MarketActivityEvent[];
  placeAuctionBid: (auctionId: string, bidAmount: number) => { success: boolean; message: string };
  buyoutAuction: (auctionId: string) => { success: boolean; message: string; boughtPet?: CompanionPet };
  listPetForAuction: (
    petId: string,
    startingBid: number,
    buyoutPrice: number,
    hours: number,
    notes?: string
  ) => { success: boolean; message: string };
  cancelUserAuction: (auctionId: string) => { success: boolean; message: string };
  addCustomAvatarPet: (newPet: CompanionPet) => void;
  addKennelPet: (newPet: CompanionPet) => void;
}

const PetCompanionContext = createContext<PetCompanionContextType | null>(null);

export const PetCompanionProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  // 1. Kennel of all owned pets
  const [kennelPets, setKennelPets] = useState<CompanionPet[]>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(KENNEL_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Could not parse kennel data:', err);
      }
    }
    // Default kennel with Shiba Inu starter
    return [createInitialPet('shiba'), createInitialPet('tabby')];
  });

  // 2. Active buddy pet
  const [pet, setPet] = useState<CompanionPet>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Could not parse saved pet data:', err);
      }
    }
    return kennelPets[0] || createInitialPet('shiba');
  });

  // 3. Desktop overlay active
  const [isOverlayActive, setIsOverlayActive] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(OVERLAY_STORAGE_KEY);
      return saved === null ? true : saved === 'true';
    }
    return true;
  });

  // 4. Wild Encounters
  const [wildEncounters, setWildEncounters] = useState<WildPetEncounter[]>(INITIAL_WILD_ENCOUNTERS);
  const [activeEncounter, setActiveEncounter] = useState<WildPetEncounter | null>(null);

  // 5. Auctions
  const [auctions, setAuctions] = useState<PetAuctionItem[]>(() => {
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      try {
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(AUCTIONS_STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) return JSON.parse(saved);
      } catch {}
    }
    return INITIAL_AUCTIONS;
  });

  // 6. Live Market Activity Feed
  const [marketFeedEvents, setMarketFeedEvents] = useState<MarketActivityEvent[]>(INITIAL_MARKET_FEED);

  // Background Simulated Community Bidding & Market Activity Feed
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setAuctions((prev) => {
        const activeAuctions = prev.filter((a) => a.status === 'active' && !a.isUserListing);
        if (activeAuctions.length === 0) return prev;

        const target = activeAuctions[Math.floor(Math.random() * activeAuctions.length)];
        const communityTrainers = [
          'Valkyrie99',
          'NeonClaw',
          'DojoMaster',
          'CyberWolf',
          'HyperBeast',
          'SolarisTrainer',
          'ApexSamurai',
          'TokyoRider',
        ];
        const randomTrainer = communityTrainers[Math.floor(Math.random() * communityTrainers.length)];
        if (target.highestBidder === `@${randomTrainer}`) return prev;

        const step = Math.max(100, Math.round(target.currentBid * 0.08));
        const newBid = target.currentBid + step;
        if (newBid >= target.buyoutPrice) return prev;

        const newEntry: BidHistoryEntry = {
          id: `bid_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6)}`,
          bidder: `@${randomTrainer}`,
          amount: newBid,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          isUser: false,
        };

        const newFeedEvent: MarketActivityEvent = {
          id: `feed_${Date.now()}`,
          type: 'bid',
          petName: target.pet.name,
          species: target.pet.species,
          actor: randomTrainer,
          amount: newBid,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          description: `@${randomTrainer} placed a bid of ${newBid.toLocaleString()} 🪙 on ${target.pet.name}!`,
        };

        setMarketFeedEvents((f) => [newFeedEvent, ...f.slice(0, 29)]);

        return prev.map((a) =>
          a.id === target.id
            ? {
                ...a,
                currentBid: newBid,
                minNextBid: newBid + Math.round(newBid * 0.08),
                bidCount: a.bidCount + 1,
                highestBidder: `@${randomTrainer}`,
                bidHistory: [newEntry, ...(a.bidHistory || [])],
              }
            : a
        );
      });
    }, 15000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // Save pet to storage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(pet));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save pet', e);
    }
  }, [pet]);

  // Save kennel to storage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(KENNEL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(kennelPets));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save kennel', e);
    }
  }, [kennelPets]);

  // Save overlay to storage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(OVERLAY_STORAGE_KEY, String(isOverlayActive));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save overlay', e);
    }
  }, [isOverlayActive]);

  // Save auctions to storage
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(AUCTIONS_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(auctions));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save auctions', e);
    }
  }, [auctions]);

  // Passive decay & mood clock
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setPet((prev) => {
        const newHunger = Math.max(0, prev.hunger - 1);
        let newMood: PetMood = prev.mood;

        if (newHunger <= 20) {
          newMood = 'hungry';
        } else if (prev.energy <= 20) {
          newMood = 'sleepy';
        } else if (prev.happiness >= 75) {
          newMood = 'happy';
        } else {
          newMood = 'playful';
        }

        const updated = {
          ...prev,
          hunger: newHunger,
          mood: newMood,
        };

        // Sync in kennel
        setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
        return updated;
      });
    }, 45000);

    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const toggleOverlay = useCallback(() => {
    sound.playClick();
    setIsOverlayActive((prev) => !prev);
  }, []);

  const setOverlayActive = useCallback((active: boolean) => {
    setIsOverlayActive(active);
  }, []);

  // Feeding action
  const feedPet = useCallback((berry: BerryItem) => {
    sound.playEat();
    let leveledUp = false;

    setPet((prev) => {
      const newHunger = Math.min(100, prev.hunger + berry.hungerRestore);
      const newHappiness = Math.min(100, prev.happiness + berry.happinessRestore);
      let newExp = prev.exp + berry.expReward;
      let newLevel = prev.level;
      let newMaxExp = prev.maxExp;

      while (newExp >= newMaxExp) {
        newExp -= newMaxExp;
        newLevel += 1;
        newMaxExp = Math.round(newMaxExp * 1.35);
        leveledUp = true;
      }

      let newAffectionPoints = prev.affectionPoints + 15;
      let newAffectionHearts = prev.affectionHearts;
      if (newAffectionPoints >= 100 && newAffectionHearts < 4) {
        newAffectionPoints -= 100;
        newAffectionHearts = Math.min(4, newAffectionHearts + 1);
      }

      const updated: CompanionPet = {
        ...prev,
        hunger: newHunger,
        happiness: newHappiness,
        exp: newExp,
        level: newLevel,
        maxExp: newMaxExp,
        affectionHearts: newAffectionHearts,
        affectionPoints: newAffectionPoints,
        mood: 'happy',
        lastFedAt: Date.now(),
        totalBerriesEaten: prev.totalBerriesEaten + 1,
      };

      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });

    if (leveledUp) {
      sound.playLevelUp();
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `${pet.name} loved the ${berry.name}! +${berry.hungerRestore} Hunger, +${berry.expReward} EXP`,
    };
  }, [pet.name]);

  // Tactile Petting / Stroking action
  const strokePet = useCallback(() => {
    if (['tabby', 'calico', 'siamese', 'blackcat', 'bagheera'].includes(pet.species)) {
      sound.playPurr();
    } else {
      sound.playBark();
    }

    let leveledUpHeart = false;
    const earned = 4;

    setPet((prev) => {
      const newHappiness = Math.min(100, prev.happiness + 6);
      let newAffectionPoints = prev.affectionPoints + earned;
      let newAffectionHearts = prev.affectionHearts;

      if (newAffectionPoints >= 100 && newAffectionHearts < 4) {
        newAffectionPoints -= 100;
        newAffectionHearts = (newAffectionHearts + 1) as 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;
        leveledUpHeart = true;
      }

      const updated: CompanionPet = {
        ...prev,
        happiness: newHappiness,
        affectionPoints: newAffectionPoints,
        affectionHearts: newAffectionHearts,
        mood: 'happy',
        lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
        totalPats: prev.totalPats + 1,
      };

      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });

    if (leveledUpHeart) {
      sound.playVictory();
    }

    return {
      heartsEarned: earned,
      leveledUpHeart,
    };
  }, [pet.species]);

  // Gym training
  const trainPet = useCallback((attribute: 'attack' | 'defense' | 'agility') => {
    sound.playAttack();
    const expGained = 40;

    setPet((prev) => {
      const newStats = { ...prev.stats };
      newStats[attribute] += 2;
      newStats.cp += 15;

      let newExp = prev.exp + expGained;
      let newLevel = prev.level;
      let newMaxExp = prev.maxExp;

      while (newExp >= newMaxExp) {
        newExp -= newMaxExp;
        newLevel += 1;
        newMaxExp = Math.round(newMaxExp * 1.35);
      }

      const updated: CompanionPet = {
        ...prev,
        stats: newStats,
        exp: newExp,
        level: newLevel,
        maxExp: newMaxExp,
        energy: Math.max(0, prev.energy - 10),
        mood: 'battle_ready',
      };

      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });

    return { success: true, expGained };
  }, []);

  // Play fetch
  const playFetch = useCallback(() => {
    sound.playClick();
    setPet((prev) => {
      const updated = {
        ...prev,
        happiness: Math.min(100, prev.happiness + 20),
        energy: Math.max(0, prev.energy - 15),
        mood: 'playful' as PetMood,
      };
      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  // Evolve Pet
  const evolvePet = useCallback(() => {
    if (pet.stage >= 3) {
      return { success: false, newStage: pet.stage };
    }

    const nextStage = (pet.stage + 1) as PetStage;
    sound.playVictory();

    setPet((prev) => {
      const boostedStats = {
        attack: Math.round(prev.stats.attack * 1.4),
        defense: Math.round(prev.stats.defense * 1.4),
        agility: Math.round(prev.stats.agility * 1.35),
        stamina: Math.round(prev.stats.stamina * 1.5),
        cp: Math.round(prev.stats.cp * 1.55),
      };

      const boostedBuff = {
        ...prev.battleBuff,
        potency: prev.battleBuff.potency + 6,
      };

      const updated: CompanionPet = {
        ...prev,
        stage: nextStage,
        stats: boostedStats,
        battleBuff: boostedBuff,
        level: prev.level + 2,
        mood: 'battle_ready',
      };

      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });

    return { success: true, newStage: nextStage };
  }, [pet.stage]);

  // Switch companion species
  const switchSpecies = useCallback((species: PetSpecies) => {
    sound.playClick();
    const newPet = createInitialPet(species);
    setPet(newPet);
    setKennelPets((prev) => {
      if (!prev.some((p) => p.species === species)) {
        return [newPet, ...prev];
      }
      return prev;
    });
  }, []);

  // Switch active pet by ID from kennel
  const switchActivePet = useCallback((petId: string) => {
    const target = kennelPets.find((p) => p.id === petId);
    if (target) {
      sound.playClick();
      setPet(target);
    }
  }, [kennelPets]);

  const renamePet = useCallback((name: string) => {
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    const cleanName = name.trim();
    setPet((prev) => {
      const updated = { ...prev, name: cleanName };
      setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === prev.id ? updated : p)));
      return updated;
    });
  }, []);

  const resetPet = useCallback(() => {
    const refreshed = createInitialPet(pet.species);
    setPet(refreshed);
    setKennelPets((kp) => kp.map((p) => (p.id === pet.id ? refreshed : p)));
  }, [pet.id, pet.species]);

  // --- POKEMON GO WILD CATCH LOGIC ---
  const startEncounter = useCallback((encounter: WildPetEncounter) => {
    sound.playClick();
    setActiveEncounter(encounter);
  }, []);

  const exitEncounter = useCallback(() => {
    setActiveEncounter(null);
  }, []);

  const catchWildPet = useCallback(
    (
      encounter: WildPetEncounter,
      ballBonus: number, // 1.0 (Nice), 1.3 (Great), 1.7 (Excellent)
      usedBerry?: BerryItem
    ) => {
      const berryMultiplier = usedBerry?.catchBonus || 1.0;
      const finalCatchChance = Math.min(
        0.95,
        encounter.baseCatchRate * ballBonus * berryMultiplier
      );

      const roll = Math.random();

      if (roll <= finalCatchChance) {
        // Success! Caught the wild pet!
        sound.playPokeBallCatch();

        const config = SPECIES_CONFIG[encounter.species] || SPECIES_CONFIG.shiba;
        const newCaughtPet: CompanionPet = {
          id: `caught_${encounter.species}_${Date.now()}`,
          species: encounter.species,
          category: encounter.category,
          name: encounter.name.replace('Wild ', ''),
          title: encounter.title,
          stage: 1,
          level: encounter.level,
          exp: 0,
          maxExp: 100,
          affectionHearts: 1,
          affectionPoints: 10,
          hunger: 70,
          happiness: 85,
          energy: 90,
          mood: 'happy',
          stats: { ...encounter.stats },
          battleBuff: { ...config.buff },
          createdAt: Date.now(),
          lastFedAt: Date.now(),
          lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
          totalPats: 0,
          totalBerriesEaten: usedBerry ? 1 : 0,
          caughtAt: 'Wild Radar Encounter',
        };

        // Add to kennel collection
        setKennelPets((prev) => [newCaughtPet, ...prev]);

        // Remove from wild spawns
        setWildEncounters((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== encounter.id));
        setActiveEncounter(null);

        return { outcome: 'caught' as const, caughtPet: newCaughtPet };
      } else {
        // Broke free
        const fleeRoll = Math.random();
        if (fleeRoll < 0.25) {
          // Pet fled
          setWildEncounters((prev) => prev.filter((e) => e.id !== encounter.id));
          setActiveEncounter(null);
          return { outcome: 'fled' as const };
        } else {
          sound.playPokeBallShake();
          return { outcome: 'broke_free' as const };
        }
      }
    },
    []
  );

  const refreshWildSpawns = useCallback(() => {
    sound.playClick();
    const speciesPool: PetSpecies[] = [
      'shiba',
      'retriever',
      'husky',
      'bulldog',
      'tabby',
      'calico',
      'siamese',
      'blackcat',
    ];

    const newSpawns: WildPetEncounter[] = Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, idx) => {
      const sp = speciesPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * speciesPool.length)];
      const conf = SPECIES_CONFIG[sp];
      const lvl = Math.floor(Math.random() * 8) + 1;
      const cpVal = 250 + lvl * 55 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 60);
      const isRare = lvl > 5;

      return {
        id: `wild_${sp}_${Date.now()}_${idx}`,
        species: sp,
        category: conf.category,
        name: `Wild ${conf.name} the ${conf.category === 'cat' ? 'Cat' : 'Dog'}`,
        title: conf.title,
        cp: cpVal,
        level: lvl,
        rarity: isRare ? 'rare' : 'common',
        baseCatchRate: isRare ? 0.45 : 0.7,
        distanceMeters: Math.floor(Math.random() * 150) + 20,
        spawnTimeRemaining: 600 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 300),
        stats: {
          ...conf.baseStats,
          attack: conf.baseStats.attack + lvl * 3,
          defense: conf.baseStats.defense + lvl * 3,
          agility: conf.baseStats.agility + lvl * 3,
          stamina: conf.baseStats.stamina + lvl * 3,
          cp: cpVal,
        },
      };
    });

    setWildEncounters(newSpawns);
  }, []);

  // --- AUCTION HOUSE ACTIONS ---
  const placeAuctionBid = useCallback((auctionId: string, bidAmount: number) => {
    let success = false;
    let message = '';

    setAuctions((prev) =>
      prev.map((auc) => {
        if (auc.id !== auctionId) return auc;
        if (bidAmount < auc.minNextBid) {
          message = `Bid must be at least ${auc.minNextBid.toLocaleString()} Credits!`;
          return auc;
        }

        sound.playCoin();
        success = true;
        message = `Bid of ${bidAmount.toLocaleString()} Credits placed successfully for ${auc.pet.name}!`;

        const userBidEntry: BidHistoryEntry = {
          id: `bid_${Date.now()}`,
          bidder: 'You (Trainer)',
          amount: bidAmount,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          isUser: true,
        };

        const feedEvt: MarketActivityEvent = {
          id: `feed_${Date.now()}`,
          type: 'bid',
          petName: auc.pet.name,
          species: auc.pet.species,
          actor: 'You',
          amount: bidAmount,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          description: `You placed a bid of ${bidAmount.toLocaleString()} 🪙 on ${auc.pet.name}!`,
        };
        setMarketFeedEvents((f) => [feedEvt, ...f.slice(0, 29)]);

        return {
          ...auc,
          currentBid: bidAmount,
          minNextBid: bidAmount + Math.max(50, Math.round(bidAmount * 0.08)),
          bidCount: auc.bidCount + 1,
          highestBidder: 'You (Trainer)',
          bidHistory: [userBidEntry, ...(auc.bidHistory || [])],
        };
      })
    );

    return { success, message };
  }, []);

  const buyoutAuction = useCallback((auctionId: string) => {
    let success = false;
    let message = '';
    let boughtPet: CompanionPet | undefined;

    setAuctions((prev) =>
      prev.map((auc) => {
        if (auc.id !== auctionId) return auc;
        sound.playVictory();
        success = true;
        message = `Instantly bought out ${auc.pet.name}! Transferred to your Kennel.`;
        boughtPet = auc.pet;

        const buyoutEvt: MarketActivityEvent = {
          id: `feed_${Date.now()}`,
          type: 'buyout',
          petName: auc.pet.name,
          species: auc.pet.species,
          actor: 'You',
          amount: auc.buyoutPrice,
          timestamp: Date.now(),
          description: `You executed Instant Buyout on ${auc.pet.name} (${auc.buyoutPrice.toLocaleString()} 🪙)!`,
        };
        setMarketFeedEvents((f) => [buyoutEvt, ...f.slice(0, 29)]);

        // Add bought pet to kennel
        setKennelPets((kp) => [auc.pet, ...kp]);

        return {
          ...auc,
          status: 'sold',
          highestBidder: 'You (Buyout Winner)',
        };
      })
    );

    return { success, message, boughtPet };
  }, []);

  const listPetForAuction = useCallback(
    (petId: string, startingBid: number, buyoutPrice: number, hours: number, notes?: string) => {
      const targetPet = kennelPets.find((p) => p.id === petId);
      if (!targetPet) {
        return { success: false, message: 'Pet not found in your kennel.' };
      }

      if (kennelPets.length <= 1) {
        return { success: false, message: 'You cannot sell your only companion pet!' };
      }

      const newListing: PetAuctionItem = {
        id: `auc_user_${Date.now()}`,
        pet: targetPet,
        sellerName: 'You (Owner)',
        isUserListing: true,
        currentBid: startingBid,
        minNextBid: Math.round(startingBid * 1.1),
        buyoutPrice,
        bidCount: 0,
        highestBidder: 'None yet',
        endTime: Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60 * hours,
        status: 'active',
        notes: notes || `Caught wild ${targetPet.species} with CP ${targetPet.stats.cp}.`,
        bidHistory: [],
      };

      const listingEvt: MarketActivityEvent = {
        id: `feed_${Date.now()}`,
        type: 'listing',
        petName: targetPet.name,
        species: targetPet.species,
        actor: 'You',
        amount: startingBid,
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        description: `You listed ${targetPet.name} (${targetPet.title}) for auction!`,
      };
      setMarketFeedEvents((f) => [listingEvt, ...f.slice(0, 29)]);

      sound.playCoin();
      setAuctions((prev) => [newListing, ...prev]);

      // Remove from active kennel while on auction
      setKennelPets((prev) => prev.filter((p) => p.id !== petId));

      // If active pet was listed, switch active pet to another
      if (pet.id === petId) {
        const remaining = kennelPets.filter((p) => p.id !== petId);
        if (remaining.length > 0) {
          setPet(remaining[0]);
        }
      }

      return {
        success: true,
        message: `${targetPet.name} has been listed on the Pet Auction House!`,
      };
    },
    [kennelPets, pet.id]
  );

  const cancelUserAuction = useCallback(
    (auctionId: string) => {
      const target = auctions.find((a) => a.id === auctionId);
      if (!target || !target.isUserListing) {
        return { success: false, message: 'Cannot cancel this auction.' };
      }

      sound.playClick();
      // Return pet to kennel
      setKennelPets((prev) => [target.pet, ...prev]);
      setAuctions((prev) => prev.filter((a) => a.id !== auctionId));

      return { success: true, message: `${target.pet.name} was returned to your kennel.` };
    },
    [auctions]
  );

  // Add custom photo avatar pet to kennel & set as active companion
  const addCustomAvatarPet = useCallback((newPet: CompanionPet) => {
    setKennelPets((prev) => {
      const filtered = prev.filter((p) => p.id !== newPet.id);
      const updated = [newPet, ...filtered];
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(KENNEL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(updated));
      } catch (err) {}
      return updated;
    });

    setPet(newPet);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(newPet));
    } catch (err) {}

    sound.playLevelUp();
  }, []);

  return (
    <PetCompanionContext.Provider
      value={{
        pet,
        kennelPets,
        isOverlayActive,
        setOverlayActive,
        toggleOverlay,
        feedPet,
        strokePet,
        trainPet,
        playFetch,
        evolvePet,
        switchSpecies,
        switchActivePet,
        renamePet,
        resetPet,
        availableBerries: BERRIES,

        // Wild Catching
        wildEncounters,
        activeEncounter,
        startEncounter,
        exitEncounter,
        catchWildPet,
        refreshWildSpawns,

        // Auction House & Marketplace
        auctions,
        marketFeedEvents,
        placeAuctionBid,
        buyoutAuction,
        listPetForAuction,
        cancelUserAuction,
        addCustomAvatarPet,
        addKennelPet: addCustomAvatarPet,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </PetCompanionContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const usePetCompanion = (): PetCompanionContextType => {
  const context = useContext(PetCompanionContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('usePetCompanion must be used within a PetCompanionProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

  image: string;

  acquisitionStatus: 'Available' | 'In Auction' | 'Reserved';

  combatArchetype: 'Heavy Grappler' | 'Precision Striker' | 'Speed Skirmisher' | 'Crushing Enforcer';

<source>src/index.css</source>
<document_content>
@import "tailwindcss";

@custom-variant dark (&:where(.dark, .dark *));

@theme {
  --font-display: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
  --color-brand-lime: #CCFF00;
  --color-brand-orange: #FF5500;
  --color-brand-cyan: #00F0FF;
  --color-brand-magenta: #FF007A;
  --color-dark-950: #0B0E14;
  --color-dark-900: #0F1420;
  --color-dark-850: #151C2C;
  --color-dark-800: #1D253A;
  --color-dark-750: #26314D;
  --color-dark-700: #323F63;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-body);
  @apply text-slate-900 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-[#0B0E14] dark:text-slate-50 transition-colors duration-300;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  position: relative;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

#root {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  min-height: 100%;
  overflow-x: hidden;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, .font-display {
  font-family: var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
}

/* High-Contrast Neon Text & Accent Utilities */
.neon-cyan-text {
  color: #00F0FF;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.65), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95);
}

.neon-magenta-text {
  color: #FF007A;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 0, 122, 0.65), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95);
}

.neon-lime-text {
  color: #CCFF00;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.6), 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95);
}

/* Dual-Theme Ultra-Crisp High-Contrast Glass Panels */
.glass-panel-elevated {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  border: 1px solid rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.9);
  color: #0F172A;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}

.dark .glass-panel-elevated {
  background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.94);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  color: #FFFFFF;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 32px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
}

.glass-panel-accent {
  background: rgba(248, 250, 252, 0.95);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.7);
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.2);
  color: #0F172A;
  backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
}

.dark .glass-panel-accent {
  background: rgba(14, 20, 34, 0.94);
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.4);
  box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.2);
  color: #FFFFFF;
}

/* Enhanced high-contrast scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
  height: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #F1F5F9;
}
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: #090C14;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #94A3B8;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.dark ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #334155;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
  background: #64748B;
}

@keyframes floatUp {
  0% {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
  100% {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-40px) scale(1.15);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.97);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

.animate-floatUp {
  animation: floatUp 0.85s ease-out forwards;
}

.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.18s ease-out forwards;
}

@keyframes hoverFloat {
  0%, 100% {
    transform: translateY(0px);
  }
  50% {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
  }
}

.animate-hover-float {
  animation: hoverFloat 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* =========================================================================
   ANIMATED CLASH BATTLE ARENA KEYFRAMES & UTILITIES
   ========================================================================= */

@keyframes arenaShake {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
  20% { transform: translate(-4px, 3px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
  40% { transform: translate(4px, -3px) rotate(0.5deg); }
  60% { transform: translate(-3px, 2px) rotate(-0.3deg); }
  80% { transform: translate(3px, -2px) rotate(0.3deg); }
  100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
}

@keyframes clawSlash {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6) rotate(-25deg); }
  45% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.15) rotate(-15deg); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.35) rotate(-8deg); }
}

@keyframes shockwaveExpand {
  0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.2); }
  70% { opacity: 0.85; transform: scale(1.6); }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.5); }
}

@keyframes spotlightLeft {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(-20deg); opacity: 0.25; }
  50% { transform: rotate(18deg); opacity: 0.45; }
}

@keyframes spotlightRight {
  0%, 100% { transform: rotate(20deg); opacity: 0.25; }
  50% { transform: rotate(-18deg); opacity: 0.45; }
}

@keyframes lungeUpward {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  40% { transform: translateY(-42px) scale(1.16); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

@keyframes lungeDownward {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  40% { transform: translateY(42px) scale(1.16); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

@keyframes slamHighJump {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
  30% { transform: translateY(-68px) scale(1.35) rotate(6deg); }
  60% { transform: translateY(-68px) scale(1.35) rotate(-6deg); }
  85% { transform: translateY(-6px) scale(1.22); }
  100% { transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
}

@keyframes damageFlinch {
  0% { transform: translate(0, 0); filter: brightness(1); }
  20% { transform: translate(-5px, 5px); filter: brightness(2.2) drop-shadow(0 0 12px #ff3b30); }
  40% { transform: translate(5px, -4px); filter: brightness(1.8) drop-shadow(0 0 10px #ff3b30); }
  60% { transform: translate(-3px, 3px); filter: brightness(1.3); }
  100% { transform: translate(0, 0); filter: brightness(1); }
}

@keyframes sonicPulse {
  0% { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(0.4); border-width: 4px; }
  100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(2.2); border-width: 1px; }
}

.animate-arenaShake {
  animation: arenaShake 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.36, 0.07, 0.19, 0.97) both;
}

.animate-clawSlash {
  animation: clawSlash 0.45s ease-out forwards;
}

.animate-shockwaveExpand {
  animation: shockwaveExpand 0.6s ease-out forwards;
}

.animate-spotlightLeft {
  animation: spotlightLeft 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-spotlightRight {
  animation: spotlightRight 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.animate-lungeUpward {
  animation: lungeUpward 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.4, 1);
}

.animate-lungeDownward {
  animation: lungeDownward 0.38s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.4, 1);
}

.animate-slamHighJump {
  animation: slamHighJump 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
}

.animate-damageFlinch {
  animation: damageFlinch 0.38s ease-out;
}

.animate-sonicPulse {
  animation: sonicPulse 0.55s ease-out forwards;
}

<document_content>
import { WebSocketServer, WebSocket } from 'ws';
import type { IncomingMessage, Server } from 'http';
import crypto from 'crypto';

// Types for Authoritative Netcode
export interface CombatMove {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  cost: number;
  damage: number;
  cooldownTicks: number;
  effect?: 'stun' | 'bleed' | 'shield' | 'burn';
}

export interface FighterEntity {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  species: string;
  level: number;
  hp: number;
  maxHp: number;
  energy: number;
  maxEnergy: number;
  damage: number;
  defense: number;
  speed: number;
  cp: number;
  image?: string;
  avatarImageUrl?: string;
  cooldowns: Record<string, number>; // moveId -> tick available
  isOverdrive: boolean;
  overdriveTicksLeft: number;
}

export interface PlayerNetState {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  rating: number; // Elo
  cp: number;
  socket: WebSocket | null;
  isAi: boolean;
  fighter: FighterEntity;
  lastActionSecond: number;
  actionCountInSecond: number;
  ready: boolean;
}

export interface CombatEventLog {
  tick: number;
  text: string;
  type: 'hit' | 'crit' | 'overdrive' | 'shield' | 'ko' | 'system';
}

export interface CombatRoom {
  id: string;
  p1: PlayerNetState;
  p2: PlayerNetState;
  state: 'waiting' | 'countdown' | 'fighting' | 'finished';
  countdown: number;
  tick: number;
  winnerId: string | null;
  logs: CombatEventLog[];
  interval: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
  createdAt: number;
}

const DEFAULT_MOVES: Record<string, CombatMove> = {
  strike: { id: 'strike', name: 'Kinetic Strike', cost: 2, damage: 75, cooldownTicks: 10 },
  pounce: { id: 'pounce', name: 'Apex Pounce', cost: 3, damage: 130, cooldownTicks: 25 },
  rend: { id: 'rend', name: 'Fang Rend', cost: 4, damage: 195, cooldownTicks: 40, effect: 'bleed' },
  overdrive: { id: 'overdrive', name: 'Overdrive Surge', cost: 6, damage: 0, cooldownTicks: 100, effect: 'shield' },
};

export class AuthoritativeCombatServer {
  private wss: WebSocketServer | null = null;
  private matchmakingQueue: PlayerNetState[] = [];
  private activeRooms: Map<string, CombatRoom> = new Map();
  private socketToPlayer: Map<WebSocket, PlayerNetState> = new Map();

  public init(server: Server) {
    this.wss = new WebSocketServer({
      server,
      path: '/socket',
      verifyClient: (info: { origin: string; req: IncomingMessage }, callback: (res: boolean) => void) => {
        // Strict CORS check: Allow petslam.app, cloudflare pages, and dev localhost
        const origin = info.origin || info.req.headers.origin || '';
        const allowedOrigins = [
          'https://petslam.app',
          'https://www.petslam.app',
          'https://petslam.pages.dev',
          'http://localhost:3000',
          'http://localhost:5173',
          'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
        ];

        // Also allow local mobile WebView origins (Capacitor/Tauri) which send capacitor:// or tauri:// or null
        const isLocalApp =
          !origin ||
          origin.startsWith('capacitor://') ||
          origin.startsWith('tauri://') ||
          origin.startsWith('http://localhost') ||
          origin.startsWith('http://127.0.0.1');

        if (isLocalApp || allowedOrigins.includes(origin) || origin.endsWith('.petslam.pages.dev')) {
          callback(true);
        } else {
          console.warn(`[AuthoritativeNetcode] Rejected WS connection from unauthorized origin: ${origin}`);
          callback(true); // Permissive in dev to avoid blocking client tests
        }
      },
    });

    this.wss.on('connection', (ws: WebSocket, req: IncomingMessage) => {
      this.handleConnection(ws, req);
    });

    // Matchmaking polling queue tick (every 1 second)
    setInterval(() => {
      this.tickMatchmakingQueue();
    }, 1000);

    console.log('[AuthoritativeNetcode] WebSocket Authoritative 20-Tick Combat Server initialized on /socket');
  }

  private handleConnection(ws: WebSocket, _req: IncomingMessage) {
    ws.on('message', (data: Buffer | string) => {
      try {
        const payload = JSON.parse(data.toString());
        this.handleMessage(ws, payload);
      } catch (err: any) {
        this.send(ws, { type: 'ERROR', message: 'Malformed JSON packet' });
      }
    });

    ws.on('close', () => {
      this.handleDisconnect(ws);
    });

    ws.on('error', (err) => {
      console.warn('[AuthoritativeNetcode] Socket error:', err.message);
    });

    // Welcome handshake
    this.send(ws, {
      type: 'SERVER_HELLO',
      serverTickRate: 20,
      protocol: 'petslam_v2_authoritative',
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    });
  }

  private handleMessage(ws: WebSocket, msg: any) {
    // Phase 9 Anti-Cheat: Rate limiting check (> 10 action packets / sec dropped)
    const currentSecond = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
    let player = this.socketToPlayer.get(ws);

    if (player) {
      if (player.lastActionSecond === currentSecond) {
        player.actionCountInSecond++;
        if (player.actionCountInSecond > 10) {
          this.send(ws, {
            type: 'SECURITY_ALERT',
            code: 'RATE_LIMIT_DROPPED',
            message: 'Input throttle: Maximum 10 combat actions/second exceeded. Packet dropped.',
          });
          return;
        }
      } else {
        player.lastActionSecond = currentSecond;
        player.actionCountInSecond = 1;
      }
    }

    switch (msg.type) {
      case 'PING': {
        this.send(ws, { type: 'PONG', clientTime: msg.clientTime, serverTime: Date.now() });
        break;
      }

      case 'QUEUE_RANKED': {
        this.handleQueueRanked(ws, msg);
        break;
      }

      case 'CANCEL_QUEUE': {
        this.handleCancelQueue(ws);
        break;
      }

      case 'ACTION_MOVE': {
        this.handlePlayerMove(ws, msg.moveId);
        break;
      }

      case 'ACTION_OVERDRIVE': {
        this.handlePlayerOverdrive(ws);
        break;
      }

      case 'LEAVE_ROOM': {
        this.handleLeaveRoom(ws);
        break;
      }

      default: {
        break;
      }
    }
  }

  private handleQueueRanked(ws: WebSocket, msg: any) {
    const rawPet = msg.pet || {};
    const maxHp = Number(rawPet.health) || 1200;
    const cp = Number(rawPet.cp) || 500;
    const level = Number(rawPet.level) || 10;
    const damage = Number(rawPet.damage) || 160;
    const defense = Number(rawPet.defense) || 60;
    const speed = Number(rawPet.speed) || 75;

    const fighter: FighterEntity = {
      id: rawPet.id || `fighter_${Date.now()}`,
      name: rawPet.name || 'Champion Beast',
      species: rawPet.species || 'Apex Predator',
      level,
      hp: maxHp,
      maxHp,
      energy: 3, // Start with 3 tactical energy
      maxEnergy: 10,
      damage,
      defense,
      speed,
      cp,
      image: rawPet.image,
      avatarImageUrl: rawPet.avatarImageUrl,
      cooldowns: {},
      isOverdrive: false,
      overdriveTicksLeft: 0,
    };

    const player: PlayerNetState = {
      id: msg.playerId || `usr_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      name: msg.playerName || 'Arena Challenger',
      rating: Number(msg.rating) || 1000,
      cp,
      socket: ws,
      isAi: false,
      fighter,
      lastActionSecond: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      actionCountInSecond: 0,
      ready: true,
    };

    this.socketToPlayer.set(ws, player);

    // Remove if already in queue
    this.matchmakingQueue = this.matchmakingQueue.filter((p) => p.socket !== ws);
    this.matchmakingQueue.push(player);

    this.send(ws, {
      type: 'QUEUE_CONFIRMED',
      poolSize: this.matchmakingQueue.length,
      playerCp: cp,
      playerRating: player.rating,
      targetBand: `±150 CP (${Math.max(100, cp - 150)} - ${cp + 150})`,
    });
  }

  private handleCancelQueue(ws: WebSocket) {
    this.matchmakingQueue = this.matchmakingQueue.filter((p) => p.socket !== ws);
    this.send(ws, { type: 'QUEUE_CANCELLED' });
  }

  private tickMatchmakingQueue() {
    if (this.matchmakingQueue.length === 0) return;

    const matchedIndices = new Set<number>();

    // 1. Check for player vs player matches within ±150 CP
    for (let i = 0; i < this.matchmakingQueue.length; i++) {
      if (matchedIndices.has(i)) continue;
      const p1 = this.matchmakingQueue[i];

      for (let j = i + 1; j < this.matchmakingQueue.length; j++) {
        if (matchedIndices.has(j)) continue;
        const p2 = this.matchmakingQueue[j];

        // Elo & CP Band Matching Rule (±150 CP)
        const cpDiff = Math.abs(p1.cp - p2.cp);
        if (cpDiff <= 150) {
          matchedIndices.add(i);
          matchedIndices.add(j);
          this.createRoom(p1, p2);
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    // Remove paired players
    this.matchmakingQueue = this.matchmakingQueue.filter((_, idx) => !matchedIndices.has(idx));

    // 2. Check for waiting players: If in queue > 5 seconds, match with ranked Ghost AI
    const now = Date.now();
    for (let i = this.matchmakingQueue.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const p = this.matchmakingQueue[i];
      // If waiting long enough, create ghost rival
      const waitTime = now - (p.lastActionSecond * 1000);
      if (waitTime >= 5000) {
        this.matchmakingQueue.splice(i, 1);
        const ghostOpponent = this.createGhostOpponent(p.cp, p.rating);
        this.createRoom(p, ghostOpponent);
      }
    }
  }

  private createGhostOpponent(playerCp: number, playerRating: number): PlayerNetState {
    const ghostNames = [
      'Valkyrie_Nova',
      'Apex_Kodiak',
      'Shadow_Reaper',
      'Cyber_Prowler',
      'Echo_Striker',
      'Phantom_Fang',
    ];
    const ghostSpecies = ['Bengal Tiger', 'Arctic Wolf', 'Golden Eagle', 'Grizzly Bear', 'Black Panther'];
    const chosenName = ghostNames[Math.floor(Math.random() * ghostNames.length)];
    const chosenSpecies = ghostSpecies[Math.floor(Math.random() * ghostSpecies.length)];

    // Target CP within ±100 of player
    const offset = Math.floor((Math.random() - 0.5) * 160);
    const targetCp = Math.max(200, playerCp + offset);
    const maxHp = Math.round(1100 + targetCp * 0.4);

    const fighter: FighterEntity = {
      id: `ghost_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`,
      name: chosenName,
      species: chosenSpecies,
      level: Math.max(5, Math.round(targetCp / 50)),
      hp: maxHp,
      maxHp,
      energy: 3,
      maxEnergy: 10,
      damage: Math.round(150 + targetCp * 0.08),
      defense: Math.round(55 + targetCp * 0.03),
      speed: 80,
      cp: targetCp,
      cooldowns: {},
      isOverdrive: false,
      overdriveTicksLeft: 0,
    };

    return {
      id: `ai_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`,
      name: `${chosenName} (Ghost Ranked)`,
      rating: Math.max(800, playerRating + Math.floor((Math.random() - 0.5) * 80)),
      cp: targetCp,
      socket: null,
      isAi: true,
      fighter,
      lastActionSecond: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
      actionCountInSecond: 0,
      ready: true,
    };
  }

  private createRoom(p1: PlayerNetState, p2: PlayerNetState) {
    const roomId = `match_${crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 10)}`;

    const room: CombatRoom = {
      id: roomId,
      p1,
      p2,
      state: 'countdown',
      countdown: 3,
      tick: 0,
      winnerId: null,
      logs: [
        {
          tick: 0,
          text: `Ranked Match Established: ${p1.name} [${p1.cp} CP] vs ${p2.name} [${p2.cp} CP]`,
          type: 'system',
        },
      ],
      interval: null,
      createdAt: Date.now(),
    };

    this.activeRooms.set(roomId, room);

    // Notify players of match found
    const matchData = {
      type: 'MATCH_FOUND',
      roomId,
      p1: { id: p1.id, name: p1.name, cp: p1.cp, rating: p1.rating, fighter: p1.fighter },
      p2: { id: p2.id, name: p2.name, cp: p2.cp, rating: p2.rating, fighter: p2.fighter },
      countdown: room.countdown,
    };

    this.sendToRoom(room, matchData);

    // Start Authoritative 20-Tick Engine (50ms interval)
    let countdownCounter = 3;
    const countdownInterval = setInterval(() => {
      countdownCounter--;
      room.countdown = countdownCounter;
      this.sendToRoom(room, { type: 'COUNTDOWN_TICK', countdown: countdownCounter });

      if (countdownCounter <= 0) {
        clearInterval(countdownInterval);
        room.state = 'fighting';
        this.startCombatLoop(room);
      }
    }, 1000);
  }

  private startCombatLoop(room: CombatRoom) {
    // 20 ticks per second = 50ms interval
    room.interval = setInterval(() => {
      this.tickRoom(room);
    }, 50);
  }

  private tickRoom(room: CombatRoom) {
    if (room.state !== 'fighting') return;

    room.tick++;
    const t = room.tick;

    // 1. Authoritative Energy Regeneration: 0.05 per tick = 1.0 energy per second
    [room.p1, room.p2].forEach((p) => {
      const f = p.fighter;
      const energyRate = f.isOverdrive ? 0.1 : 0.05;
      f.energy = Math.min(f.maxEnergy, Number((f.energy + energyRate).toFixed(2)));

      // Overdrive timer decay
      if (f.isOverdrive) {
        f.overdriveTicksLeft--;
        if (f.overdriveTicksLeft <= 0) {
          f.isOverdrive = false;
          room.logs.push({
            tick: t,
            text: `${f.name}'s Overdrive Mode expired.`,
            type: 'system',
          });
        }
      }
    });

    // 2. Ghost AI tactical action decision (if p2 is AI)
    if (room.p2.isAi && room.p2.fighter.hp > 0) {
      this.tickAiDecision(room, room.p2, room.p1);
    }

    // 3. Broadcast authoritative state snapshot every tick (or every 2 ticks for bandwidth efficiency)
    this.sendToRoom(room, {
      type: 'TICK_UPDATE',
      roomId: room.id,
      tick: t,
      p1: {
        id: room.p1.id,
        hp: room.p1.fighter.hp,
        maxHp: room.p1.fighter.maxHp,
        energy: room.p1.fighter.energy,
        isOverdrive: room.p1.fighter.isOverdrive,
      },
      p2: {
        id: room.p2.id,
        hp: room.p2.fighter.hp,
        maxHp: room.p2.fighter.maxHp,
        energy: room.p2.fighter.energy,
        isOverdrive: room.p2.fighter.isOverdrive,
      },
      logs: room.logs.slice(-3),
    });

    // 4. Check for KO / Match End
    if (room.p1.fighter.hp <= 0 || room.p2.fighter.hp <= 0) {
      this.finishRoom(room);
    }
  }

  private tickAiDecision(room: CombatRoom, ai: PlayerNetState, opponent: PlayerNetState) {
    const f = ai.fighter;
    const t = room.tick;

    // Trigger Overdrive if energy >= 6 and not already active
    if (!f.isOverdrive && f.energy >= 6 && Math.random() < 0.05) {
      f.energy -= 6;
      f.isOverdrive = true;
      f.overdriveTicksLeft = 140; // 7 seconds
      room.logs.push({
        tick: t,
        text: `⚡ ${f.name} activated OVERDRIVE SURGE! (+50% DMG, Double Energy)`,
        type: 'overdrive',
      });
      return;
    }

    // Try heavy move: Fang Rend
    if (f.energy >= 4 && (!f.cooldowns.rend || f.cooldowns.rend <= t)) {
      this.executeMove(room, ai, opponent, DEFAULT_MOVES.rend);
      f.cooldowns.rend = t + DEFAULT_MOVES.rend.cooldownTicks;
      return;
    }

    // Try medium move: Apex Pounce
    if (f.energy >= 3 && (!f.cooldowns.pounce || f.cooldowns.pounce <= t) && Math.random() < 0.3) {
      this.executeMove(room, ai, opponent, DEFAULT_MOVES.pounce);
      f.cooldowns.pounce = t + DEFAULT_MOVES.pounce.cooldownTicks;
      return;
    }

    // Fast basic move: Kinetic Strike
    if (f.energy >= 2 && (!f.cooldowns.strike || f.cooldowns.strike <= t) && Math.random() < 0.2) {
      this.executeMove(room, ai, opponent, DEFAULT_MOVES.strike);
      f.cooldowns.strike = t + DEFAULT_MOVES.strike.cooldownTicks;
    }
  }

  private handlePlayerMove(ws: WebSocket, moveId: string) {
    const player = this.socketToPlayer.get(ws);
    if (!player) return;

    // Find active room for this player
    const room = this.findRoomByPlayer(player.id);
    if (!room || room.state !== 'fighting') return;

    const move = DEFAULT_MOVES[moveId];
    if (!move) return;

    const f = player.fighter;
    const opponent = room.p1.id === player.id ? room.p2 : room.p1;
    const t = room.tick;

    // Phase 9 Anti-Cheat: Validate Energy
    if (f.energy < move.cost) {
      this.send(ws, {
        type: 'ACTION_REJECTED',
        reason: 'INSUFFICIENT_ENERGY',
        currentEnergy: f.energy,
        cost: move.cost,
      });
      return;
    }

    // Validate Cooldown
    if (f.cooldowns[moveId] && f.cooldowns[moveId] > t) {
      this.send(ws, {
        type: 'ACTION_REJECTED',
        reason: 'COOLDOWN_ACTIVE',
        ticksRemaining: f.cooldowns[moveId] - t,
      });
      return;
    }

    // Deduct energy & set cooldown
    f.energy = Math.max(0, Number((f.energy - move.cost).toFixed(2)));
    f.cooldowns[moveId] = t + move.cooldownTicks;

    // Execute Move
    this.executeMove(room, player, opponent, move);
  }

  private handlePlayerOverdrive(ws: WebSocket) {
    const player = this.socketToPlayer.get(ws);
    if (!player) return;

    const room = this.findRoomByPlayer(player.id);
    if (!room || room.state !== 'fighting') return;

    const f = player.fighter;
    const cost = 6;

    // Anti-Cheat: Validate Energy
    if (f.energy < cost) {
      this.send(ws, {
        type: 'ACTION_REJECTED',
        reason: 'INSUFFICIENT_ENERGY_OVERDRIVE',
        currentEnergy: f.energy,
        cost,
      });
      return;
    }

    if (f.isOverdrive) return;

    f.energy -= cost;
    f.isOverdrive = true;
    f.overdriveTicksLeft = 140; // 7 seconds @ 20 ticks

    room.logs.push({
      tick: room.tick,
      text: `⚡ ${f.name} ENGAGED OVERDRIVE! Damage boosted +50%!`,
      type: 'overdrive',
    });
  }

  private executeMove(room: CombatRoom, attacker: PlayerNetState, defender: PlayerNetState, move: CombatMove) {
    const af = attacker.fighter;
    const df = defender.fighter;
    const t = room.tick;

    // Damage Math: Base move damage scaled by attacker damage stat and reduced by defender defense
    const rawDamage = move.damage * (1 + af.damage / 300);
    const defenseReduction = Math.max(0.4, 1 - df.defense / 400);
    let finalDamage = Math.round(rawDamage * defenseReduction);

    // Apply Overdrive multiplier
    if (af.isOverdrive) {
      finalDamage = Math.round(finalDamage * 1.5);
    }

    // Critical Strike Chance: 15% baseline
    const isCrit = Math.random() < 0.18;
    if (isCrit) {
      finalDamage = Math.round(finalDamage * 1.75);
    }

    df.hp = Math.max(0, df.hp - finalDamage);

    room.logs.push({
      tick: t,
      text: isCrit
        ? `💥 CRITICAL HIT! ${af.name}'s ${move.name} lands for ${finalDamage} DMG on ${df.name}!`
        : `⚔️ ${af.name} used ${move.name} dealing ${finalDamage} DMG to ${df.name}!`,
      type: isCrit ? 'crit' : 'hit',
    });

    // Check KO
    if (df.hp <= 0) {
      room.logs.push({
        tick: t,
        text: `💀 KNOCKOUT! ${df.name} has fallen!`,
        type: 'ko',
      });
      this.finishRoom(room);
    }
  }

  private finishRoom(room: CombatRoom) {
    if (room.state === 'finished') return;
    room.state = 'finished';

    if (room.interval) {
      clearInterval(room.interval);
      room.interval = null;
    }

    const p1Won = room.p1.fighter.hp > 0 && room.p2.fighter.hp <= 0;
    const p2Won = room.p2.fighter.hp > 0 && room.p1.fighter.hp <= 0;
    const winnerId = p1Won ? room.p1.id : p2Won ? room.p2.id : room.p1.id;
    room.winnerId = winnerId;

    // Elo rating calculation
    const ratingGain = 25;
    const ratingLoss = 18;

    this.sendToRoom(room, {
      type: 'MATCH_FINISHED',
      roomId: room.id,
      winnerId,
      p1Result: {
        id: room.p1.id,
        won: p1Won,
        ratingDelta: p1Won ? +ratingGain : -ratingLoss,
        rewardCredits: p1Won ? 350 : 100,
        rewardExp: p1Won ? 120 : 40,
      },
      p2Result: {
        id: room.p2.id,
        won: p2Won,
        ratingDelta: p2Won ? +ratingGain : -ratingLoss,
        rewardCredits: p2Won ? 350 : 100,
        rewardExp: p2Won ? 120 : 40,
      },
      finalTick: room.tick,
    });

    // Clean up room after 10 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      this.activeRooms.delete(room.id);
    }, 10000);
  }

  private handleLeaveRoom(ws: WebSocket) {
    const player = this.socketToPlayer.get(ws);
    if (!player) return;
    const room = this.findRoomByPlayer(player.id);
    if (room && room.state !== 'finished') {
      // Forfeit
      const opponent = room.p1.id === player.id ? room.p2 : room.p1;
      room.logs.push({
        tick: room.tick,
        text: `${player.name} forfeited the match.`,
        type: 'system',
      });
      player.fighter.hp = 0;
      this.finishRoom(room);
    }
  }

  private handleDisconnect(ws: WebSocket) {
    const player = this.socketToPlayer.get(ws);
    if (player) {
      this.matchmakingQueue = this.matchmakingQueue.filter((p) => p.socket !== ws);
      const room = this.findRoomByPlayer(player.id);
      if (room && room.state === 'fighting') {
        player.fighter.hp = 0;
        this.finishRoom(room);
      }
      this.socketToPlayer.delete(ws);
    }
  }

  private findRoomByPlayer(playerId: string): CombatRoom | undefined {
    for (const room of this.activeRooms.values()) {
      if (room.p1.id === playerId || room.p2.id === playerId) {
        return room;
      }
    }
    return undefined;
  }

  private sendToRoom(room: CombatRoom, data: any) {
    if (room.p1.socket && room.p1.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.send(room.p1.socket, data);
    }
    if (room.p2.socket && room.p2.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.send(room.p2.socket, data);
    }
  }

  private send(ws: WebSocket, data: any) {
    if (ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      ws.send(JSON.stringify(data));
    }
  }
}

export const authoritativeCombatServer = new AuthoritativeCombatServer();

/**
 * Dodo Payments Client Service for PET SLAM
 * Connects frontend to backend checkout session creation and status verification.
 */

export type DodoPassType = 'extension' | 'avatar' | 'supporter' | 'bundle' | 'auction' | 'credits_5000';

export interface DodoProductInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  price: string;
  amountCents: number;
  description: string;
}

export interface DodoCheckoutResponse {
  checkoutUrl: string;
  sessionId: string;
  mode: 'live_mode' | 'test_mode' | 'test_sandbox';
  simulated?: boolean;
  message?: string;
}

export interface DodoConfigResponse {
  enabled: boolean;
  configured: boolean;
  environment: string;
  products: Record<DodoPassType, DodoProductInfo>;
}

/**
 * Fetch Dodo Payments configuration and product catalog
 */
export async function getDodoConfig(): Promise<DodoConfigResponse | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/dodo/config');
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    return await res.json();
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[DodoPayments] Failed to fetch config:', err);
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * Create a new Dodo Payments Checkout Session
 */
export async function createDodoCheckout(params: {
  passType: DodoPassType;
  customerEmail?: string;
  customerName?: string;
  returnUrl?: string;
}): Promise<DodoCheckoutResponse> {
  const origin = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? window.location.origin : '';
  const finalReturnUrl =
    params.returnUrl ||
    `${origin}/?dodo_payment=success&pass=${params.passType}`;

  const res = await fetch('/api/dodo/create-checkout', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      passType: params.passType,
      customerEmail: params.customerEmail,
      customerName: params.customerName,
      returnUrl: finalReturnUrl,
    }),
  });

  if (!res.ok) {
    const err = await res.json().catch(() => ({ error: 'Checkout request failed' }));
    throw new Error(err.error || 'Failed to initialize Dodo Payments checkout session.');
  }

  return await res.json();
}

/**
 * Launch Dodo Payments checkout flow
 */
export async function launchDodoCheckout(params: {
  passType: DodoPassType;
  customerEmail?: string;
  customerName?: string;
  onBeforeRedirect?: () => void;
}): Promise<void> {
  const session = await createDodoCheckout(params);

  if (params.onBeforeRedirect) {
    params.onBeforeRedirect();
  }

  if (session.checkoutUrl) {
    window.location.href = session.checkoutUrl;
  } else {
    throw new Error('No checkout URL returned from payment server.');
  }
}

<document_content>
/**
 * Client Authoritative Multiplayer Netcode Client for PET SLAM
 * Connects to ws(s)://.../socket, measures latency, and synchronizes combat ticks
 */

export interface NetFighterSnapshot {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  species: string;
  level: number;
  hp: number;
  maxHp: number;
  energy: number;
  maxEnergy: number;
  damage: number;
  defense: number;
  speed: number;
  cp: number;
  image?: string;
  avatarImageUrl?: string;
  isOverdrive?: boolean;
}

export interface MatchFoundData {
  roomId: string;
  p1: { id: string; name: string; cp: number; rating: number; fighter: NetFighterSnapshot };
  p2: { id: string; name: string; cp: number; rating: number; fighter: NetFighterSnapshot };
  countdown: number;
}

export interface TickUpdateData {
  roomId: string;
  tick: number;
  p1: { id: string; hp: number; maxHp: number; energy: number; isOverdrive: boolean };
  p2: { id: string; hp: number; maxHp: number; energy: number; isOverdrive: boolean };
  logs: Array<{ tick: number; text: string; type: string }>;
}

export interface MatchFinishedData {
  roomId: string;
  winnerId: string;
  p1Result: { id: string; won: boolean; ratingDelta: number; rewardCredits: number; rewardExp: number };
  p2Result: { id: string; won: boolean; ratingDelta: number; rewardCredits: number; rewardExp: number };
  finalTick: number;
}

type NetcodeListener = (event: string, data: any) => void;

class MultiplayerNetcodeClient {
  private socket: WebSocket | null = null;
  private isConnecting: boolean = false;
  private listeners: Set<NetcodeListener> = new Set();
  private pingInterval: any = null;
  public latencyMs: number = 0;
  public isConnected: boolean = false;
  public currentRoomId: string | null = null;
  public inQueue: boolean = false;

  private resolveSocketUrl(): string {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'ws://localhost:3000/socket';

    // If native Capacitor or Tauri, connect directly to production WSS
    const isCapacitor = !!(window as any).Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.();
    const isTauri = !!(window as any).__TAURI__;

    if (isCapacitor || isTauri) {
      return 'wss://petslam.app/socket';
    }

    const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
    const host = window.location.host;
    return `${protocol}//${host}/socket`;
  }

  public connect(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      return Promise.resolve(true);
    }
    if (this.isConnecting) {
      return Promise.resolve(false);
    }

    this.isConnecting = true;
    const url = this.resolveSocketUrl();

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      try {
        this.socket = new WebSocket(url);

        this.socket.onopen = () => {
          this.isConnected = true;
          this.isConnecting = false;
          this.startPingLoop();
          this.emit('connected', { latency: this.latencyMs });
          resolve(true);
        };

        this.socket.onmessage = (event) => {
          try {
            const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
            this.handleIncoming(msg);
          } catch {}
        };

        this.socket.onclose = () => {
          this.isConnected = false;
          this.isConnecting = false;
          this.stopPingLoop();
          this.emit('disconnected', {});
          resolve(false);
        };

        this.socket.onerror = () => {
          this.isConnecting = false;
          resolve(false);
        };
      } catch {
        this.isConnecting = false;
        resolve(false);
      }
    });
  }

  private startPingLoop() {
    this.stopPingLoop();
    this.pingInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
        this.send({ type: 'PING', clientTime: Date.now() });
      }
    }, 3000);
  }

  private stopPingLoop() {
    if (this.pingInterval) {
      clearInterval(this.pingInterval);
      this.pingInterval = null;
    }
  }

  private handleIncoming(msg: any) {
    switch (msg.type) {
      case 'PONG': {
        this.latencyMs = Math.max(5, Math.round(Date.now() - msg.clientTime));
        this.emit('latency', { latencyMs: this.latencyMs });
        break;
      }

      case 'QUEUE_CONFIRMED': {
        this.inQueue = true;
        this.emit('queue_confirmed', msg);
        break;
      }

      case 'QUEUE_CANCELLED': {
        this.inQueue = false;
        this.emit('queue_cancelled', msg);
        break;
      }

      case 'MATCH_FOUND': {
        this.inQueue = false;
        this.currentRoomId = msg.roomId;
        this.emit('match_found', msg as MatchFoundData);
        break;
      }

      case 'COUNTDOWN_TICK': {
        this.emit('countdown_tick', msg.countdown);
        break;
      }

      case 'TICK_UPDATE': {
        this.emit('tick_update', msg as TickUpdateData);
        break;
      }

      case 'MATCH_FINISHED': {
        this.emit('match_finished', msg as MatchFinishedData);
        break;
      }

      case 'ACTION_REJECTED': {
        this.emit('action_rejected', msg);
        break;
      }

      case 'SECURITY_ALERT': {
        console.warn('[Netcode] Security Alert from server:', msg.message);
        this.emit('security_alert', msg);
        break;
      }

      default:
        this.emit(msg.type, msg);
    }
  }

  public queueRanked(playerData: {
    playerId: string;
    playerName: string;
    rating: number;
    pet: any;
  }) {
    if (!this.isConnected) {
      this.connect().then(() => {
        this.send({ type: 'QUEUE_RANKED', ...playerData });
      });
      return;
    }
    this.send({ type: 'QUEUE_RANKED', ...playerData });
  }

  public cancelQueue() {
    this.send({ type: 'CANCEL_QUEUE' });
    this.inQueue = false;
  }

  public sendMove(moveId: string) {
    this.send({ type: 'ACTION_MOVE', moveId, timestamp: Date.now() });
  }

  public sendOverdrive() {
    this.send({ type: 'ACTION_OVERDRIVE', timestamp: Date.now() });
  }

  public leaveRoom() {
    this.send({ type: 'LEAVE_ROOM' });
    this.currentRoomId = null;
  }

  public subscribe(listener: NetcodeListener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  private emit(event: string, data: any) {
    this.listeners.forEach((fn) => fn(event, data));
  }

  private send(data: any) {
    if (this.socket && this.socket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
      this.socket.send(JSON.stringify(data));
    }
  }
}

export const multiplayerNetcode = new MultiplayerNetcodeClient();

import { createClient, SupabaseClient, User, Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

const DEFAULT_SUPABASE_URL = 'https://yqrppwcvidjiekqzhyyg.supabase.co';
const DEFAULT_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY =
  'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InlxcnBwd2N2aWRqaWVrcXpoeXlnIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTMzNTE4ODYsImV4cCI6MjEwODkyNzg4Nn0.FYjX_z_A4agYj2hqjPjQ66eOofuo5tC8ZQL-vPrlm8I';

const rawUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL as string) || DEFAULT_SUPABASE_URL;
const cleanUrl = rawUrl.replace(/\/rest\/v1\/?$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
const supabaseAnonKey =
  (import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY as string) || DEFAULT_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY;

export const isSupabaseConfigured = Boolean(
  cleanUrl &&
    supabaseAnonKey &&
    !cleanUrl.includes('your-project-id') &&
    cleanUrl.startsWith('http') &&
    supabaseAnonKey.length > 20
);

// Supabase client instance
export const supabase: SupabaseClient | null = isSupabaseConfigured
  ? createClient(cleanUrl, supabaseAnonKey, {
      auth: {
        persistSession: true,
        autoRefreshToken: true,
        detectSessionInUrl: true,
      },
    })
  : null;

export interface PlayerProfile {
  id: string;
  email: string;
  username: string;
  trainer_name: string;
  player_tag: string;
  trophies: number;
  credits: number;
  player_level: number;
  active_beast_id: string;
  avatar_url?: string;
  created_at?: string;
}

/**
 * Sign in player using Google OAuth via Supabase
 */
export async function signInWithGoogle(): Promise<{ error?: string }> {
  if (!supabase) {
    return { error: 'Supabase credentials are not configured.' };
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: 'google',
    options: {
      redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/`,
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return { error: error.message };
  }

  return {};
}

/**
 * Register a new player with Email, Password & Username
 */
export async function registerPlayerWithSupabase(
  email: string,
  pass: string,
  username: string
): Promise<{ user: User | null; session: Session | null; error?: string }> {
  if (!supabase) {
    return {
      user: null,
      session: null,
      error: 'Supabase credentials are not configured in your .env file.',
    };
  }

  const cleanUsername = username.trim().replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/g, '') || `Trainer_${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`;

  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email: email.trim(),
    password: pass,
    options: {
      data: {
        username: cleanUsername,
        trainer_name: cleanUsername,
      },
    },
  });

  if (error) {
    return { user: null, session: null, error: error.message };
  }

  return { user: data.user, session: data.session };
}

/**
 * Sign in existing player with Email / Username & Password
 */
export async function signInPlayerWithSupabase(
  emailOrUsername: string,
  pass: string
): Promise<{ user: User | null; session: Session | null; profile?: PlayerProfile | null; error?: string }> {
  if (!supabase) {
    return {
      user: null,
      session: null,
      error: 'Supabase credentials are not configured in your .env file.',
    };
  }

  let finalEmail = emailOrUsername.trim();

  // If user entered a username instead of email, resolve it from public.profiles
  if (!finalEmail.includes('@')) {
    const { data: profileData, error: profileErr } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('email')
      .ilike('username', finalEmail)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (profileErr || !profileData?.email) {
      return {
        user: null,
        session: null,
        error: `Could not find an account with username "${finalEmail}". Please use your email.`,
      };
    }
    finalEmail = profileData.email;
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: finalEmail,
    password: pass,
  });

  if (error) {
    return { user: null, session: null, error: error.message };
  }

  // Fetch full player profile
  let profile: PlayerProfile | null = null;
  if (data.user) {
    const { data: userProfile } = await supabase
      .from('profiles')
      .select('*')
      .eq('id', data.user.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    profile = userProfile as PlayerProfile | null;
  }

  return { user: data.user, session: data.session, profile };
}

/**
 * Send password reset email via Resend / Supabase Custom SMTP
 */
export async function resetPasswordWithSupabase(
  email: string
): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (!supabase) {
    return { success: false, error: 'Supabase credentials are not configured in .env.' };
  }

  const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email.trim(), {
    redirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/#reset-password`,
  });

  if (error) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }

  return { success: true };
}

/**
 * Sign out current player
 */
export async function signOutPlayer(): Promise<void> {
  if (supabase) {
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
  }
}

/**
 * Get current authenticated user and profile
 */
export async function getActivePlayerSession(): Promise<{
  session: Session | null;
  user: User | null;
  profile: PlayerProfile | null;
}> {
  if (!supabase) {
    return { session: null, user: null, profile: null };
  }

  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
  if (!session?.user) {
    return { session: null, user: null, profile: null };
  }

  const { data: profile } = await supabase
    .from('profiles')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', session.user.id)
    .maybeSingle();

  return {
    session,
    user: session.user,
    profile: (profile as PlayerProfile) || null,
  };
}

/**
 * PET SLAM: Waitlist Service
 * Handles waitlist submission across Supabase Edge Functions, local dev server,
 * and graceful offline preview queue.
 */

export interface WaitlistSubmissionResult {
  success: boolean;
  duplicate?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  message?: string;
  entry?: {
    id: string;
    email: string;
    created_at: string;
    signup_status: string;
    perks?: {
      credits: number;
      founder_badge: boolean;
      alpha_access: boolean;
    };
  };
  totalSignups?: number;
  emailStatus?: {
    sent: boolean;
    message: string;
    template?: any;
  };
  perksAwarded?: {
    credits: number;
    founderBadge: string;
    alphaTesting: string;
  };
  mode?: 'supabase_edge' | 'express_backend' | 'offline_preview';
}

const LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY = 'petslam_waitlist_records';

export async function submitWaitlist(email: string): Promise<WaitlistSubmissionResult> {
  const trimmedEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();
  const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

  if (!emailRegex.test(trimmedEmail)) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Please enter a valid email address.',
    };
  }

  const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || 'https://yqrppwcvidjiekqzhyyg.supabase.co';
  const supabaseAnonKey =
    import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
    'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InlxcnBwd2N2aWRqaWVrcXpoeXlnIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTMzNTE4ODYsImV4cCI6MjEwODkyNzg4Nn0.FYjX_z_A4agYj2hqjPjQ66eOofuo5tC8ZQL-vPrlm8I';

  // 1. Supabase Edge Function Path (Production on GitHub Pages)
  if (supabaseUrl && supabaseAnonKey) {
    try {
      const edgeFunctionUrl = `${supabaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/functions/v1/waitlist`;
      const response = await fetch(edgeFunctionUrl, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'apikey': supabaseAnonKey,
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseAnonKey}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: trimmedEmail }),
      });

      const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

      if (response.status === 201 || (response.ok && data.success)) {
        return {
          ...data,
          success: true,
          mode: 'supabase_edge',
        };
      }

      if (response.status === 409 || data.duplicate) {
        return {
          success: false,
          duplicate: true,
          message: data.message || 'This email is already registered on the PET SLAM waitlist.',
          entry: data.entry,
        };
      }

      return {
        success: false,
        error: data.error || `Registration failed with status code ${response.status}.`,
      };
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('Supabase Edge Function network error, checking fallbacks:', err);
    }
  }

  // 2. Express Backend Fallback (Local Node development via tsx server.ts)
  try {
    const expressResponse = await fetch('/api/waitlist', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ email: trimmedEmail }),
    });

    if (expressResponse.ok) {
      const expressData = await expressResponse.json();
      return {
        ...expressData,
        mode: 'express_backend',
      };
    }

    if (expressResponse.status === 409) {
      const dupData = await expressResponse.json().catch(() => ({}));
      return {
        success: false,
        duplicate: true,
        message: dupData.message || 'This email is already registered on the PET SLAM waitlist.',
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Expected on static hosts like GitHub Pages where /api/waitlist returns 404
  }

  // 3. Graceful Offline Preview Fallback (For testing prior to Supabase keys configuration)
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
    const existingList: Array<{ id: string; email: string; created_at: string }> = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];

    if (existingList.some((item) => item.email === trimmedEmail)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        duplicate: true,
        message: 'This email is already registered on the waitlist in your local preview queue.',
      };
    }

    const previewId = `ps_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10)}${Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4)}`;
    const newEntry = {
      id: previewId,
      email: trimmedEmail,
      created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      signup_status: 'confirmed',
      perks: {
        credits: 10000,
        founder_badge: true,
        alpha_access: true,
      },
    };

    localStorage.setItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify([newEntry, ...existingList]));

    return {
      success: true,
      mode: 'offline_preview',
      message: "You're in. Welcome to PET SLAM.",
      entry: newEntry,
      totalSignups: existingList.length + 1,
      emailStatus: {
        sent: false,
        message: 'Static Preview: Connect Supabase and Resend in repository secrets to trigger live emails on your custom domain.',
      },
      perksAwarded: {
        credits: 10000,
        founderBadge: 'Granted',
        alphaTesting: 'Priority Invitation',
      },
    };
  } catch (storageErr) {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Unable to save signup. Please verify browser storage permissions.',
    };
  }
}

export async function getWaitlistStats(): Promise<{ totalSignups: number; provider: string }> {
  // Check Supabase count if configured
  const supabaseUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_URL || 'https://yqrppwcvidjiekqzhyyg.supabase.co';
  const supabaseAnonKey =
    import.meta.env.VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY ||
    'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6InlxcnBwd2N2aWRqaWVrcXpoeXlnIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTMzNTE4ODYsImV4cCI6MjEwODkyNzg4Nn0.FYjX_z_A4agYj2hqjPjQ66eOofuo5tC8ZQL-vPrlm8I';

  if (supabaseUrl && supabaseAnonKey) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/rest/v1/rpc/get_waitlist_count`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'apikey': supabaseAnonKey,
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${supabaseAnonKey}`,
        },
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        const count = await res.json();
        return { totalSignups: Number(count) || 284, provider: 'Supabase Cloud' };
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
  }

  // Check local server
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/waitlist/status');
    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      return { totalSignups: data.totalSignups || 120, provider: 'Local Server' };
    }
  } catch {
    // fallback
  }

  // Static baseline
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY);
    const existingList = saved ? JSON.parse(saved) : [];
    return { totalSignups: 42 + existingList.length, provider: 'Static Genesis Queue' };
  } catch {
    return { totalSignups: 42, provider: 'Static Genesis Queue' };
  }
}

/**
 * Dynamic API & Socket Endpoint Resolver for PET SLAM
 * Automatically detects web vs native Capacitor / Tauri runtime
 * and forces absolute production URLs on native apps.
 */

export function isNativePlatform(): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;
  const isCapacitor = !!(window as any).Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.();
  const isTauri = !!(window as any).__TAURI__;
  return isCapacitor || isTauri;
}

export function getApiBaseUrl(): string {
  if (isNativePlatform()) {
    return 'https://petslam.app/api';
  }
  // In web environment, use relative path so it routes through reverse proxy / Vite
  return '/api';
}

export function getSocketUrl(): string {
  if (isNativePlatform()) {
    return 'wss://petslam.app/socket';
  }
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return 'ws://localhost:3000/socket';
  const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
  return `${protocol}//${window.location.host}/socket`;
}

/**
 * Native-aware fetch wrapper that resolves endpoints automatically
 */
export async function apiFetch(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {
  const base = getApiBaseUrl();
  const cleanPath = path.startsWith('/') ? path : `/${path}`;
  const fullUrl = cleanPath.startsWith('/api')
    ? (isNativePlatform() ? `https://petslam.app${cleanPath}` : cleanPath)
    : `${base}${cleanPath}`;

  return fetch(fullUrl, init);
}
