// Procedural Web Audio API sound effects for PET SLAM
// Runs completely client-side with zero external audio assets

class SoundEngine {
  private ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
  public enabled: boolean = true;

  private initCtx() {
    if (!this.ctx && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        this.ctx = new AudioCtx();
      }
    }
    if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') {
      this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  public playClick() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(600, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1200, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.04);
    } catch {
      // Audio fallback silent
    }
  }

  public playAttack() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(320, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(80, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.12);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playLightHit() {
    this.playAttack();
  }

  public playImpact() {
    this.playHeavyHit();
  }

  public playBattleStart() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(220, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playHeavyHit() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'triangle';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(140, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(35, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.25);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playBlock() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'square';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(450, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(220, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playDodge() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(800, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.15);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playVictory() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const notes = [440, 554.37, 659.25, 880];
      notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        if (!this.ctx) return;
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
        const startTime = this.ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.12;
        osc.type = 'triangle';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, startTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, startTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.28);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        osc.start(startTime);
        osc.stop(startTime + 0.3);
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  public playLevelUp() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const notes = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5];
      notes.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        if (!this.ctx) return;
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
        const startTime = this.ctx.currentTime + idx * 0.09;
        osc.type = 'sine';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, startTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.16, startTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, startTime + 0.22);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        osc.start(startTime);
      });
    } catch {}
  }

  public playUltimate() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      // Deep sub-bass sweep + metallic harmonic flare
      const osc1 = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain1 = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc1.type = 'sawtooth';
      osc1.frequency.setValueAtTime(60, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc1.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(320, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      gain1.gain.setValueAtTime(0.35, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain1.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc1.connect(gain1);
      gain1.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc1.start();
      osc1.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.45);

      const osc2 = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain2 = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc2.type = 'square';
      osc2.frequency.setValueAtTime(550, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
      osc2.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1100, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.35);
      gain2.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
      gain2.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.01, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
      osc2.connect(gain2);
      gain2.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc2.start(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.1);
      osc2.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.45);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playMatchSearch() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
      osc.type = 'sine';
      osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(440, this.ctx.currentTime);
      osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(880, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, this.ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
      osc.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
      osc.start();
      osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.08);
    } catch {}
  }

  public playMatchFound() {
    if (!this.enabled) return;
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.ctx) return;
      // Dramatic brass gong + ascending fanfare chord
      const chords = [220, 330, 440, 660];
      chords.forEach((freq, idx) => {
        if (!this.ctx) return;
        const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
        const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
        osc.type = 'sawtooth';
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, this.ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.18, this.ctx.currentTime);
        gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, this.ctx.currentTime + 0.6);
        osc.connect(gain);
        gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
        osc.start(this.ctx.currentTime);
        osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + 0.6);
      });
    } catch {}
  }

/**
 * Microsoft Clarity Behavior Analytics Integration for PET SLAM
 * Enables heatmaps, session recordings, and click/scroll telemetry.
 */

declare global {
  interface Window {
    clarity?: (command: string, ...args: unknown[]) => void;
    CLARITY_INITIALIZED?: boolean;
  }
}

export interface ClarityConfig {
  projectId?: string;
  enableDebug?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Initialize Microsoft Clarity tracking script
 */
export function initClarity(config?: ClarityConfig): boolean {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;

  // Prevent double-initialization
  if (window.CLARITY_INITIALIZED || (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof (window as any).clarity === 'function' && (window as any).clarity.q)) {
    window.CLARITY_INITIALIZED = true;
    return true;
  }

  const projectId =
    config?.projectId ||
    (import.meta.env.VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID as string) ||
    'z4be9kfna6';

  if (!projectId || projectId === 'YOUR_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID') {
    if (config?.enableDebug || import.meta.env.DEV) {
      console.info(
        '[Clarity] Project ID not configured. Set VITE_CLARITY_PROJECT_ID in .env to enable session replays.'
      );
    }
    return false;
  }

  try {
    // Official Microsoft Clarity loader snippet
    (function (c: any, l: Document, a: string, r: string, i: string) {
      c[a] =
        c[a] ||
        function (...args: unknown[]) {
          (c[a].q = c[a].q || []).push(args);
        };
      const t = l.createElement(r) as HTMLScriptElement;
      t.async = true;
      t.src = 'https://www.clarity.ms/tag/' + i;
      const y = l.getElementsByTagName(r)[0];
      if (y && y.parentNode) {
        y.parentNode.insertBefore(t, y);
      } else {
        l.head.appendChild(t);
      }
    })(window as any, document, 'clarity', 'script', projectId);

    window.CLARITY_INITIALIZED = true;
    console.info(`[Clarity] Initialized successfully with project ID: ${projectId}`);
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn('[Clarity] Initialization failed:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Track custom business and engagement events in Microsoft Clarity
 */
export function trackClarityEvent(eventName: string): void {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG = (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG || [];
    (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG.unshift({ event: eventName, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() });
    if ((window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG.length > 20) {
      (window as any).__CLARITY_EVENT_LOG.pop();
    }

    if (typeof window.clarity === 'function') {
      try {
        window.clarity('event', eventName);
      } catch {
        // Ignore if clarity blocked by adblockers
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Set custom metadata tags for filtering sessions in Clarity Dashboard
 */
export function setClarityTag(key: string, value: string): void {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.clarity === 'function') {
    try {
      window.clarity('set', key, value);
    } catch {
      // Ignore if clarity blocked
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Identify authenticated or active player in Clarity
 */
export function identifyClarityUser(
  customId: string,
  sessionProps?: Record<string, string>
): void {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof window.clarity === 'function') {
    try {
      window.clarity('identify', customId, sessionProps);
    } catch {
      // Ignore
    }
  }
}

import confetti from 'canvas-confetti';

export function triggerConfetti(options?: {
  particleCount?: number;
  spread?: number;
  origin?: { x: number; y: number };
}) {
  try {
    confetti({
      particleCount: options?.particleCount ?? 80,
      spread: options?.spread ?? 70,
      origin: options?.origin ?? { y: 0.6 },
      colors: ['#CCFF00', '#00E5FF', '#F59E0B', '#EF4444', '#EC4899', '#8B5CF6'],
      disableForReducedMotion: true,
    });
  } catch {
    // Graceful fallback if canvas is restricted
  }
}

export function triggerVictoryExplosion() {
  try {
    const end = Date.now() + 1.2 * 1000;
    const colors = ['#CCFF00', '#00E5FF', '#FFD700', '#FF3B30'];

    (function frame() {
      confetti({
        particleCount: 4,
        angle: 60,
        spread: 55,
        origin: { x: 0 },
        colors,
      });
      confetti({
        particleCount: 4,
        angle: 120,
        spread: 55,
        origin: { x: 1 },
        colors,
      });

      if (Date.now() < end) {
        requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      }
    })();
  } catch {
    // Fallback
  }
}

<document_content>
/**
 * Breeding Genetics & Procedural Chimera Engine for PET SLAM
 * Inherits parent attributes with ±10% gaussian variance, blends 6-tone coat hex colors,
 * implements a 5-tier weighted rarity ladder (Common -> Rare -> Epic -> Legendary -> Mythic)
 * with level/affection boost, creates true procedural Chimera hybrid cross-breeds,
 * and rolls rare mutations (Radioactive Neon, Void Nebula, Solar God, Blood Eclipse).
 */

import { CompanionPet, PetCustomPalette, PetSpecies, PetCategory, PetRarity, PetCustomFeatures } from '../types/pet';

export const RARITY_TIERS: PetRarity[] = ['common', 'rare', 'epic', 'legendary', 'mythic'];

export const RARITY_LEVEL_MAP: Record<PetRarity, number> = {
  common: 0,
  rare: 1,
  epic: 2,
  legendary: 3,
  mythic: 4,
};

export const RARITY_BADGE_COLORS: Record<PetRarity, { bg: string; text: string; border: string; glow: string }> = {
  common: { bg: 'bg-neutral-800', text: 'text-neutral-300', border: 'border-neutral-600', glow: 'rgba(163,163,163,0.3)' },
  rare: { bg: 'bg-cyan-950', text: 'text-cyan-400', border: 'border-cyan-500', glow: 'rgba(0,240,255,0.4)' },
  epic: { bg: 'bg-purple-950', text: 'text-purple-400', border: 'border-purple-500', glow: 'rgba(168,85,247,0.45)' },
  legendary: { bg: 'bg-amber-950', text: 'text-amber-400', border: 'border-amber-500', glow: 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)' },
  mythic: { bg: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-950 to-rose-950', text: 'text-fuchsia-300', border: 'border-fuchsia-400', glow: 'rgba(217,70,239,0.7)' },
};

export interface EggEntity {
  id: string;
  parent1Id: string;
  parent2Id: string;
  parent1Name: string;
  parent2Name: string;
  species: PetSpecies;
  category: PetCategory;
  name: string;
  rarity: PetRarity;
  isChimera: boolean;
  hybridSpeciesName?: string;
  customFeatures: PetCustomFeatures;
  ascendedTier: boolean;
  ascensionChancePercent: number;
  offspringPalette: PetCustomPalette;
  offspringStats: {
    attack: number;
    defense: number;
    agility: number;
    stamina: number;
    cp: number;
  };
  isMutant: boolean;
  mutationType?: string;
  laidAt: number;
  hatchDurationSeconds: number;
  isReadyToHatch: boolean;
}

// Convert hex color to RGB
function hexToRgb(hex: string): { r: number; g: number; b: number } {
  let clean = hex.replace('#', '');
  if (clean.length === 3) {
    clean = clean.split('').map((c) => c + c).join('');
  }
  const num = parseInt(clean, 16);
  return {
    r: (num >> 16) & 255,
    g: (num >> 8) & 255,
    b: num & 255,
  };
}

// Convert RGB to Hex
function rgbToHex(r: number, g: number, b: number): string {
  const toHex = (n: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(n))).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  return `#${toHex(r)}${toHex(g)}${toHex(b)}`;
}

// Blend two hex colors
export function blendHexColors(hex1: string, hex2: string, weight = 0.5): string {
  try {
    const c1 = hexToRgb(hex1);
    const c2 = hexToRgb(hex2);
    const r = c1.r * weight + c2.r * (1 - weight);
    const g = c1.g * weight + c2.g * (1 - weight);
    const b = c1.b * weight + c2.b * (1 - weight);
    return rgbToHex(r, g, b);
  } catch {
    return hex1;
  }
}

// Extract pet rarity safely
export function getPetRarity(pet: CompanionPet): PetRarity {
  if (pet.rarity) return pet.rarity;
  const t = pet.title.toLowerCase();
  if (t.includes('mythic')) return 'mythic';
  if (t.includes('mutant') || t.includes('titan') || t.includes('legendary')) return 'legendary';
  if (pet.level >= 15 || pet.stats.cp >= 550) return 'epic';
  if (pet.level >= 8 || pet.stats.cp >= 400) return 'rare';
  return 'common';
}

// Calculate ascension probability based on parent level and affection
export function calculateAscensionChance(parent1: CompanionPet, parent2: CompanionPet): number {
  const p1Rarity = getPetRarity(parent1);
  const p2Rarity = getPetRarity(parent2);
  const highestTierIdx = Math.max(RARITY_LEVEL_MAP[p1Rarity], RARITY_LEVEL_MAP[p2Rarity]);
  if (highestTierIdx >= RARITY_TIERS.length - 1) {
    return 0; // Already max tier (Mythic)
  }

  // 30% baseline chance
  let chance = 0.30;

  // Level bonus: up to +10% (scaled across parent levels)
  const avgLevel = ((parent1.level || 5) + (parent2.level || 5)) / 2;
  const levelBonus = Math.min(0.10, (avgLevel / 30) * 0.10);

  // Affection hearts bonus: up to +10% (scaled across 0-5 hearts)
  const avgHearts = ((parent1.affectionHearts || 1) + (parent2.affectionHearts || 1)) / 2;
  const heartBonus = Math.min(0.10, (avgHearts / 5) * 0.10);

  // Same tier synergy: if both parents are same high tier, +5%
  const synergy = (p1Rarity === p2Rarity && highestTierIdx > 0) ? 0.05 : 0;

  chance = Math.min(0.50, chance + levelBonus + heartBonus + synergy);
  return Math.round(chance * 100) / 100;
}

// Rare Mutations (5% chance)
const RARE_MUTATIONS = [
  {
    type: 'Radioactive Neon',
    title: 'Radioactive Chimera',
    paletteOverride: {
      primary: '#39FF14',
      secondary: '#00F0FF',
      belly: '#CCFF00',
      ear: '#FF007A',
      eye: '#00F0FF',
      nose: '#0B0F19',
    },
    statMultiplier: 1.15,
  },
  {
    type: 'Void Nebula',
    title: 'Cosmic Starborn',
    paletteOverride: {
      primary: '#6D28D9',
      secondary: '#4C1D95',
      belly: '#C4B5FD',
      ear: '#A855F7',
      eye: '#38BDF8',
      nose: '#1E1B4B',
    },
    statMultiplier: 1.18,
  },
  {
    type: 'Solar Apex God',
    title: 'Solarized Monarch',
    paletteOverride: {
      primary: '#F59E0B',
      secondary: '#B45309',
      belly: '#FEF3C7',
      ear: '#D97706',
      eye: '#FFFFFF',
      nose: '#78350F',
    },
    statMultiplier: 1.2,
  },
  {
    type: 'Blood Eclipse',
    title: 'Eclipse Hellhound',
    paletteOverride: {
      primary: '#DC2626',
      secondary: '#991B1B',
      belly: '#FEE2E2',
      ear: '#7F1D1D',
      eye: '#FBBF24',
      nose: '#450A0A',
    },
    statMultiplier: 1.16,
  },
];

const SPECIES_DISPLAY_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  bengal: 'Bengal',
  mainecoon: 'Maine Coon',
  siamese: 'Siamese',
  tabby: 'Tabby',
  british: 'British Shorthair',
  scottish: 'Scottish Fold',
  calico: 'Calico',
  blackcat: 'Shadow Cat',
  germanshepherd: 'Shepherd',
  rottweiler: 'Rottweiler',
  retriever: 'Retriever',
  husky: 'Husky',
  bulldog: 'Bulldog',
  shiba: 'Shiba',
  doberman: 'Doberman',
  corgi: 'Corgi',
  kodiak: 'Kodiak',
  bagheera: 'Panther',
  ignis: 'Ignis',
  sultan: 'Sultan',
};

export function breedCompanionPets(parent1: CompanionPet, parent2: CompanionPet): EggEntity {
  const p1Stats = parent1.stats || { attack: 60, defense: 60, agility: 60, stamina: 60, cp: 400 };
  const p2Stats = parent2.stats || { attack: 60, defense: 60, agility: 60, stamina: 60, cp: 400 };

  // 1. Stat Inheritance (Weighted Average +-10% Gaussian variance)
  const calcStat = (s1: number, s2: number) => {
    const base = (s1 + s2) / 2;
    const variance = 1 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2; // 0.90 to 1.10
    return Math.round(base * variance);
  };

  let attack = calcStat(p1Stats.attack, p2Stats.attack);
  let defense = calcStat(p1Stats.defense, p2Stats.defense);
  let agility = calcStat(p1Stats.agility, p2Stats.agility);
  let stamina = calcStat(p1Stats.stamina, p2Stats.stamina);

  // 2. Coat Hex Color Blending
  const p1Pal = parent1.customPalette || {
    primary: '#E07A5F',
    secondary: '#3D405B',
    belly: '#F4F1DE',
    ear: '#F2CC8F',
    eye: '#2A9D8F',
    nose: '#1E1E24',
  };
  const p2Pal = parent2.customPalette || {
    primary: '#94A3B8',
    secondary: '#475569',
    belly: '#F8FAFC',
    ear: '#CBD5E1',
    eye: '#38BDF8',
    nose: '#0F172A',
  };

  const weight = 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.3; // 0.35 - 0.65
  let offspringPalette: PetCustomPalette = {
    primary: blendHexColors(p1Pal.primary, p2Pal.primary, weight),
    secondary: blendHexColors(p1Pal.secondary, p2Pal.secondary, weight),
    belly: blendHexColors(p1Pal.belly, p2Pal.belly, weight),
    ear: blendHexColors(p1Pal.ear, p2Pal.ear, weight),
    eye: Math.random() > 0.5 ? p1Pal.eye : p2Pal.eye,
    nose: Math.random() > 0.5 ? p1Pal.nose : p2Pal.nose,
  };

  // 3. Rarity Progression Ladder
  const p1Rarity = getPetRarity(parent1);
  const p2Rarity = getPetRarity(parent2);
  const higherTierIdx = Math.max(RARITY_LEVEL_MAP[p1Rarity], RARITY_LEVEL_MAP[p2Rarity]);
  const ascensionChance = calculateAscensionChance(parent1, parent2);
  const rollAscend = Math.random() < ascensionChance && higherTierIdx < RARITY_TIERS.length - 1;
  const finalRarity: PetRarity = rollAscend ? RARITY_TIERS[higherTierIdx + 1] : RARITY_TIERS[higherTierIdx];

  // Rarity stat scaling multiplier
  const rarityMultipliers: Record<PetRarity, number> = {
    common: 1.0,
    rare: 1.08,
    epic: 1.18,
    legendary: 1.30,
    mythic: 1.48,
  };
  const rMult = rarityMultipliers[finalRarity];
  attack = Math.round(attack * rMult);
  defense = Math.round(defense * rMult);
  agility = Math.round(agility * rMult);
  stamina = Math.round(stamina * rMult);

  // 4. Rare Mutation Roll (5% chance)
  const isMutant = Math.random() < 0.05;
  let mutationType: string | undefined = undefined;

  if (isMutant) {
    const mutation = RARE_MUTATIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * RARE_MUTATIONS.length)];
    mutationType = mutation.type;
    offspringPalette = { ...mutation.paletteOverride };
    attack = Math.round(attack * mutation.statMultiplier);
    defense = Math.round(defense * mutation.statMultiplier);
    agility = Math.round(agility * mutation.statMultiplier);
    stamina = Math.round(stamina * mutation.statMultiplier);
  }

  const cp = Math.round(attack * 1.8 + defense * 1.4 + agility * 1.6 + stamina * 1.5);

  // 5. Procedural Chimera Hybrid Fusion
  const isCrossBreed = parent1.species !== parent2.species || parent1.category !== parent2.category;
  const isChimera = isCrossBreed;

  const p1Breed = SPECIES_DISPLAY_NAMES[parent1.species] || parent1.species;
  const p2Breed = SPECIES_DISPLAY_NAMES[parent2.species] || parent2.species;

  const hybridSpeciesName = isChimera
    ? `${p1Breed}-${p2Breed} Chimera`
    : `Purebred ${p1Breed}`;

  // Species inheritance base for physics/animation
  const species = Math.random() > 0.5 ? parent1.species : parent2.species;
  const category = Math.random() > 0.5 ? parent1.category : parent2.category;

  // Custom physical features blending
  const p1Feat = parent1.customFeatures || {};
  const p2Feat = parent2.customFeatures || {};

  const customFeatures: PetCustomFeatures = {
    isCat: category === 'cat',
    isChimera,
    hybridSpeciesName,
    parent1Species: parent1.species,
    parent2Species: parent2.species,
    earType: p1Feat.earType || (category === 'cat' ? 'pointed' : 'floppy'),
    chimeraSecondaryEarType: p2Feat.earType || (p2Feat.isCat ? 'pointed' : 'floppy'),
    hasWhiskers: category === 'cat' || parent1.category === 'cat' || parent2.category === 'cat',
    hasRosettes: parent1.species === 'bengal' || parent2.species === 'bengal' || Math.random() < 0.35,
    hasStripes: parent1.species === 'tabby' || parent2.species === 'tabby' || Math.random() < 0.35,
    hasMuzzleMask: parent1.species === 'husky' || parent2.species === 'husky' || parent1.species === 'germanshepherd' || parent2.species === 'germanshepherd' || Math.random() < 0.4,
    hasEyebrowDots: parent1.species === 'rottweiler' || parent2.species === 'rottweiler' || parent1.species === 'doberman' || parent2.species === 'doberman' || Math.random() < 0.3,
    eyePatch: Math.random() < 0.25,
    fluffyTail: true,
    collarColor: finalRarity === 'mythic' ? '#FF007A' : finalRarity === 'legendary' ? '#F59E0B' : '#CCFF00',
    signatureMove: {
      name: isChimera ? `${p1Breed}-${p2Breed} Fusion Slam` : `Genetic Instinct Pounce`,
      description: isChimera
        ? `Dual-discipline hybrid strike combining canine crushing power with feline razor agility!`
        : `Inherited ancestral technique delivering high critical-hit damage!`,
    },
  };

  const names = ['Aegis', 'Blitz', 'Cipher', 'Draco', 'Echo', 'Fable', 'Gale', 'Hyperion', 'Kaiser', 'Luna', 'Valkyrie', 'Titan', 'Zephyr', 'Orion', 'Nova'];
  const name = `${names[Math.floor(Math.random() * names.length)]} ${isChimera ? 'Chimera' : 'Junior'}`;

  return {
    id: `egg_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}`,
    parent1Id: parent1.id,
    parent2Id: parent2.id,
    parent1Name: parent1.name,
    parent2Name: parent2.name,
    species,
    category,
    name,
    rarity: finalRarity,
    isChimera,
    hybridSpeciesName,
    customFeatures,
    ascendedTier: rollAscend,
    ascensionChancePercent: Math.round(ascensionChance * 100),
    offspringPalette,
    offspringStats: { attack, defense, agility, stamina, cp },
    isMutant,
    mutationType,
    laidAt: Date.now(),
    hatchDurationSeconds: 10, // 10s fast incubation for awesome gameplay feel
    isReadyToHatch: false,
  };
}

export function hatchEggToCompanionPet(egg: EggEntity): CompanionPet {
  const isMythic = egg.rarity === 'mythic';
  const isLegendary = egg.rarity === 'legendary';

  let title = `${egg.rarity.toUpperCase()} Prodigy`;
  if (isMythic) {
    title = `Mythic ${egg.hybridSpeciesName || 'Chimera Sovereign'}`;
  } else if (egg.isMutant) {
    title = `Mutant ${egg.mutationType}`;
  } else if (egg.isChimera) {
    title = `${egg.rarity.toUpperCase()} Chimera Hybrid`;
  }

  return {
    id: `bred_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 6)}`,
    species: egg.species,
    category: egg.category,
    name: egg.name,
    title,
    rarity: egg.rarity,
    isChimera: egg.isChimera,
    hybridSpeciesName: egg.hybridSpeciesName,
    stage: 1,
    level: 1,
    exp: 0,
    maxExp: 100,
    affectionHearts: 5,
    affectionPoints: 120,
    hunger: 100,
    happiness: 100,
    energy: 100,
    mood: 'excited',
    stats: egg.offspringStats,
    battleBuff: {
      name: isMythic
        ? 'Mythic Celestial Aura'
        : egg.isMutant
        ? 'Mutant Surge'
        : egg.isChimera
        ? 'Chimera Hybrid Vigor'
        : 'Hereditary Instinct',
      description: isMythic
        ? '+35% Overdrive & +20% Critical Strike Chance from Mythic lineage.'
        : egg.isMutant
        ? '+25% Overdrive Damage from rare genetic mutation.'
        : egg.isChimera
        ? '+15% All-Round Combat Attributes from cross-species hybrid vigor.'
        : '+10% Speed in battle.',
      effectType: 'crit_chance',
      potency: isMythic ? 35 : egg.isMutant ? 25 : egg.isChimera ? 15 : 10,
    },
    createdAt: Date.now(),
    lastFedAt: Date.now(),
    lastPettedAt: Date.now(),
    totalPats: 0,
    totalBerriesEaten: 0,
    caughtAt: 'Sanctuary Genetics Lab',
    isFavorite: true,
    customPalette: egg.offspringPalette,
    customFeatures: egg.customFeatures,
    breedName: egg.isChimera ? egg.hybridSpeciesName : `Bred Gen-2 ${egg.species}`,
    personalityTraits: isMythic
      ? ['Mythic Sovereign', 'Celestial Lineage', 'Apex Predator']
      : egg.isMutant
      ? ['Rare Mutant', 'Genetic Marvel', 'Arena Apex']
      : egg.isChimera
      ? ['Chimera Hybrid', 'Dual Instinct', 'Adaptive Fighter']
      : ['Playful', 'Loyal', 'High Potential'],
    quirk: isMythic
      ? 'Radiates an iridescent celestial aura that mesmerizes opponents in the arena!'
      : egg.isMutant
      ? 'Glows in dark arenas with neon cyber radiation!'
      : egg.isChimera
      ? 'Can vocalize both a piercing bark and a stealthy purr!'
      : 'Inherited strong instincts from both parents.',
    isCustomAvatar: true,
  };
}

/**
 * Cross-platform Haptics Controller for PET SLAM
 * Integrates Capacitor Native Haptics on iOS / Android with Web Vibration API fallback.
 */

import { Haptics, ImpactStyle, NotificationType } from '@capacitor/haptics';

export async function triggerLightImpactHaptic() {
  try {
    await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Light });
  } catch {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
      navigator.vibrate(15);
    }
  }
}

export async function triggerMediumImpactHaptic() {
  try {
    await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Medium });
  } catch {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
      navigator.vibrate(35);
    }
  }
}

export async function triggerHeavyImpactHaptic() {
  try {
    await Haptics.impact({ style: ImpactStyle.Heavy });
  } catch {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
      navigator.vibrate([60, 40, 80]);
    }
  }
}

export async function triggerSuccessHaptic() {
  try {
    await Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationType.Success });
  } catch {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
      navigator.vibrate([30, 30, 50]);
    }
  }
}

export async function triggerWarningHaptic() {
  try {
    await Haptics.notification({ type: NotificationType.Warning });
  } catch {
    if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'vibrate' in navigator) {
      navigator.vibrate([50, 50, 50]);
    }
  }
}

<document_content>
/**
 * Kokoro Local TTS Service (kokoro-js)
 * 82 Million Parameter Open-Weight Local Text-To-Speech for PET SLAM
 * 100% on-device neural voice generation via ONNX WebAssembly / WebGPU.
 */

export type KokoroVoice =
  | 'af_heart'   // Default: Warm, affectionate companion pet voice
  | 'af_bella'   // Energetic, playful pet champion
  | 'af_nicole'  // Clear, crisp tactical guide
  | 'am_fenrir'  // Deep, heroic arena announcer
  | 'am_michael' // Confident champion brawler
  | 'bf_alice'   // Gentle sanctuary caretaker;

export interface KokoroOptions {
  voice?: KokoroVoice;
  speed?: number;
  pitch?: number;
}

class KokoroLocalTTSManager {
  private ttsInstance: any = null;
  private isInitializing: boolean = false;
  private isReady: boolean = false;
  private isEnabled: boolean = true;
  private currentVoice: KokoroVoice = 'af_heart';
  private audioCache = new Map<string, string>(); // text:voice -> blobUrl
  private currentAudioElement: HTMLAudioElement | null = null;

  constructor() {
    // Check localStorage preference
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const stored = localStorage.getItem('petslam_kokoro_tts_enabled');
      if (stored !== null) {
        this.isEnabled = stored === 'true';
      }
    }
  }

  /**
   * Lazily initializes the Kokoro 82M ONNX model locally in the browser.
   */
  public async init(): Promise<boolean> {
    if (this.isReady && this.ttsInstance) return true;
    if (this.isInitializing) return false;

    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return false;

    this.isInitializing = true;
    try {
      console.log('[KokoroTTS] Initializing local 82M ONNX neural TTS engine...');
      const { KokoroTTS } = await import('kokoro-js');

      // Check for WebGPU acceleration, fallback to WASM
      const hasWebGPU = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && 'gpu' in navigator;
      const device = hasWebGPU ? 'webgpu' : 'wasm';
      const dtype = hasWebGPU ? 'fp32' : 'q8'; // q8 is 8-bit quantized, ultra-fast

      this.ttsInstance = await KokoroTTS.from_pretrained(
        'onnx-community/Kokoro-82M-v1.0-ONNX',
        {
          dtype,
          device,
        }
      );

      this.isReady = true;
      this.isInitializing = false;
      console.log(`[KokoroTTS] Local model loaded successfully (${device.toUpperCase()})`);
      return true;
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.warn('[KokoroTTS] WebAssembly/WebGPU initialization notice:', err?.message || err);
      this.isInitializing = false;
      return false;
    }
  }

  /**
   * Speaks the provided text using Kokoro local TTS, falling back gracefully
   * to browser SpeechSynthesis while the model downloads/warms up.
   */
  public async speak(text: string, options?: KokoroOptions): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isEnabled || !text.trim()) return;

    const voice = options?.voice || this.currentVoice;
    const cacheKey = `${voice}_${text.trim().toLowerCase()}`;

    // 1. Instant Cache Hit
    if (this.audioCache.has(cacheKey)) {
      const cachedUrl = this.audioCache.get(cacheKey)!;
      this.playBlobUrl(cachedUrl);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Try Kokoro Local Neural TTS
    if (this.isReady && this.ttsInstance) {
      try {
        const audio = await this.ttsInstance.generate(text, {
          voice,
        });

        if (audio && typeof audio.toBlob === 'function') {
          const blob = audio.toBlob();
          const blobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
          this.audioCache.set(cacheKey, blobUrl);
          this.playBlobUrl(blobUrl);
          return;
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('[KokoroTTS] Generation warning, falling back to browser speech:', err);
      }
    }

    // 3. Background lazy load if not already started
    if (!this.isReady && !this.isInitializing) {
      this.init().catch(() => {});
    }

    // 4. Fallback: Browser Web Speech API (instant, no delay)
    this.speakNativeBrowser(text, options);
  }

  /**
   * Plays a synthesized audio blob URL.
   */
  private playBlobUrl(url: string) {
    try {
      if (this.currentAudioElement) {
        this.currentAudioElement.pause();
        this.currentAudioElement = null;
      }
      const audio = new Audio(url);
      this.currentAudioElement = audio;
      audio.play().catch(() => {});
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[KokoroTTS] Audio playback error:', e);
    }
  }

  /**
   * Browser SpeechSynthesis fallback with cute pitch modulation for pets.
   */
  private speakNativeBrowser(text: string, options?: KokoroOptions) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !('speechSynthesis' in window)) return;

    try {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
      const cleanText = text.replace(/[*_#⚡💧🧘🏃🍓🔋❤️🐶🐱]/g, '').trim();
      if (!cleanText) return;

      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(cleanText);
      utterance.pitch = options?.pitch ?? 1.35; // Cute higher pitch for pets
      utterance.rate = options?.speed ?? 1.1;

      // Select female/sweet voice if available
      const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
      const preferred = voices.find((v) =>
        v.name.includes('Natural') || v.name.includes('Samantha') || v.name.includes('Google')
      );
      if (preferred) utterance.voice = preferred;

      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    } catch {}
  }

  public setVoice(voice: KokoroVoice) {
    this.currentVoice = voice;
  }

  public getVoice(): KokoroVoice {
    return this.currentVoice;
  }

  public toggle(): boolean {
    this.isEnabled = !this.isEnabled;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('petslam_kokoro_tts_enabled', String(this.isEnabled));
    }
    return this.isEnabled;
  }

  public setEnabled(enabled: boolean) {
    this.isEnabled = enabled;
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      localStorage.setItem('petslam_kokoro_tts_enabled', String(enabled));
    }
  }

  public getIsEnabled(): boolean {
    return this.isEnabled;
  }

  public getIsReady(): boolean {
    return this.isReady;
  }

  public getIsInitializing(): boolean {
    return this.isInitializing;
  }
}

export const kokoroTTS = new KokoroLocalTTSManager();

import { ANIMALS_DATA, Animal } from '../data/animals';
import { PetSpecies, CompanionPet } from '../types/pet';

/**
 * Universal Breed Mapping: Maps any CompanionPet, species key, or animal identifier
 * to the verified, high-resolution official animal portrait in ANIMALS_DATA.
 * Ensures 100% visual uniformity across Arena, Beasts, Market, Sanctuary, Auctions, and Extension.
 */
export const SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID: Record<string, string> = {
  // Dogs
  germanshepherd: 'dog_01',
  kaiser: 'dog_01',
  rottweiler: 'dog_02',
  vulkan: 'dog_02',
  retriever: 'dog_03',
  goldenretriever: 'dog_03',
  buddy: 'dog_03',
  husky: 'dog_04',
  ghost: 'dog_04',
  bulldog: 'dog_05',
  frenchbulldog: 'dog_05',
  rocky: 'dog_05',
  shiba: 'dog_06',
  shibainu: 'dog_06',
  hachi: 'dog_06',
  doberman: 'dog_07',
  titan: 'dog_07',
  corgi: 'dog_08',
  biscuit: 'dog_08',
  mastiff: 'dog_08',
  conan: 'dog_08',

  // Cats
  bengal: 'cat_01',
  leonidas: 'cat_01',
  mainecoon: 'cat_02',
  thor: 'cat_02',
  siamese: 'cat_03',
  mochi: 'cat_03',
  tabby: 'cat_04',
  garfield: 'cat_04',
  british: 'cat_05',
  britishshorthair: 'cat_05',
  winston: 'cat_05',
  scottish: 'cat_06',
  scottishfold: 'cat_06',
  luna: 'cat_06',
  calico: 'cat_07',
  cleo: 'cat_07',
  blackcat: 'cat_08',
  shadow: 'cat_08',

  // Backwards compat aliases
  kodiak: 'dog_04',
  bagheera: 'cat_08',
  ignis: 'dog_02',
  sultan: 'cat_01',
};

/**
 * Resolves the authentic photo URL for any pet or species.
 */
export function getPetPhoto(
  pet?: Partial<CompanionPet> | Partial<Animal> | { species?: string; name?: string; image?: string; avatarImageUrl?: string } | null
): string {
  if (!pet) return ANIMALS_DATA[0].image;

  // Custom photo avatar priority
  if ('avatarImageUrl' in pet && pet.avatarImageUrl) {
    return pet.avatarImageUrl;
  }

  // Direct image property priority if already set
  if ('image' in pet && pet.image) {
    return pet.image;
  }

  // Lookup by species key
  const speciesKey = (pet.species || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '');
  if (speciesKey && SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[speciesKey]) {
    const matched = ANIMALS_DATA.find((a) => a.id === SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[speciesKey]);
    if (matched?.image) return matched.image;
  }

  // Lookup by pet name
  const nameKey = (pet.name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '');
  if (nameKey && SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[nameKey]) {
    const matched = ANIMALS_DATA.find((a) => a.id === SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[nameKey]);
    if (matched?.image) return matched.image;
  }

  // Fallback by category
  if ('category' in pet) {
    if (pet.category === 'cat' || pet.category === 'Felines') {
      return ANIMALS_DATA[8].image; // Bengal Cat
    }
  }

  return ANIMALS_DATA[0].image; // German Shepherd
}

/**
 * Resolves the display breed name for any pet
 */
export function getPetBreedName(
  pet?: Partial<CompanionPet> | Partial<Animal> | { species?: string; name?: string; breed?: string; breedName?: string } | null
): string {
  if (!pet) return 'Pedigree Champion';

  if ('breed' in pet && pet.breed) return pet.breed;
  if ('breedName' in pet && pet.breedName) return pet.breedName;

  const speciesKey = (pet.species || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g, '');
  if (speciesKey && SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[speciesKey]) {
    const matched = ANIMALS_DATA.find((a) => a.id === SPECIES_TO_ANIMAL_ID[speciesKey]);
    if (matched?.breed) return matched.breed;
  }

  return pet.species || 'Purebred';
}

/**
 * Returns a visually distinct styling for each rarity tier so no two tiers look the same.
 */
export function getRarityBadgeClasses(rarity: string): string {
  const r = (rarity || 'Common').toLowerCase();
  switch (r) {
    case 'apex':
      return 'border-2 border-[#CCFF00] bg-black text-[#CCFF00] font-display font-black text-[10px] tracking-widest uppercase shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(204,255,0,0.7)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md';
    case 'legendary':
      return 'border border-amber-400 bg-amber-950/90 text-amber-300 font-display font-black text-[9px] tracking-wider uppercase shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(245,158,11,0.5)] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md';
    case 'epic':
      return 'border border-purple-400 bg-purple-950/90 text-purple-200 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold uppercase shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(168,85,247,0.4)] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md';
    case 'rare':
      return 'border border-cyan-400 bg-cyan-950/90 text-cyan-300 font-mono text-[9px] font-bold uppercase shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(0,229,255,0.3)] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md';
    case 'common':
    default:
      return 'border border-neutral-600 bg-neutral-900/80 text-neutral-300 font-mono text-[9px] font-medium uppercase px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-md';
  }
}

/**
 * Maps any pet/beast or species string to a strongly-typed PetSpecies
 */
export function mapBeastToSpecies(speciesOrBreed?: string): PetSpecies {
  const s = (speciesOrBreed || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[\s\-_]+/g, '');
  if (s.includes('germanshepherd') || s.includes('shepherd')) return 'germanshepherd';
  if (s.includes('rottweiler')) return 'rottweiler';
  if (s.includes('retriever') || s.includes('golden')) return 'retriever';
  if (s.includes('husky') || s.includes('siberian')) return 'husky';
  if (s.includes('bulldog') || s.includes('french')) return 'bulldog';
  if (s.includes('shiba') || s.includes('inu')) return 'shiba';
  if (s.includes('doberman') || s.includes('pinscher')) return 'doberman';
  if (s.includes('corgi')) return 'corgi';
  if (s.includes('bengal')) return 'bengal';
  if (s.includes('mainecoon') || s.includes('maine')) return 'mainecoon';
  if (s.includes('siamese')) return 'siamese';
  if (s.includes('tabby')) return 'tabby';
  if (s.includes('british') || s.includes('shorthair')) return 'british';
  if (s.includes('scottish') || s.includes('fold')) return 'scottish';
  if (s.includes('calico')) return 'calico';
  if (s.includes('black') || s.includes('bombay') || s.includes('bagheera')) return 'blackcat';
  return 'shiba';
}

<document_content>
// Real Browser Voice Chat Engine for 2v2 Teammate Audio
// Supports real microphone capture via Web Audio AnalyserNode and
// audible teammate tactical voice communication via SpeechSynthesis + Radio FX.

export interface VoiceChatState {
  isMicActive: boolean;
  isMuted: boolean;
  volumeLevel: number; // 0 to 100 real-time decibel/frequency meter
  isSpeaking: boolean;
  isTeammateSpeaking: boolean;
  lastTeammateMessage: string;
  teammateVolume: number; // 0 to 1
  error: string | null;
}

class VoiceChatEngine {
  private audioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private micStream: MediaStream | null = null;
  private analyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;
  private animFrameId: number | null = null;
  private listeners: Set<(state: VoiceChatState) => void> = new Set();

  private state: VoiceChatState = {
    isMicActive: false,
    isMuted: false,
    volumeLevel: 0,
    isSpeaking: false,
    isTeammateSpeaking: false,
    lastTeammateMessage: 'Radio connected. Awaiting tactical orders.',
    teammateVolume: 0.85,
    error: null,
  };

  private notify() {
    this.listeners.forEach((listener) => listener({ ...this.state }));
  }

  public subscribe(listener: (state: VoiceChatState) => void) {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    listener({ ...this.state });
    return () => {
      this.listeners.delete(listener);
    };
  }

  // Play subtle military radio squelch / walkie-talkie chirp
  private playRadioChirp(type: 'open' | 'close') {
    try {
      const Ctx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (!Ctx) return;
      const ctx = new Ctx();
      const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
      const gain = ctx.createGain();
      const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();

      filter.type = 'bandpass';
      filter.frequency.setValueAtTime(1400, ctx.currentTime);
      filter.Q.setValueAtTime(3.0, ctx.currentTime);

      osc.type = 'sine';
      if (type === 'open') {
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1200, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(1800, ctx.currentTime + 0.05);
      } else {
        osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(1800, ctx.currentTime);
        osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(800, ctx.currentTime + 0.06);
      }

      gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.06 * this.state.teammateVolume, ctx.currentTime);
      gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + 0.06);

      osc.connect(filter);
      filter.connect(gain);
      gain.connect(ctx.destination);

      osc.start();
      osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + 0.06);
    } catch {}
  }

  // Request actual microphone stream and start real audio analyser
  public async enableMicrophone(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
          audio: {
            echoCancellation: true,
            noiseSuppression: true,
            autoGainControl: true,
          },
        });

        this.micStream = stream;
        const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
        this.audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
        const source = this.audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(stream);

        const analyser = this.audioCtx.createAnalyser();
        analyser.fftSize = 64;
        analyser.smoothingTimeConstant = 0.5;
        source.connect(analyser);
        this.analyser = analyser;

        this.state.isMicActive = true;
        this.state.isMuted = false;
        this.state.error = null;
        this.notify();

        this.startMeterLoop();
        this.speakTeammate('Mic check 1-2! Devon here, I can hear you loud and clear. Let\'s crush this 2v2!');
        return true;
      } else {
        // Fallback simulation mode
        this.state.isMicActive = true;
        this.state.isMuted = false;
        this.state.error = 'Live mic stream simulated (browser permission restricted).';
        this.notify();
        this.speakTeammate('Devon online! Tactical radio channel ready.');
        return true;
      }
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Microphone access denied';
      // Graceful fallback: Still allow simulated voice interaction
      this.state.isMicActive = true;
      this.state.isMuted = false;
      this.state.error = `Mic permission note: ${message}. Tactical comms active.`;
      this.notify();
      this.speakTeammate('Radio connected! You can hear my combat callouts.');
      return false;
    }
  }

  private startMeterLoop() {
    if (this.animFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrameId);

    const dataArray = new Uint8Array(32);

    const loop = () => {
      if (this.analyser && this.state.isMicActive && !this.state.isMuted) {
        this.analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);

        // Average frequency volume
        let sum = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
          sum += dataArray[i];
        }
        const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
        const normalized = Math.min(100, Math.round((avg / 128) * 100));

        this.state.volumeLevel = normalized;
        this.state.isSpeaking = normalized > 12;
      } else {
        this.state.volumeLevel = 0;
        this.state.isSpeaking = false;
      }

      this.notify();
      this.animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };

    loop();
  }

  public toggleMute() {
    this.state.isMuted = !this.state.isMuted;
    if (this.micStream) {
      this.micStream.getAudioTracks().forEach((track) => {
        track.enabled = !this.state.isMuted;
      });
    }
    this.notify();
    if (this.state.isMuted) {
      this.playRadioChirp('close');
    } else {
      this.playRadioChirp('open');
    }
  }

  public setTeammateVolume(vol: number) {
    this.state.teammateVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, vol));
    this.notify();
  }

  // Real Audible Teammate Speech via Web Speech API
  public speakTeammate(text: string) {
    this.state.lastTeammateMessage = text;
    this.state.isTeammateSpeaking = true;
    this.notify();

    this.playRadioChirp('open');

    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window && this.state.teammateVolume > 0.05) {
      // Cancel pending
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();

      const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
      utterance.rate = 1.12; // Fast tactical delivery
      utterance.pitch = 1.05;
      utterance.volume = this.state.teammateVolume;

      // Pick an English voice if available
      const voices = window.speechSynthesis.getVoices();
      const engVoice = voices.find((v) => v.lang.startsWith('en') && (v.name.includes('Male') || v.name.includes('David') || v.name.includes('Google')));
      if (engVoice) utterance.voice = engVoice;

      utterance.onend = () => {
        this.state.isTeammateSpeaking = false;
        this.playRadioChirp('close');
        this.notify();
      };

      utterance.onerror = () => {
        this.state.isTeammateSpeaking = false;
        this.notify();
      };

      window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
    } else {
      // Fallback timer if speech synthesis is muted
      setTimeout(() => {
        this.state.isTeammateSpeaking = false;
        this.notify();
      }, 2500);
    }
  }

  public cleanup() {
    if (this.animFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrameId);
    if (this.micStream) {
      this.micStream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    }
    if (this.audioCtx && this.audioCtx.state !== 'closed') {
      this.audioCtx.close().catch(() => {});
    }
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && 'speechSynthesis' in window) {
      window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    }
    this.state.isMicActive = false;
  }
}

export const voiceChat = new VoiceChatEngine();

<document_content>
// Real-time Voice Mimic & Pitch Shifter for Pet Companion
// Records microphone input and plays back in a pitched companion voice with mouth lip-sync!

export class VoiceMimicEngine {
  private audioCtx: AudioContext | null = null;
  private mediaStream: MediaStream | null = null;
  private mediaRecorder: MediaRecorder | null = null;
  private recordedChunks: Blob[] = [];
  private isRecording: boolean = false;
  private isPlaying: boolean = false;
  private analyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;
  private animFrameId: number | null = null;

  private initCtx() {
    if (!this.audioCtx && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
      const AudioCtx =
        window.AudioContext ||
        (window as unknown as { webkitAudioContext: typeof AudioContext }).webkitAudioContext;
      if (AudioCtx) {
        this.audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
      }
    }
    if (this.audioCtx && this.audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
      this.audioCtx.resume().catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  public get recordingStatus(): boolean {
    return this.isRecording;
  }

  public get playingStatus(): boolean {
    return this.isPlaying;
  }

  // 1. Start listening to mic
  public async startListening(
    onMicVolume?: (volume: number) => void
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
    try {
      this.initCtx();
      if (!this.audioCtx) return { success: false, error: 'Web Audio API unavailable' };

      if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Microphone not supported on this browser' };
      }

      this.mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
        audio: {
          echoCancellation: true,
          noiseSuppression: true,
        },
      });

      this.recordedChunks = [];
      this.mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(this.mediaStream);

      this.mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
        if (e.data.size > 0) {
          this.recordedChunks.push(e.data);
        }
      };

      // Set up real-time volume analyzer
      const source = this.audioCtx.createMediaStreamSource(this.mediaStream);
      const analyser = this.audioCtx.createAnalyser();
      analyser.fftSize = 256;
      source.connect(analyser);

      const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
      const checkVolume = () => {
        if (!this.isRecording) return;
        analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
        let sum = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
          sum += dataArray[i];
        }
        const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
        const normalized = Math.min(1, avg / 128);
        onMicVolume?.(normalized);
        requestAnimationFrame(checkVolume);
      };

      this.mediaRecorder.start();
      this.isRecording = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(checkVolume);

      return { success: true };
    } catch (err: unknown) {
      console.warn('Microphone permission denied or failed:', err);
      return { success: false, error: (err as Error).message || 'Microphone access denied' };
    }
  }

  // 2. Stop listening and pitch-shift repeat in companion voice!
  public async stopAndRepeat(
    onMouthSync: (amplitude: number) => void,
    onFinish: () => void
  ): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.isRecording || !this.mediaRecorder) {
      onFinish();
      return;
    }

    this.isRecording = false;

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      this.mediaRecorder!.onstop = async () => {
        // Stop all mic tracks
        if (this.mediaStream) {
          this.mediaStream.getTracks().forEach((track) => track.stop());
          this.mediaStream = null;
        }

        if (this.recordedChunks.length === 0) {
          onFinish();
          resolve();
          return;
        }

        const blob = new Blob(this.recordedChunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        const arrayBuffer = await blob.arrayBuffer();

        try {
          this.initCtx();
          if (!this.audioCtx) {
            onFinish();
            resolve();
            return;
          }

          const audioBuffer = await this.audioCtx.decodeAudioData(arrayBuffer);

          // Play pitch shifted: 1.48x playback speed creates the iconic high-pitched cartoon voice!
          const source = this.audioCtx.createBufferSource();
          source.buffer = audioBuffer;
          source.playbackRate.value = 1.48; // Cartoon pitch multiplier!

          const analyser = this.audioCtx.createAnalyser();
          analyser.fftSize = 128;
          source.connect(analyser);
          analyser.connect(this.audioCtx.destination);

          this.isPlaying = true;
          source.start();

          const dataArray = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
          const updateMouth = () => {
            if (!this.isPlaying) return;
            analyser.getByteFrequencyData(dataArray);
            let sum = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i++) {
              sum += dataArray[i];
            }
            const avg = sum / dataArray.length;
            const amp = Math.min(1, (avg / 100) * 1.5);
            onMouthSync(amp);
            this.animFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(updateMouth);
          };
          updateMouth();

          source.onended = () => {
            this.isPlaying = false;
            if (this.animFrameId) cancelAnimationFrame(this.animFrameId);
            onMouthSync(0);
            onFinish();
            resolve();
          };
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('Audio decoding failed, using fallback speech synthesis:', e);
          this.speakPresetPhrase(
            'Hahaha! I heard you loud and clear!',
            onMouthSync,
            onFinish
          );
          resolve();
        }
      };

      this.mediaRecorder!.stop();
    });
  }

  // Fallback high-pitch speech synthesis if no mic or for instant phrases
  public speakPresetPhrase(
    text: string,
    onMouthSync: (amplitude: number) => void,
    onFinish: () => void
  ) {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.speechSynthesis) {
      // Simulate mouth animation
      this.simulateSpeechAnimation(text.length * 80, onMouthSync, onFinish);
      return;
    }

    window.speechSynthesis.cancel();
    const utterance = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);
    utterance.pitch = 1.95; // High chipmunk / cartoon pitch
    utterance.rate = 1.35; // Fast bubbly rate

    this.isPlaying = true;

    // Simulate animated speech mouth flapping
    const startTime = performance.now();
    const expectedDuration = Math.max(1200, text.length * 75);

    const flapLoop = () => {
      if (!this.isPlaying) return;
      const elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
      if (elapsed > expectedDuration + 500) {
        this.isPlaying = false;
        onMouthSync(0);
        onFinish();
        return;
      }
      const amp = Math.abs(Math.sin(elapsed * 0.025)) * 0.9;
      onMouthSync(amp);
      requestAnimationFrame(flapLoop);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(flapLoop);

    utterance.onend = () => {
      this.isPlaying = false;
      onMouthSync(0);
      onFinish();
    };

    utterance.onerror = () => {
      this.isPlaying = false;
      onMouthSync(0);
      onFinish();
    };

    window.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
  }

  private simulateSpeechAnimation(
    durationMs: number,
    onMouthSync: (amp: number) => void,
    onFinish: () => void
  ) {
    this.isPlaying = true;
    const start = performance.now();
    const loop = () => {
      const elapsed = performance.now() - start;
      if (elapsed >= durationMs) {
        this.isPlaying = false;
        onMouthSync(0);
        onFinish();
        return;
      }
      const amp = Math.abs(Math.sin(elapsed * 0.022)) * 0.85;
      onMouthSync(amp);
      requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
}

export const voiceMimic = new VoiceMimicEngine();

<document_content>
// ==============================================================================
// PET SLAM: Supabase Edge Function for Secure Waitlist & Resend Emails
// Deploy with: supabase functions deploy waitlist --no-verify-jwt
// Required Secrets: RESEND_API_KEY (Set via Supabase Dashboard -> Edge Functions -> Secrets)
// ==============================================================================

import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.168.0/http/server.ts";
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.0";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, GET, OPTIONS",
};

interface WaitlistRequest {
  email: string;
}

serve(async (req: Request) => {
  // 1. Handle CORS Preflight
  if (req.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }

  try {
    // 2. Health check / status probe
    if (req.method === "GET") {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ status: "operational", service: "PET SLAM Waitlist Engine" }),
        { headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    if (req.method !== "POST") {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ error: "Method not allowed" }),
        { status: 405, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // 3. Parse and validate payload
    const body: WaitlistRequest = await req.json().catch(() => ({ email: "" }));
    const rawEmail = body.email;

    if (!rawEmail || typeof rawEmail !== "string") {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Email address is required." }),
        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    const email = rawEmail.trim().toLowerCase();
    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(email) || email.length > 254) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Please provide a valid email address." }),
        { status: 400, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // 4. Initialize Supabase Service Role client
    const supabaseUrl = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_URL") ?? "";
    const supabaseServiceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY") ?? "";

    if (!supabaseUrl || !supabaseServiceKey) {
      console.error("Missing SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Edge Function environment.");
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "Server configuration error: Database keys not detected." }),
        { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseServiceKey);

    // 5. Check duplicate registration
    const { data: existing, error: checkError } = await supabase
      .from("waitlist")
      .select("id, email, created_at, signup_status, perks")
      .eq("email", email)
      .maybeSingle();

    if (checkError) {
      console.error("Error querying waitlist:", checkError);
    }

    if (existing) {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          success: false,
          duplicate: true,
          message: "This email is already registered on the PET SLAM waitlist.",
          entry: existing,
        }),
        { status: 409, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // 6. Insert new candidate into database
    const perksData = {
      credits: 10000,
      founder_badge: true,
      alpha_access: true,
    };

    const { data: inserted, error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from("waitlist")
      .insert({
        email,
        signup_status: "confirmed",
        perks: perksData,
        email_delivery_status: "pending",
      })
      .select()
      .single();

    if (insertError || !inserted) {
      console.error("Failed to insert into waitlist:", insertError);
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          success: false,
          error: "Database error: Could not record signup. Please try again.",
        }),
        { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
      );
    }

    // 7. Dispatch Transactional Confirmation Email via Resend
    const resendApiKey = Deno.env.get("RESEND_API_KEY");
    const senderEmail = Deno.env.get("RESEND_FROM_EMAIL") || "PET SLAM <hello@petslam.com>";

    let emailSent = false;
    let emailStatusMessage = "";

    if (!resendApiKey) {
      emailStatusMessage = "RESEND_API_KEY secret not yet set in Supabase Edge Function secrets. Signup saved successfully.";
      console.warn("RESEND_API_KEY is not configured.");
    } else {
      try {
        const emailSubject = "Welcome to PET SLAM. You're on the list.";
        const plainTextBody = `WELCOME TO THE ARENA.

You're officially on the PET SLAM waitlist.

Get ready to own, train and battle your animals. We're building something different, and you'll be among the first to experience it.

As a registered genesis applicant, your voucher (${inserted.id}) includes:
• 10,000 In-App Arena Credits
• Founder Beast Badge
• Priority Closed Alpha Feature Testing

The arena is coming. Stay tuned.

– Team PET SLAM
https://petslam.com`;

        const htmlBody = `
        <!DOCTYPE html>
        <html>
        <head>
          <meta charset="utf-8">
          <style>
            body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; background-color: #0B0C10; color: #F3F4F6; margin: 0; padding: 30px 15px; }
            .container { max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto; background-color: #12141A; border: 1px solid #232734; padding: 40px 30px; }
            .logo { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; }
            .accent { color: #CCFF00; }
            .badge { display: inline-block; background-color: rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(204, 255, 0, 0.3); color: #CCFF00; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: bold; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1.5px; margin-top: 15px; }
            h1 { font-size: 24px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #FFFFFF; margin-top: 25px; margin-bottom: 15px; }
            p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #D1D5DB; margin-bottom: 16px; }
            .perks-box { background-color: #08090C; border: 1px solid #232734; padding: 20px; margin: 25px 0; }
            .perk-item { padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05); font-size: 13px; }
            .perk-item:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
            .perk-title { color: #CCFF00; font-weight: bold; }
            .voucher { font-family: monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #9CA3AF; margin-top: 10px; }
            .footer { margin-top: 35px; border-top: 1px solid #232734; padding-top: 20px; font-size: 12px; color: #6B7280; }
          </style>
        </head>
        <body>
          <div class="container">
            <div class="logo">PET<span class="accent"> SLAM</span></div>
            <div class="badge">Application Confirmed · Genesis Registry</div>
            
            <h1>WELCOME TO THE ARENA.</h1>
            
            <p>You're officially on the <strong>PET SLAM</strong> waitlist.</p>
            <p>Get ready to own, train and battle your animals. We're building something different, and you'll be among the first to experience it.</p>
            
            <div class="perks-box">
              <div style="font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #9CA3AF; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: bold;">Granted Genesis Privileges</div>
              <div class="perk-item"><span class="perk-title">10,000 Arena Credits</span> · Allocated for marketplace acquisition & leveling</div>
              <div class="perk-item"><span class="perk-title">Founder Beast Badge</span> · Permanent insignia for your competitor profile</div>
              <div class="perk-item"><span class="perk-title">Closed Alpha Access</span> · Priority invitation to playtest PvP & auctions</div>
              <div class="voucher">Registration Voucher: <strong>${inserted.id}</strong></div>
            </div>
            
            <p>The arena is coming. Stay tuned.</p>
            <p style="margin-top: 25px; font-weight: bold; color: #FFFFFF;">– Team PET SLAM</p>
            
            <div class="footer">
              © ${new Date().getFullYear()} PET SLAM Gaming Ltd. All rights reserved.<br>
              Where animal ownership meets competitive esports gaming.
            </div>
          </div>
        </body>
        </html>
        `;

        const resendResponse = await fetch("https://api.resend.com/emails", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: {
            "Authorization": `Bearer ${resendApiKey}`,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
          },
          body: JSON.stringify({
            from: senderEmail,
            to: [email],
            subject: emailSubject,
            text: plainTextBody,
            html: htmlBody,
          }),
        });

        if (resendResponse.ok) {
          emailSent = true;
          emailStatusMessage = "Confirmation email dispatched via Resend";
          // Update DB delivery status
          await supabase
            .from("waitlist")
            .update({ email_delivery_status: "sent" })
            .eq("id", inserted.id);
        } else {
          const resendError = await resendResponse.text();
          console.warn("Resend API rejected request:", resendResponse.status, resendError);
          emailStatusMessage = `Resend returned HTTP ${resendResponse.status}. Signup safely retained in database.`;
          await supabase
            .from("waitlist")
            .update({ email_delivery_status: "failed", email_delivery_error: resendError })
            .eq("id", inserted.id);
        }
      } catch (err: any) {
        console.error("Network error connecting to Resend:", err);
        emailStatusMessage = "Network error connecting to Resend. Signup safely retained in database.";
        await supabase
          .from("waitlist")
          .update({ email_delivery_status: "failed", email_delivery_error: err?.message || "Unknown error" })
          .eq("id", inserted.id);
      }
    }

    // 8. Return response
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({
        success: true,
        message: "You're in. Welcome to PET SLAM.",
        entry: inserted,
        emailStatus: {
          sent: emailSent,
          message: emailStatusMessage,
        },
        perksAwarded: {
          credits: 10000,
          founderBadge: "Granted",
          alphaTesting: "Priority Invitation",
        },
      }),
      { status: 201, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("Edge function unhandled exception:", err);
    return new Response(
      JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: "An unexpected server error occurred." }),
      { status: 500, headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
    );
  }
});

</document_content>
</document>

<source>tests/combat.spec.ts</source>
<document_content>
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('PET SLAM Combat & Arena Validation', () => {
  test('boots application and verifies canvas renders without fatal console errors', async ({ page }) => {
    const consoleErrors: string[] = [];

    page.on('console', (msg) => {
      if (msg.type() === 'error') {
        const text = msg.text();
        // Ignore known harmless network/adblocker telemetry warnings
        if (!text.includes('clarity') && !text.includes('favicon')) {
          consoleErrors.push(text);
        }
      }
    });

    page.on('pageerror', (err) => {
      consoleErrors.push(err.message);
    });

    // 1. Navigate to PET SLAM
    await page.goto('/');

    // 2. Expect App title
    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(/PET SLAM/i);

    // 3. Verify main root container exists
    const root = page.locator('#root');
    await expect(root).toBeVisible();

    // 4. Verify Combat Canvas renders
    const canvas = page.locator('canvas').first();
    await expect(canvas).toBeVisible({ timeout: 10000 });

    // 5. Assert 0 fatal JavaScript console crashes
    expect(consoleErrors).toHaveLength(0);
  });
});

</document_content>
</document>
